title: Assistant Manager - FP&A
description:
**About Us**
1% Club is an education-led fintech platform that helps people make smarter decisions with their money.
  
  
Founded by Sharan Hegde and Raghav Gupta, 1% Club was built on a core belief: financial literacy is the first step to financial independence. That belief built India's most trusted personal finance education brand, and has since evolved into a fintech platform with an app that helps users invest, plan,and manage their money in one place, powered by AI.

**Headquarters**
: Mumbai, India
  
  
**Team Size**
: 200+
  
  
Backed by
**Gruhas**
(Nikhil Kamath)
  
  
**What We Do**
*Financial Education*
7L+ learners across personal finance, taxation, insurance, credit cards, and investing through live masterclasses and a subscription-based membership.
  
  
*Fintech Services*
The 1% Club app is built to replace the traditional bank RM with something smarter, faster, and always available. It combines an AI finance copilot with a curated set of financial products, including mutual fund baskets, fixed deposits, and stock baskets, with plans to solve for credit cards, taxation, insurance, and loans over time. For users who want deeper guidance, the app offers Personal CFO, a premium SEBI-registered advisory service for end-to-end financial planning. Insurance advisory is handled through Pillow, an independent vertical focused on transparent, long-term protection.
  
  
**Compliance & Governance**
*1% Club operates under:*
SEBI-registered Investment Advisor (RIA) license
  
  
SEBI-registered Research Analyst (RA) license
  
  
Trust is the foundation. Compliance is how we protect it.
  
  
**The Road Ahead**
Build the simplest, smartest way for Indians to manage their money, end to end, in one app. The modern replacement for your bank RM.
  
  
*Come build it with us.*
**Role Overview**
We're looking for a freshly qualified Chartered Accountant with articleship experience to join our Finance team as Sr. Associate - FP&A. You've spent three years in the trenches auditing, analysing, and building rigour into everything you touch. Now it's time to move to the other side of the table and actually build something. At 1% Club, you'll own financial planning, reporting, and business finance for a fast-scaling fintech — with direct exposure to leadership and real ownership from day one.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities (KRAs)**

* Accounts Reconciliation
* Perform periodic reconciliation of bank accounts, ledgers, and sub-ledgers to ensure alignment between internal records and external statements.
* Identify and resolve discrepancies or unposted entries in a timely manner, coordinating with relevant departments where needed.
* Maintain a reconciliation tracker in Excel/ERP, ensuring audit-readiness and version control at all times.
* Prepare monthly reconciliation reports highlighting outstanding items, aged entries, and resolution status for the Finance Manager.
* Bank Receivable and Payable
* Generate and track sales invoices, maintain an ageing report for receivables, and follow up on overdue accounts to ensure timely collections.
* Record incoming payments and reconcile them against invoices, ensuring all bank receipts are coded to the correct GL account and cost center.
* Process vendor payment requests after validating invoices and supporting documents, and reconcile bank statements with the payables ledger regularly.
* Coordinate with the bank for payment processing (NEFT/RTGS/IMPS) and flag any mismatches between bank debits and recorded liabilities.
* Vendor Payments
* Validate vendor invoices against purchase orders or contracts, checking for accuracy in amounts, GST details, PAN, and banking information before processing.
* Prepare a weekly payment schedule prioritized by due date and payment terms, and submit for Finance Manager approval before disbursement.
* Process approved payments via the company banking portal and maintain a vendor payment tracker with UTR references, invoice numbers, and reconciliation status.
* Coordinate TDS deductions on applicable vendor payments as per Income Tax provisions and ensure timely deposit with the government.
* Vendor Management
* Onboard new vendors by collecting and verifying all required documentation including GST certificate, PAN, bank details, and signed vendor agreement.
* Maintain a centralized vendor master database with complete KYC records, payment terms, and contract details, and track renewals or exits proactively.
* Conduct annual vendor reconciliation by sharing ledger statements, resolving differences, and obtaining signed balance confirmation letters.
* Closely coordinate with the HR department on vendor coordination for HR-related services, sheet maintenance, timely payments, and general administration.
* Invoice Management
* Generate accurate sales invoices for all B2B transactions ensuring correct GST computation (CGST/SGST/IGST) based on the nature and place of supply.
* Receive, register, and verify all purchase invoices for completeness — checking vendor name, GSTIN, invoice number, taxable value, and HSN/SAC code.
* Match purchase invoices against purchase orders before routing for approval, and maintain a monthly invoice register for both sales and purchase transactions.
* Ensure all invoices comply with GST regulations and coordinate with the external CA for timely GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B filings.
* Business Finance
* Support the preparation of annual budgets and quarterly forecasts by working closely with department heads to gather inputs and validate assumptions.
* Track actuals vs. budget on a monthly basis, prepare variance analysis reports, and highlight key deviations with commentary for management review.
* Assist in building financial models and scenario analyses to support business decisions around new initiatives, product launches, and cost optimization.
* Prepare monthly MIS reports and financial dashboards covering P&L, cash flow, and key business metrics to support leadership decision-making.

**Skills & Qualifications**

* Strong foundation in accounting standards, financial reporting, GST, TDS, and statutory compliance — built through hands-on Big 4 exposure.
* Proficiency in MS Excel (financial modelling, pivot tables, VLOOKUP) and comfort with ERP systems; Tally knowledge is a plus.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to translate numbers into clear, actionable business insights.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills — you're comfortable presenting to leadership, not just preparing for them.
* High ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to work independently in a fast-moving environment.

**Apply Now!!!**

title: Manager Strategy
description:
About Allen Career Institute

Allen Career Institute was founded on April 18, 1988, in Kota, Rajasthan, by Rajesh Maheshwari, who began by teaching eight students out of a small rented space. His brothers Govind, Naveen and Brajesh Maheshwari joined him over time, and the institute has been run as a family-led organisation since its founding. Allen was named in memory of the founders' father, Laxmi Narayan Maheshwari.

From its early years, Allen distinguished itself by offering coaching across Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics and Biology under one roof, rather than focusing on a single subject.

This model helped establish Kota as India's best-known hub for competitive exam coaching, and Allen grew alongside it into one of the country's largest test preparation institutions, known primarily for its IIT-JEE and NEET coaching programmes.

Allen has since expanded well beyond its original Kota campus, operating classroom centres across multiple cities in India and building out a digital learning arm, Allen Online, alongside brands such as Doubtnut and Allen Intelli Brain. The company has also attracted institutional investment, including backing from Bodhi Tree Systems, and continues to explore opportunities for expansion and business transformation.

It is this next phase, spanning organic expansion, digital growth and inorganic opportunities such as partnerships, investments, acquisitions and capital market initiatives, that the Strategy Team supports directly.

Role Overview

Allen Career Institute is looking for a high-calibre Manager – Strategy to drive and support high-impact strategic initiatives across organic and inorganic growth.

The role requires a professional with 4-8 years of experience, combining strong strategic thinking, financial acumen and execution capabilities, with hands-on exposure to M&A transactions and Capital markets.The individual will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams across strategy, finance, product, operations and business functions. The position will involve evaluating strategic opportunities, supporting investment and transaction-related decisions, developing financial models and translating complex business problems into actionable recommendations.

The ideal candidate should have a strong academic background, preferably from a Tier 1 undergraduate institution, and prior experience in investment banking, M&A, transaction advisory, corporate finance, strategy consulting or similar analytical and financial roles.

This is a high-ownership role offering direct exposure to senior leadership and the C-Suite, with the opportunity to contribute to Allen's long-term growth and strategic direction.

Key Responsibilities

● Hands-on capital markets experience (mandatory) – equity fundraising, public or private issuances, investor materials and financial disclosures, or SEBI-regulated transactions.

● Hands-on M&A experience – e.g., target evaluation, due diligence, valuation and deal execution.

● Drive strategic projects linked to business growth, market expansion, operating performance and inorganic growth opportunities.

● Conduct detailed market research, competitor benchmarking, sector analysis and opportunity assessments to identify potential growth avenues.

● Build and evaluate financial models, business models, valuation models, scenario analyses and investment business cases.

● Evaluate potential acquisitions, partnerships, investments and expansion opportunities from strategic and financial perspectives.

● Develop data-backed insights and strategic recommendations to support key business and leadership decisions.

● Prepare and present leadership presentations, investment notes, strategy decks, financial analyses and decision support materials.

● Work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional stakeholders across finance, product, operations and business teams to drive strategic initiatives.

● Track market trends, competitive activity, capital market developments and sector opportunities relevant to Allen's growth priorities.

● Take ownership of high-priority strategic initiatives, ensuring structured execution, stakeholder alignment and timely delivery.

● Support the C-Suite and senior strategy leadership on critical business decisions and long-term strategic planning.

Candidate Requirements

Must-Have Criteria

● 4–8 years of full-time work experience in a relevant strategic, financial, or consulting role.

● Hands-on experience in M&A as well as capital markets.

● Strong academic background, preferably from a Tier 1 undergraduate institution.

● Strong analytical, problem-solving and structured thinking abilities.

● Demonstrated proficiency in financial analysis, financial modelling, valuation and business case preparation.

● Experience evaluating investment opportunities, strategic transactions or business growth initiatives.

● Ability to work with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.

● Strong ownership mindset, execution orientation and bias for action.

● Excellent communication, presentation and business-writing skills.

Ideal Candidate Profiles

Candidates should ideally come from one of the following backgrounds:

●
**Investment Banking Professionals:**
3–5 years of experience in M&A, fundraising, capital markets, deal execution, valuation or transaction advisory.

●
**CA Professionals:**
Qualified Chartered Accountants with 3–5 years of relevant experience in Big 4 Deals, M&A, transaction advisory, corporate finance or capital markets.

●
**Strategy & Consulting Professionals:**
Professionals with 3–5 years of experience in strategy consulting or corporate strategy, with meaningful exposure to financial modelling, M&A and capital markets.

●
**Corporate Finance / M&A Professionals:**
Candidates with experience in corporate development, investment evaluation, acquisitions, fundraising, financial structuring or strategic transactions.

Additional Preferred Experience

● Prior experience working on end-to-end M&A transactions, including deal evaluation, due diligence, valuation and execution.

● Exposure to capital markets, fundraising, investor interactions or capital structuring.

● Experience in growth strategy, market entry, business transformation or investment evaluation.

● MBA from a top-tier institute is an added advantage but not mandatory.

● Experience working with senior leadership, promoters, founders or C-suite stakeholders.

Designation

● Experience: 4–8 years.

● Potential Designations: Manager – Strategy, AVP, Associate – Level 3 or equivalent, depending on the candidates current designation and organisational structure.

Role Highlights

● Direct exposure to the C-Suite and senior leadership.

● Opportunity to work on high-impact organic and inorganic growth initiatives.

● Involvement in M&A, capital markets and strategic investment decisions.

● High ownership and visibility across critical business initiatives.

● Opportunity to contribute to the strategic growth and expansion of one of India's leading education institutions.

title: Senior Associate / Manager - Delivery and Engagement: VCFO
description:
**Who are we looking for?**
Our VCFO clients don't experience Treelife through a pitch deck - they experience it through delivery. We're looking for the person who owns that experience: the plans, the deadlines, the team, and the client relationships behind them.
  
  
He will bring 6-8 years in a client-facing finance role, a strong audit background, and the calm that comes from having managed bigger books - high volume, multiple clients, tight deadlines - ideally with time at a Big 4 or large accounting firm. A qualified CA is preferred, but if the hands-on experience backs it up, we want to hear from you anyway.
  
  
You'll own delivery across the VCFO portfolio, lead the team behind it, and be the person clients know by name. This is an ownership role, not a follow-up role.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Client calls and relationships
* Get on client calls regularly - not just when something's on fire. You're the face of delivery for your portfolio.
* Build real working relationships with founders, finance heads and their teams, so trust exists before you ever need it.
* Use calls to understand the client's business rhythm, upcoming pressures and unstated expectations - and feed that back into the delivery plan.
* Run client status reviews and onboarding calls; leave every conversation with clear decisions, owners and dates.
* Own delivery and timelines
* Build and maintain a delivery plan per client: scope, recurring deliverables, owners, client inputs, review stages, TATs, due dates.
* Drive on-time delivery across monthly close, bookkeeping, MIS, financial reporting, tax/compliance handoffs, budgets and forecasts.
* Flag upcoming statutory dates to the subject-matter owner - a calendar reminder is not technical sign-off.
* Set priorities, allocate work, watch capacity and backlog, remove blockers before they put a commitment at risk.
* Nothing reaches a client unreviewed or incomplete; you close out corrections and open items.
* Lead the team
* Lead the delivery team day to day - build rapport, set the tone, and be the person they escalate to without hesitation.
* Allocate work fairly across the team, spot overload early, and coach juniors on quality and turnaround habits.
* Run short, regular internal reviews: what's on track, what's stuck, who needs help.
* Keep the team aligned with client promises - everyone knows what was committed and by when.
* Manage client expectations
* Agree realistic timelines and input requirements at kickoff; confirm any change in scope, priority or date with the client and internal lead.
* Raise risks early, with impact and a recovery plan - never announce a missed date after the fact.
* Own delivery queries and escalations end to end, coordinating across VCFO, accounting, tax and legal.
* Run delivery governance
* Maintain one live view of all commitments: status, overdue items, client dependencies, escalation owners.
* Track and improve the numbers: on-time delivery %, TAT adherence, rework, overdue aging, escalation resolution time.
* Lead new-client transitions into VCFO: agreed scope, owners, reporting cadence, contacts, first-delivery plan.

**Key Requirements**

* Strong audit background - mandatory.
* 6-8 years of experience in a similar field (VCFO services, CA/advisory firm, outsourced finance & accounting, or comparable client-facing finance delivery).
* Qualified CA preferred - but open to candidates with equivalent hands-on experience managing books at scale.
* Has personally managed high-volume books and multiple concurrent client engagements.
* Has led or managed a team - not just delivered individually.
* Strong phone/video presence; genuinely enjoys client conversations, not just tolerates them.
* Working command of accounting and reporting cycles, MIS, month-end close, and tax/compliance coordination.
* Clear, direct communication - comfortable delivering hard news early, with a plan.

**Why this role matters:**
Our clients feel Treelife through delivery. You are the person who makes "on time, every time" true.

title: Risk Model Validation, Officer (Hybrid)
description:
As a Risk Model Validation Officer, you will independently assess and challenge credit, market, and operational risk models to strengthen Citi's risk management framework. You will perform model validations, annual reviews, and ongoing monitoring for assigned model and product types, working closely with a Validation Lead to ensure models meet rigorous performance and governance standards. This role gives you direct influence over how Citi measures and manages financial risk across the organization.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Perform model validations, annual model reviews, and ongoing monitoring reviews for low and medium risk-rated models within your assigned product area.
* Challenge model development approaches and assumptions to confirm models meet Citi's model risk management standards.
* Track model limitation remediation progress and verify that corrective actions are properly implemented.
* Evaluate the ongoing performance of validated models to confirm they continue to perform as intended.
* Contribute analysis and documentation to support regulatory exams and internal audit reviews.
* Prepare validation reports and materials for review by senior model risk management stakeholders.
* Help shape validation standards, templates, and best-practice documentation used across the model validation function.
* Identify and escalate control issues with transparency to safeguard Citi's assets, clients, and reputation.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* You bring 4-7 years of relevant experience in risk, analytics, or a related quantitative field.
* You communicate findings clearly in written reports and verbal discussions.
* You apply strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills to complex risk questions.
* You document analysis and results with precision and attention to detail.
* You manage multiple priorities and deliver accurate results under tight deadlines.
* You use Python or similar programming languages to support model analysis and testing.
* You hold a Master's degree or equivalent experience in a quantitative discipline.

**Beneficial Skills & Qualifications**

* You have experience developing or validating risk measurement models.
* You have worked on credit risk analysis or early warning tools that monitor corporate or consumer risk.
* You apply knowledge of time series analysis, statistics, and econometrics to real-world data problems.
* You have interpreted data to identify inconsistencies and define clear business issues.

**What We Offer**
Join a model validation function that shapes how one of the world's largest financial institutions identifies and manages risk. In this role, your analysis directly informs governance decisions that protect Citi and its clients.
  
  

* Work in a hybrid arrangement with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely.
* Build deep technical expertise in model validation across credit, market, and operational risk.
* Collaborate with risk teams across a global organization, expanding your professional network.
* Access ongoing learning and development opportunities to grow your analytics and risk management career.
* Benefit from financial wellbeing programs and resources that support your long-term goals.

Apply today to help safeguard Citi's financial stability through rigorous, independent model validation.

**Deputy Manger / Manager – Finance & Accounting (Taxation)**
This role focuses on tax reporting, compliance, provisioning, and reconciliations, while supporting transfer pricing and financial reporting activities. It also requires strong stakeholder management, collaboration with global teams, and the ability to handle multiple deadlines in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate should be a qualified CA (or equivalent) with solid experience in taxation, accounting principles, data analysis, and communication.
  
  
**What Can You Expect**
**Tax Reporting and Tax Returns:**

* Support the preparation, review, and filing of annual tax returns in compliance with local statutory and tax regulatory requirements.
* Support transfer pricing activities, including data gathering, analysis, and documentation.
* Contribute to the preparation and filing of group tax returns, as applicable.
* Ensure accurate tax computations through a strong conceptual understanding of tax principles and methodologies.

**Closing The Books**

* Manage the quarterly and year-end tax provision processes in close coordination with Tax and Reporting stakeholders.
* Prepare tax calculation workpapers and related adjustments for statutory financial statements.
* Apply working knowledge of tax-related accounting standards, such as IAS 12 – Income Taxes, to tax accounting and financial reporting activities.

**Reviews, Reconciliations And Project Support**

* Prepare and review return-to-provision calculations, analyzing variances between estimated and actual tax liabilities.
* Apply foundational accounting knowledge to support tax reconciliations, reporting, and close processes.
* Perform tax reconciliations between the books of account and tax authority records.
* Support tax-related or other relevant projects.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Constant engagement with LEC & the team on updating and monitoring status of above activities
* Collaborate effectively with internal teams and Controllership to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant tax reporting and filing.
* Actively participate in regular meetings on operational and tactical discussions as required

**What You Need To Have**

* Qualified CA (or equivalent accounting qualification) with either 5+ years of post-qualification experience
* Should be comfortable to work in 5:30am-2:30pm shift
* Expertise in interpreting taxation laws, accounting principles GAAP, and practices
* Experience working with senior stakeholders, global teams and cultures.
* Proficient in data analysis, summarising and presenting themes and results in a meaningful format.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills
* Strong organisational skills, including the ability to coordinate, prioritize and manage multiple activities.
* Have the flexibility required to work in a dynamic environment under stringent deadlines.

* Prior experience in a similar tax reporting profile will be an advantage

title: Investment Banking Analyst
description:
About Capital Connect Advisors

Capital Connect Advisors (CCA) is an Asia-focused boutique investment bank working with category-leading companies, institutional investors and family offices. With teams in Singapore, New Delhi and Mumbai, we advise on private capital raises, M&A, secondaries and strategic transactions across India and Southeast Asia, connecting clients with investors and strategic partners globally.

Our focus is on technology and new business models across financial services, healthcare, media, consumer, commerce, manufacturing and mobility. We combine sector understanding and trusted relationships with disciplined transaction execution.

The role

We are hiring Analysts in Mumbai to support fundraising and M&A execution across India and Southeast Asia. Strong fresh graduates and experienced Analysts are welcome. You will work closely with Associates and Partners, build a grounding in investment banking and contribute to live transactions from research and preparation through diligence and closing. The role involves demanding timelines and occasional travel to client locations.

What you will do

* Build and update financial models, including integrated financial statements, forecasts, cash flows and valuation analyses. Check assumptions, reconcile source data and explain the drivers behind the numbers.
* Research sectors, companies and business models; assess market size, competitive positioning and relevant transactions. Turn findings into clear, sourced insights for deal teams and clients.
* Prepare pitch decks, information memoranda, management presentations and other transaction materials, with careful attention to the investment narrative, numbers and presentation quality.
* Map relevant investors and strategic acquirers, maintain accurate coverage records and support targeted outreach and meeting preparation.
* Attend client, investor and management meetings with the deal team; take accurate notes and drive agreed follow-ups.
* Support data-room preparation, diligence trackers, investor Q&A and transaction coordination. Keep requests, owners and deadlines current, and flag gaps promptly.
* Improve repeatable research and execution workflows using Excel, research tools and approved AI tools. Verify outputs against reliable sources and protect client confidentiality.

What you will bring

Typically 0–3 years of relevant experience. Fresh graduates can demonstrate readiness through internships, financial modelling, research or substantial academic and independent projects; prior full-time employment is not required. Experienced applicants should show the contribution they have made to analysis or transaction execution. Ability and quality of work matter more than an institution's name.

* Strong foundations in accounting, corporate finance and valuation, with the ability to analyse a business and connect its operating drivers to financial performance.
* Practical Excel and PowerPoint skills, strong quantitative reasoning and meticulous attention to detail. You should be able to explain your work and check it independently.
* Clear business writing, thoughtful research and confident communication. You can organise incomplete information, ask useful questions and respond constructively to feedback.
* Ownership and reliability under tight deadlines: prioritise tasks, communicate progress and raise problems early.
* Interest in technology, entrepreneurship and the markets of India and Southeast Asia. Curiosity about how companies grow, raise capital and create value.

Relevant internships or experience in investment banking, corporate finance, investing, consulting or a technology business are useful. Familiarity with financial research databases (such as Capital IQ, PitchBook, Tracxn or Venture Intelligence) is a plus. A CA, CFA (any level) or finance-focused postgraduate qualification is welcome but not required.

How we work

We care about the businesses and people behind every transaction. We value curiosity, initiative and thoughtful challenge, backed by accurate work and reliable follow-through. Take ownership, ask for help early, protect confidential information and treat clients and colleagues with respect. We work closely across offices and expect everyone to contribute to the team's learning.

What we offer

Direct exposure to live mandates and to the Partners from day one, a steep learning curve across sectors and transaction types, and responsibility that grows as quickly as you demonstrate it. Competitive compensation with a performance-linked component.

How to apply

Email your CV to hr@capconnect.asia with the subject “Analyst | Mumbai | Your name”. Confirm your availability to work in Mumbai, your notice period or earliest joining date, and your current and expected compensation. Briefly describe one relevant project or transaction and your contribution; a non-confidential work sample is welcome. Fresh graduates may use an internship or academic project.

Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

CCA is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from all backgrounds.

**Finance & Accounts Manager**

**Malsons Ventures | Mumbai**

**Malsons Ventures is a media and entertainment company based in Mumbai. We’re looking for a hands-on Finance & Accounts Associate to take ownership of our day-to-day finance function and keep our accounts, payments and compliance running smoothly.**

**The role**

**You will be the sole in-house person responsible for finance and accounts, working closely with our external CA and consultants. The role calls for someone who is comfortable managing the details independently, staying ahead of deadlines and maintaining a clear picture of the company’s finances.**

**What you’ll do**

* Maintain accurate, up-to-date books of accounts in Tally Prime, including project-wise cost tracking where required.

* A B.Com or M.Com graduate with at least 6 years of hands-on accounting experience.
* Experience in media, entertainment or advertising is preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of Tally Prime and Excel.
* Experience with bulk payment uploads on corporate net banking.
* Someone organised and detail-oriented, who is comfortable taking ownership as the sole in-house finance person.

**What success looks like**

* **Accurate books and reconciliations:**
  Accounts are current in Tally, bank accounts are reconciled daily, and discrepancies are identified and followed through promptly.
* **Cash visibility:**
  A weekly cash flow forecast gives management a clear view of balances, expected collections, upcoming payments and any anticipated shortfalls.
* **Payments and payroll:**
  Payment batches and payroll are prepared accurately and on time, with the right supporting documents and approvals in place.
* **Receivables and payables:**
  Invoices are raised promptly, overdue collections are followed up, and management has visibility on outstanding client and vendor balances.
* **Project-level visibility:**
  Income and costs are tracked by project where required, so the business can understand what each project is earning and spending.
* **Compliance and reporting:**
  Filing and audit deadlines are tracked with external consultants, and a clear monthly MIS is prepared for management.
* **Open items are closed:**
  Queries, unreconciled balances and outstanding finance tasks are tracked through to resolution, with risks escalated early.

Full-time, on-site

title: Vice President - Treasury Liquidity Controllers
description:
**Job Description**
You are a strategic leader passionate about driving solutions across Treasury, Liquidity Risk, and the Investment Bank balance sheet. You have found the right team.
  
  
As a Liquidity Vice President in our Finance organization, you will lead a team responsible for critical internal and regulatory liquidity risk reporting for the Commercial & Investment Bank under Treasury Function, with a primary focus on EMEA (and strong connectivity to US liquidity frameworks). You will apply deep understanding of Investment Banking & Prime Brokerage products and Balance sheet dynamics—spanning Trading and Banking books, securities, secured financing, derivatives, wholesale products, and off-balance sheet items—to deliver accurate reporting, high-quality governance, and meaningful management insights.
  
  
This role requires strong people leadership, stakeholder management, and an ability to translate complex balance sheet movements into clear narratives for senior management, Treasury, Controllers, and Liquidity Risk Oversight partners.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead and develop a team: Responsible for producing and leading high-quality liquidity risk reporting team across daily/weekly/monthly/quarterly cycles, ensuring strong controls, reviews, documentation, and timely delivery.
* Own key liquidity Regulatory and Internal reporting deliverables: Including (as applicable by jurisdiction and governance) FR 2052a, LCR, NSFR, RLAP / liquidity stress testing, STWF and CCAR-related liquidity reporting and analysis.
* Drive variance analytics and storyboarding: Identify key drivers of period-over-period movements, explain balance sheet and liquidity impacts, and deliver crisp variance commentary for senior and regional stakeholders.
* Provide EMEA-focused liquidity expertise: While maintaining strong alignment to global (including US) liquidity risk frameworks, methodologies, assumptions, and regulatory expectations.
* Apply deep product and balance sheet knowledge (secured financing, derivatives, prime/wholesale products, securities, commitments, deposits, and other on/off-balance sheet exposures) to assess liquidity impacts and support business decisions.
* Partner with Treasury, LoB Controllers, Liquidity Risk Oversight, and global teams (e.g., FALMA, CTMO and other stakeholder groups) to ensure consistent data, methodology alignment, and escalation of issues/risks.
* Strengthen the control environment by ensuring robust reconciliations, issue management, change governance, data lineage awareness, and audit/regulatory readiness for all owned reports and processes.
* Lead process improvement and transformation initiatives, including standardization, automation, and operational risk reduction across liquidity reporting, analytics, and management information.
* Support senior management communications by preparing liquidity metrics packages, executive-ready dashboards, and briefing materials for CIB Treasury and business leadership.

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Master's degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Significant experience (typically 12+ years) in Treasury, Liquidity Risk, Balance Sheet Management, Product Control / Controllers, or Regulatory Reporting within a large bank
* Deep understanding of the Investment Bank Balance sheet & and its Line of Businesses
* Demonstrated hands-on experience with liquidity reporting and frameworks, including a strong working knowledge of LCR, NSFR, liquidity stress testing / RLAP, and familiarity with FR 2052a, STWF and CCAR liquidity reporting concepts and requirements.
* Proven people leadership skills: ability to coach, develop talent, set clear goals, manage performance, and build an inclusive and accountable team culture.
* Strong analytical capability with comfort working with large datasets; ability to identify root causes, quantify impacts, and translate technical detail into executive-level insights.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present clearly to senior stakeholders and challenge appropriately when needed.
* Strong organizational skills and ownership mindset; ability to manage competing priorities in a time-sensitive, control-focused environment.

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Investment bank experience strongly preferred
* Prior experience supporting EMEA liquidity regulatory expectations and governance, with strong connectivity to US liquidity standards and reporting practices.
* Experience driving automation and data transformation (e.g., Alteryx, Tableau, Python, SQL or similar tooling), including controls-conscious implementation.
* Familiarity with end-to-end reporting operating models (data sourcing, controls, reconciliations, change management, and documentation), and strong audit/regulatory interaction readiness.
* Ability to operate effectively across global teams and time zones, influencing stakeholders without direct reporting lines.

**ABOUT US**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Corporations, governments and institutions throughout the world entrust us with their business in more than 100 countries. The Commercial & Investment Bank provides strategic advice, raises capital, manages risk and extends liquidity in markets around the world.

title: Unit Head
description:
Unit Head – Credit Line on UPI
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Unit Head will own the end-to-end business performance of the Credit Line on UPI (CLoU) portfolio. This includes growth strategy, acquisition funnels, partner ecosystem management, monetisation, unit economics, and lifecycle optimization.
  
  
The role is deeply P&L-oriented, requiring strong cross-functional collaboration with product, risk, operations, finance, and partner-bank teams to drive scalable and sustainable business outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Business Growth & Strategy
* Own overall business performance for Credit Line on UPI—including lines created, active users, activation %, throughput, and revenue generation.
* Craft the go-to-market (GTM) strategy across target customer segments (merchant & consumer), use cases, and distribution channels.
* Develop and execute strategies to grow P2M adoption, repeat usage, frequency, and wallet share.
* Evaluate market trends, competitive landscape, and regulatory context to shape business priorities.
* Ensure predictable, controllable growth aligned with portfolio health and partner expectations.
* Partner & Ecosystem Management
* Manage relationships with partner LSPs, PSPs, TPAPs, distribution partners, and ecosystem players.
* Drive partner onboarding, integration planning, scale-up, and ongoing performance management.
* Align incentives, revenue models, and commercial structures to optimise partner throughput and profitability.
* Lead governance forums with partners—reviewing business volumes, operational issues, funnel leakages, risk metrics, and revenue outcomes.
* Ensure stable and high-performing partnerships that enable predictable business scaling.
* Acquisition & Post-Acquisition Ownership
* Work with growth, marketing, product, and channel partners to optimise acquisition funnels end-to-end.
* Identify drop-off points across onboarding, activation, and early-usage stages; drive initiatives to improve activation and engagement.
* Own lifecycle interventions post-acquisition—nudges, journeys, campaigns, and partner-led programs to improve usage and repeat transactions.
* Drive funnel improvements that translate into higher active base, improved retention, and stronger unit economics.

* Own all monetisation levers including interchange, MDR, interest income, late fees, and partner-linked revenue streams.

* Use analytics to forecast performance, optimise growth levers, and improve portfolio profitability.

title: Group Finance Manager (India)
description:
Group Finance Manager (India-based — UK and India Operations)

The Washing Machine Project — India

Full-time

Life at The Washing Machine Project - Meaningful work. Exceptional people.

**About us**

Handwashing clothes may sound like a simple task, but it poses a significant obstacle to the wellbeing and livelihood of many women worldwide. We recognise that unpaid labour is compromising lives. This needs to change.

We’re The Washing Machine Project (TWMP). Our mission is to empower women to take charge of their lives by providing displaced and low-income communities with accessible, off-grid washing solutions. We create resourceful products and solutions.

Founded by Navjot Sawhney in 2018, TWMP develops extraordinary innovations designed to improve women’s lives. People are at the heart of everything we do, and listening to communities is integral to our work and design process. At TWMP, you’ll be surrounded by people who want to improve everything and everyone around them, who are passionate about our mission, driven to solve problems, and committed to doing work that matters.

**About the role**

The India-based Finance Manager plays a critical role within The Washing Machine Project. Based in India, you will own UK and India financial reporting, budgets, cash planning, donor allocations and financial controls, while working closely with our manufacturing and operations colleagues. You will coordinate UK and India external accountants and payroll providers, maintain reliable consolidated information and support the Founder and budget holders across both countries.

You will bring substantial finance experience, normally gained over five to eight years, including at least two years independently owning a finance function with a monthly reporting cycle. You will hold a recognised accounting qualification, such as CA (ICAI), CMA (ICMAI), ACCA or CIMA, or demonstrate equivalent experience. You must have practical experience preparing reports for UK or international entities, coordinating consolidation and maintaining local accounting controls. Manufacturing, project-funded or social enterprise experience is desirable.

We're looking for someone who is comfortable working in a dynamic, entrepreneurial start-up environment. You'll need to balance strategic financial oversight with hands-on delivery, take ownership of priorities and help develop the systems and processes that will support our continued growth.

**Your responsibilities:**

* Financial Planning and Analysis:
* Develop and implement financial strategies, budgets, and forecasts aligned with the organisation's mission and objectives.
* Conduct financial analysis and provide insights on financial performance, trends, and opportunities for improvement.
* Collaborate with the management team to assess and prioritise financial resources for various projects and initiatives.
* Financial Reporting:
* Prepare accurate and timely UK and India management accounts and consolidated reporting, including reconciliations, accruals and prepayments, for internal and external stakeholders.
* Coordinate year-end accounts and financial filing inputs with UK and India external accountants, ensuring adherence to applicable accounting standards and reporting requirements.
* Provide clear and concise financial information to the management team, board of directors, and funders to support decision-making processes.
* Budgeting and Cash Flow Management:
* Lead the annual budgeting process, working closely with department heads and the executive team to establish realistic financial targets and monitor progress.
* Create short-term and longer-term cash forecasts for both projects and organisations, coordinating funding and working-capital requirements across UK and India operations.
* Identify and mitigate financial risks and implement appropriate controls and procedures.
* Financial Operations:
* Manage day-to-day financial operations, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, payroll, supplier and expense management, with appropriate separation between preparation and approval.
* Coordinate India banking, payroll and financial reporting with local providers, and work with UK advisers on UK payroll, year-end and statutory-account inputs.
* Review and improve financial processes and systems; document recurring tasks, assumptions and deadlines, and establish cover arrangements for essential and planned activities.
* Grant and Contract Management:
* Support the development and submission of grant proposals and funding applications, ensuring compliance with funder requirements.
* Monitor and report on grants and contracts, including restricted funding, partner allocations, reporting periods, carry-forward balances and cash and in-kind contributions, with supporting documentation and clear reporting deadlines.
* Work closely with India manufacturing, procurement and programme colleagues to develop reliable machine costing, purchasing and inventory information, while maintaining linked partner budgets and deployment assumptions.
* Compliance and Internal Controls:
* Establish and maintain strong internal controls and financial procedures to safeguard the organisation's assets and ensure compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
* Coordinate external audits and ensure timely completion of audit processes.
* Stay up-to-date with changes in accounting standards and best practices, and implement necessary updates as appropriate.

Why is this role important? At TWMP, you’re not a tiny cog in a big wheel. You're the wheel, and we’re in it together. Your work will impact people's lives.

**Who are we looking for**

TWMP are looking for passionate people keen to work in the humanitarian sector and positively impact people’s lives. You would be part of a collaborative, international team. You will need to work with initiative and momentum whilst maintaining a sensitivity to the various and diverse contexts your work will involve.

**Essential:**

* A recognised professional accounting qualification (e.g., CA (ICAI), CMA (ICMAI), ACCA or CIMA), or substantial equivalent experience demonstrated in comparable roles.
* Proven experience independently owning management accounts, reconciliations, budgets and cash forecasts, with experience managing project or donor-funded budgets. Nonprofit or social enterprise experience is desirable.
* Strong knowledge of Indian accounting and finance processes, practical UK or international reporting experience, and the ability to coordinate UK specialist support, intercompany reconciliations and consolidated accounts.
* Proficiency in accounting systems and advanced spreadsheets, including linked budget models, with strong attention to accuracy, documentation and version control.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
* Strong attention to detail and accuracy.
* Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate financial information effectively across international teams.
* Excellent team working, collaboration and networking skills
* Effectively work across multi-disciplinary teams with multiple decision-makers.
* Comfortable with a rapidly changing set of priorities.
* Practical verbal and written communication skills with the ability to tailor communication style based on the audience.
* Ability to thrive in high growth, entrepreneurial, and ambiguous environments.
* Demonstrated creativity with effective communication skills to bring big ideas to a broad audience.
* Confident, highly organised and motivated.
* Commitment to and respect for TWMP’s values.

**Other Requirements**

* Must be able to travel to agreed India manufacturing and operations locations, with occasional UK travel by agreement, and maintain an agreed daily overlap with UK colleagues.
* Must have the right to work in India.

**Location**

India-based (remote/hybrid working), preferably accessible to Pune or Mumbai; exact location and regular UK-hours overlap to be agreed.

**What you'll get**

We offer a genuinely purpose-led career with a culture built on trust, autonomy and flexibility. We’re an ambitious, growing organisation, and this role is a rare opportunity to help shape TWMP’s global presence and impact.

You will have the opportunity to build practical systems, strengthen supplier and partner relationships, support responsible growth, and contribute directly to products and services that improve the lives of women and communities.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at TWMP. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability status.

This advert is intended to convey information essential to understanding the scope of the role, the general nature, and the level of work performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities or working conditions associated with the role.

**To apply**

Please complete the online form to express your interest. Attach your up-to-date CV in PDF format and a cover letter clearly demonstrating your fit for this role and your motivation to work at TWMP.

If you need any support or adjustments in the application process, please contact jo@thewashingmachineproject.org.

Closing date: 23 November 2026

**What you can expect after you've applied**

Our selection process typically looks like this:

* Submit your CV, cover letter and answer a few questions.
* You will receive an email with a link to the application form if you fit the initial criteria.
* Complete the application form so that we can learn more about your relevant experience and motivation for this role.
* 20–30 minute video call with one of our team.
* 60–75 minute competency-based interview with the hiring team. You may also complete a task or presentation.
* For some positions, an additional interview with senior leadership and profiling.

*Please note: We kindly request no contact from recruitment agencies or third-party recruiters.*

title: R29560 - Finance Executive - MIS, Compliance & Commercial Controls
description:
**Role Objective:**

The Finance Executive will be responsible for preparing and maintaining Finance MIS, monitoring commercial transactions, and conducting regular checks related to dealer’s incentives, discounts, schemes, and other financial/commercial data. The role will ensure accuracy of financial information, identify discrepancies, and provide timely reports to management for decision-making. Apart from above person will perform the other duties as well based on in the department.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Perform checks and validations of sales, discounts, incentives, schemes, and other commercial transactions.
2. Verify incentive calculations and ensure payouts are as per approved policies and targets.
3. Review discounts and schemes to ensure they are within approved limits and properly authorized.
4. Identify data discrepancies, unusual transactions, errors, or financial leakages and coordinate with concerned teams for correction.
5. Maintain various MIS trackers for dealer, incentives, discounts, collections, outstanding, margins, and other key financial parameters.
6. Provide accurate and timely MIS to management for business and financial decision-making.
7. Maintain proper records and supporting documents for all MIS and control checks.
8. Coordinate with Sales and Accounts teams to resolve data-related and commercial discrepancies.
9. Monitor and ensure adherence to statutory compliances, including GST, TDS, Companies Act, and other applicable regulatory requirements.
10. Process Credit Notes and Debit Notes in the system related to incentives and other transactions.
11. Provide support to the Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable teams as and when required.
12. Assist in improving existing MIS formats, reporting systems, and internal financial controls.
13. Perform any other financial analysis or MIS-related work assigned by management.

**Key Skills & Criteria:**

1. 2–5 years of experience in Finance MIS / Commercial Finance / Management Reporting.
2. Strong Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, data analysis, and reporting.
3. Good understanding of sales data, discounts, incentives, schemes, and financial transactions.
4. Strong analytical and numerical skills.
5. High attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies.
6. Candidate should be comfortable working with large volumes of data and recurring MIS/reporting requirements.

In short, the ideal candidate should be more of a Finance MIS, Compliance & Commercial Finance person who can analyse numbers, prepare reports, and independently check incentives, discounts and other commercial transactions.

**About us:**

Headquartered in Denmark, GN Hearing is among the leading manufacturers of hearing aids in the world. The company offers a full range of instruments and accessories under several brands. The company has subsidiaries in more than 25 countries and distributors in 80 more. Driven by technological innovations and commercial excellence, GN Hearing has been the growing faster than the industry for the last many years.

In India, the hearing aid industry at wholesale prices is approximately INR 750 crores annually. Private retail consumption accounts for over 85% of the hearing aid market in revenue terms with the balance coming from government tenders. The market is growing @10~12% p.a. and likely to grow at these rates for the next decade due to very favorable demographics viz.

• 90% of hearing aid users are in the 50+ group.

• They are living longer due to healthier lifestyles.

• Leading a more active retired life and would like to enjoy life with friends and family.

• Have the money to fund hearing aids.

In the hearing-impaired population, the hearing aid penetration level is only 2%. In developed countries the penetration is in the 20~40% levels.

In India, GN is headquartered in Navi Mumbai. In 2023, GN posted revenues of INR 131 cr (USD 16 mln). GN has been the fastest growing company since 2012 growing revenues @ 18% CAGR. GN is now the 2nd largest company in the lucrative retail market with a 20% market share, up from 5% market share in 2011. GN is the most profitable company in the industry with the highest % EBITA margin. Leadership in technology, a clear India strategy and strong execution have been the drivers of this performance.

Given the strong momentum, GN has an opportunity to drive growth higher than the current already high rate. GN has put in place aggressive plans for the 2023~2025 strategy period. The strategy involves executing on multiple key sales initiatives in parallel with speed and accuracy. GN operates through a direct dealer network of about 700 customers. The larger key customers account for a disproportionate share of the industry potential and consequently GNs business.

Hearing aids are dispensed as a medical device and the dealer (dispenser) makes the brand choice. Among other things, fast, accurate and at times customized service solutions to these larger customers are important to succeed with them. The customized solutions tend to put a strain on operations increasing complexity. The relatively small size of the business is deceptive when compared to the complexity of the challenges involved.

Finance and Capital Reporting (FCR) is a key component of the Finance Department, which has an excellent reputation within the bank and externally. title: Manager - Finance
description:
Nium, the Leader in Real-Time Global Payments
  
  
Nium, the leading global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments, was founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. With the onset of the global economy, its payments infrastructure is shaping how banks, fintechs, and businesses everywhere collect, convert, and disburse funds instantly across borders. Its payout network supports 100 currencies and spans 190+ countries, 100 of which in real-time. Funds can be disbursed to accounts, wallets, and cards and collected locally in 40 markets. Nium's growing card issuance business is already available in 34 countries. Nium holds regulatory licenses and authorizations in more than 40 countries, enabling seamless onboarding, rapid integration, and compliance – independent of geography. The company is co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore.
  
  
**About the Role:**
The Manager, Accounts Payable is a middle management role within Nium's centralized Finance function in Mumbai. Operating as the hub for a globally distributed AP function, this role owns a broad mandate that spans vendor payments, multi-country payroll disbursements, statutory and
  
  
indirect tax compliance across jurisdictions, cashflow reporting, ledger reconciliations, and expense analytics — all executed centrally for 15 countries from Mumbai.
  
  
The ideal candidate is a finance professional with proven experience managing multi-country AP or finance operations — someone who can navigate diverse regulatory environments, work effectively with local finance and HR teams across geographies, and drive month-end close and audit readiness to global standards.
  
  
**About the team:**
The team manages vendor invoice processing, payroll disbursements, statutory obligations, indirect tax filings, and audit readiness, while consolidating cashflow and reconciliation across all subsidiaries and also leverages ERP platforms (NetSuite Oracle), payroll systems, expense management tools, and procurement platforms.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead end-to-end processing of vendor invoices, approval workflows, and payment disbursements across all group entities in 15 countries
* Ensure accurate AP ledgers across all subsidiaries and ensure timely settlement of vendor obligations globally
* Coordinate payroll payouts across all applicable entities and countries in close collaboration with local HR Operations and regional HR teams
* Review and deliver monthly employee cost analysis and reporting by country, entity, department, and cost Centre
* Ensure timely withholding tax (WHT) computations and payments across applicable countries; reconcile tax challans/remittances with the general ledger and coordinate with local tax advisors where required
* Handle GST, VAT, and indirect tax payments across all applicable jurisdictions; manage input tax credit reconciliation and ensure accuracy of periodic indirect tax returns filed in each country
* Ensure accurate monthly cashflow statements consolidating AP, payroll, statutory, and operational outflows across all 15 subsidiaries
* Own month-end reconciliation of all AP-related ledgers across every subsidiary — including vendor payables, accrued liabilities, prepaid expenses, advances to employees, advances to vendors, and bank reconciliations in all operating currencies
* Act as the primary owner for audit queries related to AP, payroll, indirect taxes, statutory payments, prepaid expenses, and advances -for both statutory audits at entity level and group-level internal audits across all 15 countries

**Requirements :**

* 6–9 years of progressive responsibility in Accounts Payable, Finance Operations, or Controllership roles, with Chartered Accountant (CA) qualification Mandatory
* Proven expertise in payroll accounting, statutory compliance, and indirect tax processes across multiple jurisdictions
* Strong command of ERP systems (e.g., NetSuite Oracle), including AP modules, payroll reconciliation, and multi-entity general ledger management
* Solid understanding of indirect taxes (GST, VAT, Sales Tax) and withholding tax, with exposure to APAC, EMEA, or Americas jurisdictions preferred
* Familiarity with statutory payroll obligations (social security, pension, employment levies) across regions, along with experience in payroll tools, expense management platforms, and procurement systems
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple workstreams under strict close deadlines with a strong sense of accountability
* Excellent problem-solving and analytical capabilities, coupled with meticulous attention to detail

title: Right Shore, Revenue Planning Analyst
description:
**Right Shore Revenue Planning Analyst**
Full Time | Hybrid
  
  
Location: Airoli, Navi Mumbai, India | Pune, Maharashtra, India
  
  
Team: Right Shore Sales Operations
  
  
Reports to: Right Shore Sales Operations Team Leader
  
  
Dotted line to: Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy
  
  
**Our Company**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As Right Shore Revenue Planning Analyst, you are the dedicated data owner for Teradata’s revenue planning process. You sit within the Right Shore Sales Operations team and work day to day with the Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy to run the data engine behind the annual planning cycle and the year-round change process that keeps the plan accurate.
  
  
This is a data management and processing role. You build and manage the planning templates, consolidate and reconcile submissions from across the business units, keep account and assignment data clean, and take real ownership of the final business build files that hand off into Salesforce, downstream tools and IT processes. You are the last set of eyes before planning data leaves the process — accuracy is the job.
  
  
The planning calendar moves, priorities shift, and questions arrive without warning. This role suits someone who adapts quickly, can go deep into the detail of the planning process when something does not reconcile, and takes personal pride in a clean file.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Own the final business build files: Assemble, validate and own the definitive build files for territory, account assignment, headcount and quota that feed Salesforce, downstream tools and IT processes. Run the pre-handoff checks, resolve exceptions, and sign off on what goes out.
* Build and manage planning templates: Develop, version, distribute and support the planning templates used by business unit teams; track submissions, chase gaps, and consolidate returns into a single reconciled dataset.
* Maintain account data quality: Keep account data accurate and audit-ready — account hierarchy, duplicate records, ARR category changes, ownership and assignment accuracy — through scheduled audits, exception reports and remediation.
* Process territory and assignment changes: Process and validate territory, account and people assignments in Salesforce, including Enterprise Territory Management and hierarchy changes, ensuring every change is traceable and correctly reflected.
* Support the annual revenue planning cycle: Work to the calendar and cadence set by the Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy — preparing datasets, running the consolidation, and turning around iterations at pace during planning crunch.
* Maintain headcount, coverage and quota datasets: Keep the planning datasets current and reconciled across planning, Salesforce and Finance views, and maintain the change history behind them.
* Process in-year change requests: Handle mid-year changes to territories, account assignments and quotas — validating the request, applying the change, and keeping the audit trail intact.
* Produce planning status and exception reporting: Deliver recurring completeness, status and data-quality reporting so the Manager and business unit teams always know where the cycle stands and what needs attention.
* Go deep when required: Trace a number back to source, unpick a discrepancy across systems, or rebuild a broken file under time pressure — and explain clearly what went wrong and what you changed.
* Document the work: Maintain data definitions, file specifications, run instructions and change logs so the process is repeatable and does not depend on one person’s memory.

**Who You'll Work With**

* Manager, Revenue Planning Programs & Strategy — your day-to-day business partner and dotted-line manager
* Right Shore Sales Operations Team Leader — your direct manager
* UNIT Sales Operations Managers (SOMs) and business unit teams
* Revenue Operations, IT and Salesforce delivery teams
* FP&A and People/HR planning partners

**Minimum Requirements**

* 3–5 years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, sales planning, or a data management role supporting a sales organization.
* Advanced Excel is essential — complex interconnected workbooks, pivot tables, XLOOKUP/VLOOKUP, nested formulas, template design, data consolidation and validation across large datasets.
* Proficiency in Salesforce. com, including territory and account hierarchy management, assignment processing, data quality management, and running and interrogating reports.
* Exceptional attention to detail, with the discipline to check your own work and the instinct to notice when a number looks wrong.
* Demonstrated ownership of a data deliverable end to end — not just producing it, but being accountable for its accuracy downstream.
* Ability to work to a fixed planning calendar and absorb shifting priorities without losing the thread.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English, with the confidence to flag a problem early and ask the question that unblocks the work.
* Comfort collaborating across time zones with US and EMEA stakeholders.
* Bachelor’s degree in business or a related field (finance, statistics, analytics, reporting).

**What You'll Bring**

* Ownership of the Build File: You treat the final build file as yours. You know what depends on it, you check it before anyone else has to, and you do not hand over work you are not confident in.
* Adaptability: Planning priorities change quickly. You re-sequence, absorb new requirements, and keep moving without needing the plan re-explained.
* Depth on Demand: You can drop into the mechanics of the planning process when something does not reconcile, and follow the data until you find the cause.
* Data Quality Instinct: A low tolerance for dirty data, and the habits — reconciliation, validation, exception reporting — that keep it clean rather than fixing it after the fact.
* Process Discipline: You follow the standard, document what you do, and leave the process better than you found it.
* Practical AI fluency: Comfort using a leading AI assistant (Claude preferred; ChatGPT or Gemini also relevant) to speed up data preparation, reconciliation, documentation and repetitive processing work — with the judgement to verify the output.
* Power BI experience or certification would be an added advantage.
* Familiarity with sales planning or incentive compensation platforms (Anaplan, Lative, Xactly, Varicent or equivalent) would be an added advantage.

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

**Institutional Negotiation:**
Sharp commercial acumen with a proven ability to negotiate complex loan covenants, pricing scales, and security structures with C-suite executives.

**Role:**
FRM Manager

**Job Title:**
Assistant Vice President

**Department:**
Risk Management

**Education:**
Post Graduate

**Work Location:**
Goregaon (East), Mumbai

**Role Purpose**

To lead and strengthen the Financial Risk Management framework of the Company by overseeing Asset Liability Management (ALM), Capital and Solvency Management, Liquidity Risk, Investment Risk, and Insurance Risk. The role will be responsible for assessing financial resilience through stress testing, reviewing actuarial assumptions and models, evaluating product profitability and sustainability, and supporting strategic decision-making through robust risk analytics and governance.

Closely with the Actuarial, Finance, Investments & Product team to ensure effective management of financial and insurance risks in line with Regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Financial Risk Management**

* Monitor and assess key financial risks including:
* Asset Liability Management (ALM)
* Interest Rate Risk
* Liquidity Risk
* Capital Risk
* Investment Portfolio Risk
* Market Risk
* Analyse asset-liability mismatches and recommend mitigation strategies.
* Review investment portfolio risk exposures and support risk-based investment decision-making.
* Develop and monitor relevant Financial Risk Indicators and tolerance limits.

**Insurance Risk Oversight**

* Assess and monitor insurance-related risks including:
* Mortality Risk
* Longevity Risk
* Morbidity Risk
* Expense Risk
* Lapse/Persistency Risk
* Review emerging experience trends and evaluate implications on business profitability and solvency.
* Support risk assessment of new business initiatives and product developments.

**Product Profitability & Sustainability Assessment**

* Evaluate product design from a risk and profitability perspective.
* Review pricing methodologies and assumptions used in product development.
* Assess product profitability, value creation, sustainability, and risk-return trade-offs.

**Capital Management & Stress Testing**

* Review capital adequacy, solvency position, and capital utilization.
* Support Own Risk and Solvency Assessment (ORSA) activities.
* Assess impact of economic and insurance risk scenarios on profitability, capital, and solvency

**Educational Qualification**

* Actuarial Student with significant progress in actuarial examinations
  **or**
* FRM (Financial Risk Manager) certified / FRM course completed.
* Additional qualifications such as CA, CFA, MBA (Finance) will be an added advantage.

**Experience**

* 6 years + experience.
* Relevant experience in Financial Risk Management, Actuarial, Enterprise Risk Management, or Capital Management within the Life Insurance industry.

title: R2R Financial Accountant
description:
**We Are?**

We are EnerMech, a specialist service company that delivers safe, integrated solutions for complex energy projects.

For over 50 years, we've been energizing our clients across the world with unrivalled expertise, equipment, and technology that supports the entire asset life-cycle offshore and on land.

We enable progress through our three global business lines: Energy Solutions, Infrastructure & Industrial Solutions, and Lifting Solutions.

Within these areas, we offer a wide range of services, including cranes, lifting, fluid power, training, equipment rental, pipeline and subsea, process, and valves all designed to help our clients optimize performance, enhance reliability, and improve efficiency.

With a focus on operational excellence, we deliver value through our customized integrated solutions. This approach reduces risk and enhances efficiencies making us a leading and trusted partner every step of the way.

**The Role**

The RTR Finance accountant role is responsible for transactional and operational delivery within the Record to Report (RTR) function of the Shared Services Centre (SSC). This role ensures the accurate and timely processing of financial transactions and reporting, execution of month-end and year-end close activities, and provides essential assistance to the RTR Team Lead and Process Tower Lead to maintain high standards of service delivery across multiple geographies.

Key Responsibilities

* Transaction Processing
* Accurately process journal entries as per the month end close calendar or ad-hoc as requested by Geography finance team (e.g. adjustments, re-allocations, corrections)
* Prepare supporting documents, refresh reports necessary for calculation of journal values. Raise queries and gather information required for journals calculation and preparation
* Prepare journal templates, check dimensions, GL codes, date, entity, upload and post transactions in ERP. Submit journals for approval in accordance with Level of authority and policies in place
* Support the planning and allocation of tasks of routine and ad hoc transactions in the ticketing system. Use the ticketing system for execution and monitoring of tasks
* Prepare and maintain balance sheet reconciliations, ensuring all items are supported and unreconciled items are investigated, escalated and action plan defined
* Month-End and Year-End Close
* Provide operational support for month-end and year-end close activities, including data gathering, transaction processing, and report generation

**The Requirements**

Key Skills & Experience

* Experience in shared services, in a Record to Report accounting role
* A minimum of 10 years experience in an Accounting roles
* Working knowledge of ERP systems (Navision), proficiency in Microsoft Excel, preferable reporting Power BI experience
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to accuracy and delivery on time as per the SLAs
* Good organisational and time management skills, with the ability to meet deadlines
* Effective communication skills and a collaborative approach to teamwork
* Willingness to work various shift patterns aligned to supported geographies (e.g., Europe/UK, Australia, Americas, UAE, India) as required by the SSC operating model.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

EnerMech is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive organisation. We believe that diversity enriches our team, and we welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, cultures, and identities. You will have good organisational and time management skills with the ability to meet deadlines, along with effective communication skills.

title: Founder's Office
description:
**About The Role**
For problem-solvers who want to learn fast, own real outcomes and build alongside the founders.
  
  
Sure is an early-stage fintech, and this role sits right next to the founders. There's no fixed lane. If you like variety, hate waiting for permission and get a kick out of making things happen, this is built for you.
