title: Senior Equity Research Analyst
description:
**About Us**

**iRage**
is one of India's leading high-frequency trading firms. We build and own everything in-house, from ultra-low-latency execution to our entire trading infrastructure. Our systems deliver some of the lowest latencies in the market, with order-send speeds under 100 nanoseconds - but the harder problem we've solved is keeping that latency low at scale. We run thousands of independent portfolios in parallel, carrying overnight positions across thousands of instruments, with tooling that coordinates state and information across hundreds of servers spanning multiple data centres in real time.

The stack is ours end to end: custom FPGA pipelines - including PHY and MAC layers we built on hardware firmware in-house - and a C++ codebase we control from market-data ingestion through order entry and risk. We run experiments over days just to shave off a single clock cycle.

But great technology alone doesn't move markets. Our quant and tech teams work side by side, and the results speak for themselves: millions of trades a day. To put that in perspective, we handle the equivalent of several Big Billion Days in a single day, every day, at lightning speed. iRage is where deep technical expertise meets real market impact, in one of the world's fastest-growing trading ecosystems.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Own the research product and its quant edge**

* Define the desk's coverage universe, research calendar and house style, anchored in your own sector expertise.
* Apply iRage's strengths to your fundamental work, with the quant team assisting with: market microstructure, flows, derivatives positioning, factor and statistical models, and alternative data.
* Work with iRage's quant researchers and data engineers to turn signals (earnings-surprise models, F&O open interest, delivery and block-deal data, index rebalancing, event studies) into publishable, client-ready ideas.
* Publish initiations, earnings updates, thematic and quant-screen reports, plus short daily or weekly notes.
* Personally cover your core sector(s) with full models, valuations and management access.

**2. Sell the research**

* Be the face of iRage research to institutional clients: FPIs, domestic mutual funds, insurers, PMS/AIFs and family offices.
* Run client calls, roadshows, corporate access events and analyst meets; pitch ideas directly to fund managers.
* Partner with institutional sales to win research votes, empanelment and broker rankings, and to grow broking and execution revenue.
* Translate quant outputs into a clear investment story a fundamental PM will act on.
* Gather client feedback and shape the product around what clients pay for.

**3. Lead and develop the team**

* Manage 4 junior analysts; assign sectors and set quality standards.
* Review every model and report before publication for accuracy, logic and compliance.
* Train analysts in fundamental research, and encourage them to build data and quant skills alongside iRage's quant team.
* Run weekly idea meetings, set individual goals and conduct performance reviews.

**4. Governance and compliance**

* Ensure all research complies with SEBI (Research Analysts) Regulations, disclosure norms and internal conflict-of-interest policies.
* Maintain clear separation and information barriers between research and iRage's proprietary trading.

**Qualifications**

* 7+ years of equity research experience at an institutional brokerage, investment bank, research house or buy-side fund.
* Proven coverage track record: either a few sectors, or deep, recognised expertise in 1–2 sectors (e.g., BFSI, IT, consumer, autos, pharma, capital goods).
* Strong institutional client relationships and a demonstrated ability to sell ideas to fund managers.
* Strong fundamental research skills: expert financial modelling and valuation, and a deep understanding of business models, financial statements and industry dynamics.
* Willingness to do quant-related research: curious about data-driven ideas and keen to partner with iRage's quant team. Prior quant experience is not required; the quant team provides the models and data.
* Clear, persuasive writing and presentation skills.
* NISM Research Analyst certification (or willingness to obtain it promptly) and familiarity with SEBI research regulations.
* CA, CFA, MBA (Finance) or a degree in a quantitative field.

**What we offer and how to apply**

* Direct access to iRage's market data, quant researchers and technology stack.

description:
**Nomura Overview:**

Nomura is a global financial services group with an integrated network spanning approximately 30 countries and regions. By connecting markets East & West, Nomura services the needs of individuals, institutions, corporates and governments through its three business divisions: Wealth Management, Investment Management, and Wholesale (Global Markets and Investment Banking). Founded in 1925, the firm is built on a tradition of disciplined entrepreneurship, serving clients with creative solutions and considered thought leadership. For further information about Nomura, visit www.nomura.com.

Nomura Services, India supports the group’s global businesses. With world-class capabilities in trading support, research, information technology, financial control, operations, risk management and legal support, the firm plays a key role in facilitating the group’s global operations.

At Nomura, creating an inclusive workplace is a priority. Our approach to inclusion encompasses a variety of initiatives, including sensitization campaigns, implementing conducive policies & programs, providing infrastructure support and engaging in community events. Over time, we have made meaningful progress in these areas, and this commitment has been well-recognized across the industry. We are proud recipients of the prestigious Top 10 Employers award by the India Workplace Equality Index (IWEI), IWEI Gold Employer of Choice awards, India CSR Leadership Award 2024 for Holistic Village Development Program and the YUVA Unstoppable Changemaker Awards.

**Divisional Overview:**

The Risk Management Division encompasses the firm's comprehensive risk framework responsible for determining and managing the overall risk appetite for the firm. The division is responsible for effectively managing the firm's risk-return profile, which ensures the efficient deployment of the firm's capital. It is one of the firm's core competencies and is independent of the trading areas and operational area.

The Risk Department at Nomura is broadly organised according to the main risk classes Market Risk, Credit Risk, New Business and Operational Risk. The Risk Department provides senior management with an independent view of the principal risks taken by individual business units.

**Business Unit Overview:**

Credit Risk Management (CRM) is an independent risk oversight function, reporting to the Global Chief Risk Officer (CRO). Its mandate is to manage the risk of loss arising from an obligor or counterparty’s default, insolvency or administrative proceeding, which results in the obligor’s failure to meet its contractual obligations in accordance with agreed terms.

The process for managing credit risk at Nomura includes:

* Evaluation of likelihood that a counterparty defaults on its payments and obligations;
* Assignment of internal ratings to all active counterparties;
* Approval of extensions of credit and establishment of credit limits;
* Measurement, monitoring and management of Nomura’s current and potential future credit exposures;
* Setting credit terms in legal documentation, including margin terms; and
* Use of appropriate credit risk mitigants, including netting, collateral and hedging

CRM Powai

CRM Powai is an integral part of the CRM function globally, responsible for credit risk analysis of a diverse portfolio of counterparties across sectors and regions. The team is engaged in assigning credit ratings, carrying out sector and peer reviews, recommending and monitoring credit limits, suggesting credit terms for legal agreements, tracking early warning indicators, and various other portfolio management activities, as well as participating in global projects. The team comprises of Credit Risk Analysts, Financing Risk Analysts, Portfolio and country risk Analysts to list a few.

**Position Specifications:**

As a credit Analyst, you will be responsible for managing portfolio of EMEA/AEJ based Hedge Funds and Private Equity Funds. In this role you will be responsible for managing all aspects of the portfolio, including Ratings, Limits and exposure monitoring, monitoring early warning indicators, stress testing etc. In addition, you will support the build out of specialized data analytics and portfolio tools and actively participate in the risk monitoring of the portfolio. The position requires you to frequently interact with Clients, Traders, Operations, Legal and other teams in Risk Management, and where necessary escalate credit concerns to senior management.

**Corporate Title :**
Associate

**Functional Title :**
Associate

**Experience :**
4 – 6 years

**Qualification :**
Chartered Accountant (Rank holder or 1st Attempt pass) or PGDM/MBA from top-tier Colleges. Additional qualification like CFA/FRM is preferable

**Role & Responsibilities:**

Credit Officer’s responsibility for a portfolio of Counterparties within the global Hedge Fund team, primarily includes coverage for Hedge Funds (HF) and Private Equity Fund (PE).

Daily responsibilities include:

* Undertake Due Diligence (DD) calls with clients. Collect credit information necessary for conducting detailed credit analysis.
* Conduct in-depth credit research and credit analysis and write high quality Credit Memos, to assign internal credit rating, appetite and margin tiers for clients.
* Prescribe credit terms and covenants for legal documents.
* Analyze and support trade approvals by liaising with the Financing Risk team and obtain Independent Amount (IA) or Initial Margin numbers for such trades.

* Investigate credit limit breaches by speaking to Sales, Operations and Credit Risk Analytics team, determine the cause and escalate as per Credit Policies.
* Design automated reports and implement process workflows for the Hedge Funds team to assist in the monitoring of this specialized portfolio, including highlighting hedge fund clients with elevated levels of risks based on client information (risk/ performance), market indicators, early warning indicators and credit exposure.

title: Quantitative Investment Strategies, Manager, Institutional Equity Division
description:
**Quantitative Investment Strategies, Senior Associate, Institutional Equity Division**
The Quantitative Investment Strategies business at Morgan Stanley sits within the Institutional Securities Group with a cross-asset mandate and is a global multi-function team consisting of dedicated Research, Structuring, Strats, and Trading. The mandate of the group is to design quantitative systematic strategies that can be offered to the firm’s clients to access in a variety of formats.
  
  
This is a challenging role and offering exposure to an interesting, dynamic product group and work environment to build your career in.
  
  
From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Morgan Stanley professionals use our network and technology to provide liquidity and sophisticated analysis, to manage risk and execute reliably in the fast-changing markets.
  
  
Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Equity Division (IED) is a world leader in the origination, distribution and trading of equity, equity-linked and equity-derivative securities. Our broad and deep client relationships, market-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.
  
  
Global Markets Group is the offshoring arm of Morgan Stanley’s Sales & Trading businesses in India. It covers functions across IED ranging from those associated with sales, trading, analytics, strats to risk management.
  
  
**What You'll Do In The Role**

* Work on new equity and multi-asset index development - back testing, coding, tweaking codes etc.
* Development of processes to improve index support, e.g. scripts to aid debugging, index code refactoring and standardization
* Index oversight - Daily monitoring of the complex indices & resolving calculation issues (data problems, calendar errors, common code errors etc.)
* Overseeing Index rebalance processes for client directed strategies
* Making modifications in existing live indices e.g. new cost structures, universe changes, minor methodology adjustments
* Index Description drafting for minor adjustments, Repeat Index Launch Form completion
* Carrying out performance attribution of systematic strategies
* Production of periodic standard performance reporting for client distribution
* Development and production of position, stress, composition reports for clients
* Bespoke scenario/sensitivity analysis for clients

**What You'll Bring To The Role**

* Degree with a quantitative discipline (BE, BTech, MS in Maths/Statistics/Financial Engineering) from Tier 1 or 2 institutes
* 2-4 year of prior exposure to Index/Quants Research and equities/multi asset indices analytics is important.
* Computer Skills: strong programming skills such as Python (mandatory), R and Java.
* Must be able to flexibly respond to changes in priorities, be able to communicate results to a less-technical audience, work well in a team and be comfortable in a front office environment.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills/Ability to express ideas via writing. Prior track record in writing marketing material/trade ideas for wider distribution will be advantageous.
* Proactiveness / Initiative taking & Teamwork are the skills desired
* Option Greeks and their behavior over time
* Derivative products like Swaps, Swaptions, Spread Options, Cap/Floors, range accruals, Digitals etc.
* General behavior of Equity Derivatives markets – Flow and Structured Products

At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. title: Financial Reporting Professional - Mumbai
description:
**Job Description**

**BDO India Services Private Limited: Financial Reporting Role**

BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. It’s a leading service provider for the mid-markets with client service at its heart.

BDO India Services Private Limited (or ‘BDO India’) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory & assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300+ Partners & Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi-fold.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Financial Reporting Manager to take ownership of the financial reporting and month-end close process across group entities. This is a hands-on individual contributor role requiring strong technical accounting expertise, audit management capabilities, and a strong focus on internal controls and financial governance. The role will work closely with Service Lines, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Compliance, and senior leadership to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Reporting & Month-End Close**

* Own and drive the monthly financial reporting and close process across group entities.
* Ensure timely and accurate closure of monthly books within defined timelines.
* Review trial balances, general ledger accounts, and supporting schedules.
* Review and ensure accurate accounting of provisions, accruals, prepayments, depreciation, amortization, and other month-end entries.
* Perform detailed variance analysis of actuals versus budget, forecast, and prior periods, and highlight key business drivers to management.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of financial data across entities.

**Financial Statements & Accounting Compliance**

* Prepare and review annual financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards, including Ind AS / Local GAAP.
* Ensure appropriate accounting treatment for complex transactions and financial reporting matters.
* Provide accurate financial information, schedules, and supporting documentation for regulatory and statutory filings.
* Partner with the Compliance and Secretarial teams to ensure timely and accurate regulatory reporting.

**Statutory & Internal Audit Management**

* Lead and manage statutory audits across group entities.
* Coordinate and support internal audits, including preparation of audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting documents, and deliverables.
* Act as the key point of contact between auditors and internal stakeholders.
* Manage audit timelines and ensure timely closure of audit observations and queries.
* Proactively identify and resolve audit issues with minimal escalation.

**Internal Financial Controls & Governance**

* Execute and monitor Internal Financial Controls over Financial Reporting (IFCR/IFC) within the reporting function.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and testing of key financial controls.
* Identify control gaps and drive timely remediation.
* Strengthen financial governance and control frameworks across entities.
* Ensure compliance with internal policies, accounting standards, and reporting requirements.

**Lease Accounting & Fixed Assets**

* Manage lease accounting, including maintenance of lease trackers and periodic accounting entries.
* Ensure appropriate accounting and reporting under Ind AS 116, where applicable.
* Oversee fixed asset accounting, including capitalization, depreciation, disposals, and reconciliation.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of fixed asset registers and related schedules.

**Balance Sheet & Month-End Governance**

* Ensure all balance sheet schedules are prepared, reviewed, and reconciled on a monthly basis.
* Maintain strong controls over provisions and expense recognition.
* Ensure appropriate cut-off procedures and completeness of expense recognition.
* Investigate and resolve long-outstanding reconciling items and unusual balances.
* Drive high standards of accuracy and financial discipline across the reporting process.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate closely with Service Lines, FP&A, AP, AR, Tax, Treasury, Compliance, and other cross-functional teams.
* Provide management with relevant financial information, analysis, and insights.
* Partner with stakeholders to resolve accounting, reporting, and close-related issues.
* Build strong working relationships with senior stakeholders and external auditors.

**Process Improvement & Systems**

* Identify opportunities to improve and standardize financial reporting and close processes.
* Drive standardization of reconciliations, reporting schedules, and management reporting formats.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen controls and improve process efficiency.
* Support enhanced utilization and optimization of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or Oracle.
* Drive process improvements, automation, and reporting efficiencies wherever relevant.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) Mandatory.
* Experience in financial reporting, accounting, controllership, or related finance functions.
* Strong hands-on experience in:
* Financial reporting and financial statements
* Month-end and year-end close
* Statutory and internal audits
* Balance sheet reconciliations
* Internal financial controls
* Technical accounting
* Experience managing reporting across multiple entities will be preferred.
* Experience in professional services, consulting, Big 4, or similar environments will be an advantage.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or Oracle.

FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
  
  
Our Philosophy
  
  
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
Our Culture
  
  
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: Sr Program Controls Specialist
description:
**Job Description**
Are you ready to help us make the future?
  
  
Project Control Specialist’s primary function is to assist project managers in scheduling and cost controls and do regular projects audits to proactively identify and communicate the risks and opportunities during the project life cycle. The Project Control Specialist support project managers to maximize their facetime with the customers, keep them informed of the potential risks, opportunities like change orders, estimate at completion, and other issues. Project Control Specialist also tracks the project issues and corrective actions He/ She ensures all customer projects follow standard methodology and ensure all projects are maintained in our financial and project execution systems. He/ She ensures that the Program / Project Management processes are implemented effectively. He / She will support business and program management leaders to ensure data integrity by enforcing compliance to management operating system and processes. The Project Control Specialist will also lead a team of Project Controls Analysts
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Principal Responsibilities
  
  
The Project Controls Organization’s (PCO) primary function is to ensure all customer projects follow standard methodology and ensure all projects are setup, reviewed and maintained to the Honeywell HBS standards in financial and project execution systems. PCO ensures data integrity by enforcing compliance to project management methodology, and project accounting requirements.
  
  
The Project Control Specialist will be responsible for complying to the systems, tools, and processes for effective PCO function for the assigned geography and LOB. The Project Control Specialist will ensure program / project management processes are implemented effectively. He/ She will ensure standardize project analysis tools and reports are used for a portfolio of large, medium and small projects.
  
  
**Other Expectations From This Role**

* Deploy standard systems and processes for the project reviews and bring in consistency to ensure common project control processes are followed for all projects
* Leverage existing tools and systems to optimize the Project Control Processes
* Candidate should have PMP or CAPM certificate issued by PMI,USA (Preferred)
* Implementation of the standard Project Controls tool sets and work processes on all projects assigned within regional Operations.
* Set-up of projects schedules, tracking, reporting, highlights deviations and proposes recovery plans.
* Set-up of project controls tools for Budget control and monitoring project Earned Value and productivity.
* Assist in Project timesheet coordination and management.
* Support the Project Managers in managing project review, control and reporting processes.
* Support Project Manager in planning, scheduling and cost control including monthly review and audit on Projects, setting up of Workbook, DCI and uploading to Project Review & Forecast Integrated System PPM Cora.
* Perform monthly reviews, projects gating reviews (support affiliates) and audit on projects.
* Assist project manager to coordinate internal project reviews and preparation of monthly project reports.
* Assist the PM in tracking and monitoring project variation with respect to budget & schedule and change management.
* Ensure the Project Control policies and procedures are consistently applied on the projects.
* Work with Program Managers, Project Manager, Operation Managers and engineering manager to implement the work processes, data structures and technology for Project Controls.
* Partner with the project managers, project coordinators, project admins to ensure that there is seamless handover between various project, operations, finance, sales, and engineering teams
* Deploy standard process and tools and measure effectiveness
* Establish regular project reviews as per guidelines, and make sure that the ERP and Project Execution systems are effectively used and updated with the most current project status.
* Reporting the potential EACs, Change Order potentials, and exceptions to the business leaders and following up corrective actions

**Qualifications**
YOU MUST HAVE
  
  

* Sound understanding of various solutions HON provides to its customers
* Basic Commercial & Financial & Contracts know how
* Strong Project financials understanding – Cost Controls, POC, EAC, Budget, Forecasting, Contracts
* Finance Or Process Background with Project Ops exposure shall be a plus
* Coaching abilities / strong communication
* 7+ years of experience including team supervisory roles (optional).
* Cost risk analysis and Concept of Change Management
* Familiar with MS Office applications, SAP Applications or equivalent business systems , Expert in Primavera Project Planner and / or Microsoft projects
* Project Controls Analysis (data, indices, variances, trends, projects), Planning and Integrated scheduling (concepts and work processes
* Well versed with Data Analytics dashboards and tools viz. Power BI,Tableau

WE VALUE
  
  

* Bachelor’s Degree preferred with 7+ years of experience.
* Degree in Business, Science or Engineering, Finance or Accounting or related field
* Experience as Business Analyst
* Self-starter, eye for detailing
* Demonstrated leadership experience in coordinating and overseeing successful projects and entry-level employees
* Ability to consistently make timely decisions even in the face of complexity, balancing systematic analysis with decisiveness.
* Ability to convey subtle or complex messages clearly, as appropriate for the topic and audience
* Experience in financial data compilation, analysis and metrics management
* User experience of SAP system
* Experience in project operations & Project Management certification shall be a plus

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Business Strategist
description:
The Business Strategist is a key hire as IMC India builds out its Business Strategy function to support the office's rapid growth ambitions over the coming years. You will join a small, high-impact team working closely with IMC's India leadership and trading desk leads, and you will report to the Head of Business Strategy and Corporate Development for India. The working environment is collaborative and non-hierarchical, and you will manage a wide range of stakeholders.
  
  
**Your Core Responsibilities**
  
  

* Contribute to and shape definition of strategic priorities to help the India team achieve its growth ambitions over the next years.

+ Assess attractiveness of a new opportunities based on opportunity size, competition, and internal capabilities.
+ For example: make a business case for trading a new class of products, with cost and benefits analysis and an organizational, legal and compliance set-up.

* Drive real business impact by supporting the execution of the defined strategic priorities

+ Help translate the strategy into planning.
+ Support execution of specific strategic priorities.
+ For example: build annual plans that tie to the long-term strategy with trading, tech and support teams, or develop a joint roadmap for the various teams that trade cryptocurrencies, including taking care of the synergies between the teams.

* Support on specific (ad hoc) strategic problems and opportunities

+ Detect and solve ad hoc problems in a solution-oriented way by using analytical skills.
+ Help detect (operational) bottlenecks within the organization and apply your problem-solving skills to work towards solutions.
+ Run strategy off-sites for teams.
+ For example: hold workshop to improve efficiency of central trading processes.

* Gather external insights, asses their implications for IMC strategy and help decide on a response

+ Ongoing external engagement: play a pivotal role in corporate development projects relevant to the business (e.g. identify threats, opportunities and actions for IMC, leading acquisitions, establishing partnerships, etc.).
+ Develop a perspective on industry trends/developments as well as on the competitive landscape in the secretive field of trading.
+ For example: conduct global competitive analyses into the Indian and global equity markets, make a mapping of various players, revenues, FTEs, trading styles and strategies.

**Your Skills And Experience**

* Experience at a top-tier consulting firm in strategy, preferably at the manager level or higher
* Outstanding problem solving and people skills
* Bachelor's degree in STEM from a Tier 1 University mandatory
* Master’s degree in Physics, Mathematics or Econometrics
* Ability to deal with organizational complexity and ambiguity
* Capable of dealing with a large scope of and senior stakeholders
* Likes to work in an innovative technology driven fast-paced environment, surrounded by highly educated, ambitious and collaborative colleagues

**About Us**
*IMC is a research-driven trading firm where quantitative modeling, machine learning, and engineering shape how modern markets are traded. A stabilizing force in markets since 1989, we provide liquidity across trading venues, delivering the best outcome in value and risk management to investors. Using our own technology and capital, we build proprietary systems and algorithms that operate across global markets. Our researchers, traders, and engineers work as a collective, combining rapid experimentation, advanced infrastructure, and real-time feedback to turn insight into execution and execution into advantage.*

title: Fund Accountant
description:
We are looking for an experienced Fund Accountant with 5+ years of hands-on experience in Private Equity, Hedge Fund or Multi-Asset Fund Accounting. The candidate will be responsible for NAV calculation, financial reporting, trade and cash reconciliation, investment accounting and fund operations while ensuring accuracy and timely delivery.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Prepare daily, monthly and quarterly NAV calculations and financial reports.
* Handle fund accounting, general ledger, journal entries and trial balance.
* Perform cash, position and trade reconciliations.
* Process investment transactions, corporate actions, income and expenses.
* Calculate management fees, performance fees and fund expenses.
* Handle capital calls, distributions and investor allocations for Private Equity funds.
* Manage subscriptions, redemptions, P&L and trade reconciliation for Hedge Funds.
* Prepare financial statements under IFRS / US GAAP.
* Support annual audits and regulatory reporting requirements.
* Communicate with international clients, investment managers and offshore teams.
* Review accounting activities and support process improvements.

**Required Skills**

* Strong experience in Fund Accounting and Investment Accounting.
* Hands-on experience in Hedge Funds, Private Equity or Multi-Asset funds.
* Expertise in NAV Calculation and Reconciliation.
* Knowledge of General Ledger, Financial Reporting and P&L.
* Working knowledge of IFRS or US GAAP.
* Advanced MS Excel skills (Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, XLOOKUP and Macros).
* Good understanding of financial instruments and investment operations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to meet strict reporting deadlines and work with international teams.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with Investran, eFront, Allvue, Geneva, Paxus, Multifonds or similar fund accounting platforms.
* Knowledge of Bloomberg or Refinitiv.
* Exposure to Cayman, Luxembourg, Ireland or GIFT City fund structures.
* CA, CFA, CPA, ACCA or CMA qualification (preferred).

title: Asset Management Business Management - Associate
description:

* Excellent communication, organization and project management skills
* Ability to articulate and demonstrate thoughtful rationale in design decisions
* Intermediate to advanced level ability expected in all MS Office tools (Excel, PowerPoint, Pivot Tables)
* Self-motivated, tenacious and able to work with high degree of independence
* Excellent written and oral communication skills
* Strong time management and prioritization skills

Morgan and Chase brands. title: Head of Finance
description:
Talasha has been mandated to hire a
**Head of Finance**
for a
**VC funded fintech platform**
that provides B2B commerce, payments, and working capital solutions tailored for the pharmaceutical supply chain. This is a leadership role that will set up, own & scale the end to end of Finance function including c

* Experience in leading startup finance - both Controllership (accounts, taxation, compliances) & Business Finance (Mis, profitability analysis, fund raising)

title: Specialist - Research
description:
As a part of the Business Intelligence Group (BIG) Asia - Strategic Research team in India Knowledge Services function of Marsh (India) Private Limited, the candidate will be aligned to the regional sales and client engagement vertical, supporting sales enablement projects and live client pitches for the sales team, partners, and risk advisors.
  
  
Dedicatedly working for Asia, the BIG team supports stakeholders with insights to achieve distinctive client outcomes. We track clients, prospects, industries, markets, competitors as well as emerging risks and develop research collateral critical to growth and sales strategy.
  
  
**What is in it for you?**

* Discover what is great about working at Marsh – from the opportunities that our size brings, to our commitment to our communities and understanding the benefits you will receive. We are four businesses with one PURPOSE: helping companies meet the challenges of our time
* As a global leader in insurance broking and risk management, we are devoted to finding diverse individuals who are committed to the success of our clients and our organisation. Joining us will provide a solid foundation for you to accelerate your career in the risk and insurance industry. You will join a team of talented professionals from across the globe, who are dedicated to helping clients manage some of the world's most challenging and complex risks. We can promise you extraordinary challenges, extraordinary colleagues, and the opportunity to make a difference
* Our rich history has created a client service culture that we believe is second to none. Our commitments to Diversity and Inclusion , Corporate Social Responsibility , and sustainability demonstrate our commitment to stand for what is right

**What will you focus on:**

* Client dialogue decks to support initial discussions with clients and prospects, encompassing business overview, financial analysis, strategic priorities and risk assessment
* Prospect identification of companies around industries, locations, business type, etc.
* Industry assessment highlighting deep insights into addressable market size, industry trends, challenges, outlook, external drivers, as well as key existing and emerging risks
* Competitor analysis that highlights client/ prospects, competitors’ strategic objectives, key investments/ activities undertaken, and how these factors connect to potential opportunities
* Insurance market analysis that provides a detailed analysis of specific market and product line

**We will count on you to:**

* Invest in understanding our business thoroughly
* Independently deliver high-impact research engagements ─ projects commissioned by regional leaders, strategy and sales communities within the firm
* High attention to detail in both research and creation of end products, with focus on producing insightful, synthetized, well written outputs/ reports
* Be extremely responsive in daily work and showcase research process excellence
* Maintain regular project manager interaction for constant flow of information on delivery status, expectations, process changes and new opportunities
* Develop strong relationships with colleagues and stakeholders through high-quality project delivery, responsiveness, and agile and clear communication
* Contribute to process improvement of the team by making relevant recommendations and executing the process initiatives to enhance the efficiency and quality of overall delivery

**What you need to have:**

* Bachelors / Masters in Economics or Masters in Business Administration (MBA) / equivalent post-graduation certification from a reputed institute
* 2 to 4 years of experience in strategy advisory, research (quantitative and qualitative | secondary) experience, at a leading professional services / consulting firm / market intelligence / research firm
* Strong commitment to absorb and engage in feedback discussions and enhancing own knowledge and quality of end products
* Proven ability to present project updates to stakeholders, with strong project management expertise
* Exposure in building frameworks, drawing data driven insights and performing analysis aligned to the ‘Sales Strategy’, focusing on clients / prospects, markets, competitors, products and regulatory developments
* Good understanding of financial concepts, global marketplace, key trends, economic and geo-political developments, key business and financial risks
* Strong understanding of strategy frameworks (PESTEL, Porter’s 5 forces, BCG Matrix, SWOT, etc.) and their applications in bringing out innovative insights
* Strong analytical, critical thinking, problem solving, storyboarding and report writing skills, and excellent communication skills – verbal, writing, listening
* Advanced level of proficiency in MS Office - PowerPoint, Word, Excel, and SharePoint
* Extensive exposure of commercial databases such as S&P Cap IQ, Factiva, Global Data, A.M Best Insurance service etc.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Exposure to working in a global setting
* Experience in risk consulting or insurance/ re-insurance related research or advisory support in related verticals
* Knowledge/ exposure of global insurance markets, risk advisory, enterprise risk management or risk consulting space

Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
Marsh is committed to providing an inclusive work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best, most qualified people and value colleagues of all backgrounds, without regard to age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
  
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

title: Deputy Manager - B&M (Category Management)
description:
The Deputy Manager – Buying & Merchandising (Category Management) will support the seasonal range planning, assortment building, category performance management and commercial execution for the Footwear category.
  
  
The role will be responsible for translating category and business requirements into effective assortments, tracking seasonal deliveries, monitoring sell-through and category performance, supporting End of Season Sale (EOSS) planning, and providing actionable insights at store, region, gender, style and size levels.
  
  
The position will work closely with Buying, Merchandising, Retail Operations, Marketing, Planning, Product Development and Store teams to ensure successful execution of the seasonal category strategy.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Season Range Planning & Assortment
* Support the development of seasonal range plans and assortment architecture for the Footwear category.
* Assist in building the right assortment based on category objectives, consumer preferences, store potential, historical performance and business requirements.
* Support assortment decisions across gender, category, style, size, price point and store grades.
* Participate in seasonal product conferences and contribute to product and assortment discussions.
* Identify assortment gaps and opportunities based on sales trends, market insights and category performance.
* Seasonal Product & Delivery Management
* Take ownership of tracking seasonal product deliveries for the respective category.
* Monitor delivery timelines against the agreed seasonal calendar and highlight potential delays or gaps.
* Coordinate with relevant internal stakeholders to ensure timely availability of products across channels and stores.
* Maintain and update seasonal product trackers and provide regular visibility on delivery status.
* Buying & Merchandise Planning
* Support the Buying Manager in developing seasonal buy plans aligned with category and business objectives.
* Prepare and maintain seasonal buy forms, catalogues and relevant merchandising documentation.
* Support merchandise planning to ensure the right product, quantity and assortment is available across stores and channels.
* Monitor inventory and sell-through trends and provide recommendations for corrective actions wherever required.
* Category Performance & Sell-Through Management
* Monitor and analyse category performance on a periodic basis across regions, stores and store grades.
* Conduct detailed analysis at category, gender, style and size levels to identify key performance drivers and gaps.
* Track sell-through and identify slow-moving, underperforming and high-performing products.
* Provide actionable recommendations to improve category productivity and inventory efficiency.
* Monitor performance against agreed GM% and category deliverables and highlight deviations.
* End of Season Sale (EOSS)
* Support the Buying Manager in EOSS planning and execution for the Footwear category.
* Analyze inventory ageing, sell-through and product performance to support markdown and liquidation decisions.
* Track EOSS performance and provide periodic updates on sales, inventory and sell-through.
* Support identification of products requiring specific interventions to optimize inventory liquidation.
* Marketing & Seasonal Initiatives
* Support the development and execution of the seasonal marketing calendar and key marketing initiatives.
* Coordinate with Marketing and relevant stakeholders to ensure category priorities are incorporated into seasonal campaigns.
* Support the creation of merchandise display plans for new-season products during the season.
* Ensure merchandising initiatives are aligned with product launches and category priorities.
* Product Knowledge & Store Training
* Conduct product training sessions for store teams to enhance product knowledge and selling effectiveness.
* Build awareness of key product features, technologies, benefits and selling propositions among store staff.
* Work with Retail Operations and store teams to ensure effective communication of seasonal product launches and priorities.
* Product Development & Channel Support
* Support new product development initiatives for key channels and business partners.
* Provide category and market inputs based on consumer trends, store-level performance and sales insights.
* Collaborate with relevant stakeholders to identify product opportunities and assortment requirements for specific channels/partners.
* Business Analytics & Insights
* Perform periodic, in-depth analysis of category performance across:

+ Region
+ Store and store grade
+ Category
+ Gender
+ Style
+ Size
+ Sell-through
+ Inventory/productivity

* Identify trends, opportunities and risks and translate data into actionable business recommendations.
* Prepare and present category performance reports and insights to relevant stakeholders.
* Support data-driven decision-making for range, assortment, replenishment and EOSS planning.

**Key Stakeholder Interfaces**
**The Role Will Work Closely With**

* Buying & Merchandising
* Retail Operations
* Planning & Allocation
* Marketing
* Product Development
* Finance
* Supply Chain
* Store Teams
* Key Channel / Business Partners

**Role Specifications**
**Qualification**

* Graduate from FDDI preferred.
* Additional qualification in Fashion, Retail, Merchandising, Business Management or a related discipline will be an advantage.

**Experience**

* Minimum 4 years of relevant experience in Buying & Merchandising / Category Management, preferably within the Footwear, Fashion, Sportswear or Lifestyle Retail industry.
* Experience in seasonal range planning, assortment building and category performance management will be preferred.

**Key Competencies**
**Functional Competencies**

* Season range planning and assortment building
* Category management
* Sell-through management
* Merchandise planning
* EOSS planning and execution
* Category and store-level performance analysis
* Style and size-level analysis
* Inventory and assortment productivity
* GM% management
* Product knowledge and merchandising
* Retail and consumer understanding

**Behavioral Competencies**

* Strong analytical and numerical ability
* Commercial acumen
* Attention to detail
* Problem-solving and decision-making skills
* Strong communication and stakeholder management
* Ability to work collaboratively across functions
* Ownership and accountability
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven retail environment
* Strong presentation and data interpretation skills

**Key Success Measures**
**Success In The Role Will Be Measured Through**

* Effectiveness of seasonal range and assortment planning
* Category sell-through and productivity
* Achievement of agreed GM% deliverables
* Timely tracking and availability of seasonal deliveries
* Effectiveness of EOSS planning and inventory liquidation
* Category performance across stores, regions, styles and sizes
* Quality of business insights and recommendations
* Effectiveness of product knowledge and store training initiatives
* Successful execution of seasonal and category priorities

**About Skechers**
Skechers, a global Fortune 500® company, develops and markets a diverse range of lifestyle and performance footwear, apparel, and accessories. Serving over 180 countries and territories, Skechers connects customers to products through department and specialty stores, e-commerce and digital stores, and through our more than 5,300 Skechers retail locations.

The role combines Accounting, Financial Reporting, FP&A, Treasury, Working Capital, Compliance, Taxation, Internal Controls and MIS, while managing the AR and AP functions.

The ideal candidate should be a strong one-stop finance professional who can manage day-to-day finance operations while providing meaningful financial analysis, cash-flow visibility and decision support to the CFO.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Accounting & Month-End Close**

* Review journal entries, provisions, accruals, reconciliations and supporting schedules.
* Ensure proper accounting of EPC projects, O&M contracts, procurement and project-related transactions.
* Maintain balance-sheet discipline and timely account reconciliations.
* Coordinate with statutory, tax and internal auditors and support audit requirements.

**FP&A, MIS & Business Analysis**

* Own budgeting, forecasting and financial planning.
* Prepare monthly MIS, management dashboards and financial analysis for the CFO and leadership team.
* Analyse revenue, margins, project profitability, costs and variances against budget/forecast.
* Provide project-level financial analysis and identify profitability and cost-control opportunities.
* Develop cash-flow forecasts and financial models to support business decisions.
* Provide timely financial insights and decision support beyond accounting and compliance.

**Treasury & Working Capital**

* Manage day-to-day treasury and liquidity requirements and prepare daily/weekly cash-flow positions.
* Track collections, payments and working-capital requirements.
* Coordinate banking activities and maintain appropriate bank documentation.
* Manage processes relating to Performance BGs, Bid Guarantees, LCs, Advance Bank Guarantees and other banking facilities.
* Monitor fund-based and non-fund-based facilities.
* Support optimisation of working capital and cash conversion.
* Closely monitor government receivables, milestone billing and collections.

**Accounts Receivable & Collections**

* Lead and supervise the AR Executive.
* Ensure timely and accurate customer billing and monitor receivable ageing.
* Drive customer reconciliations and resolution of outstanding items.
* Work closely with Operations/Projects to ensure milestone billing happens on time.
* Escalate delayed collections and support the CFO in improving cash conversion.

**Accounts Payable & Vendor Management**

* Lead and supervise the AP Executive.
* Ensure accurate vendor accounting and timely, controlled payments.
* Review payment proposals and maintain appropriate payment controls.
* Monitor vendor reconciliations and outstanding liabilities.
* Ensure cash-flow prioritisation of payments.

**Taxation & Compliance**

* Oversee day-to-day taxation matters, including GST, TDS and other applicable statutory requirements.
* Ensure timely statutory filings, payments and compliance.
* Coordinate with external tax advisors/consultants wherever required.
* Review tax positions, identify potential risks and ensure appropriate documentation.
* Coordinate with statutory, tax and internal auditors.

**Internal Controls & Governance**

* Establish and maintain strong finance processes, SOPs and internal controls.
* Strengthen controls around billing, collections, procurement, payments, banking and expenses.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of duties and approval controls.
* Identify financial and operational risks and recommend corrective actions.
* Drive process improvement, standardisation and automation.

**4. Ideal Candidate Profile**

* CA / CMA / MBA Finance or equivalent qualification preferred.
* 6–9 years of relevant finance experience, preferably in EPC, infrastructure, project-based, engineering, technology or similar businesses.
* Strong hands-on experience across accounting, month-end close, FP&A, MIS and treasury.
* Good understanding of working capital and cash-flow management.
* Experience handling banking facilities, BGs, LCs and working-capital limits.
* Strong knowledge of GST, TDS, statutory compliance and audit.
* Experience in budgeting, forecasting, management reporting and project profitability analysis.
* Strong Excel / financial modelling skills and preferably ERP experience.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently and operate effectively in a lean organisation.

**5. Role Profile**

**This is not an accounting-only role. The Finance Manager will be expected to operate as the CFO’s key day-to-day finance partner, providing visibility on P&L, cash flow, collections, payments, working capital, banking, compliance, project profitability and key matters requiring management attention.**

* Bank Entry Verification in Tally – Checking and verifying bank entries recorded in Tally software to ensure accurate accounting and proper classification of transactions.
* TDS Entries and Verification – Passing and verifying TDS entries in Tally, ensuring correct ledger accounting and reconciliation of TDS transactions.
* Monthly Logistics Bill Verification – Checking and verifying monthly logistics bills, supporting documents, and invoice accuracy before processing.
* Logistics MIS Preparation – Preparing monthly logistics MIS reports.
* Sales Invoice Management – Sending sales invoices to customers and respective sales personnel and ensuring timely invoice communication.
* MSME Notice Preparation – Preparing MSME payment notices for overdue outstanding invoices and coordinating follow-ups for payment recovery.
* Outstanding Payment Monitoring – Tracking overdue payments, reviewing pending invoices, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure timely collections.
* Ledger Reconciliation and Accuracy – Reviewing customer ledgers, bank transactions, and related accounting records to maintain accurate books of accounts.

**What Are We Looking In You**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce (B.Com) or a related field.
* Candidates with a Master's degree in Commerce (M.Com) or MBA in Finance will be preferred.
* Strong understanding of Accounting, Finance, and taxation principles.
* Knowledge of GST compliance, including GSTR-2B reconciliation and GSTR-3B filing.
* Familiarity with TDS, accounts receivable, debtor management, and ledger reconciliation.
* Working knowledge of accounting software, preferably Tally ERP/Tally Prime.
* Basic understanding of MSME payment regulations and statutory compliance.

Putting your name on things with confidence to drive progress and results quickly

title: Risk & Quantitative Strats, Private Financing Solutions (PFS), Associate/Vice President
description:
**About This Role**
HPS Investment Partners is a credit-focused alternative investment manager that seeks to provide creative capital solutions and generate attractive risk-adjusted returns for our clients. We manage various strategies across the capital structure, including privately negotiated senior debt; privately negotiated junior capital solutions in debt, preferred and equity formats; liquid credit including syndicated leveraged loans, collateralized loan obligations and high yield bonds; asset-based finance and real estate. The scale and breadth of our platform offer the flexibility to invest in companies large and small, through standard or customized solutions. At our core, we share a common thread of intellectual rigor and discipline that enables us to create value for our clients
  
  
**Position Description**
PFS is seeking an Associate/Vice President level individual to join our Risk & Quant Strat (RQS) team in Mumbai. The VP/Associate will support the day-to-day business-as-usual (BAU) operations of the Quant Credit pod within the Private Financing Solutions (PFS) Risk function. The role will help ensure that recurring credit analytics, portfolio monitoring and reporting processes are completed accurately and on schedule. A core focus will be data quality assurance through structured reconciliations, exception investigation, documentation and coordination with business, risk, data and technology stakeholders. The VP/Associate will also support business requests, process improvements and project delivery across private credit risk workflows.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Specific responsibilities will include but not be limited to the following:
  
  
**BAU Operations & Process Execution**

* Execute and coordinate recurring Quant Credit pod processes, including data preparation, validation, portfolio monitoring and reporting activities.
* Maintain process calendars, checklists, trackers and operating documentation to ensure deliverables are completed accurately and on time.
* Monitor daily and periodic workflows, identify exceptions or breaks, and coordinate timely follow-up with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Serve as a dependable point of contact for routine process questions, status updates and operational support.

**Data Quality Assurance & Reconciliations**

* Perform recurring reconciliations across source systems, databases, analytical outputs and reporting files to assess accuracy, completeness and consistency.
* Investigate data mismatches, missing records, stale inputs and other exceptions; document findings and support root-cause analysis and remediation.
* Maintain clear evidence of data checks, exceptions, resolutions and approvals to support control, governance and auditability requirements.
* Track data-quality issues and trends, escalate material exceptions, and follow through with business and technology teams until resolution.
* Support testing and validation of data changes, process enhancements and model or reporting updates before production use.

**Credit Analytics & Business Support**

* Support recurring credit-risk analytics and portfolio monitoring, including rating migration, downgrade-risk and related surveillance metrics.
* Prepare analyses, management information, presentation materials and status updates for business and risk stakeholders.
* Respond to ad hoc data and analytical requests by gathering requirements, validating outputs and communicating results clearly.
* Develop a practical understanding of private credit portfolios, underlying data, analytical methodologies and downstream reporting requirements

title: Manager - Revenue Assurance
description:
**About Credit Saison**
Established in 2019, Credit Saison India (CS India) is one of the country’s fastest growing Non-Bank Financial Company (NBFC) lenders, with verticals in wholesale, direct lending and tech-enabled partnerships with Non-Bank Financial Companies (NBFCs) and fintech's. Its tech-enabled model coupled with underwriting capability facilitates lending at scale, meeting India’s huge gap for credit, especially with underserved and under penetrated segments of the population.
  
  
Credit Saison India is committed to growing as a lender and evolving its offerings in India for the long-term for MSMEs, households, individuals and more. Credit Saison India is registered with the Reserve Bank of India (RBI)and has an AAA rating from CRISIL (a subsidiary of S&P Global) and CARE Ratings.
  
  
Currently, Credit Saison India has a branch network of 80+physical offices,2.06 million active loans, an AUM of over US$2B and an employee base of about approx ~2000 employees.
  
  
Credit Saison India is part of Saison International, a global financial company with a mission to bring people, partners and technology together, creating resilient and innovative financial solutions for positive impact. Across its business arms of lending and corporate venture capital, Saison International is committed to being a transformative partner in creating opportunities and enabling the dreams of people.
  
  
Saison International is the international headquarters (IHQ)of Credit Saison Company Limited, founded in 1951 and one of Japan’s largest lending conglomerates with over 70 years of history and listed on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The Company has evolved from a credit-card issuer to a diversified financial services provider across payments, leasing, finance, real estate and entertainment. Based in Singapore, Saison International’s global operations span over Singapore, India, Indonesia, Thailand, Vietnam, Mexico, Brazil, with active investments in debt, equity, corporate venture capital, and technology.
  
  
**Job Description**
The Revenue Assurance Manager will be responsible for end-to-end assurance of revenue streams, aiming to identify, analyze, and plug revenue leakages. This role involves rigorous reconciliation, system configuration validation, and reporting to senior management, ensuring income recognition is accurate and compliant with RBI regulations and Ind-AS standards.
  
  

* Identify and investigate anomalies, discrepancies, and leakage points across all product lines (Loan Against Property, MSME, Personal Loans, etc.).
* Analyze revenue data to plug leakages resulting from system bugs, incorrect interest configurations, fee waivers, or operational lapses.
* Perform root cause analysis of detected revenue gaps and work with Business/Tech teams to fix them.
* Oversee critical reconciliations between the Loan Management System (LMS) and the General Ledger (GL).
* Validate interest calculations, penal interest, processing fees, and other charges against customer contracts and company policy.
* Prepare detailed monthly revenue assurance dashboards, highlighting leakage metrics, recovery status, and risk areas for senior management.
* Monthly preparation & Review of partner book and reporting, Co-work with other team for reconciliation of transactions for partner payout at partner level.
* Prepare Financial Statements, Business Activity Reports and Financial Forecasts.
* Validate data integrity for regulatory reporting (e.g., RBI returns such as NBS-1, NBS-7).
* Analyze portfolio yield, net interest margins (NIM), and fee income trends.
* Perform User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for new products, system changes, or interest rate updates to ensure accurate revenue capture.
* Laisioning with auditors, external agencies, consultants and close end to end audits and activities.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Education: CA / MBA (Finance) preferred.
* Experience: 3–5 years of experience in Revenue Assurance, preferably in NBFC, Fintech, or Banking.
* Technical Skills: Advanced MS Excel (VLOOKUP, Pivot tables, Macros) and strong experience with SQL for data extraction and analysis.
* Domain Knowledge: Solid understanding of Loan Lifecycles, Income Recognition, and RBI Guidelines for NBFCs.
* Attributes: Analytical mindset, high attention to detail, and ability to handle large data volumes.

title: Credit Controller
description:
The candidate will be responsible for improving collection efficiency, reducing overdue receivables, managing credit exposure and ensuring effective coordination with Sales, Operations and Finance teams to optimise working capital.

Key Roles & Responsibilities1. Accounts Receivable & Collection Management

* Monitor PAN India receivables, including domestic and overseas customers.
* Review outstanding balances, ageing reports and overdue accounts regularly.
* Drive timely collections and maintain Days Sales Outstanding (DSO) within established targets.
* Coordinate with Regional Heads, Sales teams and branch accountants for recovery of overdue payments.
* Conduct weekly collection review meetings and escalate critical overdue accounts to management.
* Ensure timely reconciliation of customer receipts against outstanding invoices.
* Identify long-outstanding balances and recommend corrective or recovery actions.

2. Customer Credit Risk Assessment

* Evaluate new and existing customers' creditworthiness through financial analysis, credit reports, payment history and trade references.
* Assess proposed credit limits, credit periods and overall customer exposure.
* Provide recommendations for approval, modification or rejection of credit requests in accordance with company policy.
* Review customer credit exposure periodically and identify potential defaults or high-risk accounts.
* Monitor adherence to approved credit terms and recommend credit holds or restrictions wherever required.
* Ensure timely processing of credit approval requests.

3. Cash Flow & Collection Forecasting

* Prepare weekly and monthly customer collection forecasts.
* Track actual collections against forecasts and analyse variances.
* Coordinate with Regional Heads to obtain realistic and achievable collection commitments.
* Identify collection shortfalls and highlight their impact on cash flow and working capital.
* Support Finance management in cash flow planning and liquidity management.

4. Customer Dispute Resolution

* Coordinate with Sales, Operations and customers to resolve billing, documentation and payment disputes.
* Ensure timely resolution of domestic and overseas customer discrepancies affecting collections.
* Identify recurring disputes and recommend process improvements.
* Maintain professional customer relationships while ensuring adherence to agreed payment terms.

5. MIS Reporting & Management Review

* Prepare and circulate weekly and monthly receivables ageing reports, including region-wise and customer-wise analysis.
* Provide management with overdue trends, collection performance, DSO analysis and credit exposure reports.
* Highlight high-risk customers, collection delays and deviations from approved credit policies.
* Prepare accurate MIS reports to support management decisions.
* Coordinate with IT/ERP teams for data accuracy, reporting improvements and customised reporting requirements.
* Support internal and external audits relating to receivables and credit control.

6. Statutory Compliance & Accounting Support

* Perform periodic reconciliation of Form 26AS with customer TDS ledgers.
* Prepare foreign currency revaluation workings and provisions for doubtful debts for month-end/year-end closure.
* Coordinate with the Compliance team on GST-related customer queries, reconciliations and documentation.
* Ensure accuracy of customer ledgers, receipts and related accounting records.

7. Process Improvement & Automation

* Identify opportunities to automate collection tracking, customer reminders and receivables reporting.
* Improve accuracy and turnaround time of credit control and reporting processes.
* Strengthen internal controls relating to customer credit approvals, receivables monitoring and collections.
* Ensure compliance with credit control SOPs and recommend improvements.

title: Finanace Controller - US based operations
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION

Finance Controller – US Operations

Location: Mumbai, India

Employment Type: Full-Time

Client: US-Based Company

Experience: Minimum 5–8 years

Mandatory Qualification: Certified Public Accountant (CPA), USA

Position Overview

We are seeking an experienced and qualified Finance Controller to manage and oversee the financial operations, accounting, reporting and compliance functions for a US-based client from our Mumbai office.

The ideal candidate must hold a US CPA qualification and have a minimum of five years of hands-on experience working with US Generally Accepted Accounting Principles (US GAAP).

The role requires strong technical accounting knowledge, financial management capabilities, and the ability to independently manage financial reporting, month-end closing, budgeting, internal controls and compliance requirements while coordinating closely with the client’s US-based management team.

Key Responsibilities

1. Financial Accounting & Reporting

\* Oversee day-to-day accounting operations in accordance with US GAAP.

\* Manage monthly, quarterly and annual financial closing processes.

\* Prepare and review financial statements, including Profit & Loss, Balance Sheet and Cash Flow statements.

\* Ensure accuracy, completeness and timeliness of financial records and management reports.

\* Analyse financial performance, identify variances and provide actionable insights to management.

\* Maintain appropriate accounting policies, procedures and documentation.

2. Financial Planning & Analysis

\* Lead annual budgeting, forecasting and financial planning activities.

\* Monitor actual performance against budgets and forecasts.

\* Conduct variance analysis and identify opportunities for cost optimisation.

\* Prepare financial dashboards, MIS reports and business performance presentations.

\* Provide financial insights to support strategic and operational decision-making.

3. US GAAP, Compliance & Audit

\* Ensure compliance with US GAAP and applicable US financial reporting requirements.

\* Coordinate internal and external audits and manage audit-related documentation.

\* Ensure appropriate internal financial controls and risk management practices.

\* Review accounting treatments for complex transactions and ensure accurate financial recognition.

\* Support compliance with applicable US tax and regulatory reporting requirements in coordination with relevant specialists.

4. Treasury & Cash Flow Management

\* Monitor cash flows, working capital and liquidity requirements.

\* Oversee accounts payable, accounts receivable and general ledger activities.

\* Monitor banking transactions, reconciliations and cash management.

\* Develop cash flow forecasts and ensure timely financial obligations.

title: Senior Executive - Accounts
description:
**The role in a gist:**

In this role, you will handle loan-portfolio accounting under Ind AS 109, preparing EIR and transaction cost amortization schedules for the loan book. You will interpret commercial terms in vendor and partner agreements to ensure correct accounting treatment. Day-to-day work involves managing large loan-level datasets in Excel and Tally or an ERP, along with reconciliations and close coordination with business, operations and partner teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Loan origination cost amortization**

* Review expense ledgers at transaction and vendor level to identify costs directly attributable to loan origination, such as marketing, sourcing, call centre, channel partner and marketplace costs, in line with Ind AS 109.
* Reclassify identified costs to the appropriate cost heads and record the related reclassification entries.
* Map costs to disbursements by channel, vendor and campaign using disbursement and lead data, separately for on-book and off-book loans (variabilization).
* Prepare and maintain amortization schedules under the EIR method, including the treatment of prepayments, foreclosures and write-offs.
* Record monthly amortization entries, and reconcile ledger balances with amortization workings at vendor level.
* Interpret performance-linked vendor and partner agreements (e.g. commission on disbursements, expenses paid on the partner's behalf and adjusted against invoices), and compute amounts payable or recoverable.
* Prepare marketing and processing cost MIS, including projections of expected costs and their EIR impact.
* Maintain a master record of agreements, invoices and approvals, and coordinate with marketing, business and operations teams.
* Prepare schedules and support internal, statutory and tax audits for amortization.
* Contribute to the automation of amortization and reconciliation workings.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* B.Com/M.Com or CA Inter / semi-qualified CA, with 4–6 years of experience in accounting at an NBFC, bank or fintech.
* Working knowledge of Ind AS 109, particularly EIR and transaction cost amortization.
* Experience in preparing amortization schedules for a loan portfolio.
* Ability to interpret commercial terms in vendor and partner agreements.
* Advanced Excel proficiency (pivot tables, lookups; Power Query an advantage) for handling large transaction-level and loan-level datasets; working knowledge of Tally or an ERP.
* Strong reconciliation skills and the ability to work with business, operations and partner teams.
* Exposure to NBFC lending or audit of financial services entities preferred.
