title: Intelligence & Insights – Manager / Senior Analyst
description:
TRYST, IIT Bombay, is looking for talented professionals to join its
**Intelligence & Insights team**
at two levels –
**Manager (5–7 years)**
and
**Senior Analyst (2–3 years)**
.

This is an exciting opportunity for professionals from management consulting, industry research, strategy, technology intelligence and analytics backgrounds who are passionate about understanding emerging industries, technological developments and the future of innovation.

The selected professionals will work at the intersection of
**frontier research, industry strategy, technology, investment and national priorities**
, helping shape TRYST's perspective on India's evolving industrial and technological landscape.

**Key Focus Areas**

The Intelligence & Insights team will work across the following domains:

* Healthcare & Life Sciences
* Semiconductors & Electronics
* Energy & Clean Technology
* Climate & Sustainability
* AI & Digital Technologies

AI and digital technologies will also be explored as cross-industry enablers across TRYST's priority sectors.

**Role 1: Manager – Intelligence & Insights**

**Experience: 5–8 Years**

The Manager will lead industry, technology and innovation intelligence across TRYST's priority domains, developing strategic perspectives and identifying opportunities that connect industry challenges with IIT Bombay's research strengths.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Lead industry, technology and innovation intelligence, covering market structures, industry segments, value chains, emerging technologies and frontier research.
* Develop five-year and ten-year industry outlooks, scenarios and strategic assessments.
* Evaluate India's competitive positioning, strategic dependencies and capability gaps against leading global economies, companies and research institutions.
* Identify high-value technology challenges across industries and connect them with IIT Bombay's research capabilities.
* Evaluate the innovation and investment landscape, including public research funding, deep-tech venture capital, corporate R&D and commercialisation barriers.
* Prepare industry outlook reports, white papers, strategic presentations and executive briefings for senior stakeholders.
* Engage with CXOs, R&D leaders, founders, investors, policymakers and faculty to validate and strengthen industry perspectives.
* Lead, mentor and develop the team of analysts while establishing research frameworks, methodologies and quality standards.

**Role 2: Senior Analyst – Intelligence & Insights**

**Experience: 2–3 Years**

The Senior Analyst will lead research and intelligence on AI & Digital Technologies while supporting the broader industry intelligence agenda across TRYST's priority sectors.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Conduct in-depth research on industries, technologies and markets, developing structured views of industry segments, sub-segments and value chains.
* Develop market models and analytical assessments to evaluate market size, growth opportunities and strategic dependencies.
* Track emerging technologies, frontier research, startups and investment activities to identify opportunities for research translation and commercialization.
* Contribute to five-year and ten-year industry outlooks, comparative assessments and global best-practice studies.
* Analyse India's position across relevant technology and industry segments, identifying areas where India leads, lags or depends on global capabilities.
* Synthesise research findings into high-quality reports, presentations, briefs and publications.
* Support engagements and interactions with industry leaders, investors, policymakers and faculty.
* Build expertise in AI and digital technologies while contributing to intelligence across healthcare, semiconductors, energy and climate-related domains.

**Preferred Candidate Profile – Applicable to Both Roles**

We are particularly interested in candidates with:

* Experience in management consulting, strategy consulting, industry research, market intelligence, research and analytics, corporate strategy, or R&D and product-related roles.
* Exposure to direct client and stakeholder interactions, including industry leaders and senior decision-makers.
* Strong experience in primary research, industry analysis, market intelligence and gathering insights through stakeholder engagements.
* Industry exposure in one or more of the following areas:
* Semiconductors & Electronics
* Energy & Clean Technology
* Healthcare & Life Sciences
* Climate & Sustainability
* Understanding of technology trends, innovation ecosystems, product development, technology commercialisation and emerging deep-tech opportunities.
* Strong analytical, quantitative, problem-solving and research capabilities.
* Excellent communication, report writing, presentation and stakeholder management skills.

Educational Qualifications

**Manager:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Science.
* MBA or an advanced degree from a leading institution is preferred.

**Senior Analyst:**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Science or Pharmacy.
* Master's degree or MBA will be an advantage.

**Why Join TRYST – IIT Bombay?**

* Shape where one of India's leading research institutions directs its research translation efforts.
* Work at the intersection of frontier science, industry strategy, capital and national priorities.
* Gain direct exposure to industry leaders, investors, policymakers and world-class faculty.
* Contribute to strategic initiatives that connect cutting-edge research with industry needs and real-world opportunities.

title: Manager Business Finance
description:
**Overview**
WELCOME TO SITA
  
  
At SITA, we keep airports moving, airlines flying smoothly, and borders open. Our technology and communication innovations power the success of the global air travel industry.
  
  
You'll find us in 95% of international airports, working closely with over 2,500 transportation and government clients. Each partnership brings unique challenges, and we thrive on delivering fresh solutions and cutting-edge tech to keep operations running like clockwork. We don't just move the world forward-we're proud to be recognized as a
**Great Place to Work**
® by 79% of our employees and certified in most of our growing locations. Here, we feel empowered, supported, and inspired to grow.
  
  
Are you ready to love your job?
  
  
The adventure begins right here, with you, at SITA.
  
  
PURPOSE
  
  
As the trusted partner to the BU CFO / Director for all Business Finance matters, the Finance Business Partner enables financially sound planning and decision making across the partner organization. The role spreads financial acumen, tells clear, data-driven stories that spur action, bridges the gap between finance and operations, and helps shape the decision support tools delivered with Data and Analytics / FP&A.
  
  
The role takes a technology-guided, coaching-led approach to partnering, enabling decision makers to act more independently. It interprets data, advises the business and supports long-run performance management, drawing on a deep understanding of SITA's business models and financial drivers to convert analysis into decisions, targets and outcomes. It does not produce reporting; production is owned centrally by Data and Analytics / FP&A.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Deepen decision makers’ Business Finance acumen**

* Continuously coach decision makers on how Business Finance analyzes situations, develops insights, and applies them to decisions.
* Influence decisions through narrative and visuals: Turn financial analysis into clear, compelling stories linked to business decisions. Use standardized Data & Analytics / FP&A and BI reports, ERP analytics, Copilot, and tailored visuals based on governed data. Focus on decision quality rather than analysis volume.
* Challenge assumptions through problem analysis and root-cause exercises to reduce bias and introduce a Finance perspective.
* Train decision makers to use value-driver trees to connect operational decisions with enterprise value creation, risk mitigation, investment priorities, and financial impact.
* Improve financial data literacy through learning programs, financial storytelling, modeling, and scenario analysis, helping stakeholders understand financial impacts and risks.

**Assess and anticipate decision makers’ needs**

* Build strong relationships with executives and business leaders to understand financial needs, challenges, and the most effective support required.
* Identify latent needs through active listening and uncover opportunities for new decision-support tools and services from Data & Analytics / FP&A.
* Maintain continuous stakeholder feedback loops to rapidly improve Finance services and support.

**Provide personalized decision support to executives**

* Proactively guide executives toward meeting and exceeding performance goals.
* Monitor leading indicators to identify delivery risks and performance gaps, drive corrective actions, and recommend alternative approaches.
* Help executives identify opportunities to create enterprise value or mitigate risk through effective metric prioritization.

**Support nonexecutive decision makers when appropriate**

* Assess and prioritize inbound support requests and determine whether existing decision-support tools can meet the need or new solutions are required.
* Identify cost optimization opportunities and support cost-reduction planning.
* Pressure-test budgets, providing Business Finance expertise on potential risks and constraints.
* Lead comprehensive business cases for investments, product initiatives, internal funding, and M&A. Assess benefits, costs, risks, and ROI through realistic, measurable, stress-tested financial models. Partner with Pricing, Product, and transversal teams; present and defend cases to Investment Boards; track actual versus projected ROI; drive corrective actions; and lead post-M&A integration planning.
* Identify performance issues and support course correction.

**Facilitate digital decision-support tools**

* Partner with technology teams to ensure tools provide actionable guidance for operational and strategic decisions.
* Act as the voice of the internal customer with Data & Analytics / FP&A and technology teams, helping design intuitive reports, analyses, and dashboards for nonexecutive decision makers.

**Drive adoption of decision-support tools**

* Match stakeholders with the most appropriate decision-support tools.
* Demonstrate their value through success stories and early adopters/change champions, tailoring communications to different audiences.
* Support change-management strategies that increase adoption of new tools and processes.
* Translate financial insights into clear business language so recommendations embedded in tools are intuitive and actionable.

**Monitor and assess the value of support**

* Champion Finance Business Partner and Data & Analytics / FP&A knowledge-sharing forums to exchange lessons on educating and supporting decision makers.
* Help define success criteria and measurable business and technical metrics for decision-support tools, monitoring utilization and quality.
* Proactively seek stakeholder feedback.

**Qualifications**
EXPERIENCE
  
  

* Extensive experience in financial planning and analysis, including budgeting, forecasting, and financial modeling
* Proven ability to train decision makers to have an enterprisewide perspective and in simplifying complex financial analysis into easily digestible logic
* Proven history of building and maintaining strong relationships with business unit leaders and other stakeholders
* Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams to create and implement financial decision support tools
* Preferred familiarity with managing change and ensuring the smooth adoption of new tools and processes
* Has established and monitored success criteria and metrics for financial tools
* 7+ years in financial analysis, controlling or business partnering, preferably in a multinational, high-technology environment.
* Experience interacting at senior management level and exercising sound judgement between personal involvement and delegation.
* People management experience in an international, multi-matrix organisation.

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Financial planning and analysis expertise: Expert knowledge of financial planning, budgeting, and forecasting processes, including the ability to drive continuous improvement in these areas. Deep understanding of the P&L and balance sheet, KPI driver maps and reporting methodologies
* Strategic thinking and business acumen: Deep understanding of revenue drivers, sales optimization, margin management, and metrics cascades to provide insightful, performance-inflecting decision support to business leaders
* Communication and storytelling: Excellent storytelling, communication and presentation skills to effectively convey financial insights, analysis and recommendations to decision makers
* AI and digital fluency: Conversational fluency with GenAI and Copilot equivalent to support exploratory analysis and content generation, with sound prompt construction, validation of AI outputs for bias and error, and the judgement to know when human oversight is required. Able to exploit digital technologies for better finance and business outcomes and to drive tool requirement discussions with Data and Analytics / FP&A and technology teams.
* Data and AI literacy: Data storytelling built on the single governed data source; self-service visualization through ERP analytics and Copilot / equivalent; basic statistical literacy to challenge assumptions, test causation versus correlation and spot data quality issues; and conceptual awareness of agentic AI and when to escalate governance concerns.
* Applies AI and analytics, does not build it: Uses and interprets AI and analytics outputs to support decisions. Does not build production models, pipelines or data products, which remain with Data and Analytics / FP&A.
* Financial coaching and training: Competence in coaching and training decision makers to internalize and apply FP&A concepts
* Problem-solving: Ability to challenge assumptions, teach problem analysis techniques to decision makers and identify root causes and develop effective solutions
* Relationship building and collaboration: Proven ability to build strong relationships with business unit leaders and stakeholders. Active listening skills to uncover latent needs and opportunities for support. Ability to collaborate with FP&A and technology teams to design intuitive reports, analyses and dashboards
* Continuous improvement: Ability to define success criteria and establish measurable metrics for monitoring tool utilization and quality. Ability to work effectively on a team that uses agile principles to continuously iterate the delivery and development of financial tools and solutions
* Industry insight: Deep understanding of Travel tech market, and of the economic drivers, management accounting and accounting standards relevant to them.
* Financial systems and ERP: Well-versed in ERP and financial systems such as SAP, Oracle and Onstream, Fabric….
* International and matrixed environments: Experience operating in international, multi-matrix organizations and driving collaboration and teamwork across them.
* Leadership and stakeholder management: Strong leadership and stakeholder management, including the ability to manage, motivate and develop teams where there is management responsibility.

PROFESSION COMPETENCIES
  
  

* AI and automation fluency — experience leveraging AI tools to accelerate financial analysis, reporting, and insight generation
* Advanced financial modelling in Excel
* Driver-based forecasting and scenario analysis
* Business case development — end to end
* ERP systems: SAP, Oracle, Onstream
* Data visualisation: Power BI, Tableau

**Education & Qualifications**

Strengthen investor confidence and support long-term sustainable growth by serving as a strategic bridge between the organization and investors through transparent communication and effective stakeholder engagement.

**Key Accountabilities (2/7)**
**Analyzing market and competitor information to prepare benchmarks and derive insights**

* Implement benchmarking frameworks and identify/update sources for data collation and analysis

**Key Accountabilities (3/7)**
**Conducting cross-functional due diligence on identified opportunities**

* Evaluate identified opportunities by analyzing potential synergies, complementary strengths, and overall fit with the company’s needs
* Build detailed financial models to gauge valuation scenarios and risks of the investment
* Present findings to various levels of management to gain interest and deal approval

**Key Accountabilities (4/7)**
**Ensuring compliance and secretarial approvals as per SEBI guidelines during deal execution**

* Collaborate with the company secretarial team and external compliance advisors to ensure adherence to SEBI guidelines.

**Key Accountabilities (5/7)**
**Deliver simplified & comprehensive Board Presentations on results along with detailedscorecards for the month & complete bridge vs plan to enable management identify hits and misses**

* Prepare standalone & consolidated management accounts
* Collaborate with Corporate Accounts with the monthly P&L closing activities
* P&L and key performance metrics reporting
* Monthly flash on business performance (sales by BU & provisional P&L / LBE) for the Board
* Provide visibility to the leadership on the key business risks - sales, mix, costs, competition
* Enhance the quality of the investor relations material to provide better externalcommunication

**Key Accountabilities (6/7)**
**Partner with BUs and Functions to achieve cost management and delivery of annual plan**

* Holding actual vs budget discussions with BUs
* Understanding and preparing business analysis - DTM / B2B, book integration implications etc.
* Performing monthly variance analysis for corporate functions (HR, Legal, IT etc.) andintervention planning to help deliver the plans
* Identify risks & opportunities in P&L delivery - one offs, recurring costs assessment
* Work with corporate functions & BU CFOs for ring fencing & cost control

**Key Accountabilities (7/7)**
**Design the annual operating plan / budget and forecast future performance for thecompany to monitor and control performance (growth & margins)**

* Work with the BUs/Functions on the next year budget planning for bottoms up
* Integrate the budget plans for one central budgeting & P&L prep
* Provide trend based and BU LBE guidance to business leadership team
* Simulation based forecasting for the quarterly & full year P&L

**Major Challenges**

* Communicating effectively with diverse stakeholders - Ensure transparency through concise and accurate updates, fostering open dialogue.
* Forecast Uncertainty – Improving forecast agility and accuracy (Streamlining the forecasting process to address thechanging market conditions and establishing a driver based rolling forecast process)
* Delivering real-time and up-to-the-minute results to leadership team through consolidating &analysing inputs from multiple sources (Automation & Standardisation)
* Navigating competitive pressures - Stay ahead with regular competitor analyses, benchmarking, and tracking industry trends.
* Ensuring compliance with SEBI regulations - Collaborate with secretarial and compliance teams to adhere to guidelines and remain updated on regulatory changes.

**Key Interactions (Internal)**

* Coordinate on operational updates, compliance requirements, and investor relations strategy.
* BU CFOs and BU Finance Team (Monthly; Business Analysis & intervention plans for keeping performance on track)
* Corporate Finance Team - Accounts/Costing/Tax/Treasury (Monthly; P&L closing activities)
* Corporate Functions (Monthly; Cost plans, actuals & intervention planning to help deliver the plans)
* CS team of annual report
* CEO and CXO data for comparative analysis

**Key Interactions (External)**

* External Stakeholders (e.g., Investors, Analysts, Brokers) - Share company performance insights, market information, and build trust to attract investments.
* Compliance Advisors (e.g., Secretarial Team and ESG Team) - Ensure adherence to SEBI guidelines and other compliance-related approvals
* Auditors

**Dimensions**

* Financial Reports: Preparation and presentation of quarterly and annual reports, earnings releases, and SEC filings.
* Investor Communication: Organizing investor meetings, roadshows, and earnings calls to maintain transparency.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Building relationships with analysts, institutional investors, and media.
* Market Analysis: Monitoring analyst reports and summarizing market trends for senior management.
* Strategic Messaging: Crafting communication materials like press releases and presentations to align with the company's vision.
* Crisis Management: Addressing investor concerns during financial or operational challenges.
* Performance Metrics: Tracking stock price movements, shareholder value, and investment community feedback.

**Key Decisions (1/2)**

* Decisions related to resolving issues and questions by BU Finance as the first point of contact for issues
* Decisions on Forecasting assumptions based on business insights and sensitivity reporting based on multiple scenarios
* Early warning signal to financial health of the company – escalate triggers to senior leadership
* Content Creation - Drafting press releases, investor presentations, and communication materials.
* Event Coordination - Planning and executing investor meetings, roadshows, and earnings calls.
* Market Monitoring - Tracking analyst reports and summarizing market trends for internal use.
* Stakeholder Engagement - Managing relationships with analysts and investors

**Key Decisions (2/2)**

* Recommendations on budget allocations/ring fencing for BUs/Functions at time of annual budgeting based on analysis of current & past trends of revenue and expenses
* Recommendations on intervention plans for keeping performance on track based on expenditure analysis, industry/peer group comparisons
* Recommendations related to developing standard financial models/templates distributed for use by Finance Team during planning process to ensure quality and accuracy
* Strategic Messaging - Proposing communication strategies aligned with the company's vision.
* Financial Disclosure - Advising on the timing and content of financial reports and disclosures.
* Crisis Management - Suggesting approaches to address investor concerns during challenges.
* Investment Community Feedback - Providing insights on market perception and investor sentiment.

Qualified Chartered Accountant / MBA – Finance

4-8 years of work experience.

Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. **Financial and Valuation Advisory**
Over the past 50+ years, Houlihan Lokey has established one of the largest worldwide financial and valuation advisory practices. Our transaction expertise and leadership in the field of valuation inspire confidence in the financial executives, boards of directors, special committees, investors, and business owners we serve. In 2025, LSEG ranked us the No. 1 global M&A fairness opinion advisor over the past 25 years. Our stability, integrity, technical leadership, and global capabilities make us a trusted advisor for clients worldwide, across a wide range of services, including the Transaction Opinions, Transaction Advisory Services, Corporate Valuation Advisory Services, Portfolio Valuation and Fund Advisory Services, Real Estate Valuation and Advisory Services, and Dispute Resolution Consulting practices.
  
  
**Transaction Advisory Services**
Houlihan Lokey’s Transaction Advisory Services (TAS) practice assists private equity and corporate clients with financial, IT and tax due diligence, business analytics, and technical accounting matters associated with corporate mergers, divestitures, and acquisitions (M&A). Drawing on Houlihan Lokey’s market leadership in middle-market M&A transactions, our due diligence experts provide candid, unbiased, and rigorous support on matters most impacting deal value, and assist investors in identifying and evaluating key value drivers and risk factors.
  
  
TAS India
  
  
TAS India covers Financial due diligence, Accounting and financial reporting and Digital value creation services. We have a highly integrated ‘one-team’ working model where TAS India team members are fully embedded into an engagement lifecycle - from client pitch to client discussions through closure. They have similar exposure to project complexities and client situations as their counterparts in the global TAS teams, and work in similar ownership and accountability construct. With a strong industry orientation and innovation-focused environment, we offer a unique proposition comprising best-in-class functional, industry and technology competencies along with an exposure to global M&A markets.
  
  
**Job Description**
TAS is seeking talented professionals to join our fast-growing Digital Value Creation group (DVC) at the Associate level. DVC provides our clients value-creating insights from vast market, operational, and financial data. DVC professionals work closely with HL due diligence, valuation and investment banking teams alongside clients’ deal and operating teams. As a professional in the group, you will be teamed with highly talented and dedicated M&A professionals in various industry groups including Industrials, Consumer, Technology, Business Services and Financial Services. This opportunity provides you broad exposure to different transactional issues affecting businesses in an M&A environment.
  
  
This is a unique opportunity for someone with proficiency in data analytics along with experience in applying data analytics techniques to financial and operational analyses that is fundamental to an M&A process. DVC provides you ample exposure to the M&A and corporate finance industry and capital markets. You will further develop and extend your data analytics knowledge, and hone your interpersonal skills as you deliver valuable insights that derive transaction and strategic decision making for internal and external stakeholders.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead engagement tasks or workstreams within an engagement, taking ownership of the execution, and quality and timeliness of deliverable to clients
* Communicate effectively with internal project teams as well as client teams, showing ability to put forth points of view and drive discussions towards required objectives
* Gather, evaluate, sanitize, and organize applicable meta data
* Prepare data workflows to clean and combine data from multiple sources
* Prepare data visualizations and dashboards to deliver key insights
* Generate insights on the drivers of business growth, profitability, and liquidity
* Identify the key business risks and opportunities impacting business valuation
* Be willing to learn and train peers in the advisory practice on data analysis and visualization tools
* Continuously develop industry knowledge and qualifications
* Be able to work on multiple assignments simultaneously
* Support and actively participate in business development efforts
* Review the work of team members to ensure desired quality and insights

**Basic (must-have) Qualifications**

Work experience

description:
**Senior Manager - Strategic Finance**

**Location: Mumbai**

**Function: Finance**

**Reporting to: Head of Finance**

**About the Role**

We are looking for a high-calibre Senior Manager - Strategic Finance to join the Finance team and work closely with the Head of Finance and senior leadership team on some of CoinDCX's most important strategic, financial and enterprise-wide initiatives.

This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role for someone who can operate comfortably between strategy and execution. The individual will work on complex business problems, strategic planning, financial analysis, capital allocation, enterprise performance, financial infrastructure, crypto-asset reconciliation frameworks, financial processes and controls, and other high-priority initiatives led by the Head of Finance.

The ideal candidate will bring the structured problem-solving approach of a top-tier consultant, strong financial acumen and an operator's mindset.

This is not a traditional FP&A, Business Finance, Controllership or investment-banking role. The role is designed to be a strategic extension of the Head of Finance, focused on solving complex, ambiguous problems and driving high-impact initiatives across the organisation.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Strategic Finance & Enterprise Problem Solving

- Partner closely with the Head of Finance and senior leadership team on high-priority strategic and financial decisions.

- Take ownership of complex, ambiguous and cross-functional problems and develop structured, data-driven solutions.

- Analyse enterprise-level financial and operating drivers to support strategic decision-making, including cost structures, capital allocation, liquidity, cash deployment and operating leverage.

- Build financial models, scenarios and analytical frameworks to evaluate strategic choices and business decisions.

- Identify key risks, opportunities and value-creation levers and translate analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.

- Challenge existing assumptions and bring an objective, fact-based perspective to strategic discussions.

- Support Head of Finance in evaluating new initiatives, business models, strategic investments and other enterprise-level decisions.

2. Special Projects

- Lead high-impact strategic projects sponsored by the Head of Finance, often involving multiple functions.

- Establish project governance, milestones, decision points and accountability for Head of Finance-sponsored initiatives.

- Identify execution risks and proactively drive resolution across functions.

3. Crypto & Financial Infrastructure

- Partner with Finance, Treasury, Operations, Product and Technology teams to strengthen crypto-asset and fiat reconciliation frameworks.

- Develop and enhance frameworks for reconciliation of customer balances, crypto assets, liabilities and financial records.

- Develop a strong understanding of complex transaction flows across wallets, exchanges, banking partners and internal systems.

- Identify systemic reconciliation gaps, control weaknesses and process inefficiencies and translate them into process, technology and control requirements.

- Design scalable frameworks for digital-asset financial reporting, reconciliation and operational finance.

- Support annual planning, forecasting and scenario analysis on strategic topics, where required.

- Identify opportunities to improve financial efficiency, capital utilisation and operating leverage at an enterprise level.

- Develop dashboards, analytical tools and management frameworks that enable senior leadership to make better decisions.

- Support Head of Finance in evaluating strategic trade-offs across growth, profitability, liquidity, risk and capital allocation.

- Support Head of Finance on IPO readiness and capital-markets-related initiatives as and when required.

- Work with investment bankers, auditors, lawyers and other external advisors on relevant projects.

- Support benchmarking, financial analysis, investor materials and management presentations.

- Help strengthen financial processes, reporting, governance and internal controls required for a potential public-market environment.

- Support projects relating to equity story, investor readiness, financial disclosures and capital-market benchmarking.

- Coordinate cross-functional workstreams required to close identified IPO-readiness gaps.

**What We Are Looking For**

We are looking for someone with exceptional analytical horsepower, structured thinking, financial depth and the ability to independently drive ambiguous, high-impact problems.

- Candidates from McKinsey, BCG, Bain, EY-Parthenon, Strategy&, Kearney, Deloitte, Accenture Strategy, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan and similar institutions would be relevant.

- Strong understanding of financial statements, corporate finance, financial modelling and business drivers.

- Excellent Gen AI capabilities.

- Demonstrated ability to break down complex and ambiguous problems into structured analytical frameworks.

- Ability to independently develop a point of view from incomplete or complex information.

- Strong commercial judgement and ability to translate analysis into actionable recommendations.

- Ability to operate independently with limited supervision and significant ambiguity.

- Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders.

- High attention to detail combined with strong strategic judgement.

- Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial and evolving environment.

**Preferred Experience**

- Strategic Finance / CFO Office experience.

- Top-tier consulting experience with significant exposure to financial services, fintech or technology.

- Experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation or strategic projects.

- Experience designing financial controls, reconciliation frameworks or financial infrastructure.

- Fintech / financial services / digital-asset experience.

- IPO / capital-markets exposure.

- Experience working with technology teams on automation of finance processes and data flows.

**What Success Looks Like**

The successful candidate will be capable of independently taking ownership of important strategic initiatives and driving them from ambiguity to execution.

**Success will be measured by the individual's ability to:**

- Independently solve high-priority, ambiguous problems.

- Drive strategic initiatives from problem definition through execution.

- Develop high-quality analysis and recommendations that materially improve management decision-making.

- Build scalable frameworks and automation rather than relying on manual processes.

title: Associate Manager/ Manager – Finance & Accounts
description:
**About Shalina Healthcare:**

We are one of the largest, privately owned pharmaceutical businesses across Africa (Global Head Quarters- Dubai, UAE) with recent forays across multiple, new lines of businesses including Diagnostics and Consumer Healthcare.

Over the last 40 years, operating across multiple geographies, we have made it our mission to provide quality medicines to those who need it the most. We manufacture and distribute branded prescription and over-the-counter pharmaceutical and consumer products, across a broad range of therapeutic groups, including anti-malarial, antibiotics, anti-inflammatory, respiratory, gastrointestinal, nutrition, oral care, dermatology, sexual well-being, and antiseptic liquids & soaps. Leading brands, great teams and a focus on influencing the well-being of people have made Shalina a household name in Africa.

We have a track record few can match, and our brands are among the most trusted in Africa. We are proud of our history and have big ambitions for the future. Our vision for 2030 is to be the health champion of Sub-Saharan Africa. To achieve this, we are looking for the right people to join us and create a lasting impact not just within our company but on the communities that we serve; people who identify with our Core Values and are as passionate about our Mission as we are.

**What you become a part of:**

The successful candidate will lead and coordinate the Group's financial consolidation and reporting processes, working closely with subsidiaries across multiple geographies to ensure accurate, consistent and timely financial reporting.

The role will involve managing quarterly and annual consolidation, ensuring compliance with IFRS / IAS requirements, coordinating Group audits and supporting complex accounting matters arising from business combinations, acquisitions and restructuring initiatives.

You will also contribute to strengthening financial controls, improving reporting processes through automation and supporting strategic financial initiatives across the Group.

**What to expect:**

**1.**
**Group Consolidation, Financial Reporting & Audit-**

* Lead the quarterly and annual Group consolidation process, ensuring timely and accurate reporting across subsidiaries
* Prepare full sets of multi-currency consolidated & standalone financial statements in compliance with all relevant reporting and accounting standards.
* Prepares necessary workings for IFRS / IAS related aspects such as leases, financials instruments, hyper-inflation accounting & business combinations.

**2.**
**Strategic Finance & Business Support -**

* Provide support on strategic projects relating to mergers, acquisitions, joint arrangements.
* Support business decisions by evaluating accounting impacts of new business events, projects, joint ventures, acquisitions, or business combinations.
* Collaborate closely with regional teams to respond to queries from external, internal, and state auditors, providing requested information, explanations, supporting evidence, and managing interpretations to ensure timely audit closures.
* Support corporate tax compliances including Group transfer pricing requirements
* Prepare working capital and cash flow analysis
* Improvement of internal control through proper review of financial information, processes and guiding teams on corrective steps

**3.**
**Systems, Automation & Process Improvement-**

* Drive improvements in the Group consolidation and financial reporting processes through standardisation and automation.
* Support the implementation and enhancement of consolidation tools and financial reporting systems.
* Collaborate with IT and Finance teams on system enhancements and process improvements.
* Identify opportunities to improve reporting accuracy, efficiency and turnaround time through technology.

**Essential qualifications & experience:**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accountancy, professional Accounting Qualification (ACCA, CA) is highly preferred.
* 4 7 years of relevant post-qualification experience in financial accounting and consolidation.
* Prior experience in a similar role within pharmaceuticals, consumer goods, or adjacent industries is mandatory.
* Hands-on experience in foreign currency consolidation and multi-currency financial reporting is mandatory.
* Strong practical knowledge of IFRS / IAS standards and their application.
* Exposure to working with a Big Four audit firm is an added advantage.

**Desired skills & attributes:**

* Experience implementing consolidation automation tools such as 'Emerge' or similar platforms is highly preferable.
* Knowledge & experience in MS Navision/ Business Central or equivalent ERP systems is an advantage.
* Strong knowledge and experience in applying IFRS standards.
* Deep understanding of accounting principles and procedures.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent consulting and communication skills, with the ability to build effective stakeholder relationships.
* High attention to detail, time management, and cross-functional coordination skills.
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a dynamic environment
* Self-motivated and able to work independently while managing deliverables.
* Experience working in cross-cultural and diverse teams.

**Why Join Us?**

* Be part of a fast-growing, mission-led organization transforming healthcare access in Africa.
* Work alongside passionate teams with deep expertise and commitment.
* Opportunity to work in a dynamic, international environment with significant growth potential.

description:

* Day-to-day hands-on responsibilities for fund operations, fund reporting and investor reporting.

* Strong understanding of U.S. GAAP

* Strong proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint and Word (e.g.: complex formulas, macros)
* Experience with Power BI, Tableau or other business intelligence tools, a plus

* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high growth environment.
* Highly motivated team player with a strong work ethic.
* Flexibility in switching priorities or assisting the team when called to over personal tasks
* Highest degree of integrity, motivation and intellectual curiosity
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills - Ability to analyze and summarize complex information both verbally and in writing with colleagues in the United States
* Strong problem-solving and analytical skills - research and leverage available resources to accomplish the task at hand
* Ability to multi-task, prioritize/manage deadlines.
* Intermediate or advanced Excel user.
* Excellent organizational and interpersonal skills; attention to detail and timelines required
* Knowledge of private equity structures, fixed income securities, debt instruments, alternative investments, securitization, or other investment products preferred
* Proven experience of collaborating with teams in remote locations to ensure efficiency, effectiveness and high level of supervisory oversight
* Comfort in dealing with ambiguity and uncertainty in a dynamic and fast-paced environment
* Energetic, self-motivated, and team-oriented approach; a zest for challenges in a fast-paced, dynamic environment – often under pressure to meet demanding deadlines
* Strong work ethic, an entrepreneurial spirit and a desire to learn
* Dependable, great attitude, highly motivated and a team player

Principal, Strategic Partnerships

title: Associate- Finance Operations (Collections) - Contract
description:
**About the Role :**

We are looking for a Collections Analyst to own collections and receivables follow-up across our 1,300+ customers, while supporting dashboard operations and accounts payable within our Fin-Ops team.

You will work closely with Finance, Sales, Sales Operations, Product, and Engineering to ensure invoices are collected on time and billing is accurate. The role needs strong attention to detail, comfort with large datasets, and the tact to follow up with customers while keeping relationships intact. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role for someone who enjoys working with numbers, systems, and cross-functional stakeholders.

**What will you do :**

* **Collections & Receivables:**
  Follow up on outstanding invoices through reminders, calls, and escalations; maintain AR ageing reports and prioritise overdue accounts; track promises-to-pay, disputes, and short payments; coordinate with Sales and Customer Success to resolve blockers; apply cash and reconcile receipts against open invoices; calculate and collect MAU, email, and WhatsApp usage overages; and share collection updates and bad-debt inputs at month-end.
* **Dashboard & Account Support:**
  Create trial accounts, provision plans and add-ons, close SFDC cases within the 24-hour SLA, test billing modules for new launches, and review closed-won contracts to validate billing terms and IACV.
* **Accounts Payable Support:**
  Process vendor invoices by verifying against POs, coding, and posting; prepare payment runs; manage vendor reconciliations; ensure compliance with approval workflows, tax requirements, and payment terms; and assist with accruals and AP ageing reviews.
* **Reporting & MIS:**
  Publish collections MIS covering AR ageing, DSO, collection efficiency, and overdue trends; prepare monthly C4S, data-usage, and self-serve reports.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Resolve dashboard and billing-related issues in coordination with Product and Engineering; support Sales and Sales Ops with overage and invoice queries; and maintain effective, customer-first communication with customers and internal stakeholders.

**What are we looking for ?**

* Graduate in Commerce, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
* 0–1 years in collections, AR/AP, billing, or order-to-cash; SaaS experience preferred.
* Open to working in shifts
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets (lookups, pivots, large data, reconciliation).
* Working knowledge of AR/AP, ageing analysis, and cash application.
* Ability to extract billing and payment terms from contracts and order forms.
* Strong numerical accuracy and process discipline in deadline-driven work.
* Clear communication, with the tact to follow up with customers and senior stakeholders.
* Strong ownership and attention to detail.

**Contract Terms**

* Fixed-term employment contract for 6 months from the date of joining.
* Shift-based working will be required.
* Extension or conversion to a permanent role may be considered based on individual performance and business requirements.

**Why join us**

* Contribute to a product backed by 11 technology patents, showcasing industry-leading innovation.
* You are passionate about technology and its impact on the high-growth mobile technology space
* Power personalized engagement at scale, processing over 30 billion events daily and reaching 3+ billion devices worldwide.
* Flourish in an Environment that Nurtures Growth and Curiosity

**Learn More**

Get to know us better before you apply!

Check out our product documentation, engineering blog, and customer stories to see how we work and what we value.

title: Accounting Lead- OTC
description:
**Your Tasks**
The Accounting Lead – Order to Cash (OTC) is responsible for managing the end-to-end OTC finance process, including credit management, collections, cash application, and dispute resolution. The role requires strong business partnering with internal stakeholders and direct interaction with external customers to resolve disputes, ensure timely collections, and maintain accounting hygiene. The incumbent will collaborate closely with Sales, Customer Service, Sales Controlling, Tax, Accounting, and other related functions to drive efficient cash flow and compliance with global standards. The key responsibilities are:
  
  

* Order To Cash Operations
* Oversee the end-to-end Order to Cash (OTC) process, ensuring accuracy, timeliness, and compliance with internal controls.
* Monitor and manage the customer credit portfolio, including periodic credit reviews, credit limit updates, and mitigation of credit risks.
* Credit & Collections Management
* Forecast collections and support cash flow planning activities.
* Ensure timely follow-up on outstanding claims and collections with customers.
* Monitor customer deductions and drive quick resolution by coordinating with Sales, Customer Service, Sales Controlling, and Warehouse teams.
* Cash Application & Accounting
* Monitor cash application of customer payments and ensure strong accounting hygiene.
* Ensure adherence to global accounting and OTC process standards.
* Stakeholder & Customer Management
* Maintain regular and effective communication with external customers to resolve disputes and collection-related issues.
* Build and sustain strong working relationships with Sales teams and customers.
* Partner closely with internal stakeholders across functions including Accounting, Tax, Sales Controlling, and Customer Service.
* Reporting, Compliance & Audits
* Track, report, and ensure compliance with global OTC KPIs.
* Prepare performance and management reports for local and global stakeholders.
* Support data requirements and documentation for internal and external audits.
* Process Improvement
* Stay current with industry trends and best practices in credit and OTC management.
* Actively contributes to continuous improvement initiatives related to credit evaluation, deduction management, and OTC processes

**Your Profile**

* Qualification in Accounting (CMA / CWA / CA Inter) and/or a master’s degree in business administration with specialization in Finance and Accounting or a related field.
* 5-8 Years of experience in consumer product Industries.
* Hands-on knowledge of SAP ERP or similar enterprise resource planning systems.
* Sound understanding of general ledger accounting and accounts payable processes
* Strong communication skills and experience working with international stakeholders
* Team spirit, proactive and objective oriented with great attention to detail.

At Beiersdorf, we want to help people feel good about their skin – and our commitment goes far beyond caring for skin. For 140 years, we have developed innovative skin and body care products for well-known brands such as NIVEA, Eucerin, La Prairie, Hansaplast, and Labello. We act according to our purpose, WE CARE BEYOND SKIN, and take responsibility for our consumers, our employees, the environment and society.
  
  
Behind every brand, every product and every accomplishment are our more than 20,000 employees. It is for them that we live an inclusive culture of respect and trust that is strongly aligned with our values – CARE, COURAGE, SIMPLICITY and TRUST. We also embrace diversity by valuing the uniqueness of each individual and being committed to equal opportunities for all.

Your responsible recruiter is Kalyani Deshmukh.

About Russell Investments, Mumbai:
  
  
Russell Investments is a leading outsourced financial partner and global investment solutions firm providing a wide range of investment capabilities to institutional investors, financial intermediaries, and individual investors around the world. Based in Goregaon (East), you will have the opportunity to work alongside colleagues around the world, contribute to meaningful initiatives, and build your career in a collaborative and inclusive environment. The Mumbai office operates with varying shifts to support collaboration across global time zones.
  
  
For more information, please visit https://www.russellinvestments.com.
  
  
Job Description:
  
  
**Graduate Trainee/Apprenticeship – Global Operations**
Apprenticeship is a 12-month program that will provide a comprehensive learning experience, blending theoretical knowledge with on-the-job training. Over the 12-month period, apprentices at Russell Investments will gain valuable exposure to industry while developing essential soft skills and acclimating to a professional corporate environment.
  
  
**Eligibility**

* Should not be self-employed
* Should not be enrolled under other government-funded programs
* Should not be practicing professionally at the time of application
* Should not be registered on EPF/ ESIC Portal
* Should not have completed their education from a foreign university

Apprentices who enroll should have their Aadhaar seeded with their personal mobile number and personal email address. This is a mandate.
  
  
**About Russell Investments, Mumbai**
Russell Investments is a leading outsourced financial partner and global investment solutions firm providing a wide range of investment capabilities to institutional investors, financial intermediaries, and individual investors around the world. Building on an 87-year legacy of continuous innovation to deliver exceptional value to clients, Russell Investments works every day to improve the financial security of its clients. The firm is the world’s sixth-largest investment adviser, with $1 trillion in assets under advisement (as of June 30, 2022) and $288.3 billion in assets under management (as of March 31, 2023) for clients in 30 countries. title: Senior Finance Manager
description:
**Senior Finance Manager – Accounts & Taxation**

Event Management / Experiential Marketing | Andheri East, Mumbai | Full-Time | 5 to 8 years

Reports to: Head of Finance

**About the role**

Own the complete accounting, taxation and compliance function of an event management business. You will run day-to-day accounts independently and coordinate with management, vendors, clients, banks, auditors and consultants to keep books accurate, reconciled and audit-ready.

**What you will do**

**Accounting and reconciliation**

* End-to-end accounting in Tally: sales, purchases, expenses, receipts, payments, journals, debit/credit notes
* Ledger scrutiny, bank and cash reconciliation, monthly/quarterly/annual closing
* Correct classification of expenses, project costs, revenue, assets, liabilities and provisions

**Receivables, payables and cash flow**

* Client invoicing with correct GST treatment (place of supply, SAC); ageing reports and collections follow-up
* Track client advances, milestone billing, cancellations, refunds and credit adjustments
* Verify vendor invoices against POs/work orders, flag duplicates and tax errors, reconcile vendor statements
* Vendor payouts with TDS/GST checks; track advances, retentions and settlements
* Weekly/monthly cash flow forecasts, working capital planning, and a calendar of statutory and vendor dues

**Taxation and statutory compliance**

* GST: GSTR-1 and 3B filing, GSTR-2B/ITC reconciliation, RCM, advances, notices and GST audit support
* TDS: deduction, deposit, quarterly returns, Form 16A, 26AS/AIS reconciliation, advance tax tracking
* Payroll compliance: PF, ESI, Professional Tax, employee-wise records, coordination with HR and payroll consultants
* LLP filings with your CA/CS: Form 11, Form 8, Form 3 and event-based forms; partner capital and drawings records

**Audit and reporting**

* Prepare schedules, reconciliations and trial balances for statutory, tax and GST audits; close audit observations
* Note: certification and sign-off stay with a practising professional; you handle preparation and coordination
* MIS: P&L, Balance Sheet, cash flow, AR/AP ageing, budget vs actual, event-wise and project-wise profitability, statutory liability summaries
* Flag cost overruns, margin variances and unusual expenses

**Event-specific work**

* Manage accounts for multiple events, exhibitions and activations at once
* Maintain event-wise budgets and margins; coordinate with project and production teams for approved budgets and vendor invoices
* Ensure timely financial closure of each event (final billing and vendor settlement)

**What we are looking for**

* B.Com (mandatory); M.Com/MBA Finance an advantage; CA Inter/CMA Inter preferred
* 5 to 8 years in accounting and taxation, ideally in events, exhibitions, advertising, production or project-based services
* Strong practical knowledge of GST, TDS, PF/ESI/PT and LLP filings
* Advanced Excel (XLOOKUP, INDEX-MATCH, SUMIFS, Pivots, Power Query) and TallyPrime
* Proven record of independently running end-to-end accounts and working with auditors and tax consultants
* Detail-oriented, deadline-driven, commercially aware, with high integrity and ownership

**How you will be measured**

* Accuracy and timeliness of entries, month-end closes and reconciliations
* On-time statutory filings and payments, with no preventable penalties or interest
* Fewer errors, duplicates and unreconciled balances
* Timely vendor payouts and receivable follow-ups
* Audit schedule turnaround and closure of observations
* Quality of event-wise MIS and cash flow reporting
* Efficiency gains through Excel automation and process controls

You will bring a good understanding of P&L and balance sheet management, a focus on financial controls and governance, and the ability to identify, communicate and resolve financial risks and issues. Working closely with Finance Business Partners and the wider Financial Controller community, you will help promote consistency, best practice and high-quality financial reporting across the business.

The opportunity to work for an organization that has a clear sense of purpose, is values-based and helps colleagues to develop professionally and personally through our range of people development programmes.
  
  
A full-time permanent role
  
  
**The role**

* Ensure that monthly, quarterly and annual performance is accurately reported and ready for review by Business Finance in accordance with published timetables.
* Ensure that all material variances to Budget, latest forecast and Prior Year are explained clearly and concisely
* Support the annual Global Functions budgeting cycle by preparing and reviewing budget submissions, ensuring underlying assumptions are robust and aligned with business strategy.
* Collaborate with budget owners to ensure cost lines (e.g., personnel, L&P, insurance, promotional costs) reflect accurate phasing and expected activity.
* Prepare periodic Global Functions forecasts (i.e. 0+12, 3+9, 6+6 & 9+3 cycles) to assess whether the business remains on track to deliver its budget.
* Update forecast assumptions through engagement with stakeholders, including headcount planning, staff movements, cross-charges and major cost drivers.
* Work with the Finance Shared Service Centre, the Statutory Compliance and GL teams, as well as Business Managers to gain a full understanding of financial performance.
* Work with fellow controllers, the Head of Finance Controlling and the Head of Financial accounting to ensure that common processes with common templates are followed.
* Provide answers to questions from Class & Advisory Finance and management in relation to financial performance; and where answers are not known, to take responsibility for obtaining the answers in a timely manner.
* Act as an interface between Class & Advisory Finance and the Statutory Compliance Team, GL team and the Finance Shared Service Centre, helping to resolve any reporting and process issues.
* Ensure that the Balance Sheet is reviewed and understood and that any risks and opportunities in the Balance Sheet are clearly communicated to Class & Advisory Finance in liaison with the GL team.
* Respond to audit queries in relation to P&L and Balance Sheet movements. Ensuring the responses are clear and concise and reflect the risk to the reported results.

**What You Bring**

* Degree qualified with a management accounting/commercial accounting background; a recognised professional accountancy qualification (ACA/ACCA/CIMA) and significant experience of operating in an international finance function, with medium to large matrix structure.
* Being regarded as a trusted and credible resource by key stakeholders within both business and/or area management teams; able to build good relationships. Have a practical approach, visible across the businesses with good communication and other interpersonal skills.
* A motivated and effective collaborator who can establish and maintain good relationships with business leaders and across the Finance community.
* Ability to demonstrate a thorough understanding of a solid control framework.

* Is able to self-manage and prioritize tasks towards meeting goals
* Is effective at solving problems, trouble-shooting and making timely decisions
* Is motivated and willing to take initiative
* Communicates in a structured way and has ability to present technical ideas in user-friendly language
* Displays a team spirit, particularly in a multicultural environment
* Responds positively to learning opportunities and is comfortable stepping out of own comfort zone

Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a Senior Analyst – BCG Vantage on our Client Focus path within BCG's Risk and Compliance Practice Area, your focus will be supporting the Risk Analytics team and will work in a growing global team, delivering value to clients via individual expertise and/or institutionalized BCG Vantage assets (products, tools, data, workshops, frameworks, surveys, domain-specific data and related expertise, etc.). You will contribute on cases and proposals by contributing relevant analysis and insights and help case teams create strong impact for clients. While contributing to client cases, workshops and proposals, occasional travel to serve clients onsite during staffing assignments is expected to understand client requirements, and design / develop solutions.
  
  
You will support commercialization efforts for the topic/sector working, in conjunction with business leaders, through contributing analysis and insights to proposals, client workshops and marketing materials. Additionally, as a Senior Analyst – BCG Vantage, you will contribute to developing intellectual property & assets for the business and assist in onboarding and training junior colleagues based on your topic/sector expertise. You will apply your subject matter knowledge to support project proposals, including outside-in analyses, competitive benchmarking, and maturity assessments. You will contribute to the development of client-ready deliverables, including presentations, white papers, maturity models, and regulatory trackers and will support ongoing knowledge curation efforts, including vendor landscape evaluations and toolkit development for the compliance and risk domain.
  
  
You will collaborate with case teams to support clients in identifying, assessing, and managing regulatory, financial, and non-financial risks across a range of domains (especially credit risk). You will conduct research and analysis on relevant regulations, risk and compliance frameworks, and industry benchmarks to generate actionable insights. You will liaise with specialized teams (e.g., BCG X, Risk Expert Consultants) to co-develop optimal solutions and ensure seamless delivery of projects and will work alongside consultants to collect, synthesize, and analyze case team learnings, contributing to the development of new knowledge assets such as case vignettes, frameworks, and methodologies.
  
  
The R&C PA helps clients to manage key risks strategically, to advance organizational resilience and establish a profound risk culture, by defining and transforming R&C operating models. We cover a diverse set of topics across financial and non-financial risks and assist in enabling clients' strategy through technical enablement with the help of our deep expertise in risk modelling, analytics and digitization.
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  

* 2+ years of consulting experience in the Banking/Financial Services, Insurance (in India) sectors and Credit risk; candidates with consulting experience strongly preferred
* In lieu of consulting experience, 3+ years minimum industry experience required; 4-6+ years of industry experience strongly preferred in Banking/Financial Services, Insurance (in India) in financial risk and regulations - Credit Risk (required), additional Risk types (bonus)

title: US Revenue Accountant
description:
The role will be responsible for supporting revenue accounting and revenue recognition activities, including contract review, revenue adjustments, deferred revenue reconciliation, journal entries, and month-end close activities. The position will also act as a backup for key approval processes and collaborate with Billing, Sales, Finance, and Revenue Operations teams to ensure accurate and timely revenue reporting.

Key Responsibilities

1. Contract & Approval Management

· Act as a backup for Ironclad approvals and ensure contracts are reviewed and processed in a timely manner.

· Act as a backup for Salesforce (SFDC) approvals.

· Review and approve contract setups, including revenue recognition and billing schedules, as a backup to the designated approver.

· Review contracts and ensure revenue and billing arrangements are aligned with contractual terms and accounting requirements.

2. Revenue Recognition & Accounting

· Review revenue arrangements and ensure revenue is recognized accurately in accordance with applicable accounting policies.

· Book subscription revenue journal entries (JEs) during the month-end close.

· Manage Advisory – Fulfill Revenue recognition activities.

· Prepare and post Advisory revenue journal entries.

· Review and process revenue adjustments as required.

· Coordinate and process billing adjustments related to revenue adjustments.

· Review and account for Catalyst Connect revenue.

· Support revenue accounting.

3. Deferred Revenue & Reconciliation

· Review deferred revenue schedules and perform reconciliation against the general ledger and supporting reports.

· Investigate and resolve variances identified during deferred revenue reconciliation.

· Ensure that deferred revenue balances are accurate and properly supported.

· Review unbilled revenue balances and supporting schedules.

· Perform unbilled revenue reclassification entries as required.

· Perform short-term/long-term (ST/LT) revenue reclassifications and ensure appropriate accounting treatment.

4. Month-End Close & Financial Reporting

· Perform Income Statement tie-outs and investigate discrepancies.

· Prepare and post required revenue-related journal entries as part of the month-end close process.

· Review revenue, deferred revenue, unbilled revenue, and related accounts for completeness and accuracy.

· Ensure all assigned revenue accounting activities are completed within established month-end close timelines.

· Maintain appropriate supporting documentation for journal entries, reconciliations, and adjustments.

5. Analysis & Issue Resolution

· Analyze revenue and billing data to identify discrepancies, unusual movements, and accounting issues.

· Work closely with Billing, Sales, Finance, Revenue Recognition, and other cross-functional teams to resolve issues.

· Support investigation and resolution of contract, billing, and revenue recognition issues.

· Ensure appropriate follow-up and timely resolution of outstanding items.

6. Additional Responsibilities

· Handle miscellaneous finance and revenue accounting tasks as required.

· Support process improvements and automation initiatives related to revenue accounting.

· Assist with ad-hoc reporting, analysis, and management requests.

· Provide backup support to team members during leave or other periods of unavailability.

· Ensure compliance with company policies, accounting guidelines, and internal controls.

Key Skills & Competencies

· Strong understanding of revenue recognition and accounting principles.

· Knowledge of US GAAP / ASC 606 is preferred.

· Experience with NetSuite & its automation functions, Salesforce, Ironclad, or similar ERP/CRM systems.

· Strong understanding of deferred revenue, unbilled revenue, revenue adjustments, and journal entries.

· Good analytical and reconciliation skills.

· Strong attention to detail and accuracy.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet month-end close deadlines.

· Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

· Ability to identify issues, investigate root causes, and recommend solutions.

Preferred Experience

· Bachelor's degree in accounting, Finance, or a related field.

· Experience in Revenue Accounting / Revenue Recognition / Financial Accounting.

· Experience working with SaaS or subscription-based revenue models is an advantage.

· Prior experience with month-end close, reconciliations, journal entries, and financial reporting.

* · Experience with ASC 606 and US GAAP revenue recognition is preferred.

From accounting and financial planning to risk/fraud analysis and payments, our Finance team ensures not only our company’s financial security, but that our customers can buy from us with confidence. Priceline.com – a part of Booking Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: BKNG), a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $130 billion – is looking for a Senior Accountant to join its Accounting team.
  
  
**Why This Job’s a Big Deal**
As a key member of Priceline’s General Ledger Accounting team, this Senior Accountant will ensure the accurate and timely preparation of journal entries and account reconciliations while owning core intercompany accounting activities across Booking Holdings brands, including monthly recording, reconciliation, settlement, reporting, and eliminations.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring strong technical accounting judgment, experience handling intercompany accounting across multiple entities and currencies, and disciplined close execution. They will also have the communication skills and business acumen to partner effectively with teams across Priceline and Booking Holdings, safeguard internal controls, and identify opportunities to improve and automate processes.
  
  
**In This Role You Will Get To**

* Own the monthly intercompany close process for assigned entities, including journal entries, reconciliations, confirmations, settlement, reporting, and elimination support.
* Partner with accounting teams across all Booking Holdings’ brands to ensure intercompany elimination activities are completed accurately and in accordance with the monthly close timeline.
* Exhibit a detailed understanding of all intercompany relationships, including but not limited to revenue share and cost-plus arrangements.
* Maintain and monitor that internal controls are effectively operating for assigned tasks and identify enhancements where gaps are identified.
* Ensure intercompany activity is recorded in accordance with US GAAP, internal accounting policies, and the applicable intercompany agreements.
* Support implementation and ongoing optimization of the BlackLine Intercompany module, including testing, process documentation, controls, and issue resolution.
* Prepare monthly journal entries primarily for intercompany transactions, along with other related tasks
* Prepare monthly reconciliations for assigned balance sheet accounts; investigate and resolve reconciling items, intercompany breaks, aged balances, and timing differences on a timely basis.
* Prepare and analyze monthly and yearly variance explanations for income statement and balance sheet accounts, identifying key drivers of fluctuations.
* Recommend improvements to the efficiency of accounting processes and timeliness of deliverables.
* Contribute to and support special projects in order to create a more efficient and controlled environment (e.g. automation, AI-enabled solutions, ERP implementation, process improvements etc.)

**Who You Are**

* Experience with Oracle, BlackLine and OneStream desired
* 4+ years of accounting experience, including meaningful experience with intercompany accounting, consolidations, or multinational close processes; experience with a U.S. multinational company or Big 4 accounting firm preferred.
* Qualified Chartered Accountant preferred.
* Advanced Excel skills required
* Demonstrated ownership mindset and ability to independently identify, investigate, and resolve issues.
* Highly detail-oriented with strong analytical skills and sound judgment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams.
* Ability to use data, reporting tools, and automation to improve the accuracy and efficiency of recurring accounting activities.
* Demonstrated ability to manage competing priorities and meet close deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Demonstrated history of living the values important to priceline.com: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust. Unquestionable integrity and ethics.

**1. Fund Operations**

* Own end-to-end fund administration including capital calls, drawdowns, distributions, and NAV computation in coordination with the fund administrator and custodian.
* Maintain and reconcile the investment register, portfolio valuation workings, and fund-level waterfall calculations on a periodic basis.
* Manage documentation and execution workflows for new investments, follow-ons, and exits, including term sheets, subscription agreements, and board resolutions.
* Coordinate with registrar, custodian, fund administrator, legal counsel, and auditors to ensure smooth operational closure of all fund activities.
* Track portfolio company reporting timelines and consolidate data for internal investment committee reviews and quarterly portfolio updates.

**2. Finance & Accounts**

* Oversee fund-level accounting including maintenance of books, preparation of management accounts, and coordination with auditors for statutory and tax audits.
* Manage fee calculations including management fees, carried interest, and hurdle computations in line with the PPM and LPA provisions.
* Track fund expenses, vendor payments, and ensure timely filing of GST returns, TDS, and other applicable direct and indirect tax obligations.
* Prepare financial statements for the fund entity and any associated SPVs, ensuring compliance with applicable accounting standards (Ind AS / IGAAP as applicable).
* Support the preparation of annual budgets, cash flow forecasts, and expense reports for management and trustee review.

**3. Compliance**

* Ensure ongoing compliance with SEBI AIF Regulations 2012 and circulars, including periodic filings, disclosures, and reporting obligations to the regulator.
* Maintain and update the fund’s compliance calendar; coordinate with legal counsel on amendments to fund documents and regulatory submissions.
* Oversee KYC/AML processes for existing and new investors, ensuring documentation is complete and refreshed as per PMLA and SEBI requirements.
* Liaise with the fund trustee, compliance officer, and legal advisors on any regulatory queries, show cause notices, or ad hoc SEBI communications.
* Monitor changes in SEBI, RBI, FEMA, and income tax regulations relevant to AIF operations and proactively flag implications to the investment team.

**4. Investor Relations**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for LP queries on capital accounts, tax documents, portfolio updates, and fund-related communications.
* Prepare quarterly and annual investor reports including portfolio performance summaries, capital account statements, and fund-level financial highlights.
* Coordinate the preparation and dispatch of capital call notices, distribution notices, and tax certificates (Form 64C/64D) within stipulated timelines.
* Maintain the investor data room and ensure all fund documents, NAV reports, and compliance certificates are current and accessible to LPs.
* Support fundraising efforts by preparing data room materials, responding to LP due diligence requests, and coordinating onboarding of new investors.

**Qualifications**

* CA, MBA (Finance), or CFA with 4–7 years of relevant experience in an AIF, NBFC, PE/VC fund, or Big 4 advisory firm.
* Strong working knowledge of SEBI AIF Regulations, PMLA/KYC requirements, and fund accounting principles.
* Prior experience handling SEBI filings, investor reporting, and coordination with fund administrators and custodians.
* Proficiency in Excel; experience with fund administration software or accounting tools is a plus.
* Excellent written communication skills; ability to draft investor communications, compliance memos, and board presentations independently.

title: Accounting Analyst – General Ledger
description:
**Job Purpose:**

Maintain complete, accurate and timely accounting records by preparing and posting entries in the designated accounting system, reconciling balances and supporting a controlled monthly close.

**Key Responsibilities:**

Daily deliverable:

Post approved journals for accruals, prepayments, payroll allocations, fixed assets, bank and other GL transactions; validate supporting documents, account codes, cost centres and project/grant tags; maintain journal logs and supporting schedules; reconcile GL accounts and investigate differences; assist with opening-balance uploads, master-data checks, system testing and month-end close; provide clean schedules to FP&A and audit teams. Escalate unsupported or incorrectly classified entries rather than posting them.

**Core Skills / Technical Capabilities:**

Solid debit/credit, accrual and double-entry accounting; journal preparation and GL reconciliations; basic financial statements; proficiency in Excel (lookups, pivots, reconciliations); accuracy in accounting software; documentation and audit-trail discipline.

**Metrics / KPIs to be Handled:**

Journal posting accuracy and timeliness; percentage of journals with complete support; reconciliation completion by deadline; unreconciled item ageing; month-end close task completion; correction/reversal rate; master-data coding accuracy.

**Qualifications:**

**Essential:**
B.Com or equivalent accounting qualification; strong practical understanding of basic accounting principles.

**Preferred:**
M.Com, CA Inter/CMA Inter or relevant accounting-system certification.

**Experience:**

**Essential:**
Practical exposure to bookkeeping, journal entries, ledgers and reconciliations; applicants from accounting or audit firms are welcome where hands-on accounting knowledge is demonstrated.

**Advantageous:**

1–3 years in GL or accounting operations; month-end close, accounting-system use, multi-cost-centre/project coding or NPO experience.

**Personal Qualities & Skills:**

**Specific:**
Methodical, detail-oriented, willing to verify entries and ask questions when evidence is insufficient.

**General:**

Dependable, receptive to feedback, discreet with financial data and comfortable learning new systems and processes.

**Job Purpose**
