**Key Accountabilities (1/6)**
**Monitor Slow moving / Near Expiry RMPM Inventory in India and ensure liquidation plans are in place to minimize inventory write off.**

* Coordinate with planning cluster and align slow moving inventory target for the year.
* Prepare and circulate slow moving MIS covering cluster wise actual slow moving vs target / LE comparison.
* Participate in periodic inventory performance review with respective cluster and ensure reason for slow-moving liquidation plan and timeline are available and updated in SAP.
* Prepare monthly slow-moving projections for 6 months and ensure liquidations plan are available and updated in SAP. Inventory without liquidation plan is highlighted as risk inventory and discussed in respective forum to minimize inventory write off risk.

**Key Accountabilities (2/6)**
**Monitor Slow moving / Near Expiry FG Inventory in India for export market and ensure liquidation plans are in place to minimize inventory write off.**

* Prepare and circulate monthly MIS on slow-moving / Near expiry inventory
* Discuss risk inventory with Business to ensure liquidation plan are available to minimize inventory write off risk.
* Evaluate inventory provisions where liquidation plans are not available, align with business and communicate to costing team on monthly basis for inventory provision

**Prepare and circulate various MIS, support MOR review and adhoc analysis as required**

* Prepare and circulate Monthly slow-moving MIS, Export FG near expiry, Consumption v/s Receipts.
* Prepare presentations on slow-moving RMPM inventory, Export FG inventory, Covid Portfolio, High value inventory coverage analysis for monthly operational review (MOR) with Global Supply chain head.
* Drive Governance through Dashboards as far as possible to reduce man hours.

**Key Accountabilities (3/6)**
**Validate disposal proposals, monitor disposal progress and outstanding receivables.**

* Evaluate all disposal proposal and liaison with procurement to get better rate and generate revenue and minimize CoPE.
* Prepare and circulate weekly MIS on pending disposal status and driving governance meeting with planning and procurement for early disposal action.
* Review outstanding receivables due to disposal sale and follow up with stake holders for timely collection / accounts clearing.

**Evaluate high value purchase requisitions and assist team lead in releasing PR in SAP**

* Evaluate purchase requisitions basis business demand, stock in hand and open purchase orders.
* Validate data source of purchase requisitions raised for strategic buy / supply disruption etc

**Key Accountabilities (4/6)**
**Continuously evaluate existing process, propose process simplification and automation, and drive its implementation**

* Evaluate existing process, propose simplification / automation initiatives and align with respective stakeholders for implementation.
* Coordinate with IT team on automation design and ensure proper financial controls are in place.
* Act as Finance partner for various IT and SCM automation projects (Slow Moving, FG etc).

**Key Accountabilities (5/6)**
**Monitor India RMPM COPE and discussions across CFT for reduction of same**

* Participate and have regular discussion with CFT for reduction of India RMPM COPE
* Preparation and analysis of COPE so as to ensure reduction in cost control.

**Key Accountabilities (6/6)**
**Monitor Export Freight and preparation of MIS**

* Discussions with CFT to check Air Sea Mix and have regular discussions with Planners to track Export Freight and thereby ensuring reduction in overall Air freight cost
* Prepare necessary MIS to track and monitor Export Freight.

* Dealing with multiple stakeholders of Supply Chain function across Cipla.

**Overcome by:**
Conducting regular meetings, regular monitoring of the action plan and follow ups providing timely reports/regular follow ups/in-person meeting.
  
  

* High volume disposal transactions and ensuring physical dispatch before quotation / inventory expiry.

**Overcome by**
– Prioritising high value items, sending regular update and continuous follow up.
  
  
**Key Interactions (1/2)**

* Cluster heads, Unit planners, Unit Stores.
* Business Unit, Procurement & planning team for Inventory optimization
* SAP, IT teams (need-based) for IT development of SCM and simplification projects.
* SCC Team Members

**Key Interactions (2/2)**

* External Consultants (Addressing need-based Data-related, SAP-related queries)
* Statutory Auditor.

**Dimensions**

* FG inventory for export BU worth 250- 300 Cr
* Processing ~150-200 Disposal transaction amounting to ~43-50 Cr.
* Approval of PR > 1 Cr - ~ 450 PR.

description:
**Business Unit:**
Financial And Valuation Advisory
  
  
**Industry:**
Portfolio Valuation
  
  
**Overview**
Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.
  
  
**Financial and Valuation Advisory**
Over the past 50+ years, Houlihan Lokey has established one of the largest worldwide financial and valuation advisory practices. Our transaction expertise and leadership in the field of valuation inspire confidence in the financial executives, boards of directors, special committees, investors, and business owners we serve. In 2025, LSEG ranked us the No. 1 global M&A fairness opinion advisor over the past 25 years. Our stability, integrity, technical leadership, and global capabilities make us a trusted advisor for clients worldwide, across a wide range of services, including the Transaction Opinions, Transaction Advisory Services, Corporate Valuation Advisory Services, Portfolio Valuation and Fund Advisory Services, Real Estate Valuation and Advisory Services, and Dispute Resolution Consulting practices.
  
  
**Structured Products Valuation Advisory**
Drawing on our extensive experience analyzing, structuring, securitizing, underwriting, investing in, and trading whole loans and structured credit instruments, our professionals employ thorough analytical methods and powerful proprietary modeling techniques. Our valuation process incorporates robust market data to provide clients with superior valuation and advisory services that reflect current market developments for all structured products.
  
  
Our professionals have analyzed multibillion-dollar portfolios of individual securities, whole loans, and everything in between on behalf of originators, hedge funds, private equity funds, banks, insurance companies, fund administrators, and other financial institutions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
The Financial Analyst position presents an excellent career opportunity for you to join our rapidly growing firm. Financial Analysts within our Financial Valuation Advisory Services business are fully integrated members of our engagement teams. You will work with a dedicated, highly talented staff of professionals who will give you a broad exposure to many issues and concerns affecting businesses today.
  
  
We offer a unique opportunity to work on a wealth of projects that provide exposure to various financial advisory challenges, including the valuation of complex securities. You will also have an opportunity to interact with clients on active engagements and participate in the firm’s marketing efforts. After completing training specific to certain valuation techniques, databases and tools, your general responsibilities will include the following:
  
  

* Analyzing and valuing various structured products, asset-backed loans, loan pools and other illiquid securities
* Determining relevant valuation assumptions based on historical performance, collateral type, and economic scenarios
* Utilizing a discounted cash flows framework to derive value indications at appropriate market discount margins / yields
* Performing market research; calibrating proprietary valuation models to incorporate market-based assumptions
* Reviewing and compiling published financial information, such as industry research reports, remittance data, and market data across a wide range of asset classes
* Preparing client deliverables including valuation reports, pitch materials and information requests
* Participating in due diligence meetings/discussions and drafting responses to auditor questions regarding valuation analyses prepared by Houlihan Lokey
* Participating in presenting valuation analyses and conclusions internally to review committees, externally to our clients’ senior management and boards of directors, and to fiduciaries
* Performing quantitative and qualitative assessments on distribution reports, financial statement, and other sources of information, as required
* Assisting in the researching and reporting on (a) general economic conditions, (b) industry-specific conditions and trends, and (c) various investment attributes of illiquid securities
* Assisting with sales and marketing initiatives for prospective and existing clients
* Performing other ad-hoc research, analytics, and support for the FVA project teams as required

**Qualifications**
The environment at Houlihan Lokey is collegial and entrepreneurial and, as such, rewards staff with substantial responsibility and interaction with senior-level professionals and clients. The ideal candidate thinks strategically, is motivated, detail oriented, creative, outgoing, possesses strong quantitative skills and exhibits exceptional work ethic. The Financial Analyst will primarily support Structured Products valuation professionals in the Portfolio Valuation & Advisory Services practice and will gain broad exposure to a wide range of assets.
  
  
The following general qualifications are required:
  
  

* The ideal candidate should have 1-3 years of work experience
* Completed CFA Level 1
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in finance, accounting, business, applied mathematics, statistics, engineering, or equivalent quantitative field
* A fundamental understanding of financial valuation theory, methodologies, and applications
* Understanding of basic probability and statistical concepts
* Strong analytical abilities including demonstrated ability to model discounted cash flows
* Strong problem solving skills and the ability to work through complex financial models to determine the key assumptions, implicit caveats and limitations
* Strong knowledge of Excel
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills; ability to prepare reports and presentations to team and clients, including graphic and written sections
* Demonstrated ability to work cooperatively with team members
* Ability to work independently in a fast paced environment
* An exceptional work ethic and attention to detail
* Ability to manage multiple projects and interact with clients and internal management
* Flexibility to travel to client site for due diligence meetings as required

The following specific qualifications are desirable but not required:
  
  

* Knowledge of multiple valuation techniques
* Knowledge of various structured products including Residential and Commercial Mortgage Securities (RMBS and CMBS), Asset-Backed Securities (ABS), and Collateralized Loan Obligations (CLO)
* Knowledge of and experience with statistical packages and data sources such as Intex and Bloomberg

***We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.***

Job Title

Piramal Critical Care (PCC) is a global pharmaceutical business with operations across 7+ entities spanning the US, UK, Netherlands, Italy, India, South Africa and Australia. We are looking for a finance professional to support our FP&A, MIS, planning and finance transformation agenda. Low

CA / MBA Finance with 5–8 years of experience in FP&A, MIS or commercial finance, preferably in
  
  
a global / multi-entity environment.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Monthly Management Reporting & MIS

+ Support timely release of monthly sales flash on the 2nd working day; coordinate with entity controllers and 3PL teams to validate data accuracy and resolve discrepancies.
+ Prepare and consolidate monthly MIS reports across PCC entities, including P&L, balance sheet, product margin and KPI schedules.
+ Execute the monthly MIS production cycle through Anaplan, replacing the legacy Excel-based process.
+ Process inter-company stock margin elimination workings, including SKU-level reconciliation, GIT inclusion, entity-level validation and analytical checks.
+ Prepare variance analysis (Actual vs. Budget vs. Prior Year), supporting schedules, exhibits and analytics requested by senior management.

* Budgeting, Forecasting & Long-Range Planning

+ Assist in preparation of the annual budget across PCC entities, including data collection, template population, consolidation and validation of submissions.
+ Collect, validate and consolidate forecast inputs from Sales, SCM, Site Controllers and Corporate Finance; assist in preparing weekly revenue trackers, monthly EBITDA forecasts and rolling outlook submissions.
+ Support preparation of financial performance statements and supporting workings for Long-Range Planning (LRP) cycles.
+ Prepare profitability analysis across products, customers, entities and businesses (IA, IP, Other Pharma, ITT, CHG).
+ Support cashflow forecasting and working capital reporting workings in coordination with site finance and corporate finance teams.

* Anaplan & Qlik Operations

+ Maintain Anaplan modules covering Actuals, Budget, Forecast, P&L, Balance Sheet and Cashflow reporting across PCC's global entities.
+ Execute data uploads, mapping updates, hierarchy maintenance, version freeze/rollover and module validations.
+ Maintain Qlik dashboards covering Revenue, Product Margin, AR Ageing, MTD Daily Sales, Reporting Margin Variation and Fixed Asset reporting.
+ Execute Qlik rollover activities for FY budget cycles; ensure smooth data flow between Anaplan, EDP and Qlik.
+ Provide inputs to Business IT and EDP teams on AR Intelligence dashboard requirements (SAP S/4HANA customer master + Azure sales master linkage).
+ Liaise with PwC, Anaplan technical teams and Piramal IT on day-to-day issue resolution and minor enhancements.

* SAP S/4HANA Transition Support

+ Support readiness for SAP ECC → S/4HANA migration (India go-live Apr 2026; rest of entities Dec 2026).
+ Execute mapping updates for revenue pipelines, GL mappings, profit centre, cost centre hierarchy, capex/loan/manual GL logic and product master integration.
+ Coordinate with PwC, SAP team, EDP and the broader project team on parallel-run validations during transition.

* Daily Sales & 3PL Reporting

+ Maintain the MTD Daily Sales dashboard; support entity controllers in adoption, capture of manual finance adjustments and reconciliation.
+ Support automation of SAP entries for 3PL sales and manage source file structure changes across geographies.

* Leadership Reporting & Stakeholder Coordination

+ Prepare supporting slides and data exhibits for MBR, PEC, Finance Opscomm, Townhalls, Board decks and ExComm reviews.
+ Coordinate with global finance stakeholders, entity controllers, corporate teams and external partners (PwC) to ensure timely closure of deliverables.
+ Escalate issues and risks to the Chief Manager – Finance in a timely manner.

* Process Documentation & Governance Support

+ Maintain and update Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) for Anaplan modules, Qlik dashboards and MIS processes.
+ Support exception tracking, escalation logs and process review activities.

**Key Competencies**

* Hands-on experience in Anaplan, Qlik Sense, SAP / S/4HANA and advanced Excel; Power BI a plus.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with sharp attention to detail.
* Exposure to system implementation or ERP migration projects preferred.
* Good stakeholder coordination skills across geographies and time zones.
* Process orientation, ownership mindset and ability to deliver under tight deadlines.
* Comfort working in a transformation-heavy, fast-paced environment.
* Digital & AI Skill

+ Leverage AI and automation tools to enhance financial analysis, forecasting, reporting and management insights, improving speed and quality of decision-making.
+ Demonstrate an AI-first mindset by identifying and implementing use cases that simplify FP&A processes, automate repetitive activities and improve finance productivity.

**Why Join Us**
This is an opportunity to be part of a dynamic commercial finance team driving one of the most significant finance transformation journeys within the Piramal Group. You will gain hands-on exposure to Anaplan, Qlik and SAP S/4HANA across a global pharmaceutical business, work closely with senior leadership and contribute meaningfully to building a future-ready finance operating model

title: Research Analyst - US Equity
description:
Job Description – Research Analyst / Senior Research Analyst – US Equities
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai
  
  
**Department:**
Research
  
  
**Experience:**
3–8 Years
  
  
**Industry:**
Capital Markets / Equity Research / Investment Banking / Asset Management
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
We are seeking an experienced US Equity Research Analyst to conduct in-depth fundamental research and analysis of US-listed companies and sectors. The role involves identifying investment opportunities, developing financial models, analysing market trends, and delivering actionable research insights to support investment and trading decisions.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Equity Research: Conduct fundamental research on US-listed companies, sectors, and industries to identify investment opportunities.
* Financial Modelling & Valuation: Develop and maintain financial models, earnings forecasts, and valuation frameworks using DCF, comparable company analysis, and other relevant methodologies.
* Market Analysis: Monitor US equity markets, macroeconomic developments, Federal Reserve policies, earnings announcements, and sector-specific trends.
* Investment Recommendations: Generate actionable investment ideas, stock recommendations, and research reports supported by detailed analysis.
* Earnings & Portfolio Tracking: Analyse quarterly earnings, company guidance, financial performance, and key business developments.
* Research Publications: Prepare company initiation reports, earnings updates, sector outlooks, and market commentaries.
* Stakeholder Collaboration: Work closely with the Research Head, trading desks, and investment teams to provide timely market insights and research support.
* Risk Assessment: Evaluate company-specific, sectoral, valuation, and macroeconomic risks associated with investment recommendations.

Desired Candidate Profile
  
  

* 3–8 years of relevant experience in equity research, preferably covering US equities or global developed markets.
* Strong understanding of US equity markets, listed companies, sector dynamics, and investment strategies.
* Hands-on experience in financial modelling, financial statement analysis, and company valuation.
* Ability to independently research companies, build investment theses, and generate actionable stock ideas.
* Familiarity with Bloomberg, Refinitiv, FactSet, Capital IQ, or similar financial databases.
* Strong analytical, quantitative, report-writing, and presentation skills.
* Understanding of US market regulations, corporate disclosures, and financial reporting standards.
* Willingness to work flexible hours to accommodate US market developments, earnings announcements, and business requirements.

**Educational Qualifications**

* MBA / PGDM in Finance, Economics, or a related discipline.
* CFA / CA or equivalent professional qualifications preferred.

**Preferred Candidate Background**
Professionals from equity research firms, institutional broking houses, investment banks, asset management companies, hedge funds, or global research teams with direct exposure to US-listed equities.
  
  
**Key Hiring Requirement:**
Candidates must have hands-on experience in fundamental equity research, financial modelling, and valuation, with the ability to independently generate well-researched investment ideas on US-listed companies. Direct US equity coverage experience will be strongly preferred.

title: Financial Director
description:
**About the Role**

We're looking for a hands-on Finance Director to run day-to-day financial reporting, cost control and P&L management for a growing, multi-unit hospitality group in Mumbai.

This is an execution-focused role: pulling information out of outlets, kitchens, purchase teams and

vendors, turning it into accurate reporting, and using it to actively manage costs, cash flow and

profitability.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Financial Planning & Budgeting

• Prepare annual budgets, monthly/quarterly forecasts and rolling cash-flow and profitability

projections for the group and each outlet, tracking actuals against budget and chasing down variances.

2. Management Information System (MIS)

• Prepare the group's MIS - daily revenue flash, weekly P&L, monthly management accounts and outlet-

wise P&L - with cost percentages, margins, EBITDA and variance explanations.

3. Cost Control & Profitability

• Monitor food, beverage, labour and operating costs with the F&B Cost Controller; track inventory

variances, wastage and vendor pricing to catch leakage and fix recurring issues with operations and

kitchen teams.

4. Purchase & Vendor Controls

• Run the purchase-order process against budgets and approved rates, track vendor balances and

payment schedules, and benchmark rates to flag duplicate or inflated purchases.
5. Events & Commercial Pricing

• Work out event contribution margins and pricing against minimum-margin requirements, and review

profitability after each event to sharpen future pricing.

6. Cash Flow & Treasury

• Prepare weekly cash-flow forecasts, plan payment runs, track receivables and collections, and flag

cash-flow gaps early.

7. Capex & New Projects

• Prepare pre-opening and project budgets, track capex and vendor commitments against approvals,

and build financial models for new locations.

8. Outlet Financial Accountability

• Set clear monthly targets for each outlet, then walk through performance with the GM every month -

what was budgeted, what actually happened, why, and what's being done about it.

9. Compliance, Accounting & Statutory Matters

• Handle monthly closing, keep books accurate, and coordinate with CAs, auditors and tax consultants

on GST, TDS, income tax and annual audits.

10. Partner Reporting

• Prepare group- and outlet-wise reporting on revenue, margins, EBITDA, cash position and key risks for partner review.

11. Coordination & Follow-Through

• Work alongside the Accounts and Cost Control team day to day, keep SOPs followed on the ground,

and support better systems and less manual reconciliation.

**Skills & Competencies**

• Financial: P&L management, budgeting & forecasting, cash-flow management, cost accounting, variance

analysis, working-capital & capex tracking, statutory compliance.

• Hospitality/Commercial: Restaurant P&L, food & beverage costing, inventory control, vendor

management, event profitability, outlet-level profitability, labour-cost management.

• Systems: Advanced Excel/Google Sheets, accounting/ERP systems, POS and MIS dashboards - used hands- on, daily.

**Personal Attributes**

• Hands-on and detail-oriented - comfortable doing the legwork of pulling numbers together, not just

reviewing what others prepare.

• Organised and analytical, with strong follow-through on chasing information from the right people

until variances are explained.

• Able to work directly with founders, partners, GMs and vendors, and communicate financial

information clearly to non-finance colleagues.

• Most importantly: reliable and thorough - someone who executes and turns raw information into

accurate, timely reporting, every time.

**Key Performance Indicators**

As an Fixed Income Index Operations and Pricing Controls Analyst within the Index Calculation Agent team, you will define, refine, and deliver daily goals that support accurate pricing and valuation control outcomes. You will investigate pricing and valuation movements and communicate clear drivers and impacts to stakeholders and clients. You will improve process resilience through disciplined controls, documentation, and timely issue resolution.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Validate daily third-party price capture for fixed income securities using multiple market sources.
* Investigate price and valuation movements and explain what is driving changes.
* Partner with pricing vendors to resolve data issues quickly and reduce operational risk.
* Monitor daily production runs, identify breaks, and coordinate with technology partners to restore processing.
* Prepare and share daily pricing and market impact summaries with clear context.
* Produce month-end index rebalance and composition reporting, incorporating new issuance and corporate actions.
* Analyze valuation movements within client portfolios on a daily and monthly basis and highlight key drivers.
* Complete daily, monthly, and ad-hoc tasks accurately and on deadline, with strong attention to detail.
* Resolve client queries promptly and professionally, ensuring timely follow-up and closure.
* Present during monthly client meetings, communicating results in a client-friendly way.
* Enhance pricing controls, procedures, and documentation to strengthen the end-to-end process.

**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**

* Earn a bachelor's degree (or equivalent experience).
* Bring 6+ years of relevant experience in fixed income operations, valuations, pricing, index operations, or a closely related area.
* Demonstrate strong understanding of fixed income instruments and their key characteristics (for example pricing conventions, cash flows, and lifecycle events).
* Use market data sources and pricing platforms (for example Bloomberg and Refinitiv) and reconcile differences across sources.
* Apply strong analytical skills to isolate issues, identify root cause, and drive items to resolution.
* Communicate outcomes clearly to stakeholders and clients.
* Own actions end-to-end by proactively tracking items to completion and escalating when needed.
* Collaborate across global teams and time zones.
* Build spreadsheets and analyses while working with large datasets.
* Maintain strong attention to detail and perform under daily cutoffs and month-end deadlines.
* Lead through influence while contributing to a strong team environment.

**Preferred Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**

* Leverage automation or data tooling (for example Python, Visual Basic for Applications, or Structured Query Language).
* Attain a Chartered Financial Analyst designation.
* Complete a Master of Business Administration.
* Developing experience using AI-powered analytics, workflow automation, or intelligent process tools to drive efficiency gains, reduce manual effort, or improve accuracy in operational processes.

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. title: Financial Business Intelligence Manager
description:
****This role is eligible for our hybrid work model: Two days in-office.****
We’re a data-driven organization, which makes our Reporting & Analytics teams the backbone of our operation: constantly creating, testing, learning and iterating to better meet the needs of our customers. If you thrive in a fast-paced, ideas-led environment, you’re in the right place.
  
  
**Why This Job’s a Big Deal**
In your capacity as a BI Manager for Finance, you will drive results by resolving critical inquiries regarding business performance across various financial sectors. You will serve as the lead ambassador for BI programs within the department, steering strategic growth through the creation and oversight of analytical frameworks that shape organizational outcomes.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Serve as the main stakeholder liaison for BI architecture, active reports, and incoming reporting requests across Finance.
* Collaborate with Finance partners to analyze business workflows, discover opportunities, and execute core data-driven programs.
* Convert business needs into structured data models, datasets, and detailed technical specifications.
* Lead the deployment, development, and maintenance of interactive Tableau Cloud dashboards and report portfolios to empower business decision-making.
* Oversee legacy OBIEE and OAS reporting platforms, maintaining stability while driving strategic migration and modernization efforts.
* Identify architectural bottlenecks and champion continuous improvements across BI systems.
* Align with Data Engineering, Finance, and cross-functional partners to uphold data governance, accuracy, and consistency.
* Direct the complete lifecycle of reporting solutions from requirement discovery through deployment and support.
* Document report logic, data definitions, and processes to promote self-service and long-term knowledge transfer.
* Enforce best practices to guarantee maintainability and technical sustainability over time.

**Who You Are**

* Professional background with a BE/B.Tech and 8–10 years of experience in Data Analytics, Business Intelligence, or related fields.
* Proven track record of delivering stakeholder-facing BI solutions, preferably within Finance or Financial Reporting domains, and co-ordinate across departments.
* Expertise in dashboard authoring, publishing, and administration using Tableau Cloud (essential).
* Proficiency with legacy BI platforms like OBIEE and OAS to support and maintain current setups.
* Strong understanding of data architecture and data warehousing concepts (e.g., dimensional modeling, star/snowflake schemas, ETL/ELT processes, data marts, fact/dimension design) — able to work closely with the data team to translate business/reporting requirements into clear technical data requirements that can be designed and built.
* Advanced SQL capability covering data modeling, complex queries, and performance tuning.
* Hands-on experience leveraging Google BigQuery for analytics workflows.
* Skilled in designing BI enterprise architecture and transforming ambiguous business demands into structured technical plans.
* Strong communication and stakeholder leadership skills, equipped to manage competing priorities and act as the BI ambassador for key business units.
* Hands-on experience configuring and managing a ticketing/workflow tool (e.g., Jira Service Management or something similar ).
* Prior experience in consulting, product-focused environments, or financial analytics, with financial domain knowledge considered a plus.
* Illustrated history of living the values necessary to Priceline: Customer, Innovation, Team, Accountability and Trust.
* The Right Results, the Right Way is not just a motto at Priceline; it’s a way of life. Unquestionable integrity and ethics is essential.

**Who We Are**
**WE ARE PRICELINE.**
Our success as one of the biggest players in online travel is all thanks to our incredible, dedicated team of talented employees. Priceliners are focused on being the best travel deal makers in the world, motivated by our passion to help everyone experience the moments that matter most in their lives. Whether it’s a dream vacation, your cousin’s graduation, or your best friend’s wedding - we make travel affordable and accessible to our customers.
  
  
Our culture is unique and inspiring (that’s what our employees tell us). We’re a grown-up, startup. We deliver the excitement of a new venture, without the struggles and chaos that can come with a business that hasn’t stabilized.
  
  
We’re on the cutting edge of innovative technologies. We keep the customer at the center of all that we do. Our ability to meet their needs relies on the strength of a workforce as diverse as the customers we serve. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration.
  
  
Priceline is part of the Booking Holdings, Inc. (Nasdaq: BKNG) family of companies, a highly profitable global online travel company with a market capitalization of over $80 billion. Our sister companies include Booking.com, BookingGo, Agoda, Kayak and OpenTable.
  
  
If you want to be part of something truly special, check us out!

title: Analyst - Accounting
description:
**Main purpose**

This role is responsible for the accounting, reporting and control of the Trading legal entities with primary responsibilities of monthly closing of the books, entity-specific accounting policy, legal entity maintenance, account reconciliation & account structure management. The role will require an in-depth understanding of these entities including their business strategies, associated technical accounting and disclosure requirements.

**Key responsibilities**

**Balance Sheet Review & Control**

* Provide and support input into the end-to-end control and ownership of legal entity balance sheets for the division supported

* Drive the monthly financial close which entails analytical review and sign off of the balance sheet, profit and loss accounts for entities of the specified trading division

* Perform the month end close process including but not limited to revenue recognition checks, stock verification and valuation, debtors aging along with provision review, intercompany & related party balance confirmation

* Ensure strong control framework by implementing and maintaining effective internal controls

* Address ad hoc requests from various stakeholders and counterparts like consolidation, and regional accounting teams

* Coordinate with multiple teams on matters relating to intercompany settlements, transfer pricing, legal, compliance

* Analyse impact of various journals and processes on trial balance areas.

* Prepare monthly, quarterly and annual MIS packs, dashboards and KPI reports for management.
* Ensure timely and accurate month-end close inputs and reconciliation of reports.

**Audit**

* Liaise with external auditors during the group & statutory audits

* Coordinate with various functions to provide auditable support & evidence to external auditors

* Prepare audit documentations and walkthrough

**Change Management**

* Drive change projects to support any accounting policy changes or new reporting requirements for the legal entities in scope

* Challenge the current processes for improvement and constantly review processes for efficiencies

* Identify and escalate control gaps, data discrepancies and process improvement opportunities.

**Tax Accounting**

* Oversee accurate tax accounting, monthly tax provisions and tax-related financial reporting across assigned legal entities.

* Ensure timely preparation, review and filing of corporate income tax returns and compliance with local tax regulations.

* Support Pillar Two reporting, transfer pricing requirements and intercompany tax assessments.

* Coordinate with tax advisors, manage tax audits and assessments, and monitor tax payments, filing deadlines and overall tax risks

**Required qualifications**

* Minimum  1-3 years experience in Accounting.
* Chartered Accountant / post-graduation accounting qualification
* Determined and able to take end-to-end ownership
* Keen to question and challenge the existing processes with a view of creating reporting efficiencies and improvements
* Can work with multiple data sets, various systems and Excel
* Eager to take up fresh challenges and support the team wherever required
* Comfortable to work with non-accounting teams for regular activities and projects

**Attributes for success**

* Strong interpersonal skills
* Eager to take up fresh challenges and support the team wherever required

 

**Department overview**

The Financial Control & Reporting team operates across various APAC and MEA locations, acting as the entity-level financial reviewer, reporting to the Regional Controller. The team plays a critical role in ensuring accurate accounting, reviewed financial statements, compliance with applicable accounting standards, and effective financial controls across all legal entities. This covers both trading and non-trading entities, including financial reporting, reconciliations, P&L and balance sheet oversight, tax accounting, tax compliance, and ensuring accurate tax provisions and disclosures while mitigating financial and tax risks.

We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
  
  
Our Philosophy
  
  
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Through our P-S-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
Our Culture
  
  
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.

title: Growth & Revenue Lead
description:
**About Project Noon**

Project Noon is building India's first Sun Control brand- reimagining how people protect, comfort, and recover from everyday sun exposure. We believe the future of sun care goes far beyond sunscreen, and we're creating an entirely new category of products designed to help people live better under the sun.

Built at The Foundery, backed by Nikhil Kamath, Kishore Biyani, and Ronnie Screwvala, Project Noon is being built as a next-generation consumer brand with the ambition to define a new category from India for the world. By combining breakthrough product innovation, thoughtful design, and world-class brand building, we're creating a company that's changing the way millions of people experience the sun.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a Revenue Lead to own and drive Project Noon's revenue performance across every sales channel. This is a high-ownership, commercially focused role for someone who can connect the dots between channel strategy, sales execution, marketing investment, customer behaviour and business profitability.

You will be responsible for translating the company's growth ambitions into clear channel-wise targets and actionable plans across D2C, e-commerce marketplaces, quick commerce and general/traditional trade. You will build the revenue planning and reporting discipline that helps the business understand where growth is coming from, what is holding it back, and where to place its next bets.

This role works closely with the Founder and is a central partner to Performance Marketing, Brand, Finance, Supply Chain and external channel partners. It offers the opportunity to shape the commercial engine of an ambitious, early-stage consumer brand as it scales.

**Experience:**

Minimum 5 years of relevant experience across fast growing FMCG brands

**Work arrangement:**

Full-time, on-site | Worli, Mumbai

**Key Responsibilities:*****Revenue Strategy & Channel Ownership***

* Own the overall revenue plan and delivery against monthly, quarterly and annual business targets.
* Develop channel-wise growth strategies and targets across D2C, e-commerce marketplaces, quick commerce and GT/MT.
* Track revenue, orders, average order value, repeat behaviour, channel mix and growth trends; identify gaps and build clear action plans.
* Identify opportunities to improve channel productivity, expand distribution, increase product visibility and accelerate sell-through.
* Build a strong understanding of the economics, operating models and growth levers of each channel.

***Commercial Planning & Performance***

* Build and maintain revenue forecasts, budgets, monthly business plans and channel-wise performance dashboards.
* Monitor net sales, gross-to-net movements, discounts, promotions, commissions, trade spends and contribution margins.
* Strategize on & Evaluate the commercial impact of offers, bundles, pricing, assortment, launches and channel-specific promotions.
* Partner with Finance to track revenue realisation, channel costs, profitability, reconciliations and business performance.
* Use data to distinguish between topline growth and profitable, sustainable growth.

***Channel Partner & Account Management***

* Build and manage working relationships with marketplace, quick-commerce and other channel partners.
* Coordinate with channel teams on onboarding, assortment, catalogue readiness, visibility plans, promotional calendars and business reviews.
* Track channel-specific requirements, commercial terms, campaign opportunities and execution timelines.
* Work with partners to address sales or operational bottlenecks and improve availability, discoverability and conversion.

***Growth & Cross-Functional Collaboration***

* Work closely with the Performance Marketing Associate to connect paid media performance with overall revenue outcomes, channel priorities and business targets.
* Collaborate with Brand and Creative teams to translate consumer, category and channel insights into campaigns, launches, offers and growth initiatives.
* Partner with Supply Chain & Operations on demand forecasts, inventory availability, replenishment priorities and launch planning to minimise stock-outs and excess inventory.
* Work with Finance to ensure that revenue reporting, budgets, channel costs and profitability metrics are accurate and timely.
* Bring together insights from D2C, marketplaces and quick commerce to identify what is working, what is not, and where the business should focus.

***Reporting & Business Reviews***

* Own the weekly and monthly revenue review cadence, including channel-wise performance against targets.
* Create clear, decision-oriented reports that explain performance drivers, risks, opportunities and recommended actions.
* Establish consistent metrics, reporting definitions and processes so that leadership has a reliable view of business performance.
* Translate analysis into decisions and follow through to ensure agreed actions are implemented.

**What We're Looking For**

* A minimum of 5 years of experience in revenue, sales, business growth, category management, e-commerce or commercial roles.
* Previous experience in fast-paced FMCG or consumer brands is ideal; experience in D2C, beauty, skincare, personal care, wellness or lifestyle is highly relevant.
* Strong understanding of multi-channel consumer businesses, ideally spanning D2C, e-commerce marketplaces and quick commerce.
* Demonstrated ability to own revenue targets, build forecasts and translate business goals into channel-level plans.
* Strong commercial and financial acumen, including familiarity with net revenue, gross margins, contribution margins, discounts, trade spends and channel economics.
* Comfortable working with data, building and interpreting dashboards, and using Excel/Google Sheets to drive decisions.
* Strong stakeholder and partner-management skills, with the ability to work across internal teams and external platforms.
* A hands-on, ownership-oriented approach and the ability to operate in a fast-paced startup environment.

**Key Stakeholders & Liaison**

* Founder: revenue priorities, business reviews, growth plans and key commercial decisions.
* Performance Marketing Associate: paid marketing performance, acquisition efficiency, channel contribution and budget priorities.
* Finance: budgets, revenue reporting, reconciliations, channel costs and profitability.
* Brand & Creative: product launches, campaigns, promotions, consumer insights and channel-specific marketing plans.
* Supply Chain & Operations: demand planning, inventory availability, replenishment and fulfilment readiness.
* External channel partners: marketplace, quick-commerce and other sales-platform teams.

﻿

**Preferred Traits**

* Commercially sharp, analytical and comfortable taking ownership of business outcomes.
* A builder mindset: able to create structure, reporting rhythms and processes where they do not yet exist.
* Able to move between strategic thinking and hands-on execution.
* Curious about consumer behaviour, category trends and the evolving Indian beauty and personal-care landscape.
* Clear communicator who can influence stakeholders and turn insights into action.
* Comfortable with ambiguity, pace and the demands of building a new consumer category.
* Candidates from Tier-1 institutions will be preferred.

*Project Noon is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diverse perspectives and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive.*

B.Com / M.Com / BBA (Finance) or equivalent qualification.

title: Manager, Cost and Operations Excellence
description:
**What You'll Do**
The role is responsible for driving financial transparency, performance managing operational and cost KPIs through a “One set of numbers” approach, establishing a clear link between financial data and operational performance working closely with the P2P Cost Control team and Business Administration (Finance). The successful incumbent must pair financial expertise with operational acumen to identify opportunities, mitigate risks, and challenge the status quo. The position also acts as the right hand to the Director of Operations for Area MIN, playing a pivotal role in providing leadership with data-driven recommendations for impactful decision-making in your Area and will act as change agent in the Area cementing the regionally designed performance management framework based on the four disciplines of Execution (4DX) and the Daily Operating System (DOS). The position reports directly to the Regional Director of Cost Control and Operational Steering, working closely with regional OPSS and P2P Cost Control teams, Area Management and Operations, Finance and QSC colleagues to ensure that Area performance is effectively planned, monitored, and continuously improved. You will also act as the lead/senior OPSS business partner across the Area OPSS community with respect to Functional Change Management, Performance Management and Cost Control strategy
**Qualifications**

* Performance Management & Insights
* Facilitate a daily operating system (DOS) and performance management framework in the operations teams of Area India (MIN)
* Translate business targets into operational KPIs per country/cluster.
* Calculate and analyze performance gaps against Budget, Plan, and Savings targets; provide recommendations on corrective actions with stakeholders through data-driven performance management cycles.
* Collect, analyze ands provide insights on Area-specific operational data to support Area and Regional dashboards and scorecards.
* Impact decision making by providing forward looking, data driven analytics with actionable recommendations
* Objectively challenge the performance and decisions of operational teams to drive accountability and continuous improvement. Pro-actively answer questions that have not yet been asked
* Forecast key P&L elements on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis for the Area.
* Cost Analytics, Control & Optimization
* Own the narrative behind cost trends by maintaining a deep understanding of cost and volume drivers within operations.
* Conduct independent, balanced analysis to identify opportunities for profitability, cost efficiencies, and challenge cost escalations.
* Drive and track cost-saving initiatives while applying tools and frameworks that ensure high-impact, data-informed decision-making.
* Prevent sub-optimization by evaluating relevant, sunk, and total cost of ownership in operational choices.
* Support cost modeling and forecasting for the Area, working closely with P2P Cost Control, QSC and Controlling teams.
* Performance manage operational leading indicators influencing the cost as well as being the visible driving force of performance managing the unit cost in your Area
* Collaborate on cost-saving initiatives, support accurate accruals, and ensure consistent cost categorization.
* Data Management & Reporting
* Act as a data steward in your Area – validate, test, define and ensure data quality for unit cost and KPI reporting.
* Collaborate with QSCs, P2P Cost Control and Regional OPSS to ensure a unified “one set of numbers” approach.
* Contribute and maintain a standardized KPI repository and assist in linking performance reporting to the budget process.
* Drive and share best practices to facilitate the continuous improvement mind set
* Own the data management of TRACO updates and coordinate the deviations on unit cost with P2P Cost Control
* Planning & Budget Support
* Provide input during forecasting and budgeting cycles, including challenge and validation of assumptions.
* Support tracking of cost and operational performance against budget with relevant stakeholders.
* Partner with Area leadership with scenario analysis and planning for strategic initiatives to ensure alignment on cost development, forecasting, and strategic priorities
* Stakeholder Engagement & Execution Support
* Be the source of energy within the area of responsibility, driving for team engagement and continuous improvement
* Act as a strategic thought partner in cost transformation, supporting the Director of Cost Control to shape smarter decision-making frameworks.
* Contribute to the wider Finance community by sharing insights, best practices, and aligning with digital tools and reporting standards.
* Liaise between Area, QSC, and Regional OPSS and P2P Cost Control to ensure clear implementation of priorities.
* Engage with procurement and operations on savings plans and KPI alignment.
* Participate in regional workshops, training, and best-practice sharing initiatives.
* Masters/Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Engineering, or a related field.
* 4-8 years of relevant experience in Finance Business Partnering, Planning, Financial Analysis, Cost Control, or Operational reporting.
* Experience in driving performance management dialogues based on 4 Disciplines of Execution (4DX) is a pre-requisite.

**Technical & Analytical Skills**

* SAP proficient
* Advanced Excel proficiency; knowledge of Power BI, Tableau, SQL, or similar tools is a strong plus.
* Ability to interpret large data sets, identify trends, and develop actionable insights.

**Key Competencies:**

* Outgoing, extrovert approach to understanding underlying business drivers for financial performance
* Strong analytical mindset with a hands-on, execution-driven approach.
* Ability to influence without direct authority and get required results
* Ability to synthesize data and derive actionable insights. Always applying a forward-looking perspective in discussions

* Empathic and strong interpersonal skills
* Comfortable communicating with cross-functional teams and aligning diverse stakeholders.
* High levels of positive energy with a can-do attitude
* Structured, self-driven, and able to manage multiple streams of work.
* Passion for continuous improvement and process enhancement.

**About Us**
**Hapag-Lloyd**
is one of the world’s leading liner shipping companies, connecting businesses and people across more than
**600 ports worldwide**
. With a fleet of over
**300 modern container ships**
and a

and a growing portfolio of terminal and infrastructure investments. This scale enables us to deliver consistent, high-quality service across continents and to support our customers in even the most complex supply chains.
  
  
When you join us, you become part of
**more than 19,600 colleagues**
working across borders, functions and cultures, to not only deliver quality for our customers, but to create innovation and opportunities across roles, regions and perspectives.
  
  
We believe that every exploration is a chance to grow, and every port is a place to belong.
**Your journey, our horizon.**

title: Financial Reporting - Assistant Manager - Mumbai
description:
**Job Description**

**Financial Reporting - Assistant Manager - Mumbai (Dadar)**

**Who We Are:**

BDO is a global network of professional services firms with a presence in over 166 countries, revenue of over USD 14 billion, and experience of over 60 years. It’s a leading service provider for the mid-markets with client service at its heart.

BDO India Services Private Limited (or ‘BDO India’) is the India member firm of BDO International. BDO India offers strategic, operational, accounting and tax, and regulatory advisory & assistance for both domestic and international organizations across a range of industries. BDO India is led by more than 300+ Partners & Directors with a team of over 10,000 professionals operating across 14 cities and 20 offices. We expect to grow sizably in the coming 3-5 years, adding various dimensions to our business and multiplying and increasing the current team size multi-fold.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced Financial Reporting Manager to take ownership of the financial reporting and month-end close process across group entities. This is a hands-on individual contributor role requiring strong technical accounting expertise, audit management capabilities, and a strong focus on internal controls and financial governance.The role will work closely with Service Lines, FP&A, Tax, Treasury, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Compliance, and senior leadership to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Financial Reporting & Month-End Close**

* Own and drive the monthly financial reporting and close process across group entities.
* Ensure timely and accurate closure of monthly books within defined timelines.
* Review trial balances, general ledger accounts, and supporting schedules.
* Review and ensure accurate accounting of provisions, accruals, prepayments, depreciation, amortization, and other month-end entries.
* Perform detailed variance analysis of actuals versus budget, forecast, and prior periods, and highlight key business drivers to management.
* Ensure completeness and accuracy of financial data across entities.

**Financial Statements & Accounting Compliance**

* Prepare and review annual financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards, including Ind AS / Local GAAP.
* Ensure appropriate accounting treatment for complex transactions and financial reporting matters.
* Provide accurate financial information, schedules, and supporting documentation for regulatory and statutory filings.
* Partner with the Compliance and Secretarial teams to ensure timely and accurate regulatory reporting.

**Statutory & Internal Audit Management**

* Lead and manage statutory audits across group entities.
* Coordinate and support internal audits, including preparation of audit schedules, reconciliations, supporting documents, and deliverables.
* Act as the key point of contact between auditors and internal stakeholders.
* Manage audit timelines and ensure timely closure of audit observations and queries.
* Proactively identify and resolve audit issues with minimal escalation.

**Internal Financial Controls & Governance**

* Execute and monitor Internal Financial Controls over Financial Reporting (IFCR/IFC) within the reporting function.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and testing of key financial controls.
* Identify control gaps and drive timely remediation.
* Strengthen financial governance and control frameworks across entities.
* Ensure compliance with internal policies, accounting standards, and reporting requirements.

**Lease Accounting & Fixed Assets**

* Manage lease accounting, including maintenance of lease trackers and periodic accounting entries.
* Ensure appropriate accounting and reporting under Ind AS 116, where applicable.
* Oversee fixed asset accounting, including capitalization, depreciation, disposals, and reconciliation.
* Ensure accuracy and completeness of fixed asset registers and related schedules.

**Balance Sheet & Month-End Governance**

* Ensure all balance sheet schedules are prepared, reviewed, and reconciled on a monthly basis.
* Maintain strong controls over provisions and expense recognition.
* Ensure appropriate cut-off procedures and completeness of expense recognition.
* Investigate and resolve long-outstanding reconciling items and unusual balances.
* Drive high standards of accuracy and financial discipline across the reporting process.

**Stakeholder Management**

* Collaborate closely with Service Lines, FP&A, AP, AR, Tax, Treasury, Compliance, and other cross-functional teams.
* Provide management with relevant financial information, analysis, and insights.
* Partner with stakeholders to resolve accounting, reporting, and close-related issues.
* Build strong working relationships with senior stakeholders and external auditors.

**Process Improvement & Systems**

* Identify opportunities to improve and standardize financial reporting and close processes.
* Drive standardization of reconciliations, reporting schedules, and management reporting formats.
* Identify opportunities to strengthen controls and improve process efficiency.
* Support enhanced utilization and optimization of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or Oracle.
* Drive process improvements, automation, and reporting efficiencies wherever relevant.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) Mandatory.
* 2+ years of post-qualification experience in financial reporting, accounting, controllership, or related finance functions.
* Strong hands-on experience in:
* Financial reporting and financial statements
* Month-end and year-end close
* Statutory and internal audits
* Balance sheet reconciliations
* Internal financial controls
* Technical accounting
* Experience managing reporting across multiple entities will be preferred.
* Experience in professional services, consulting, Big 4, or similar environments will be an advantage.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems such as Microsoft Dynamics 365, SAP, or Oracle.

title: Analyst BCO
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
Credit & Capital Management (C&CM) under CIB are in the process of implementing a new, modern, and consistent E2E operating model. A key component of this operating model is the introduction of a first line credit management office, the Business Credit Office (BCO)
  
  
The BCO function will complete tasks currently owned by multiple actors including Credit Analysis Unit, Credit Analysts, and RMs in the management of the first line credit risk responsibilities including structuring, credit analysis and rating recommendation, client credit monitoring tasks, credit terms and docs negotiation with WCMR and clients acting as a single handoff from a RM to the BCO for all C&L tasks, creating a single control point. The function will be client facing and customer service orientated.
  
  
The BCO Manager provides credit management support to Relationship Managers (RMs) / Coverage and facilitates client review and renewal activities, and is responsible for carrying out customer outreach, research, financial and credit analysis on behalf of the RMs, ensuring exemplary risk management acumen and control standards are embedded within the end-to-end C&L process. In discharging their duties the role holder must ensure a common, reliable, and predictable underwriting and lending process, that protects the business from exposure, whilst responding to clients borrowing needs. They are also responsible for co-ordination and completion of credit applications or renewals and risk escalation management. The role holder will report to the BCO Team Lead and will work closely with the Coverage and Transaction Support teams to ensure seamless customer experience and consistency of service for all customers.
  
  
The BCO manager will need to be an effective collaborator and skilled stakeholder manager, successfully navigating complex landscape to deliver exceptional outcomes for our customers and stakeholders.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Responsible for the delivery of BCO tasks in line with agreed OKRs, SLAs and KPIs
* Own the end-to-end Credit & Lending servicing journey, ensuring a seamless and efficient process for customers and internal stakeholders
* Combine client relationship management with strong risk assessment and management capabilities ensuring the required credit quality & requisite returns on risk
* Continuously drive improvement in their productivity whilst enhancing client experience.
* Adopt technology and customer experience improvement initiatives, including alignment to a globally consistent C&L operating model and active participation in training initiatives
* Participate in deal discussions and meetings with clients or credit risk as required
* Strong execution and implementation ability.
* Ability to build and maintain strong relationships across the teams, including credibility with both Business and Risk leaders.
* Protect the Bank by acting as First Line of Defence and adhering to all controls
* Maintain HSBC internal control standards, including timely implementation of internal and external audit recomentations, along with addressing any issues raised by external regulators
* Demonstrates ability to engage in constructive and consistent dialogue with risk partners, in a manner that effectively balances commercial outcomes and risk management
* Work with the BCO Team Lead to ensure adequate credit risk management controls are built into the operational process and robust MI is in place to track and measure risk against agreed thresholds

**Knowledge And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, or a related field
* 5-8 years corporate lending experience with strong analytical skills and sound credit knowledge
* Strong understanding of various financing instruments and banking products for Wholesale Banking
* Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to navigate complex situations and drive alignment among senior leaders
* Clear understanding of the Group credit risk principles, policies and statutory compliances
* Strong commercial mindset
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate effectively across all levels of the organization

**Pro-Tip:**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable .
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

title: Senior Accountant
description: Job DescriptionThe person is responsible for the execution and supervision of accounting, financial reporting, taxation and internal control processes for multiple ledgers.The position ensures that ledger-level activities, monthly and quarterly closing, account reconciliations, tax compliances, financial reporting and SOX control requirements are completed accurately, consistently and within prescribed timelines.The role will work closely with Operations, Shared Services, Finance and Accounting teams, Tax, Treasury, Internal Audit, External Auditors and other business functions to ensure a smooth, timely and well-controlled financial close. The position is also responsible for identifying accounting, tax and control risks, resolving issues and driving continuous process improvements.Responsibilities Key Responsibilities 1. Accounting and Ledger Close Manage and oversee daily, monthly, quarterly and annual accounting close activities. Ensure that journal entries, accruals, provisions, reclassifications and other accounting adjustments are prepared, supported, reviewed and posted accurately. Monitor the completion of close checklists and ensure adherence to the financial reporting calendar. Review general ledger balances and investigate unusual, aged or inconsistent items. Ensure accurate accounting for revenue, expenses, assets, liabilities, intercompany transactions, employee-related costs and other significant financial statement areas. Coordinate with Shared Services and business teams to obtain complete and accurate information for timely closure of books. Ensure that all accounting activities comply with company accounting policies, applicable accounting standards and internal procedures. 2. Financial Reporting and Accounting Standards Prepare and review monthly, quarterly and annual financial statements and management reports. Ensure compliance with Indian GAAP, including applicable Accounting Standards and Ind AS requirements, as relevant to the entity. Ensure compliance with US GAAP requirements for group reporting, consolidation and reporting requirements. Analyse and document differences between Indian accounting requirements and US GAAP, wherever applicable. Review balance sheet, profit and loss account and cash-flow movements, and provide explanations for significant variances. Support preparation and review of quarterly reporting packages, account analyses, schedules and management presentations. 3. Account Reconciliations Ensure that all balance sheet and other key account reconciliations are prepared and reviewed within agreed timelines. Review reconciliation quality, supporting documentation, ageing and the appropriateness of reconciling items. Identify unresolved or high-risk reconciliation items and ensure timely corrective action. Maintain oversight of reconciliation outcomes even where the detailed preparation or review is performed by another team. Ensure compliance with the organisation’s reconciliation policy, materiality thresholds and documentation standards. Escalate significant accounting discrepancies, control gaps or unresolved items to Finance leadership. 4. SOX Compliance and Internal Controls Execute, supervise and review ledger-level SOX controls and other financial reporting controls. Ensure that controls are performed on time and supported by complete, accurate and audit-ready documentation. Remain accountable for the timeliness, accuracy and quality of control activities, including control components performed by Shared Services or other functional teams. Support SOX testing conducted by Internal Audit, External Audit and other assurance teams. Ensure compliance with segregation of duties, delegation of authority and system-access controls. 5. Direct Tax Compliance Direct tax accounting, compliance and reporting requirements compliances to be done at ledger level. Provide details to regional Tax team for corporate income-tax computations, advance-tax calculations and tax provisions. Ensure timely compliance with tax-deduction-at-source requirements, including payments Ensure timely provision of accurate data for various returns, reconciliations under Income Tax Act. Provide transfer-pricing details/ documentation, tax audit requirements and related-party transaction reporting and documents, where applicable. Reconcile tax balances appearing in the books with tax returns, government portals and statutory records. 6. Indirect Tax Compliance Comply with GST and other applicable indirect tax requirements. Ensure timely and accurate provision data related to filing of GST returns, reconciliations and payments. Provide support for Review input-tax-credit eligibility and ensure appropriate documentation and accounting. Support GST audits, departmental notices, assessments and information requests. 7. Audit and Statutory Compliance Provide required support to statutory auditors, internal auditors, tax auditors and other assurance providers. title: General Manager, Finance & Accounts
description:
**POSITION PURPOSE**

The General Manager – Financial Consolidation & Accounts Reconciliation is a mid-senior management role responsible for group-level financial consolidation and accounts reconciliation across Essar's domestic entities. Working closely with the Sr. Vice President – Finance & Accounts, the role also extends dedicated financial reporting and reconciliation support to Family Office.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role suited to a finance professional who can independently own the consolidation and reconciliation cycle — from entity-level trial balances through to consolidated group financial statements under Ind AS — while maintaining the accuracy, timeliness, and confidentiality expected in a Family Office environment. The incumbent will work closely with statutory auditors, entity-level finance teams, and the Family Office to ensure clean, fully reconciled books across all domestic entities.

**POSITION REQUIREMENTS**

**Education**

* Chartered Accountant (CA) – Mandatory.
* Additional qualification such as Cost & Management Accountant (CMA) or Company Secretary (CS) would be an advantage.
* Experience with a mid-size or Big Four audit/assurance firm, or a large corporate finance function, is preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of Ind AS, group consolidation accounting, and ERP-based financial reporting (SAP or equivalent) is essential.

**Experience**

Minimum 8-12 years of post-qualification experience in financial consolidation, accounts reconciliation, and financial reporting, ideally within a diversified conglomerate, investment holding company, family office, or multi-entity domestic group.

* Demonstrated experience managing group-level consolidation across multiple domestic entities/subsidiaries under Ind AS.
* Hands-on experience in accounts reconciliation — inter-company, bank, vendor, and general ledger reconciliations — across a multi-entity environment.
* Experience finalizing books of accounts, coordinating statutory audits, and closing quarterly/annual financial statements.
* Exposure to Family Office or promoter-group financial reporting, with the discretion and commercial sensitivity such environments demand.
* Strong command of MIS reporting, budget variance analysis, and month-end/quarter-end close processes.
* Working knowledge of direct and indirect tax compliance, and coordination with tax and statutory auditors, is an advantage.

**SKILL/COMPETENCIES REQUIREMENTS**

* Strong technical command of Ind AS / Indian GAAP, group consolidation principles, and financial statement closure processes across multi-entity structures.
* Hands-on expertise in accounts reconciliation — inter-company, bank, vendor/creditor, debtor, and general ledger reconciliations — with the ability to independently resolve reconciliation differences.
* Strong MIS and management-reporting skills — monthly closing, budget vs. actuals, variance analysis, and board/promoter-level financial packs.
* Commercial fluency across investment holding structures, inter-company transactions, and Family Office financial arrangements, with the discretion such an environment requires.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with statutory auditors, tax consultants, and business finance teams to ensure timely, accurate, and audit-ready closures.
* Strong process orientation — able to identify reconciliation gaps, streamline closing timelines, and strengthen financial controls across entities.
* Self-directed and detail-oriented, able to manage multiple entities and deadlines within a lean team structure.

**KEY ACTIVITIES**

*Financial Consolidation*

* Own the end-to-end group financial consolidation process for Essar's domestic entities — collating entity-level financials, eliminating inter-company transactions, and preparing consolidated financial statements under Ind AS.
* Ensure consolidation adjustments (minority interest, investment eliminations, unrealised profits) are accurately captured and documented.
* Coordinate with entity-level finance teams to obtain timely and accurate trial balances and supporting schedules for consolidation.
* Maintain and continuously improve consolidation templates, checklists, and timelines to shorten the group close cycle.

*Accounts Reconciliation*

* Drive periodic reconciliation of inter-company balances, bank accounts, vendor/creditor ledgers, and debtor accounts across domestic entities.
* Investigate and resolve reconciliation differences on a timely basis, escalating unresolved items to the Sr. Vice President – Finance & Accounts.
* Establish standardised reconciliation formats and cadences across entities to improve consistency and audit readiness.
* Maintain clean, reconciled general ledgers to support accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual closes.

*Family Office Financial Reporting*

* Support the Family Office with accurate, timely, and confidential financial reporting on domestic entity performance and consolidated positions.
* Prepare periodic financial summaries and reconciliation status updates for Promoters and Directors.
* Maintain the highest level of discretion in handling Family Office-related financial information and inter-entity transactions.

*MIS & Management Reporting*

* Prepare monthly MIS, consolidated financial packs, and variance analysis for senior management review.
* Support budgeting and forecasting processes with accurate, reconciled actuals across entities.
* Provide ad hoc financial analysis and reporting support to the Sr. Vice President – Finance & Accounts and Operating Partner as required.

*Statutory Compliance & Audit Coordination*

* Coordinate with statutory auditors for timely completion of audits across domestic entities and at the consolidated group level.
* Ensure consolidation and reconciliation working papers are audit-ready and support closure of audit queries.
* Work with tax consultants and internal teams to ensure accurate tax provisioning and compliance inputs are reflected in the consolidated financials.
