title: MSET QR Corporate Actions_Senior Manager_Institutional Equity Division
description:
**Company Profile**
Morgan Stanley is a leading global financial services firm providing a wide range of investment banking, securities, investment management and wealth management services. The Firm's employees serve clients worldwide including corporations, governments, and individuals from more than 1,200 offices in 43 countries.
  
  
As a market leader, the talent and passion of our people is critical to our success. Together, we share a common set of values rooted in integrity, excellence and strong team ethic. Morgan Stanley can provide a superior foundation for building a professional career - a place for people to learn, to achieve and grow. A philosophy that balances personal lifestyles, perspectives and needs is an important part of our culture.
  
  
**Department Profile**
From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Morgan Stanley professionals use our network and technology to provide liquidity and sophisticated analysis, to manage risk and execute reliably in the fast-changing markets.
  
  
Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Equity Division (IED) is a world leader in the origination, distribution and trading of equity, equity-linked and equity-derivative securities. Our broad and deep client relationships, market-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.
  
  
The Quantitative Research (QR) group designs, builds and maintains the models which drive the equity trading engines at Morgan Stanley. Our systems are used globally by both internal trading groups and clients of the firm. We utilize systematic, data-driven approaches to understand how markets work and put those ideas in action. The team spans the disciplines of finance, econometrics, statistics, mathematics, machine learning and data analysis, with many team members well versed in multiple areas. We are looking to hire highly talented, creative individuals who are enthusiastic about research; and enthusiastic about making a contribution to a leading-edge team, in an intellectually stimulating environment.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
This role, based in Mumbai, requires the individual to work with global Morgan Stanley Quantitative Research teams. The successful candidate will be a fast-learning, dynamic, pro-active and self-motivated individual who can assist the team in maintaining and analyzing referential data, as well as generating ad hoc performance and market condition reports for clients.
  
  
**What You’ll Do In The Role**

* Responsible for analyzing ongoing corporate events like M&As, spin-offs, bankruptcies, reorganizations, and other corporate actions (e.g., stock splits, rights offerings, dividends, etc.)
* Timely identification and reviewing nature of the corporate action and it’s impact index memberships, weights, size, style, and industry classifications.
* Collaborating globally to deliver timely and high-quality responses to queries related to corporate events raised by our global clients and internal teams.
* Share insights through emails and presentations by preparing deep-dive analytical content on corporate actions, index events, and market microstructure.
* Collaborate regularly with cross-functional teams including Sales, Trading, and Strats.

**Core Requirements**
We are looking for a confident and outgoing individual, who has exceptional attention to detail and takes initiative.
  
  

* 5+ years of experience in the financial sector with direct practical experience in equity markets
* Experience in monitoring activity in underlying markets to capture relevant corporate events
* Able to demonstrate practical mastery of handling complex corporate actions
* Experience in making presentations for complex corporate actions with proposed implementation to senior decision-making Committees
* Handle client queries related to corporate actions and Equity Benchmark methodology
* A degree in quantitative discipline (e.g., BE, BTech, MS in Mathematics, Statistics, Financial Engineering, or Economics).
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate ideas clearly. Experience in writing marketing materials or trade ideas for broad distribution is a plus.
* Exceptional attention to detail.

**Complementary Skills**

* Experience in EU/EMEA markets, with active involvement in strategic decision-making for complex corporate event implementations.
* Market knowledge on Index rebalances, Funds, ETFs, and mechanisms
* Experience or progress towards gaining proficiency in Python

**What You Can Expect From Morgan Stanley**
At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values - putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back - aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. At Morgan Stanley, you’ll find an opportunity to work alongside the best and the brightest, in an environment where you are supported and empowered. Our teams are relentless collaborators and creative thinkers, fueled by their diverse backgrounds and experiences. We are proud to support our employees and their families at every point along their work-life journey, offering some of the most attractive and comprehensive employee benefits and perks in the industry. There’s also ample opportunity to move about the business for those who show passion and grit in their work.
  
  
To learn more about our offices across the globe, please copy and paste https://www.morganstanley.com/about-us/global-offices into your browser.
  
  
Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunity employer committed to building and maintaining a workforce that is diverse in experience and background. Our recruiting efforts reflect our strong commitment to a culture of inclusion, where individuals are hired, developed, and advanced based on their skills and talents.
  
  
Our workforce reflects a broad cross-section of the global communities in which we operate, bringing a variety of backgrounds, talents, perspectives, and experiences.
  
  
For more information, please visit: https://www.morganstanley.com/people-opportunities/eeo.

title: Manager - Fund ops, Finance and IR
description:
**About the job**

Cedar Hill Capital is the region’s leading early-stage FinTech venture capital fund, primarily focused on enterprise technology investments in the Financial Services space. The INR ~200 Cr fund is on track to achieve Final Close shortly, and has already completed a few initial investments.

The fund is built on the legacy Cedar Consulting (www.cedar-consulting.com) and IBS Intelligence (www.ibsintelligence.com) platform, which comprises over 60 years of research and consulting experience for Banks and Technology players globally.

The fund GP, Sahil Anand, in his prior role, co-created the region’s only FinTech Lab, which has demonstrated a strong track-record of accelerating 65+ FinTechs across the region (www.cedaribsifintechlab.com).

The fund is independently structured, follows a classic LP-GP model, and is backed by leading institutional and family office investors across the region

**Responsibilities**

We are looking for a sharp, detail-oriented manager to anchor the operational backbone of our CAT II AIF. This is a broad, high-ownership role that sits at the intersection of fund operations, finance, regulatory compliance, and investor relations. The ideal candidate has prior experience in an AIF, NBFC, or investment management firm and is comfortable working in a lean, high-accountability environment.

**1. Fund Operations**

* Own end-to-end fund administration including capital calls, drawdowns, distributions, and NAV computation in coordination with the fund administrator and custodian.
* Maintain and reconcile the investment register, portfolio valuation workings, and fund-level waterfall calculations on a periodic basis.
* Manage documentation and execution workflows for new investments, follow-ons, and exits, including term sheets, subscription agreements, and board resolutions.
* Coordinate with registrar, custodian, fund administrator, legal counsel, and auditors to ensure smooth operational closure of all fund activities.
* Track portfolio company reporting timelines and consolidate data for internal investment committee reviews and quarterly portfolio updates.

**2. Finance & Accounts**

* Oversee fund-level accounting including maintenance of books, preparation of management accounts, and coordination with auditors for statutory and tax audits.
* Manage fee calculations including management fees, carried interest, and hurdle computations in line with the PPM and LPA provisions.
* Track fund expenses, vendor payments, and ensure timely filing of GST returns, TDS, and other applicable direct and indirect tax obligations.
* Prepare financial statements for the fund entity and any associated SPVs, ensuring compliance with applicable accounting standards (Ind AS / IGAAP as applicable).
* Support the preparation of annual budgets, cash flow forecasts, and expense reports for management and trustee review.

**3. Compliance**

* Ensure ongoing compliance with SEBI AIF Regulations 2012 and circulars, including periodic filings, disclosures, and reporting obligations to the regulator.
* Maintain and update the fund’s compliance calendar; coordinate with legal counsel on amendments to fund documents and regulatory submissions.
* Oversee KYC/AML processes for existing and new investors, ensuring documentation is complete and refreshed as per PMLA and SEBI requirements.
* Liaise with the fund trustee, compliance officer, and legal advisors on any regulatory queries, show cause notices, or ad hoc SEBI communications.
* Monitor changes in SEBI, RBI, FEMA, and income tax regulations relevant to AIF operations and proactively flag implications to the investment team.

**4. Investor Relations**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for LP queries on capital accounts, tax documents, portfolio updates, and fund-related communications.
* Prepare quarterly and annual investor reports including portfolio performance summaries, capital account statements, and fund-level financial highlights.
* Coordinate the preparation and dispatch of capital call notices, distribution notices, and tax certificates (Form 64C/64D) within stipulated timelines.
* Maintain the investor data room and ensure all fund documents, NAV reports, and compliance certificates are current and accessible to LPs.
* Support fundraising efforts by preparing data room materials, responding to LP due diligence requests, and coordinating onboarding of new investors.

**Qualifications**

* CA, MBA (Finance), or CFA with 4–7 years of relevant experience in an AIF, NBFC, PE/VC fund, or Big 4 advisory firm.
* Strong working knowledge of SEBI AIF Regulations, PMLA/KYC requirements, and fund accounting principles.
* Prior experience handling SEBI filings, investor reporting, and coordination with fund administrators and custodians.
* Proficiency in Excel; experience with fund administration software or accounting tools is a plus.
* Excellent written communication skills; ability to draft investor communications, compliance memos, and board presentations independently.

* Excellent communication, documentation, analytical, and problem-solving skills.

* Mining and Metals
* Iron Ore Processing and Pellet Plants
* Steel and Heavy Engineering
* Manufacturing and Industrial Operations
* Capital-Intensive Projects and Asset Management

**SAP FICO & Fund Management Consultant**
who can independently manage finance and budget management implementation activities.

The ideal candidate should possess strong functional configuration skills, understand integration across SAP modules, and be capable of working directly with business stakeholders to deliver an accelerated SAP S/4HANA implementation for Mesabi Metallics.

Candidates with experience implementing Fund Management, budget availability control, CAPEX/OPEX tracking, and financial processes in SAP S/4HANA Cloud environments will be highly preferred.

**Recruitment Note:**
SAP Funds Management functionality and extensibility differ between S/4HANA Public Cloud and Private Cloud. Candidates should be evaluated on their understanding of these differences and their ability to recommend appropriate supported budget control solutions.

title: Senior Manager - BFSI (Lending & speciality finance)
description:
**About us:**
1Lattice™ is a 360-degree business decision support partner with a tech-enabled services stack of data, people network, and custom research. Powered by advanced tech tools and unique data-gathering approaches, 1Lattice is an integrated product suite to make decisions smartly, right from Inputs to Validation to Execution to Measurement. 1Lattice works with clients and partners globally, helping clients solving a wide variety of organizational and business challenges through actionable research-led insights.
  
  
Location: Mumbai
  
  
About the role:
  
  
As an Senior Manager (SM), you will have four key responsibilities: (1) Driving account growth and supporting business development activities, (2) Client management, (3) Ensuring project delivery, and (4) Team management.
  
  
The foremost responsibility of this role is to drive account growth, client retention, and project profitability. You will be expected to seamlessly own and nurture existing client accounts for repeat and continued business, identify cross-sell and upsell opportunities within existing accounts, and ensure sustained client engagement. In addition, you will support the Director in business development activities, including proposal development, solutioning, and other pre-sales initiatives. Apart from ensuring account continuity and growth, you will also be responsible for the profitability of your projects by effectively managing direct and indirect costs. You will further contribute towards the development and enhancement of product offerings and capabilities within 1Lattice.
  
  
This role will be expected to develop close connections and relationships with senior level executives across the BFSI (Lending & Specialty Finance) space. This will require building and developing a wide network in the industry and leading interactions with them, playing a significant role in influencing their thinking, identifying potential project leads / opportunities / proposals and driving them to closure. This will also involve ensuring high quality project delivery through your teams to ensure high client satisfaction and repeat business.
  
  
This position will lead and drive delivery teams of 10+ members in the BFSI (Lending & Specialty Finance) department for 1Lattice, including senior members who will be responsible for project delivery, and mid-junior levels for execution. This will involve supervising and guiding the research process and generating insights that help clients make critical business decisions across key sub-verticals within BFSI - Lending & Specialty Finance.
  
  
You will also play a very important leadership role internally - to grow and engage your team and align them to the 1Lattcie culture. As such, your team's success will also enhance your own personal results. You will support and promote the 1Lattice culture by motivating your team members, train them and help them develop their skills, showcase their talents, make them feel part of the 1Lattice family, and overall helping them grow professionally. As such, you will be responsible for both their growth as well as overall happiness.
  
  
Roles and responsibilities:
  
  

* Ensuring sustained growth and profitability of existing accounts through effective account farming, client retention, and identification of expansion opportunities within key accounts.
* Driving business continuity with existing clients, ensuring repeat business and long-term engagement from key accounts.
* Supporting the Director in business development activities, including proposal development, solutioning, client discussions, and other pre-sales initiatives.
* Driving sectoral marketing, industry visibility, representing the 1Lattice brand, and supporting lead generation and conversion initiatives.
* End-to-end ownership of project scoping and delivery by leading high-impact teams and ensuring overall client satisfaction and engagement.
* Driving thought leadership in projects and coming up with compelling approaches, frameworks, and solutions to client problems.
* Managing team growth and satisfaction - be responsible for their success as well as build a strong team culture.
* Play an active role in recruitment and build project delivery teams in your vertical.

Competencies and skills:
  
  

* Deep understanding of the BFSI domain, including lending & specialty finance-linked segments.
* Proven experience in business research / consulting / data services, with a minimum of 8+ years of experience leading and managing teams in the BFSI, Lending, or Specialty Finance industry.
* Strong and credible industry relationships with the ability to manage senior stakeholder conversations, drive account growth within existing clients, understand client needs, and develop trusted relationships.
* Ability to create impactful proposals for specific projects with a tailored approach and support business development initiatives for maximum conversions.
* Demonstrated ability to execute and project manage large-scale projects from beginning to completion, with a strong orientation to planning work, defining scope and approach for assignments, and driving work through teams with high efficiency.
* Strong team management skills: building a strong team culture, driving high impact and efficiency, and ensuring team growth and happiness.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, deriving insights from data and conversations.
* Excellent communication skills, both written (slide / text output) and verbal (client presentations).

title: Accounts Payable & Receivable Executive -Andheri East
description:
Role Summary
  
  
We are looking for a detail-oriented Accounts Payable & Receivable Executive to manage the day-to-day finance operations of the company. You will own the end-to-end payables and receivables cycle, from vendor invoice processing and payments to customer billing and collections, while ensuring accuracy, statutory compliance and timely reporting.
  
  
Key ResponsibilitiesAccounts Payable
  
  

* Verify, code and process vendor invoices with proper three-way matching (PO, GRN, invoice).
* Prepare and execute vendor payments on schedule via NEFT/RTGS/UPI and other banking channels, after required approvals.
* Maintain vendor master data, including bank details, GST and PAN, and ensure KYC and documentation are complete.
* Reconcile vendor statements with the books and resolve discrepancies or disputes promptly.
* Track payment due dates, manage the payment calendar and avoid late payment penalties.
* Ensure correct TDS deduction, GST input credit eligibility and timely deposit of statutory dues.
* Process employee expense claims and petty cash, where applicable.

Accounts Receivable
  
  

* Prepare and issue customer invoices, credit notes and debit notes accurately and on time.
* Monitor outstanding receivables, maintain ageing reports and follow up with customers for timely collections.
* Perform cash application: match receipts to invoices and update the ledgers.
* Coordinate with sales and operations teams to resolve billing queries and disputes.
* Escalate overdue and doubtful accounts to management with recommended actions.
* Reconcile customer ledgers and share account statements and balance confirmations.

Operations & Monitoring
  
  

* Post daily accounting entries in the ERP/accounting software (Tally, Zoho Books, SAP or similar).
* Perform bank reconciliations (daily/weekly/monthly) and clear reconciling items.
* Monitor cash flow, payment schedules and receivable inflows; provide regular cash position updates.
* Prepare MIS reports: payables ageing, receivables ageing, vendor outstanding, DSO and collection summaries.
* Support month-end and year-end closing, including provisions, accruals and ledger scrutiny.
* Assist with GST, TDS and other statutory filings and coordinate with external CAs and auditors.
* Support internal and statutory audits by providing documents and clarifications.
* Improve and document AP/AR processes and internal controls.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* B.Com / M.Com or equivalent; CA Inter, MBA (Finance) or similar is a plus.
* 4–15 years of experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable or general accounting.
* Working knowledge of GST, TDS and basic Indian accounting and taxation norms.
* Proficiency in Tally / Zoho Books / SAP or similar accounting software.
* Strong Excel skills (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables, reconciliations).
* Good understanding of banking operations and online payment processes.
* Strong attention to detail, with good analytical and numerical ability.
* Clear communication skills for dealing with vendors, customers and internal teams.
* Ability to manage deadlines and work with minimal supervision.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Experience handling a high volume of vendor payments and collections.
* Exposure to ERP systems and automation of finance workflows.
* High integrity and discretion in handling confidential financial information.
* Proactive, ownership-driven approach to problem solving.

Key Performance Indicators
  
  

* Timeliness and accuracy of vendor payments
* Reduction in overdue receivables and DSO
* Accuracy of reconciliations and month-end closing timelines
* Zero statutory penalties or late filings
* Quality and timeliness of MIS reporting

title: Regulatory Capital Risk Sr. Lead Analyst, Senior Vice President
description:
Shape how Citi assesses and safeguards capital resilience as a Senior Regulatory Capital Risk Analyst within Finance Risk's International Capital Planning Review Team. In this role, you will lead independent review and challenge of ICAAPs and recovery plans for legal entities across Asia North and South, while also driving the governance framework that keeps the review function consistent and well controlled. Your assessments and credible challenge will directly inform how senior leaders and regulators view the capital strength of Citi's international legal entities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Lead independent review and challenge of ICAAPs and Local Recovery Plans for a portfolio of legal entities across Asia North and South, assessing capital adequacy and resilience against local regulatory expectations.
* Evaluate core ICAAP components, including risk identification, capital planning, economic capital, stress testing and recovery planning linkages, to identify emerging regulatory and capital risk themes.
* Present review conclusions and challenge findings to senior management and governance forums, and track remediation of identified issues through to completion.
* Own the governance framework for the regulatory capital review function, including the annual review plan, operating procedures and quality standards.
* Coordinate review planning and execution tracking across a global regulatory capital review portfolio to support consistent, on-time delivery.
* Manage issue tracking, recommendation follow-up and management reporting to support timely escalation and transparent governance.
* Partner with regional leads to coordinate regulatory examinations, internal audit reviews and quality assurance activities, maintaining a strong control environment.
* Build trusted relationships across Legal Entity CFO, Risk, Treasury and Capital Management teams to influence remediation plans and strengthen capital management practices.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* 12+ years of experience in regulatory capital, ICAAP, capital management, treasury, enterprise risk, internal audit or regulatory policy.
* Working knowledge of Basel regulatory capital frameworks, ICAAP requirements, stress testing and legal entity capital management.
* Background conducting independent review and challenge, regulatory examinations, internal audit reviews or second-line risk oversight.
* Experience managing governance, controls, issue tracking and regulatory engagement processes.
* Capability to assess complex capital adequacy frameworks and deliver credible challenge to senior stakeholders and governance forums.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills combined with proven project and stakeholder management capabilities across a global organization.
* Bachelor's degree and advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

* Experience applying data analytics techniques to support regulatory capital and risk assessments.

title: Sustainability Data, Process & Reporting, Associate – Global Corporate Sustainability Controllers
description:
**About This Role**
**Your Team**
The Global Corporate Sustainability Controllers (GCSC) team is responsible for the governance, management, and reporting of sustainability data and metrics that support internal decision-making, external disclosures, assurance activities, and evolving reporting requirements across the firm. The team partners closely with stakeholders across Finance & Strategy, Corporate Sustainability, Technology, Operations, and other business functions to enhance the quality, consistency, governance, and accessibility of sustainability-related information. As sustainability reporting requirements continue to evolve, the team is focused on strengthening controls, improving data quality, increasing reporting efficiency, and building scalable processes that support future business needs.
  
  
This role sits within the Greenhouse Gas (GHG) Reporting pillar of GCSC. The pillar is responsible for the development, governance, reporting, and continuous improvement of the firm's operational GHG inventory and associated reporting processes. The team plays an important role in delivering trusted emissions data, supporting assurance activities, and helping the firm monitor progress against its operational sustainability objectives.
  
  
**Your Role and Impact**
The Sustainability Data, Process & Reporting Associate will play a key role in both the delivery and modernization of the firm's operational GHG reporting processes. This role combines participation in GHG inventory reporting, controls, and assurance activities with dedicated responsibility for identifying, designing, and implementing process improvements. The successful candidate will help improve how sustainability data is collected, managed, validated, and reported while supporting the team's efforts to enhance reporting efficiency, scalability, timeliness, and data quality.
  
  
The role provides a unique opportunity to apply data analysis, process optimization, automation, and technology-enabled problem solving within a rapidly evolving sustainability reporting environment. Working closely with business and technology stakeholders, the individual will help challenge existing ways of working, identify opportunities for improvement, and support the development of more efficient and scalable reporting capabilities.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities**

* Support the collection, validation, reconciliation, and consolidation of data used in the operational GHG inventory and related sustainability reporting activities.
* Support reporting, controls, documentation, audit readiness, and assurance activities to help ensure the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of reported information.
* Develop a detailed understanding of existing sustainability reporting processes, data flows, systems, operational dependencies, and control frameworks.
* Identify opportunities to improve reporting efficiency, strengthen controls, re
* duce manual effort, and enhance data quality through data-driven process improvements.
* Design, develop, and implement automation opportunities, workflow enhancements, and scalable reporting solutions that improve operational effectiveness and reporting timeliness.
* Partner with stakeholders across sustainability, enterprise services, finance, data, and technology teams to deliver reporting improvements and support implementation of enhanced processes and tools.
* Evaluate emerging technologies and artificial intelligence-enabled capabilities that can enhance sustainability reporting, management information, operational decision-making, and process efficiency.

**Your Experience**

* Experience working within reporting, controls, or assurance environments, with a strong understanding of reporting processes, reconciliations, governance frameworks, and the production of reliable management or external reporting.
* Experience working with complex datasets and proven ability to identify inefficiencies and implement process improvements through automation, workflow redesign, technology-enabled solutions, or continuous improvement initiatives.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with the ability to translate business requirements into practical and scalable solutions.
* Sustainability reporting, GHG accounting, environmental reporting, or environmental data management experience.
* Experience partnering effectively with stakeholders across business, operations, and technology teams to deliver improvements and solve complex business challenges.
* Demonstrated interest in emerging technologies, automation, and artificial intelligence-enabled solutions, with a focus on improving business processes, reporting capabilities, and operational efficiency.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to collaborate effectively across business and technical teams.

**Yours Skills And Qualifications**

* Bachelor or Masters degree.
* 3-5 years relevant work experience (ideally Financial Services).
* Experience working with PowerBI, SQL, AI models or comparable data management and automation tools.

**What Will Help You Excel**

* A natural curiosity for how processes work and how they can be improved.
* A passion for using data to solve business problems and drive better outcomes.
* A proactive mindset with the confidence to challenge existing ways of working and propose new approaches.
* The ability to balance delivery of operational responsibilities with longer-term improvement initiatives.
* Interest in sustainability, environmental reporting, and the evolving role of technology within reporting and controls functions.

**Why Join Us**

* This role offers a unique opportunity to help shape the future of sustainability reporting within a growing and evolving function. You will contribute to critical GHG reporting activities while helping drive improvements in data quality, reporting efficiency, automation, controls, and process design.
* You will work at the intersection of sustainability, data, process improvement, and technology, helping build more scalable and timely reporting capabilities that support the firm's operational sustainability objectives and evolving reporting requirements.

**Our Benefits**
To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
  
  
**Our hybrid work model**
BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.
  
  
**Guidance on AI use for candidates**
At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided
**guidance**
on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.
  
  
**About BlackRock**
At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.
  
  
This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.
  
  
To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

**Role Purpose**

Drive commercial excellence across large-scale Asia projects in
**infrastructure, energy, and natural resources**
, ensuring robust contract strategy, disciplined cost control, and proactive risk management. You will lead negotiations for complex construction agreements, manage claims and disputes, and establish governance frameworks that protect margins and enable successful delivery of multi-billion-dollar projects.

**Strategic Imperative**

Transform commercial and contractual rigor into a strategic advantage: standardize contract playbooks, enforce risk allocation discipline (FIDIC/NEC/local forms), lead high-value negotiations, and institutionalize lessons learned to strengthen delivery certainty and profitability across diverse Asia markets.

* Develop and execute commercial strategies for major infrastructure and energy projects across Asia.
* Define procurement approaches for EPC, EPCM, Design & Build, and other bespoke agreements to regional market conditions.
* Establish and maintain contract playbooks and negotiation guidelines to ensure consistency and best practice.

**2) Contracting & Negotiations**

* Lead negotiations for large-scale construction agreements, ensuring optimal risk allocation and commercial value.
* Integrate technical and execution constraints into enforceable contractual terms, including LDs, performance guarantees, and incentive mechanisms.
* Collaborate with Legal and Project Delivery teams to ensure contracts are executable and aligned with delivery capabilities.

**3) Cost Management & Financial Control**

* Oversee project budgets, forecasts, and cash flow; implement rigorous change control processes.
* Drive value engineering initiatives and monitor commitments against approved budgets.
* Provide executive-level reporting on commercial exposure and recovery strategies.

**4) Risk & Compliance**

* Identify and mitigate commercial, legal, and execution risks across multi-jurisdictional projects.
* Apply international and regional contract standards (FIDIC, NEC, local forms) and ensure compliance with regulatory frameworks.
* Conduct post-project reviews to capture lessons learned and improve future contracting strategies.

**5) Claims & Dispute Management**

* Lead complex variation and extension-of-time claims, ensuring timely resolution and margin protection.
* Manage dispute avoidance and resolution boards (DAB/DRB) and negotiate settlement agreements where necessary.
* Implement claims governance and early-warning systems to minimize escalation.

**6) Stakeholder & Partner Engagement**

* Act as the senior commercial representative with clients, contractors, lenders, and government authorities.
* Build strong relationships to facilitate approvals, resolve issues, and secure successful project outcomes.

**7) Leadership & Team Development**

* Mentor and develop Commercial Managers and Analysts; foster a culture of accountability and continuous improvement.

Promote collaboration across Project Delivery, Engineering, Legal, and Finance teams

**Essential**

* 10–15+ years’ experience in commercial management for major infrastructure, energy, or natural resource projects.
* Degree in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, Engineering, Finance, or related discipline.
* Proven track record in negotiating multi-million-dollar EPC and O&M contracts for large-scale projects.
* Expertise in claims management and dispute resolution for projects exceeding $500M.
* Strong knowledge of FIDIC/NEC and regional contract forms; ability to tailor risk allocation by jurisdiction.
* Advanced negotiation, financial analysis, and stakeholder management skills.

**Preferred**

* Professional certifications (MRICS, AIQS, PMP or equivalent).
* Experience in renewable energy, power generation, or heavy engineering sectors.
* Familiarity with cultural and regulatory nuances across APAC markets.

**Core Competencies**

* **Commercial Acumen:**
  Understands full P&L impact and risk exposure.

* **Claims Expertise:**

description:

We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one other and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**
The role delivers as the Finance leader to all the service delivery of the global / regional hubs for AR/AP & GAO organization.
  
  
This in partnership with functional business stakeholders to identify service components to deliver business outcomes and capabilities with a focus on delivery through vendor partners. This role will oversee vendor service delivery and finance operations, ensuring seamless integration and execution of financial services across the organization. The role is crucial in managing vendor relationships, optimizing service delivery and driving operational efficiency while ensuring that all finance operations are aligned with company goals. This role also leads the finance operations transformation agenda by advancing scalable processes, modern business systems, and high-performing external partnerships to improve control, efficiency, service, and business value.
  
  
The incumbent needs to be a strategic thinker with a strong background in vendor management, finance operations, and process optimization. They need to establish and maintain strong relationships with all stakeholders, service delivery teams and vendor partners to deliver business results. This role leads a strong adherence to governance procedure to maintain the health across all delivery centers for vendors partners and across geographies. The role will also be responsible for projects delivery involving multiple internal, external and matrix partners.
  
  
**Key Accountabilities**
**Finance Operations Strategy & Service Delivery**

* Develop strategy & road map for driving global finance operations with service excellence, digital integration and actionable insights driven organization
* Lead end-to-end delivery across Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, and General Accounting Operations across global and regional hubs like India, China, Europe and North America
* Ensure finance operations are aligned to business priorities, scalable for growth, and executed with high standards of consistency and quality.
* Act as a trusted advisor to finance leaders, controllers, and business stakeholders on strategic priorities and operational decisions.

**Vendor Governance & External Partnership Management**

* Lead strategic relationships with external partners to ensure delivery against SLAs, contractual commitments, and business expectations
* Oversee the right source mix across in-house and outsourced models to expand scope and strengthen capability delivery.
* Monitor service performance and relationship health through structured reviews with stakeholders and finance leadership.

**Controls, Compliance & Operational Excellence**

* Ensure all finance processes operate efficiently, remain compliant, and meet business and control requirements
* Strengthen governance documentation and operating discipline to support regulatory compliance and sustainable service delivery.
* Ensure General Mills control protocols and defined guidelines are consistently implemented across vendor-managed operations
* Partner with Audit and Compliance teams to support reviews, issue resolution, and overall process integrity

**Transformation, Digitization & Continuous Improvement**

* Lead the finance operations transformation agenda to improve control, efficiency, service, and business value
* Identify and apply external best practices, digital trends, and emerging capabilities to advance finance operations maturity
* Build business cases for technology enablement and process modernization to enhance service delivery and operational effectiveness
* Drive a continuous improvement mindset focused on simplification, standardization, and automation

**People Leadership & Organization Capability**

* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing global finance organization across multiple regions
* Drive team engagement, performance management, and talent planning to build a strong and sustainable leadership pipeline
* Foster a collaborative, results-oriented culture supported by ongoing capability building and professional development
* Strengthen organizational resilience through business continuity planning, cross-training, and knowledge management
* Influence talent interventions and employer brand strategies to position General Mills as an employer of choice
* Build strong engagement with vendor teams to protect critical talent and reinforce the General Mills brand

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Minimum Education – Full time Graduation from an Accredited university (B. Com)
* Total Experience - 15+ years
* Significant experience in finance domain with controllership / Finance operations of a division or Business / Leadership roles in Finance organization

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Preferred Major Area of Study: Finance & Accounting
* Major Area of Study: Finance, Analytics, Accountancy, Costing
* Preferred Qualification: Master’s in commerce / finance / accounting, CA (ICAI), MBA
* Financial Acumen: Strong understanding of financial principles, processes, and systems is essential for driving process scope expansion, capability definition, and delivery.
* Knowledge and understanding of Accounting Standards (Indian and US GAAP)
* Strong knowledge and expertise in accounting function and processes like general ledger, inventory management, and cost accounting
* Proven track record of leading and coordinating strategic initiatives within a global organization, with experience in setting interfaces and aligning functional strategies
* Knowledge of Systems like SAP and expertise on technical tools is preferred
* Management of third-party service partners

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Financial Planning & Analysis Partner II
description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Scope of this role**
We are seeking a detail-oriented, highly analytical Financial Planning & Analysis Partner II to join our finance team. The Financial Planning & Analysis Partner II will primarily assist with financial forecasting, budgeting, modeling, and variance analysis to support strategic decision-making across the organization. The ideal candidate should have strong financial modeling skills, data analytics skills, and excellent communication abilities.
  
  
**Responsibilities**- Drive the monthly forecasting and annual planning related activities which include the following:

* Planning & Budgeting; current year and mid/long-term rolling corporate estimates and forecasts including cash forecasting. Serve as a thought leader to drive process improvement and create documentation to set precedence.
* Performance tracking against operating plans and KPIs; identifying risks and opportunities, driving accountability.
* Business intelligence, insight identification, and decision analytics for business partners and executive teams.
* Execute financial close and reporting processes in partnership with controllership, commercial, and accounting teams. Also, look for opportunities related to process improvement and drive change.
* Analyze financial performance, highlight trends and variances against budget and forecast with qualitative comments. Variance analysis of actuals vs forecast with key highlights/call outs to the management.
* Foster strong relationships with stakeholders, promoting effective communication and collaboration
* Lead and partner with cross-functional business teams in delivering analytics, data, and insights to drive key business decisions and support negotiations.
* Actively partner with global leaders to drive standardization, accuracy, and efficiency.
* Actively drive automation of reporting at the corporate level; support the FP&A organization through an end-to-end enterprise transformation.

**A Little About You**
A successful FP&A Analyst should be detail-oriented, and have a strong analytical mindset with the ability to identify and strengthen areas of business risks. They should help develop and maintain the right reporting models (completeness and accuracy) and adapt to business needs/strategic and growth mindset. This requires a lot of diligence and an attitude to take on new tasks while being solution-oriented.
  
  

* Strong work ethic, self-motivated work style, attention to detail, effective communicator
* Ability to organize multiple responsibilities and deliver results in an accurate and timely manner while adapting to changes in priorities.
* Ability to influence and strategically partner with individuals of various educational and technical backgrounds, both inside and outside the organization
* Strong business acumen and analytical skills with a demonstrated ability to gather, analyze, and present data
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines under pressure
* Self-starter with a strong sense of urgency and follow-up skills.

**Qualifications**

title: Finance Executive

Role Summary
  
  
Provide dedicated financial oversight for the Airoli data center client engagement, where JLL delivers both direct resources and agency services. Own spend tracking, billing accuracy, and financial governance across the account, acting as the primary financial liaison between JLL operations and client finance teams. Support PR/PO tracking, SLA-linked financial governance, and cost pass-through management for site-level operational and ad-hoc activities.

**Client Financial Management & Day-to-Day Operations**
Lead spend tracking and budget/forecast variance analysis for the Airoli account. Oversee invoicing, payment processing, cash application, and month-end accruals/deferrals. Conduct daily AP/AR reconciliation and resolve payment discrepancies with vendors and the client. Develop financial dashboards and executive presentations covering spend trends, cost-saving opportunities, and performance metrics for the account. Deliver variance analysis (actuals vs. budget vs. forecast) and support quarterly and annual business reviews, including financial run-rate reporting. Maintain internal controls, support audit processes, and ensure compliance with client-specific financial policies. Track and reconcile SLA-linked penalty calculations against operational performance, where commercial terms are tied to monthly recurring charges.
  
  
**Stakeholder & Escalation Management**
Serve as primary financial point of contact between JLL operations and the client's finance department. Facilitate monthly financial review meetings, manage escalations on financial matters, and coordinate with procurement on vendor management and contract optimization for the account.
  
  
**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or related field.
* 8–10 years' experience in finance, accounting, or client financial management; service industry experience (facilities management or real estate) preferred.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint proficiency for financial modeling and client presentations.
* Strong knowledge of GAAP and financial reporting standards.
* Experience with invoicing, AP/AR reconciliation, and budget/forecast variance analysis.
* Familiarity with SLA-linked commercial structures (e.g., penalty frameworks tied to monthly recurring charges) is an advantage.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and presentation skills across varied audiences.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple priorities independently.

The role will primarily focus on day-to-day finance operations, SAP transaction monitoring, procurement finance, inventory and working capital management, accounting reconciliations, and financial reporting, while continuing to support product costing and profitability analysis.
  
  
The Finance Professional will work closely with Procurement, SCM, Manufacturing, Engineering, CRM, GBS, and Finance teams to ensure timely financial transactions, effective operational controls, and continuous process improvements.
  
  
The position requires a
**hands-on finance professional with strong SAP knowledge, sound accounting fundamentals, commercial understanding, and analytical capabilities.**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Operational Finance & Accounting
* Support daily operational finance activities relating to procurement, manufacturing, inventory, logistics, and customer orders.
* Monitor SAP financial transactions and ensure correct GL accounts, cost centres, profit centres, and sales order assignments.
* Coordinate with Procurement, SCM, GBS, and Finance teams to resolve GRN/IR, invoice, payment, and accounting-related issues.
* Review operating expenses, provisions, accruals, and cost allocations to ensure accurate accounting and reporting.
* Support monthly and year-end closing activities, including reconciliations, accounting adjustments, and financial validations.
* Procurement Finance & Vendor Reconciliation
* Review purchase orders for financial accuracy, account assignments, and compliance with established processes.
* Monitor GR/IR balances, vendor payables, supplier advances, blocked invoices, and outstanding reconciliations.
* Coordinate with Procurement, SCM, and GBS teams to resolve transactional discrepancies and ensure timely financial closure.
* Support financial monitoring of imports, freight, customs duties, and supplier payments.
* Ensure compliance with internal financial controls and applicable company policies.
* Inventory & Working Capital Management
* Monitor inventory movements, stock valuation, inventory ageing, and related SAP transactions.
* Support perpetual inventory verification, physical stock reconciliation, and inventory provision calculations.
* Analyse slow-moving and non-moving inventory and coordinate corrective actions with relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor supplier advances, payables, and other operational working capital elements.
* Support initiatives to improve inventory accuracy, working capital efficiency, and transaction discipline.
* Product Costing & Profitability Analysis
* Support product costing for Motors and Drives, including planned, standard, committed, and actual costs.
* Monitor sales order profitability, cost variances, material costs, and manufacturing-related expenses.
* Review BOM costing, material master data, costing assumptions, and standard price updates.
* Coordinate with Engineering, Procurement, Manufacturing, and CRM teams to identify cost deviations and support corrective actions.
* Prepare cost-to-sales analysis, profitability reports, and operational performance reports.
* Financial Reporting, Compliance & Business Support
* Prepare monthly operational finance MIS, cost analysis, and management reports.
* Support NCC, warranty, royalty, brand fee, and intercompany cost calculations and reconciliations.
* Coordinate with stakeholders for timely accounting entries, supporting documentation, and financial clarifications.

title: Financial Controller - Analyst
description:
**Job Description**
You are a strategic thinker passionate about driving solutions in financial control. You have found the right team.
  
  
As an Analyst within the Global Technology Controllers in Corporate Sector Controllers, you will be responsible for providing controllership support to the technology function, including accounting for technology in accordance with US GAAP and JPMC standards.
  
  
Global Technology Controller provide controllership support to technology function in to Hardware, Software, Professional services and other direct expense lines. Team is also responsible for capitalization of tangible or intangible assets.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Determine expense versus capitalization treatment, ensure timely disposal recognition, and post close entries with appropriate support and approvals.
* Partner with Technology, P&A, Business Management, and Procurement to align on project scope, in-service dates, and cutover timing, and maintain SOX-compliant controls and audit-ready evidence.

* Validate operational impacts and future benefit assumptions with Technology and business stakeholders and record entries accurately and timely in the general ledger.
* Ensure balance sheet positions are appropriately supported to maintain a strong fortress balance sheet.
* Document analytics through estimates, walk-forwards, controller financial reviews, and flash reports.
* Analyze, communicate, and resolve material variances between the general ledger and upstream systems, as defined by the line of business.

* 3 years of related experience
* General Ledger experience. Experience with financial reporting and month end close responsibilities
* Comfortable liaising with business and risk managers

* Able to understand business drivers and requirements and influence middle and front office partners to deliver solutions to business issues and problems
* Strong analytical skills: Ability to quickly understand workings of a complex processing system and general ledger systems across the infrastructure and their interrelationships and dependencies
* Excellent desktop/spreadsheet/database skills
* Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills

* Able to multi-task in a constantly changing environment

title: Research Analyst - Commodities
description:
**Job Summary**

The Research Analyst – Commodities will be responsible for conducting in-depth research and analysis of domestic and global commodity markets to provide timely, actionable investment recommendations for institutional and retail clients. The role requires a strong understanding of macroeconomic factors, commodity fundamentals, and technical analysis to develop market outlooks and identify trading and investment opportunities across commodity segments.

**Key Responsibilities**

• Analyse domestic and global commodity markets, including precious metals, base metals, energy, and other relevant commodity segments.

• Undertake both fundamental and technical analysis to assess market trends, price movements, and investment opportunities.

• Prepare daily, weekly, and periodic commodity research reports providing:

• Overall market outlook.

• Investment recommendations.

• Specific trading and investment views on individual commodities.

• Track and interpret macroeconomic developments, including central bank policies, inflation trends, interest rates, currency movements, geopolitical events, and global economic indicators to assess their impact on commodity markets.

• Monitor supply-demand dynamics, inventory levels, production trends, weather patterns (where applicable), and other market drivers affecting commodity prices.

• Develop price forecasts and generate actionable recommendations for clients and internal stakeholders.

• Present market views through reports, presentations, webinars, client interactions, and media engagements as required.

• Collaborate with sales, dealing, and advisory teams to provide timely market intelligence and support business objectives.

• Continuously monitor market developments and update investment recommendations based on changing market conditions.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

• Strong knowledge of commodity markets, derivatives, and global macroeconomic trends.

• Proficiency in conducting both fundamental and technical analysis of commodity markets.

• Ability to convert complex market data into clear, actionable investment recommendations.

• Excellent analytical, report-writing, and presentation skills.

• Experience using market data platforms such as Bloomberg, Reuters, or similar financial information systems is preferred.

• Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

**Educational Qualifications**

• MBA (Finance), CFA, CA, Economics, Commerce, Finance, or any related discipline.

• Relevant certifications in technical analysis or financial markets will be an added advantage.

title: Manager - Finance
description:
**We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive Finance Manager professional to join our team. The role involves managing month-end closing, audits, taxation, and comprehensive accounting operations while ensuring accurate reporting and timely compliance. You will also collaborate closely with internal teams to drive financial discipline, oversee reconciliations, and support critical business reporting. If you excel in a dynamic environment and are committed to maintaining high standards of financial integrity, we’d love to connect.
  
  
What You'll Do:**

* Financial Accounting & Period-End Closure:
* Month-End & Year-End Close: Lead and streamline the monthly and annual book-close processes for the multiple business line in accordance with established timelines.
* D2C & E-Commerce Accounting: Spearheaded end-to-end accounting for the goods business vertical, including inventory valuation, revenue and procurement recognition, and SKU-level gross margin analysis across multiple e-commerce platforms.
* P&L & Balance Sheet Review: Conduct thorough P&L reviews and quarterly Balance Sheet reconciliations, providing clear variance analysis and business justifications for cost fluctuations.
* Provisions & Accruals: Track, record, and periodically review provisions, unbilled revenues, and accrual aging schedules for timely adjustments or releases.
* Audits, Governance & Statutory Compliance:
* Statutory & Entity Audits: Spearhead internal and external audits for legal entities (UAE, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia), ensuring timely resolution of audit queries and sign-off well within management deadlines.
* Direct Tax Audits & Assessments: Coordinate and close Tax Audits, Transfer Pricing audits, and regulatory filings (including COI/statutory disclosures).
* Tax Assessment Support: Facilitate Income Tax and Transfer Pricing assessments by preparing schedules, documentation, and liaison with external tax consultants.
* Taxation (Direct & Indirect):
* TDS Compliance: Ensure accurate deduction and accounting of Tax Deducted at Source (TDS) based on the applicable sections and nature of vendor contracts.
* GST & ITC Reconciliation: Manage GST compliance, maximise Input Tax Credit (ITC) utilisation strictly adhering to statutory rules, and maintain monthly GSTR-2B/3B reconciliations.
* Working Capital & Operational Finance:
* Accounts Payable (AP): Oversee invoice verification, coding, and accurate, timely disbursement processing.
* Accounts Receivable (AR) & Credit Control: Monitor customer aging reports, ensure proactive follow-up for collections, and maintain strict adherence to agreed credit periods.
* Reconciliations: Perform regular vendor, client, and inter-company ledger reconciliations to minimise unadjusted balances.
* Management Reporting & Strategic Projects:
* MIS & Management Reporting: Prepare and present routine management packs, including Sales & Cost analysis, AP/AR ageing summaries, and working capital overviews.
* Cross-Functional Projects: Partner with cross-functional teams on process improvement, ERP enhancements, and ad-hoc accounting projects.
* Executive Support: Support the Head of Department (HOD) and senior leadership with ad-hoc analytical assignments and special initiatives.

**Who You Are:**

* Education: MBA , Semi-qualified CA or ACCA preferred.
* Experience: Min 7 to 12 years of hands-on experience in financial reporting, corporate taxation (TDS/GST), and audit management.
* Technical Skills: Strong proficiency in ERP platforms (SAP / Oracle / NetSuite / Tally) and advanced Microsoft Excel (financial modelling, pivot tables, lookup formulas).
* Core Competencies: High attention to detail, strong analytical capability, proactive stakeholder communication, and strict adherence to statutory deadlines.

**Job Description**
**SCOPE OF WORK FOR SR. ASSOCIATE ACCOUNT MANAGEMENT ROLE**

* Loan Application Review & Credit Assessment:

Review and analyze loan applications and supporting documentation including income, credit reports, employment history, and property details. Assess borrower creditworthiness using the 4 C's methodology (Character, Capacity, Capital, Collateral) to ensure sound lending decisions and adherence to underwriting guidelines.
  
  

* Income Calculation & Financial Analysis:

Evaluate and calculate borrower income from various sources including salaried, hourly, commission, bonus, rental, and self-employment income. Analyze documents such as paystubs, W-2s, tax returns, and business financials (Schedule C, K-1, 1065, 1120S) to determine qualifying income accurately and consistently.
  
  

* Collateral & Property Evaluation:

Review appraisal reports, AVMs, and residential valuation documents to validate property value and ensure compliance with lending guidelines. Analyze title reports, lien positions, and ownership details to mitigate collateral risk.
  
  

* Underwriting Decision & Documentation:

Prepare detailed underwriting summaries, identify red flags, and document conditions and stipulations within the Loan Origination System (LOS), preferably Encompass. Recommend appropriate loan structures based on comprehensive risk assessment and borrower profile analysis.
  
  

* Workflow Management & Communication:

Collaborate with processors, loan officers, and internal stakeholders throughout the underwriting lifecycle. Provide clear communication on loan decisions, required conditions, and final clear-to-close (CTC) status to facilitate timely loan closing.
  
  

* Risk Identification & Compliance:

Identify discrepancies, inconsistencies, and potential risks in loan files. Ensure all underwriting decisions comply with internal policies, regulatory requirements, and investor guidelines to maintain portfolio quality.
  
  

* Reporting & Reconciliation:

Handle reconciliation of complex borrower accounts and prepare daily aging and pipeline reports to track loan progress, turnaround times, and performance metrics against departmental KPIs.
  
  

* System Utilization & Process Adherence:

Utilize LOS platforms (Encompass preferred) and adhere to underwriting workflows, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and compliance with company standards and best practices.
  
  

* Borrower Communication & Clarification Requests:

Issue clear and professional requests for additional documentation or clarification from borrowers and their representatives. Follow up on outstanding items to maintain loan file completeness and expedite the underwriting process.
  
  

* Exception Handling & Escalation:

Identify loans that fall outside standard guidelines and prepare exception reports with supporting analysis. Escalate complex or non-standard situations to management with recommendations for approval or denial.
  
  

* Quality Assurance & File Review:

Conduct thorough quality reviews of loan files to ensure completeness, accuracy, and compliance. Identify process improvements and provide feedback to team members to enhance overall departmental performance.
  
  

* Regulatory Compliance & Audit Readiness:

Maintain current knowledge of federal and state lending regulations, including TRID, ECOA, FHA, VA, and USDA guidelines. Ensure all underwriting decisions and documentation are audit-ready and compliant with regulatory examinations.
  
  

* Loan Product Knowledge & Guideline Updates:

Stay current with evolving loan products, investor guidelines, and underwriting standards. Communicate guideline changes to team members and implement updates to underwriting procedures promptly.
  
  

* Mentoring & Knowledge Sharing:

As a senior-level associate, mentor junior underwriting staff and processors on best practices, complex underwriting scenarios, and policy interpretations to foster team development and consistency.

* High School Diploma/GED and Bachelor's Degree (Mandatory)
* Mortgage industry certification or licensing (e.g., NMLS) preferred

:

title: Sr Manager- Commercial
description:
*Earlier this year, building on the strong foundation of Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP) as a fund manager, we introduced an optimized CIP Platform, with three platform companies providing services to CIP. To learn more, please refer to the CIP Platform section below.*
*In our optimized CIP Platform, CIP Terra Technologies – a project delivery company delivering projects from onshore wind, solar PV and battery energy storage systems, to bioenergy, thermal and transmission infrastructure – is currently looking for a Development Manager, to join the team in Mumbai, India*
**Role**
The Commercial Manager will oversee commercial and contractual management for our renewable energy project through development, construction and commissioning. The role will ensure that project contracts are commercially robust, contractual obligations are actively managed, changes and claims are controlled, and commercial risks are identified and mitigated to protect project returns and delivery timelines.This is a high-visibility position with direct exposure to senior management, the Steering Committee and international shareholders. It suits a commercially minded finance professional who is comfortable operating at the intersection of finance, contracts and operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities will consist of but are not limited to:**
Strategic decision support
  
  

* Support the management in strategic decision-making through robust commercial analysis, scenario modelling and clear recommendations.
* Evaluate options relating to financing, offtake, O&M, curtailment, merchant exposure, refinancing, asset optimisation and potential M&A / divestment, and articulate trade-offs and risks.

Board and Steering Committee material
  
  

* Prepare periodic reporting materials, SteerCo decks and supporting papers, consolidating inputs from Finance, Operations, Legal, Construction / Technical and external advisors.
* Ensure board material is accurate, concise, decision-oriented and delivered on time; track and close out SteerCo action items.

Contract management
  
  

* Perform the commercial evaluation of new contracts and contract amendments
* Assess commercial exposure, liquidated damages, claims, change orders, delay and performance entitlements; quantify financial impact for negotiation strategy.
* Support the evaluation, response and management of commercial disputes and notices (including claims, change in law, and termination-related notices) in coordination with Legal and external counsel.
* Maintain a contract register, key dates and obligations tracker.

Quarterly fair value
  
  

* Determine and recommend key valuation assumptions (e.g. power price and curtailment, generation / P50-P90, opex, inflation, discount rate, tax, and macro inputs) in line with the valuation policy
* Perform quality assurance on the financial model and results, including reconciliation to prior quarter, variance and sensitivity analysis, and review with auditors / valuers where required.
* Prepare and present the quarterly fair value reporting material to the management.

Budget and liquidity management
  
  

* Monitor Estimate at Completion (EAC) versus approved budget; analyse variances, forecast cost-to-complete and flag overruns early with proposed mitigations.
* Own the sources and uses of funds, rolling cash-flow forecasts and funding requirements (equity, debt drawdowns, working capital), and liaise with Treasury / Finance and the Sponsor on funding calls.

Risk management
  
  

* Maintain the project risk register: identify, quantify, assign owners and track mitigations across commercial, financial, construction, operational, regulatory and counterparty risks.
* Escalate key risks and present risk updates to management and the SteerCo.

Monitoring of financing, offtake and operations
  
  

* Financing: track debt covenants, compliance certificates, drawdowns, hedging, DSRA / reserve requirements and lender relationships.
* Offtake: monitor PPA terms and performance, tariff, payment and receivables, curtailment, deviation settlement and grid / counterparty developments.
* Operations: track generation, availability, O&M performance, opex versus budget and key operational KPIs, and translate them into commercial impact.
* Keep abreast of regulatory and policy developments in the Indian power sector (CERC / SERC / MNRE, open access, transmission charges, RPO / GNA, etc.).

**You**
You should have a Chartered Accountant (CA), CFA, MBA, BE from a reputed institute, or an equivalent professional qualification, with 8–10 years of relevant experience in commercial, finance, or project management roles, within the renewable energy, power, or infrastructure sectors. Practical experience with the construction and/or operation of large-scale wind, solar, or hybrid projects in India is required. You should also have experience in valuation and fair-value reporting, financial modelling, and investor or board reporting, with prior exposure to an international sponsor, private equity/infrastructure fund, or Big 4/advisory firm.
  
  
**We look for the following in a candidate:**

* Commercial acumen and structured judgment; ability to form a view and recommend a decision.
* Clear and effective communication, both written and spoken;
* High attention to detail, ownership, and ability to manage multiple deadlines and recurring reporting cycles.
* Integrity, discretion with confidential information, and a collaborative, solutions-oriented approach.

**The process**
Please apply online as soon as possible as applications will be processed on an ongoing basis. For questions related to the role, please reach out to our Talent Acquisition team at recruitment@cipfs.com. We do not include CV's and Cover Letters sent by email.
  
  
As we continue to improve our candidate experience, diversity and avoid unconscious bias, please avoid having a photo in your CV. We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality for all applicants.
  
  
Please be aware that we will not accept speculative CV submissions for any of our roles from recruitment agencies, and any unsolicited candidate submissions will be exempt from any payment expectations and ownership.
  
  
**CIP Terra Technologies’ commitment to diversity and inclusion**
CIP Terra Technologies is committed to securing a diverse and inclusive work environment where everyone feels respected and heard.
  
  
A diverse workforce allows CIP Terra Technologies to achieve results through different approaches and solutions to task execution and problem solving. We want all our employees to have equal opportunities for personal growth and career opportunities regardless of age, gender, sexual orientation, disability, religion, nationality, and ethnicity.
  
  
**About CIP Terra Technologies**
CIP Terra Technologies is a project delivery company working for CIP. CIP Terra Technologies is majority owned by the funds managed by CIP, with the purpose of delivering best-in-class project development and execution services to the growing portfolio of land-based renewable energy assets.
  
  
We engage in the energy transition through specialist project delivery, value creation, and collaboration with trusted third-party suppliers. Our core focus is the development, procurement, construction, and delivery of renewable energy projects, and we provide a variety of services including technical development, engineering, supply chain, construction management, and project execution.
  
  
We provide global support and a local presence in our key markets, and our teams are continuously delivering and refining services tailored to a wide range of technologies – from onshore wind, solar PV and battery energy storage systems, to bioenergy, thermal and transmission infrastructure. For more information, please visit CIP Terra Technologies.
  
  
**Optimized CIP Platform**
Earlier this year, we introduced an optimized CIP Platform. With three platform companies providing services to CIP—and while maintaining our current relationship with Copenhagen Offshore Partners (COP), CIP’s exclusive offshore wind development partner—we have effectively strengthened our organizational and operational capabilities, creating a platform scaled for growth and designing the CIP blueprint for the future.
  
  
We have established CIP Molecule Technologies, a tech-focused project delivery company dedicated to molecule projects; CIP Terra Technologies, a tech-focused project delivery company managing a diverse portfolio of onshore projects; and CIP Fund Solutions, a delivery company with expertise in complex fund management and investment services. For more info on this, please see: Optimized CIP Platform.

This individual will redesign complex Excel-based workflows into scalable, controlled solutions using tools such as Alteryx, Power BI, Power Query, VBA, Python, Tableau, and approved AI platforms. Beyond automation delivery, this role will evaluate transformation opportunities holistically, identifying improved data sourcing strategies, redesigning inefficient processes, and supporting the exploration of AI tools and vendors (e.g., Claude). The Associate will operate in an agile environment, partnering directly with Finance, Accounting, and Investment stakeholders to develop scalable, sustainable solutions.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
**Process Redesign & Automation**

* Analyze and deconstruct complex Excel-based processes with multiple manual steps and dependencies.
* Redesign workflows to improve scalability, transparency, and control.
* Develop automation solutions primarily using Alteryx and complementary tools.
* Implement reconciliation checks and automated validation controls to ensure accuracy and completeness.
* Optimize existing workflows to improve efficiency and performance.

**AI & Advanced Analytics Enablement**

* Evaluate AI and automation use cases within Finance Transformation.
* Research and assess emerging tools and vendors, including generative AI platforms.
* Support pilot initiatives and proof-of-concept development.
* Collaborate with leadership to define metrics, tracking frameworks, and KPIs to measure transformation impact.
* Assist in communicating program progress and results to stakeholders.

**Solution Design & Data Structuring**

* Apply strong data modeling principles to support scalable reporting solutions.
* Structure transformed data to enable reporting, trending, variance analysis, and future enhancements.
* Balance ideal-state architecture with practical tool constraints.

**Delivery Ownership & Initiative Coordination**

* Own E2E delivery of assigned transformation initiatives/JIRA stories
* Partner with stakeholders to define scope, requirements, objectives, and delivery
* Develop and maintain lightweight timelines
* Coordinate execution across Finance, Accounting, and Technology.

**Stakeholder Collaboration & Communication**

* Partner directly with Finance, Accounting, and Investment stakeholders.
* Translate business requirements into structured solution designs.
* Present findings and recommendations clearly using organized documentation and summaries.
* Support adoption and change management for new automated processes.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Data Analytics, or related field.
* 5–8 years of experience in Finance or Accounting, Data Transformation, Financial Systems, Automation, or related roles
* Demonstrated experience automating complex Excel-based processes.
* Hands-on experience with Alteryx or comparable automation tools.
* Experience working directly with business stakeholders to redesign and improve processes.
* Exposure to AI tools, analytics platforms, or transformation program initiatives preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Advanced Excel (complex formulas, structured modeling).
* Strong Alteryx development experience.
* Experience with BI tools (Power BI, Tableau).
* Experience with data transformation tools (Power Query or equivalent).
* Strong understanding of data modeling principles to support scalable reporting solutions.
* Experience implementing reconciliation checks and automated validation controls.
* Familiarity with AI platforms or automation frameworks is a plus.

**Core Competencies**

* Structured analytical thinking and problem-solving
* Ability to evaluate processes holistically and challenge inefficient workflows
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Comfort operating in an agile, evolving environment
* Ability to balance innovation with practical implementation constraints.
* Strong stakeholder relationship management skills.
