title: Investment Associate – Venture Capital
description:
**Investment Associate – Venture Capital**

**Location: Mumbai | Full-time | On-site**

**About Rockstud Capital**

**Rockstud Capital is an India-focused investment platform managing SEBI-registered Category I and Category II Alternative Investment Funds. Our current investment focus centres on manufacturing-led businesses and applied deep technology, including advanced manufacturing, industrial systems, defence, aerospace, space technologies, industrial sustainability and manufacturing-led consumer businesses.**

**We assess opportunities through commercial and operating fundamentals: engineering capability, competitive differentiation, unit economics, capital efficiency, governance and the ability to scale. We work closely with founders on investment strategy, business priorities and long-term growth.**

**About the Role**

**We are looking for an Investment Associate who can independently identify promising businesses, build relationships with founders and industry participants, and develop well-reasoned investment recommendations.**

**This is a sourcing-led investment role within a lean, founder-led team. You will take ownership of opportunities from identification and initial engagement through preliminary evaluation and preparation for deeper diligence, working closely with colleagues responsible for transaction execution and portfolio management.**

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Originate investment opportunities:**
  Build a consistent pipeline aligned with Rockstud’s investment focus through direct founder outreach, sector research and relationships with investors, incubators, accelerators and industry networks.
* **Own founder engagement:**
  Lead initial discussions, ask commercially relevant questions, maintain timely follow-ups and build constructive relationships.
* **Develop sector insight:**
  Map industries, value chains and emerging businesses to identify attractive investment themes and sourcing opportunities.
* **Evaluate businesses:**
  Assess business models, market opportunities, competitive positioning, technology differentiation, customer adoption, unit economics and scalability.
* **Analyse financial performance:**
  Review financial statements, build appropriate projections and valuation analyses, and assess working-capital requirements, capital intensity and funding needs.
* **Prepare investment recommendations:**
  Write clear screening notes and investment memos that explain the opportunity, key risks, unresolved questions and recommended next steps.
* **Support diligence and transactions:**
  Coordinate with the investment team, founders and relevant specialists, ensuring a clear handover of findings, documents and outstanding issues.
* **Maintain investment records:**
  Keep pipeline information, meeting notes, source documents and next actions current and organised.
* Contribute to selected portfolio and strategic projects where your sector knowledge or relationships can add value.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Relevant experience in venture capital, private equity, investment banking, transaction advisory, consulting or an industrial/technology business.
* Evidence of independently identifying opportunities, developing relationships and taking work through to a clear outcome.
* A strong interest in manufacturing and applied technology, with the ability to understand unfamiliar businesses and distinguish technical claims from commercial potential.
* Sound financial analysis, modelling and valuation skills.
* Clear writing and communication, including the ability to form and defend an investment view.
* Initiative, sound judgement and disciplined follow-through in a lean team.
* Comfort working from our Mumbai office and travelling for founder meetings, industry engagement and site visits when required.
* A degree in Finance, Economics, Engineering, Business or a related discipline. CA, CFA progress or an MBA would be an advantage.
* Candidates should be able to explain their individual contribution to previous sourcing, evaluation or transaction work, including the decisions made and outcomes achieved.

eam & Stakeholder Management

title: Assistant Manager, Accounts Payable
description:
**Overview**
Cactus Life Sciences is a remote-first organization, and we embrace an accelerate from anywhere culture. You may be required to travel to our Mumbai office based on business requirements or for company/team events.
  
  
We are looking for an Assistant Manager , Accounts Payable to join our Finance team and play a key role in managing day-to-day invoice processing and Accounts Payable activities.
  
  
In this role,you will own end-to-end Accounts Payable operations across our US, India, UK and Swiss entities, and the reporting that gives management visibility into payables, vendor exposure and cash commitments. You are required to set the standard for AP accuracy, control, and timeliness. You work closely with procurement, business users, taxation, and the month-end close team
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Own the full procure-to-pay AP cycle across markets: invoice validation, PO matching, coding, approvals, payment runs and reconciliations.
* Review and approve payment proposals against due dates, priorities, and cash availability.
* Review vendor ageing, advances and open balances, and ensure timely vendor statement reconciliations.
* Act as the escalation point for vendors and internal queries, resolving issues quickly with procurement and business users.
* Govern vendor master data, including onboarding checks and bank detail changes
* Ensure correct withholding tax and indirect tax treatment on vendor invoices (TDS and GST in India, 1099 reporting in the US, VAT in the UK and Switzerland).
* Reconcile GSTR-2B with the purchase and vendor ledgers each month.
* Coordinate with the tax team on AP-related filings and queries.
* Identify control gaps and drive corrective action.
* Prepare AP schedules, reconciliations and supporting documents for statutory, internal and tax audits, and close audit observations related to AP.
* Maintain controls against duplicate, incorrect, and unauthorized payments.
* Deliver AP sub-ledger reconciliations, accruals, prepayments and GRNI reviews within close timelines.
* Resolve open items and ensure AP-related journals are accurate and supported.
* Produce a regular AP reporting pack covering ageing, DPO, payment commitments, vendor concentration, statutory liabilities, and cash outflow forecasts.
* Provide inputs to treasury and the CFO for cash flow planning and working capital decisions.
* Track and report AP KPIs such as invoice cycle time, first-pass match rate, overdue payables, and late-payment exposure.
* Identify and implement improvements in AP workflow, invoice capture, approvals, and reconciliations.
* Drive effective use of Oracle Fusion and work with IT on automation initiatives.
* Document and maintain SOPs for AP and reconciliation processes.

**Qualifications And Prerequisites**

* CA, MBA (Finance) or equivalent, with 6 to 8 years of AP experience, preferably across multiple geographies.
* Hands-on experience with month-end close and audit support
* Strong working knowledge of withholding tax and indirect tax (India required; US, UK and Swiss exposure preferred).
* Working knowledge of accounting principles (Ind AS, US GAAP, or IFRS).
* Proficiency in an ERP, with Oracle or Oracle Fusion preferred, and advanced Excel (pivots, lookups, reconciliations). Power BI or similar is a plus.
* Strong analytical, reconciliation, and reporting skills.
* Attention to detail, ownership, and the ability to work tight deadlines across time zones.
* Clear communication with vendors, auditors, and senior management.

Application Process
  
  
Before applying, please ensure you meet the role requirements listed above and have legal authorization to work in the country where this role is advertised. Our selection process typically involves an initial screening by a recruiter, a technical assessment, and two to three interview rounds. For this role, the process starts with a recruiter screening, followed by 4 interview rounds, including the HRBP interview.
  
  
**AI at Cactus Life Sciences**
The life sciences industry is undergoing a fundamental shift in how scientific knowledge is created, communicated, and delivered. We are building our work around it.
  
  
AI is embedded meaningfully across everything we do, through proprietary platforms purpose-built for life sciences and generative tools that deliver measurable value to our clients. It is core to how we operate, and an expected way of working for everyone who joins us.
  
  
We believe in Human-Anchored AI™: whatever your discipline - science, communications, strategy, or operations, you will work in an environment where AI augments your expertise rather than replaces it.
  
  
You will build skills that are in genuine demand and still taking shape across the industry. If you are curious and focused on building capabilities for the world where human intelligence meets artificial intelligence, this is where you belong.
  
  
**Equal Opportunity**
Our hiring practices reflect our commitment to providing equal opportunities and creating an environment where everyone can thrive, develop, and succeed. We celebrate the uniqueness of our team members and prohibit discrimination of any kind, based on race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, or any other protected characteristic.
  
  
**About CACTUS**
At Cactus Life Sciences (cactuslifesciences.com), we believe the future of medical communications lies at the intersection of science, technology, and human connection. Headquartered in Princeton, New Jersey, with teams in Switzerland, the United Kingdom, India, and Japan, we help biopharmaceutical organizations redefine scientific exchange—leveraging AI, automation, and innovation while keeping patients at the heart of everything we do.
  
  
Our expertise spans medical strategy, scientific content development, and medical education across therapeutic areas and the product lifecycle. By blending scientific rigor, agile operational models, and future-ready technologies, we partner with medical affairs teams to catalyze their transformation, adapt to a changing landscape, and drive meaningful outcomes for healthcare communities worldwide.

title: Data Steward, SAPAC (contract)
description:
**With a passion for life**
Join our diverse teams of passionate people and a career that allows you to develop both personally and professionally. At Getinge we exist to make life-saving technology accessible for more people. To make a true difference for our customers – and to save more lives, we need team players, forward thinkers, and game changers.
  
  
Are you looking for an inspiring career? You just found it.
  
  
**Please Note - This is a 24-month contractual position**
**Job Purpose**
The Data Steward is the operational execution lead for commercial data quality across SAPAC, supporting the Data Coordinator and the respective business data owners. The role performs recurring data verification, audits, sampling and correction activities, directly supports designated markets, and produces the reporting required to identify and resolve data quality issues — flagging the underlying cause of each issue so that it can be addressed at source.
  
  
**Output: accurate data, completed corrections under owner approval, managed exceptions, root causes flagged, and timely data quality reporting.**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Recurring verification and reporting (all markets, under the agreed allocation)**

* Post-load price verification after every price load: sample SKUs against the approved price file and flag mismatches for correction (accuracy — distinct from the Data Coordinator's quarterly audit of timeliness)
* All cost-to-price reconciliation: spare parts each price-increase cycle (selling price versus current transfer price per part, flagging negative or below-threshold margins) and completeness checks on capital and consumables reconciliation
* Monthly contract-expiry report per market: contracts expiring within 90 days with no renewal action, and the on-time renewal rate
* Monthly preventive-maintenance completion reporting using the regional tracker template
* Quarterly customer-master-to-pricing audits where applicable: affiliations, hierarchies and classifications that drive pricing conditions
* Quarterly customer master hygiene runs: duplicate detection, entity and payer verification, classification checks
* Quarterly point-of-sale service-contract reconciliation and warranty-versus-installation allocation sampling
* Rotating monthly contract-record completeness sampling by market (expiry, pricing and coverage fields)
* For every recurring exception, record the likely underlying cause (process, ownership, system) alongside the correction, so patterns can be addressed by the Data Coordinator and the business owner

**Direct execution for designated markets (primary executor)**

* Prepare, validate and load price files into SAP for designated markets — reviewed by the Data Coordinator, verified and signed off by the market's Finance Director
* Execute installed base corrections and cleansing, customer master de-duplication and corrections, and contract-record completion, each under business-owner approval
* Capture point-of-sale service contracts into the portfolio and maintain preventive-maintenance tracking where local capacity is limited
* Enter and maintain distributor installation and end-customer data received under the regional collection standard
* Keep the execution log: every change, its approving data owner, and turnaround — reported to the Steering Committee via the Lead

**Installed base (all markets)**

* Execute the corrections arising from the installed base accuracy programme coordinated by the Data Coordinator; maintain the underlying data for the country accuracy score

**Support and enablement**

* Handle hands-on support requests from non-designated markets — price-file validation, IB corrections, de-duplication — logged and reported, with the Steering Committee managing the balance against verification work
* Maintain the single current repository of data SOPs using existing global platforms (GetBasic, GetLibrary, GetQMS, the Finance Manual) rather than local copies
* Produce one-page filter, currency and refresh-cycle guides for the global dashboards and support market training

**Phase 2 (from month 6, gated)**

* Zone and region performance reporting for India, building on work already under way with the Service Director
* Account-history and customer summary requests for sales and service teams, once scoped by the Steering Committee

**Requirements**
**Must have:**

* 4–8 years in data operations, master data maintenance, finance operations, order management or service administration
* Hands-on SAP experience in at least two of: customer master, material master, pricing conditions, equipment and service-contract records — including creating and maintaining records, not only reporting on them
* Advanced Excel (lookups, pivots, reconciliations); Power BI a strong advantage
* Meticulous attention to detail and the persistence to work through large record sets methodically
* The habit of asking why an error occurred — able to recognise when a data problem is really a process or ownership problem, and to say so
* Good written and spoken English; able to explain an exception clearly to a colleague in another country
* Comfortable working across cultures and time zones with people who do not report to you

**Good To Have**

* An analytics background or interest — the role has a Phase 2 pathway into reporting and analytics work
* Medical-device, pharmaceutical or other regulated-industry experience
* Exposure to service-contract or installed-base administration
* Experience with distributor or channel data

**About Us**
With a firm belief that every person and community should have access to the best possible care, Getinge provides hospitals and life science institutions with products and solutions aiming to improve clinical results and optimize workflows. The offering includes products and solutions for intensive care, cardiovascular procedures, operating rooms, sterile reprocessing and life science. Getinge employs over 12,000 people worldwide and the products are sold in more than 135 countries.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

title: Investment Analyst, Portfolio Management
description: ABOUT VANTROCKVantrock is an operator-led real assets platform, built to work in the white space of every strategy it enters. A real asset is three jobs: finding the land, building and running the asset, managing the capital that owns it. Vantrock does all three with one team. Headquartered in Mumbai, it originates, develops, operates and manages institutional-grade real assets from land to operations. Warehousing, industrial and logistics parks are the first strategy. The platform is run by operators, and it is built to run lean. Suburban office campuses, strata offices, data centres, senior living and infrastructure assets follow, each as its own strategy, sequenced on delivery and each in a white space others have left open, with a clear path to REITs and InvITs. Real assets only, across every class the platform grows into, in sequence.WHY THIS ROLE EXISTSThe portfolio management company needs clean research, accurate data and books that close every day. This seat provides all three, working directly with the Principal Officer.It is an analyst seat with a wide view. You research listed markets and credit, build the real asset data that sits behind the platform's thinking, and keep the portfolios, records and reports right. You prepare the case. The Principal Officer makes the decision.You should not apply if you want a pure research seat with no reconciliation in it. The operations work is half the seat, and it matters as much as the research.WHAT YOU WILL OWNConduct research and analysis on listed companies to identify potential investment opportunities.Analyse financial statements, business performance, earnings growth, balance sheets and cash flows.Assist in preparing financial models, company valuations, investment notes and research reports.Track stock-market developments, company announcements, quarterly results and relevant sector trends.Monitor portfolio holdings, share-price movements, investment performance and sector exposures.Support portfolio reviews, investment recommendations and periodic reporting.Research real estate industry fundamentals, including property demand, rental growth, REIT performance, developer sales and leverage.Maintain investment research records and supporting documentation.Coordinate with the investment team to support portfolio monitoring and other investment-related activities.Follow applicable internal policies, investment mandates and regulatory procedures.WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOREssentialA graduate degree in any discipline from a recognised Indian or foreign university.2+ years in the securities market, at a portfolio manager, alternative investment manager, asset manager, stock broker, investment adviser or research analyst. Real estate development, leasing or consulting does not count towards this.Excel models you have built yourself.You use AI tools every day in your work and can show what you have done with them.Mumbai, on site.AdvantageousAn MBA, a CA, or the CFA at any level.NISM certifications, such as XXI-B or XIX-D.Real estate or infrastructure investing, REITs or InvITs.Bloomberg, Capitaline, ACE Equity or similar tools.Portfolio accounting or back-office systems.What this role is notIt is not a decision-making seat. You do not approve investments or vote at the Investment Committee.It is not an investment banking seat. Deal preparation and investor coordination for the platform sit with the capital formation team.It is not a finance or accounts seat. Accounts and treasury sit with the finance team.STANDING REQUIREMENTSAI proficiency is a standing requirement in every seat at Vantrock. You use AI tools daily as force multipliers, and you judge their output rather than forwarding it. This is tested for every appointment through a supervised assessment. There are no exceptions by seniority.Partner command is the second standing requirement. Vantrock runs on outsourced partners, so every person here must be able to scope, brief, hold to an SLA, score and commercially discipline a partner, and must know what should never be delegated.COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHYThe people who build the platform own a piece of it, vesting over time. A market salary covers the month. The rest of what you earn here is built: pay on what you bring in, for land, leases and capital, so a good year in your seat is yours and not only the company's, and a stake in a platform designed to be worth more for every rupee it manages than one assembled the old way. Most careers in this industry pay you for your time. This one is built to make you wealthier for what you build. * Well-being: Thrive in a workplace that supports your physical and mental health by promoting a wide range of facilities and activities like birthday events, sports sessions, in-house coaches and healthy meal options.

We’re a leading game changer that optimizes supply chains with our very own smart software and services. With a team of 1,400+ passionate, creative minds from over 70 nationalities, we help the world’s largest companies to run their supply chains more efficiently and sustainably. Our customers include BASF, Johnson & Johnson, L’Oréal, Nestlé, and Procter & Gamble.

title: Record to Report Accountant
description:
We are looking for a
**Record to Report Accountant**
to join our Group Finance team, with a strong focus on
**R2R governance, financial controls, reconciliations and process oversight**
.
  
  
The role will support the design, implementation and monitoring of finance controls across the R2R function, while maintaining a strong understanding of accounting processes, systems and month-end activities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Support the R2R framework, including monitoring of key financial controls and adherence to established policies and procedures.
* Perform and monitor ICOFR / internal control activities, including control execution, evidence review, exception identification and remediation tracking.
* Support BlackLine governance and controls, including reconciliation compliance, journal controls, workflow monitoring, exception reporting and follow-up of outstanding actions.
* Review Balance Sheet reconciliations and accounting processes to identify control gaps, unusual movements, aged/open items and potential financial reporting risks.
* Assess the design and operational effectiveness of controls and support documentation of control procedures, testing and conclusions.
* Prepare and maintain control workpapers, process documentation, evidence packs and management reporting in line with governance requirements.
* Identify control exceptions and process gaps, perform root-cause analysis, and work with process owners to drive timely remediation.
* Support internal and external audits, including preparation of audit schedules, supporting documentation, walkthroughs and responses to audit queries.
* Assist in drafting and documenting audit findings, control observations and remediation actions for discussion with senior stakeholders.
* Monitor R2R governance metrics and prepare dashboards and management reports covering areas such as reconciliation compliance, BlackLine performance, control exceptions, aged items and action closure.
* Support month-end and year-end close activities, including journals, accruals, prepayments, reclassifications, FX and Balance Sheet accounting, where required.
* Maintain a strong understanding of the underlying accounting processes and General Ledger, ensuring that governance and controls remain connected to the accounting activity.
* Work with Finance teams to identify opportunities for standardisation, automation and process improvement.

**Technical Skills & Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Commerce or a related field.
* 5–8 years of experience in Record to Report, General Ledger, Financial Controls, Internal Audit or a similar finance environment.
* Strong understanding of R2R accounting processes, Balance Sheet reconciliations and month-end close.
* Experience in control testing, control monitoring and assessment of control design and operational effectiveness.
* Exposure to Internal Audit, SOX/ICOFR, risk and control frameworks is preferred.

**System Knowledge**

* Understanding of BlackLine or similar reconciliation/journal management platforms.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, including data analysis, reporting and dashboard preparation.
* Experience working with ERP systems such as Oracle NetSuite, SAP, Navision or similar.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. title: Principal Officer- PMS
description: ABOUT VANTROCKVantrock is an operator-led real assets platform, built to work in the white space of every strategy it enters. A real asset is three jobs: finding the land, building and running the asset, managing the capital that owns it. Vantrock does all three with one team. Headquartered in Mumbai, it originates, develops, operates and manages institutional-grade real assets from land to operations. Warehousing, industrial and logistics parks are the first strategy. The platform is run by operators, and it is built to run lean. Suburban office campuses, strata offices, data centres, senior living and infrastructure assets follow, each as its own strategy, sequenced on delivery and each in a white space others have left open, with a clear path to REITs and InvITs. Real assets only, across every class the platform grows into, in sequence.WHY THIS ROLE EXISTSWe are launching the platform's portfolio management company. It will manage discretionary and non-discretionary portfolios and advisory mandates for investors, in listed and unlisted securities, within the rules. Those rules require one person to answer for every decision made for a client and for how the business runs. That person is the Principal Officer.This seat is that person. You design the investment approaches, build the process and the operating platform, make the portfolio decisions and keep the record of why each one was made. You bring a securities-market discipline to a platform whose roots are in real assets.You should not apply if your recent years have been spent in coverage or product while someone else ran the portfolios. We are looking for the person who ran them.WHAT YOU WILL OWN1. Investment Strategy and Portfolio ManagementDevelop and execute the PMS investment strategy, with a focus on listed real estate and real estate-linked companies.Identify investment opportunities across market capitalisations, sectors and investment styles, based on fundamental research and valuation discipline.Lead portfolio construction, security selection, position sizing, capital allocation and portfolio rebalancing.Develop investment theses based on business fundamentals, earnings growth, asset quality, management capability, balance-sheet strength and valuation.Monitor market conditions, sector developments, interest-rate movements, liquidity and macroeconomic factors affecting portfolio performance.Make investment recommendations and decisions in accordance with the approved investment mandate, client objectives and risk parameters.2. Real Estate and Sector ResearchConduct detailed research on listed real estate developers, REITs, warehousing and industrial park operators, construction companies, cement and building-material manufacturers, and other real estate-related businesses.Analyse real estate market cycles, residential and commercial demand, office leasing, rental growth, vacancy levels, absorption, project launches and inventory.Understand the business models of asset-heavy companies, developers, landlords, REITs and real estate service providers.Evaluate land banks, development pipelines, project-level economics, pre-sales, collections, rental yields, occupancy, lease expiries and capital expenditure requirements, wherever relevant.Assess the implications of interest rates, financing costs, leverage, refinancing requirements and regulatory changes on sector participants.Track listed-company disclosures, earnings announcements, corporate actions, industry data and competitor performance to identify emerging opportunities and risks.3. Financial Analysis and ValuationBuild and review financial models, forecasts, scenario analyses and valuation frameworks for investment opportunities.Apply relevant valuation methodologies, including discounted cash flow (DCF), comparable-company analysis, EV/EBITDA, price-to-earnings, NAV-based valuation and cap-rate-based valuation, as appropriate to the business.Analyse revenue recognition, earnings quality, operating cash flows, working capital, debt maturity profiles and capital allocation.Evaluate the relationship between market prices and underlying business fundamentals, asset values and future earnings potential.Perform sensitivity analysis to assess downside risks arising from lower sales, rental pressure, delayed projects, higher financing costs or valuation multiple compression.Establish clear investment theses, target valuations, downside scenarios, investment horizons and exit criteria.4. Investment Research and Due DiligenceLead fundamental research on prospective investments and prepare detailed investment notes for internal review.Review annual reports, quarterly results, investor presentations, credit ratings, exchange disclosures and relevant industry publications.Conduct management interactions, analyst calls, industry expert discussions and other permitted research activities.Assess corporate governance, promoter track records, related-party transactions, auditor observations, capital allocation practices and other material risks.Maintain a documented investment process covering the rationale for entry, ongoing monitoring, changes in thesis and exit decisions.Track the performance of investment recommendations against relevant benchmarks and evaluate the effectiveness of the investment process.5. Portfolio Risk Management and Performance MonitoringMonitor portfolio concentration, sector exposures, liquidity, volatility, drawdowns and security-specific risks.Establish and review appropriate portfolio risk limits, monitoring triggers and escalation procedures.Assess correlations between holdings and the portfolio's sensitivity to interest rates, credit conditions, real estate cycles and broader equity-market movements.Conduct portfolio stress tests and downside scenario analyses.Review portfolio performance against the appropriate benchmark and evaluate the contribution of individual securities, sectors and investment decisions.Take timely action when the investment thesis weakens, valuations become unattractive or risk parameters are breached.6. Regulatory Responsibilities and GovernanceDischarge the responsibilities assigned to the Principal Officer under the applicable SEBI Portfolio Managers Regulations and other relevant regulatory requirements.Ensure that investment activities are undertaken within the PMS's approved investment mandate, applicable client agreements and internal investment policies.Work closely with the Compliance Officer to support compliance with SEBI requirements, disclosure obligations, reporting requirements and applicable internal controls.Ensure that investment decisions and material portfolio actions are appropriately documented and supported by the investment process.Promote fair treatment of clients, appropriate handling of conflicts of interest, confidentiality and adherence to applicable conduct standards.Participate in regulatory reviews, internal audits, compliance reviews and inspections, as required.Oversee the implementation of appropriate investment controls, escalation mechanisms and governance processes in coordination with the relevant functions.7. Client and Stakeholder EngagementExplain investment strategy, portfolio positioning, sector outlook and performance drivers to senior management and relevant stakeholders.Contribute to periodic investment updates, portfolio commentary and performance reviews.Support the preparation of investment-related content for client communications and marketing materials, subject to applicable regulatory requirements.Coordinate with the Compliance Officer, operations team, research analysts, custodians and other service providers to ensure smooth functioning of the PMS business.WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOREssentialOne of these qualifications: a CFA charter. A Chartered Accountant or Cost and Management Accountant. A graduate degree with a professional qualification in finance, law, accountancy or business management, such as an MBA, PGDM or LLB. Or the one-year NISM Post Graduate Program in Securities Market (Portfolio Management). CFA Level I or II, FRM or CFP alone do not qualify.8+ years work experience in the securities market, at a portfolio manager, alternative investment manager, asset manager, stock broker, investment adviser or research analyst, with at least 2 of those years in portfolio management, investment advisory or fund management. Real estate development, leasing or consulting does not count towards this.A current NISM-Series-XXI-B Portfolio Managers certificate when you join.A clean record: no adverse securities-market proceedings, no relevant conviction and no regulatory debarment.You use AI tools every day in your work and can show what you have done with them.Mumbai, on site.AdvantageousReal estate, infrastructure or credit portfolios at an alternative investment manager, a REIT or an InvIT.NISM-Series-XIX-C or XIX-D certification.Setting up or scaling a portfolio management or advisory business.Credit analysis of debentures and structured debt.What this role is notIt is not the co-investment seat. Co-investment alongside the investment manager sits with the investment manager's own team.It is not a capital-raising seat. Investor and capital-partner coverage for the platform sits with the capital formation team.It is not a land origination seat. Land sits with the land and investments team.It is not a finance or treasury seat. Accounts, treasury and banking relationships sit with the finance team.STANDING REQUIREMENTSAI proficiency is a standing requirement in every seat at Vantrock. You use AI tools daily as force multipliers, and you judge their output rather than forwarding it. This is tested for every appointment through a supervised assessment. There are no exceptions by seniority.Partner command is the second standing requirement. Vantrock runs on outsourced partners, so every person here must be able to scope, brief, hold to an SLA, score and commercially discipline a partner, and must know what should never be delegated.COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHYThe people who build the platform own a piece of it, vesting over time. A market salary covers the month. The rest of what you earn here is built: pay on what you bring in, for land, leases and capital, so a good year in your seat is yours and not only the company's, and a stake in a platform designed to be worth more for every rupee it manages than one assembled the old way. Most careers in this industry pay you for your time. This one is built to make you wealthier for what you build. Run your seat like it is yours, because part of it is.CULTURAL FITWe're building Vantrock over a decade, not a funding cycle. We're looking for people who treat technology as the default answer rather than a supplement, who want to be co-builders of the platform rather than employees executing instructions, and who are comfortable saying "I don't know" and "I was wrong." If you want a defined role with defined edges, this isn't the right seat. If you want to help build an institution from zero, it might be.We don't fill seats. We build the platform.

title: Business Manager
description:
Ingram Micro is a leading technology company for the global information technology ecosystem.
  
  
With the ability to reach nearly 90% of the global population, we play a vital role in the worldwide IT sales channel, bringing products and services from technology manufacturers and cloud providers to business-to-business technology experts.
  
  
Our market reach, diverse solutions and services portfolio, and digital platform Ingram Micro Xvantage™ set us apart
  
  
**Job Summary**
We are seeking an experienced and commercially driven Business Manager to manage and grow the assigned technology portfolio. The role will be responsible for driving vendor relationships, business planning, product lifecycle management, demand generation, profitability, and market growth across Server, Storage, Backup, and Data Protection solutions.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess strong technical knowledge, vendor management experience, and the ability to work closely with Sales, Pre-Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Channel Partners to achieve revenue and profitability objectives.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Product & Vendor Management**

* Own and manage the complete product portfolio for Server, Storage, Backup, and Data Protection solutions.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with OEMs and technology vendors.
* Develop and execute business plans to drive revenue growth, profitability, and market penetration.
* Manage vendor programs, rebates, incentives, pricing, and business reviews.
* Drive quarterly and annual business planning with technology vendors.

**Revenue & Profitability Management**

* Achieve assigned revenue, gross margin, and market share targets.
* Monitor business performance and implement strategies to maximize profitability.
* Identify growth opportunities across existing and new customer segments.
* Work with sales teams to accelerate pipeline creation and opportunity conversion.

**Demand Planning & Inventory Management**

* Forecast demand and manage inventory levels to ensure product availability.
* Optimize working capital through effective stock planning and inventory control.
* Monitor inventory ageing and implement corrective actions.
* Coordinate with operations and procurement teams to ensure timely product availability.

**Go-to-Market (GTM) Strategy**

* Develop and execute go-to-market plans for new product launches and technology solutions.
* Plan promotions, channel programs, incentives, and partner engagement activities.
* Work with marketing teams on events, webinars, campaigns, and lead-generation initiatives.
* Monitor effectiveness of marketing programs and recommend improvements.

**Channel & Sales Enablement**

* Support channel partners and internal sales teams with product positioning and competitive strategies.
* Conduct product training sessions, technical workshops, and partner enablement programs.
* Develop sales kits, presentations, solution briefs, and competitive battle cards.
* Assist sales teams in strategic opportunities and large deal closures.

**Market Intelligence & Competitive Analysis**

* Track industry trends, emerging technologies, and competitive developments.
* Analyze market demand and customer requirements.
* Develop competitive positioning strategies to strengthen market presence.
* Provide insights and recommendations for portfolio expansion.

**Customer & Partner Engagement**

* Engage with key customers, system integrators, and channel partners.
* Participate in customer meetings, solution discussions, and business reviews.
* Support the development of strategic customer relationships.
* Work closely with partners to create and close business opportunities.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Collaborate with Sales, Pre-Sales, Marketing, Operations, Finance, and Vendor teams.
* Drive alignment between business objectives and execution plans.
* Prepare business reports, forecasts, dashboards, and management presentations.
* Ensure smooth execution of commercial and operational processes.

**Desired Skills & Competencies**

* Strong understanding of Server, Storage, Backup, Disaster Recovery, and Data Protection solutions.
* Excellent vendor and product management skills.
* Business planning and revenue management expertise.
* Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills.
* Inventory planning and working capital management knowledge.
* Data-driven and analytical approach to decision-making.
* Excellent presentation and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong communication and relationship-building capabilities.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

title: Billing Analyst
description:
**Are you ready to join our digital revolution journey?**
At
**Aleph**
, we’re not just part of the digital advertising landscape—we’re shaping its future. Representing the world’s leading platforms, including TikTok, Amazon, Google, and nearly 55 others, we operate in 130+ markets across new and existing geographies.
  
  
Our mission is to empower advertisers and brands to unlock the full potential of these platforms' advertising capabilities. By fostering long-lasting partnerships, we create limitless opportunities for people and businesses to advertise effectively at both local and global levels.
  
  
With a presence spanning continents, Aleph offers you the chance to be part of a fast-growing, innovative team where your work makes a direct impact. If you’re ambitious, forward-thinking, and eager to thrive in a dynamic, global environment, Aleph is the perfect place to build your career.
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Billing Analyst in our Finance team, you will keep Aleph’s client billing accurate and on time. You will work in SAP across invoicing, accounts receivable (AR) operations, reconciliation and financial reporting, including month-end close.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Prepare, verify and issue client invoices accurately and on schedule, including during high-volume billing cycles.
* Review bills and billing data before processing to confirm they are complete and correct.
* Resolve complex billing issues using the Dispute application in SAP.
* Post bank receipt entries in the books of account and apply them to customer accounts in SAP, making sure all bank offset accounts and bank-in-transit items are cleared on a weekly basis.
* Reconcile customer accounts and receivables.
* Review, monitor and control the accrued revenue balance to ensure that all accruals are settled.
* Support month-end closing for the billing group and prepare billing and AR financial reports.
* Respond to client queries and revise invoices when needed; send hard-copy invoices and Release Orders (ROs) to clients where required.
* Apply basic tax knowledge when preparing invoices and reconciling accounts, in line with local requirements.
* Support internal and external auditors with billing data, documentation and bill verification, and liaise with other stakeholders as needed.
* Follow billing procedures and quality checks, and suggest practical improvements to how we bill and reconcile.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Business Administration or a related field.
* 4–5 years of relevant experience in billing, accounts receivable or finance operations.
* At least 2 years of hands-on SAP experience (any version, for example SAP ECC or S/4HANA).
* Strong accounting fundamentals, including reconciliations, accruals and month-end close.
* Basic tax knowledge (a tax specialist background is not needed).
* Ability to handle large-volume invoicing with accuracy and attention to detail.
* Basic English proficiency
* Flexibility to work across time zones and to put in extended hours during seasonal peaks.
* Professional certifications (for example CPA or CFA) are not required.
* Nice to have: prior experience in the media or advertising industry; an MBA in Finance.

**Why Join Aleph**

* Impact: Your work keeps billing and revenue flowing for partnerships that help platforms like TikTok, Amazon and Google grow advertising in 130+ markets.
* Growth: We give our internal talent room to grow and learn together; this role builds depth in SAP, AR operations, accrual control and month-end close.
* Team culture: Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives and talents, where people support each other and value open communication and partnership.
* Market context: Digital advertising changes fast, and our finance team sits at the centre of a global, multi-market business. You will join a market with a deep finance and shared-services talent community.
* Curiosity welcome: We stay flexible and adaptable, move with the speed of change, and encourage everyone to keep learning and seeking out new opportunities.

**Why Join Us?**
Aleph is a place of many cultures, perspectives, and talents. We support each other, creating an environment of giving and receiving. We value partnership and communication because we believe it takes a group of people to achieve great things. We are energized by our ever-changing industry, our curiosity keeps us learning and seeking out new opportunities.
  
  
We stay flexible and adaptable, and believe in moving with the speed of change. We encourage everyone to strive for more, providing our internal talent with growth opportunities and the ability to learn together.

title: Associate Director/Senior Manager Commercial Finance
description:
Role Summary

We have an exciting opportunity for you to join our team as Associate Director/ Senior Manager, Commercial Finance. Based in Mumbai, India, this role is a critical enabler within Vistra's finance function, combining hands-on financial analysis with strategic business partnering. Based in Mumbai, India, you will be embedded within the global Commercial Finance centre of excellence, taking ownership of key analytical workstreams, driving insights that inform senior leadership decisions, and supporting the delivery of high-impact finance initiatives across multiple geographies and business lines.

Key Responsibilities

The role supports three core pillars of responsibility, working closely with the Director, Commercial

Finance:

1. Performance Analysis & Management

• Conduct detailed financial performance analysis across revenues, staff costs, non-staff costs, CAPEX, exceptional items, and free cash flow at profit center, customer, product, and cost center levels.

• Prepare and maintain the monthly Financial Pack, ensuring data accuracy, clear commentary, and timely delivery to senior management, Board, and shareholders.

• Support the facilitation of monthly Business Performance Reviews, preparing analytical packs and tracking action items arising from discussions with Profit Center Leads.

• Perform monthly variance analysis with overhead cost center managers, highlighting risks and opportunities for disciplined cost management.

• Develop and refine presentation materials for the Executive Leadership Team, Board, and shareholder meetings.

• Build and maintain performance dashboards and KPI trackers that drive accountability across the organisation.

• Promote financial awareness across business units through regular engagement, training, and clear communication of results.

• Support the transition from manual reporting to automated, technology-enabled financial reporting by identifying process improvement opportunities and collaborating with technology teams.

2. Planning & Forecasting

• Support the co-ordination and execution of the annual Budget process and in-year reforecasts at a granular level by month, customer, and employee.

• Prepare and maintain the monthly rolling 3-month forward EBITDA projections, ensuring accuracy and providing clear narrative on key movements.

• Manage rolling run-rate EBITDA calculations, normalising for one-off items and maintaining a clear view of underlying business trajectory.

• Provide analytical support for strategic financial planning including value creation programmes, cost optimisation, revenue growth initiatives, and M&A scenario modelling.

• Contribute to the adoption of modern planning tools by testing, implementing, and refining predictive analytics and scenario planning capabilities.

• Identify and implement automation opportunities within planning processes, leveraging enterprise systems for improved data flow and efficiency.

3. Decision Support

As a growth-oriented business, Vistra requires robust commercial finance analysis to support strategic decision-making across several workstreams:

a) Accelerating Profitable Revenue Growth

• Provide analytical support for sales lead generation, pipeline management, and opportunity conversion tracking.

• Analyse customer acquisition costs, contract value, and client onboarding timelines to identify improvement opportunities.

• Conduct customer profitability analysis to support pricing decisions and margin management.

• Deliver data-driven insights to support customer retention, upselling, and cross-selling programmes.

• Build and maintain customer lifetime value models to inform commercial strategy.

• Collaborate with commercial and operations teams to analyse and optimise cost-to-serve for different customer segments.

• Support Sales Operations in the analysis and maintenance of commercial incentive plan effectiveness.

b) Organisational Optimisation & Cost Control

• Develop financial models to support organisational design and Target Operating Model initiatives.

• Provide analytical support for workforce planning, location strategy, and productivity improvement programmes.

• Build and maintain staff utilisation and productivity dashboards, identifying trends and improvement levers.

• Conduct detailed analysis of third-party supplier spend across direct and indirect cost categories.

• Support procurement optimisation through robust financial analysis and vendor performance tracking.

c) Technological Transformation

• Develop financial business cases and benefits tracking frameworks for major technology transformation programmes.

• Support the quantification of ROI and efficiency gains from AI, automation, and digital initiatives.

• Utilise advanced analytics and business intelligence tools to deliver deeper commercial insights and support data-driven decision-making.

Across all three areas, the emphasis is on delivering actionable analysis that drives performance

improvement, supports financial accountability, and contributes to major group-wide value creation projects.

Key Requirements

• Minimum 8-12 years of relevant experience in Financial Planning & Analysis, Commercial Finance, or a related strategic finance discipline.

• Bachelor's degree or professional qualification in Accounting, Business, Finance, or related field (CA,CMA, CFA, or MBA in Finance preferred).

• Strong working experience with business reporting, planning, and intelligence systems.

• Hands-on experience with enterprise systems such as SAP S/4 HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud, Salesforce, SuccessFactors, or equivalent platforms would be a significant advantage.

• Exposure to AI-powered analytics and business intelligence tools is desirable.

• Fluency in written and spoken English, with the ability to communicate complex financial information clearly to senior stakeholders.

• Strong analytical mindset with a process-oriented approach to problem-solving and attention to detail.

• Experience with data analytics on large-scale datasets (e.g., tens of thousands of customers, thousands of employees across multiple jurisdictions).

• Proven ability to manage multiple deliverables simultaneously in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.

• Results and solutions-oriented, with a focus on delivering quality outputs on-time.

• Collaborative working style, with the ability to work effectively across global teams and functions.

• Demonstrated ability to build effective working relationships with senior finance leaders and cross- functional partners.

title: Financial Analyst, Transaction Opinions / Fund Opinions / CVAS
description:
**Business Unit:**
Financial And Valuation Advisory
  
  
**Industry:**
Transaction Opinions
  
  
****Overview****
Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a leading global investment bank recognized for delivering independent strategic and financial advice to corporations, financial sponsors, and governments. With uniquely deep industry expertise, broad international reach, and a partnership approach rooted in trust, the firm provides innovative, integrated solutions across mergers and acquisitions, capital solutions, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Our unmatched transaction volumes provide differentiated, data-driven perspectives that help our clients achieve their most critical goals. To learn more about Houlihan Lokey, please visit HL.com.
  
  
**Financial and Valuation Advisory**
Over the past 50+ years, Houlihan Lokey has established one of the largest worldwide financial and valuation advisory practices. Our transaction expertise and leadership in the field of valuation inspire confidence in the financial executives, boards of directors, special committees, investors, and business owners we serve. In 2025, LSEG ranked us the No. 1 global M&A fairness opinion advisor over the past 25 years. Our stability, integrity, technical leadership, and global capabilities make us a trusted advisor for clients worldwide, across a wide range of services, including the Transaction Opinions, Fund Opinions, Transaction Advisory Services, Corporate Valuation Advisory Services, Portfolio Valuation, Real Estate Valuation and Advisory Services, and Dispute Resolution Consulting practices.
  
  
**Job Description – Financial Analyst, Transaction Opinions / Fund Opinions / CVAS**
****Overview****
Houlihan Lokey, Inc. (NYSE:HLI) is a global investment bank with expertise in mergers and acquisitions, capital markets, financial restructuring, and financial and valuation advisory. Houlihan Lokey serves corporations, institutions, and governments worldwide with offices in the Americas, Europe, the Middle East, and the Asia-Pacific region. Independent advice and intellectual rigor are hallmarks of the firm’s commitment to client success across its advisory services. The firm is the No. 1 investment bank for all global M&A transactions for the past two consecutive years, the No. 1 M&A advisor for the past 10 consecutive years in the U.S., the No. 1 global restructuring advisor for the past 11 consecutive years, and the No. 1 global M&A fairness opinion advisor over the past 25 years, all based on number of transactions and according to data provided by LSEG (formerly Refinitiv).
  
  
**Scope**
Our Board & Special Committee Advisory group provides advice to board of directors and special committees in valuing complex businesses and securities, understanding and structuring critical transaction issues, advising on alternatives, and rendering transaction opinions. The group primarily focuses on complex situations, related-party transactions, and other corporate governance issues for board of directors and special committees.
  
  
Our Fund Opinions group delivers fairness opinions and valuation advisory services to financial sponsors, including private equity funds, hedge funds, and credit funds. We provide advice to these sponsors across a variety of situations, including mergers, acquisitions, continuation fund and other portfolio company transactions.
  
  
The Corporate Valuation and Advisory Services group (CVAS) focuses on complex analytics, business valuations, financial models and other valuation services, frequently teaming with accounting and tax advisory, capital markets and M&A professionals.
  
  
As the No. 1 global M&A fairness opinion advisor over the past 25 years, Houlihan Lokey enjoys industry-leading credibility in transaction opinions. Our dedicated Transaction Opinions group delivers fairness, solvency, and valuation advisory services across a variety of situations, including mergers, acquisitions, divestitures/spin-offs, SPACs/PIPEs, recapitalizations, restructurings, and activist shareholder situations.
  
  
****Job Description****
We are looking for an Analyst to be part of an interdiscplinary team that focuses on complex analytics, financial models, and valuation – and works hand-in-hand with other teams within our firm (e.g., M&A, industry groups, etc.) to deliver investment banking services to clients. Our Analysts work on corporate fairness, fund fairness, solvency, and transaction-based valuation opinions, as well as a variety of business valuation and intangible asset valuation in connection with mergers and acquisitions, corporate restructurings and financial and tax reporting requirements. Analysts support engagements and new business development by:
  
  

* Analyzing and explaining historical and projected financial information
* Performing business and financial due diligence
* Conducting industry and sub-sector research
* Valuing companies, businesses, and securities
* Building complex financial models (e.g., to support negotiating/advocacy positions, assess cash flows of a company and/or value specific securities)
* Assisting in the preparation of board/special committee presentations supporting advice and opinions
* Helping pitch engagements and participating in business development initiatives

In addition, the current role will have the additional responsibility and opportunity to help build out regional capabilities via hiring an expanding team and being uniquely cross-functional within FVA across Transaction Opinions, Fund Opinions and CVAS.
  
  
****Qualifications****

* Prior investment banking, valuation, or related experience
* Advanced accounting, finance, financial modeling, and analytical abilities
* Strong qualitative and quantitative research skills (analyst)
* Excellent oral and written communication skills
* Experience managing analysts or other personnel (associate)
* Be an independent thinker and resourceful problem solver driven to succeed in a fast-paced environment
* Have a very strong work ethic, organizational skills, and ability to multi-task

Additional consideration will be given to candidates who possess:
  
  

* Chartered Accountant or MBA preferable, with CFA being an added advantage
* Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in investment banking or financial valuation
* A demonstrated ability to work cooperatively with all levels of staff

***We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.***

title: Senior Investment Analyst - Buy Side (AIF) (Mumbai)
description:
Monarch AIF is hiring a Senior Investment Analyst to join the buy-side investment team, working directly with the Fund Manager on a concentrated, high-conviction equity portfolio.

**What You Will Do:**

This is a highly entrepreneurial role. You will be part of a small, high-ownership team , not a 50-person research factory. You will conduct sector agnostic, bottoms up research on companies identified through Monarch AIF's proprietary screeners. You will build financial models, analyse business models, meet management teams, conduct channel checks, visit plants, attend AGMs, and develop investment pitches that the Fund Manager acts on. You will track BFSI, IT and Tech, Consumer, and Mid and Small Caps, because great investors are not sector specialists, they are business analysts.

The right person is equal parts analytical and passionate. A self starter who seeks ownership, not instructions. Someone who is not afraid to get their hands dirty through on-ground, primary research , not just desk-based screen work.

**What We're Looking For:**

▸ 6-7+ years of equity research experience — Indian buy-side or sell-side at a reputable firm

▸ CA or CFA (USA) qualification , MBA , Post graduation — non-negotiable

▸ Sectors that we are looking for - BFSI, IT, Consumer, Mid and Small Caps

▸ Deep understanding of financial statements, valuation frameworks, and business model analysis

▸ Excellent management interaction skills , you will be the fund's face in front of company managements

▸ Advanced Excel is a must. Strong writing and presentation skills.

**What We Offer:**

▸ Compensation at par with industry standards

▸ ESOPs for exceptional performers , 47% of Monarch employees hold ESOPs at ₹10 (CMP: ₹380)

▸ Direct access to the Fund Manager and CEO

▸ A platform where your research moves real capital across AIF, PMS, and HNI advisory

▸ The opportunity to build a track record at one of India's fastest-growing AIF platforms

**Location:**
Mumbai, BKC

Before you read further, understand what this role is: your research will not sit in an inbox. It will move capital. Every stock you recommend, every thesis you build, every channel check you conduct directly impacts a ₹1,000+ Crore AIF and a ₹300+ Crore PMS. Your conviction becomes the fund's conviction.

﻿

The Platform:

Monarch AIF has outperformed Nifty 500 TRI by 580 basis points since inception. Ranked in the top decile among 84 Category III long-only AIFs. ₹1,000+ Crore AUM scaled from ₹70 Crore in under 5 years , entirely through performance, not distribution. The growth runway ahead is even bigger.

title: Equity Research Analyst
description:
**Job Summary:**

We are looking for an analytical and detail-oriented Equity Research Analyst with 2–5 years of experience in buy-side equity research and the Indian equity markets. The role involves conducting in-depth company and sector analysis, evaluating investment opportunities through financial modelling and valuation techniques, and monitoring market developments. The ideal candidate will support investment decisions by delivering high-quality research reports, actionable insights, and data-driven recommendations.

**Job Responsibilities**

**1 Company & Sector Research:**
Conduct in-depth fundamental research on companies, sectors, and industries within the Indian equity markets to identify investment opportunities and assess business performance.

**2. Financial Analysis & Valuation:**
Perform financial statement analysis, financial modelling, and valuation using appropriate methodologies, including relative valuation and comparable company analysis.

**3. Market & Industry Monitoring:**
Track corporate announcements, quarterly earnings, company developments, macroeconomic indicators, and industry trends to identify potential investment opportunities and risks.

**4. Research Reports & Investment Insights:**
Prepare comprehensive research reports, company updates, earnings analysis, and investment notes with actionable insights to support investment decisions.

**5. Portfolio & Investment Strategy Support:**
Collaborate with the investment team to contribute to portfolio reviews, stock selection, investment strategies, and discussions on market opportunities and risks.

**Requirements**

**Experience**
: 2–5 years of relevant experience in equity research, preferably in a buy-side investment firm or the research division of a broking or financial services organisation. Prior buy-side equity research experience is mandatory.

**Education:**
Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accountancy, or a related discipline. A postgraduate degree or MBA in Finance is desirable.

**Equity Market Knowledge:**
Strong understanding of the Indian equity markets, fundamental research, company analysis, and sectoral trends.

**Financial Modelling & Valuation:**
Proficiency in financial modelling, financial statement analysis, Microsoft Excel, and valuation methodologies, including relative valuation.

**Analytical Skills:**
Strong quantitative, analytical, and critical-thinking abilities, with the capacity to evaluate investment opportunities and assess financial risks.

**AI & Research Tools:**
Proficiency in AI-powered research tools and the ability to leverage technology for efficient data analysis and research.

**Communication Skills:**
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex financial concepts and investment views clearly.

**Certifications**
: CFA or other relevant professional certifications are an added advantage but not mandatory.

**Service Ownership, Environment Management & Availability**

* Own the Finance support operating model for Kyriba, including service health, environment governance, operational readiness and escalation.
* Be accountable for Kyriba environment management and coordinate production and non-production activities with Kyriba Support, implementation partners and internal technology teams.
* Take responsibility for Kyriba environment availability, ensuring service interruptions are assessed, communicated and progressed through the appropriate incident and problem-management channels.
* Maintain clear operational ownership, support contacts, dependencies, recovery expectations and evidence required for service governance.

**Integration Ownership & Operational Resilience**

* Own Finance-side support and coordination for various integration applications e.g. Kyriba–Bridger and Kyriba–Adjuto payment integrations and the Kyriba–Sonata integration via FADS for forecasting.
* Coordinate investigation of interface failures, missing or delayed files, rejected transactions, scheduling issues and upstream or downstream data exceptions.
* Work with FinOps, Treasury, other M&G systems, Kyriba Support and implementation partners to restore service, validate outcomes and address recurring integration risks.
* Maintain functional knowledge of interface purpose, control points, business impact, dependencies and recovery procedures.

**Access Governance, Logs & Recertification**

* Be accountable for controlled access to Kyriba application logs, ensuring access is appropriately authorised, traceable and aligned with support requirements.
* Be accountable for quarterly user recertification, coordinating evidence, exceptions, remediation and completion with IDAM/SailPoint, supervisors and relevant business owners.
* Provide Finance consultation for ARC role management, user-access management and SCIM setup and management, ensuring the proposed access model supports business responsibilities and control expectations.
* Remain informed on API-key management and assess Finance impact where credential changes could affect Kyriba services or integrations.

**Bank Connectivity & Market Data Support**

* Provide Finance consultation for monitoring payment and statement connectivity, helping assess business impact, prioritise exceptions and coordinate remediation.
* Support the Finance assessment of bank acknowledgements, rejected or delayed flows, statement availability and related operational dependencies.
* Provide Finance consultation for the input integration status information on IDP-to-Kyriba FX-rate process, including business validation of rates, exception assessment and coordination with the responsible support teams.

**Release, Change & Control Assurance**

* Remain informed of Kyriba release-note assessments and opt-in regression-testing outcomes, identifying Finance impacts, risks and required stakeholder actions.
* Ensure material changes affecting Finance-owned integrations, controls or service availability are supported by appropriate impact assessment, testing evidence and operational readiness.
* Support incident, problem, change and release governance, including root-cause follow-up, risk tracking and audit evidence.

**Stakeholder, Vendor & Continuous Improvement**

* Act as the Finance support contact across FinOps, Treasury, RDM FinOps Kyriba Business Management, Corporate Functions Technology, Kyriba Support and implementation partners.
* Translate Finance priorities and business impacts into clear actions for technical teams and vendors, and provide concise updates through resolution.
* Identify opportunities to improve monitoring, automate controls, simplify support processes, strengthen knowledge articles and reduce repeat incidents.
* Promote disciplined ownership, effective hand-offs and sustainable service improvements across the Kyriba support ecosystem.

**Application Support & Incident Management**

* Provide expert technical support for finance applications, ensuring incidents and service requests are triaged, prioritised and progressed in line with agreed service levels.
* Investigate application and integration issues, perform initial diagnosis, gather technical evidence and coordinate resolution with software vendors, infrastructure teams and business stakeholders.
* Maintain clear ownership of issues through to closure, including timely stakeholder updates, root-cause follow-up and verification that service has been restored.
* Support problem management by identifying recurring issues, contributing to root-cause analysis and tracking preventive actions.

**Integration & Interface Support**

* Actively support system integrations and interfaces connecting finance applications with upstream and downstream platforms.
* Monitor scheduled feeds, jobs and interfaces; identify failures, data exceptions or processing delays and coordinate recovery with relevant application teams.
* Work across internal technology teams and external vendors to resolve interface dependencies, connectivity issues and data-flow failures.
* Maintain operational knowledge of interface schedules, dependencies, support contacts, control points and recovery procedures.

**User Onboarding & Experience**

* Coordinate user onboarding, access enablement and application readiness in line with approved controls and defined operating procedures.
* Provide practical guidance to users, improve support documentation and help reduce avoidable incidents through clear communication and knowledge sharing.
* Identify opportunities to enhance user experience, simplify support journeys and improve the quality and responsiveness of application services.

**Vendor & Service Management**

* Act as a key technical contact for application vendors and business stakeholders during incident investigation and service improvement activity.
* Plan and conduct regular service review meetings with application vendors, covering incidents, service levels, recurring issues, risks, upcoming changes and improvement actions.
* Track agreed actions to completion and challenge vendors constructively where service quality, responsiveness or technical outcomes require improvement.
* Support operational governance, audit evidence and service reporting for the applications in scope.

**Release, Upgrade & UAT Support**

* Support application version upgrades, patches and technical lifecycle activities by coordinating impact assessment, readiness checks, implementation support and post-release validation.
* Plan and conduct user acceptance testing for small enhancements and bug fixes, including test preparation, execution, defect logging, retesting and evidence retention.
* Collaborate with business users, vendors and change teams to ensure releases are appropriately tested and introduced with minimal service disruption.

**Security Credentials & Technical Administration**

* Manage application certificates and integration keys throughout their lifecycle, including inventory, renewal coordination, secure implementation and validation.
* Monitor expiry dates and dependencies to prevent avoidable service disruption, ensuring changes are completed through approved security and change-control processes.
* Maintain accurate technical and operational documentation for certificates, keys, interfaces, configurations and support procedures.

**Continuous Improvement & Innovation**

* Propose and implement innovative ideas to improve monitoring, automation, support efficiency, service resilience and user experience over time.
* Use incident trends, vendor performance and operational feedback to identify improvement opportunities and prioritise sustainable fixes.
* Contribute to a culture of ownership, knowledge sharing, control discipline and continual service improvement.

We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

The Opportunity
  
  
As an Associate – Production Finance, you'll be a key business partner supporting Netflix's growing slate of original productions in India.
  
  
This is much more than a finance role. You'll work at the intersection of finance, production, and strategy—partnering with internal teams and production companies to help productions make informed financial decisions from development through delivery.
  
  
You'll gain exposure to every stage of the production lifecycle while helping ensure our productions are financially sound, operationally efficient, and positioned for success.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
**Partner with Productions**

* Work closely with production companies, line producers, production accountants, production auditors and internal Netflix teams throughout the lifecycle of a production.
* Build trusted relationships with creative, production, legal, business affairs, tax, accounts payable, and external stakeholders to ensure smooth financial operations.
* Support production partners by providing guidance on Netflix's financial policies, reporting expectations, and production finance processes.

**Drive Financial Excellence**

* Review and analyze production budgets, cost reports, cash flows, and forecasts.
* Monitor production spend against approved budgets and identify financial risks, trends, and opportunities early.
* Partner with productions to develop accurate Estimates to Complete (ETCs) and final cost projections.
* Perform variance analysis and communicate meaningful insights that support business decisions.
* Review invoices, funding requests, and production payments for accuracy and compliance.

**Deliver Meaningful Insights**

* Go beyond validating numbers by identifying cost optimization opportunities and operational efficiencies.
* Analyze production schedules, resource utilization, and spending patterns to proactively highlight financial risks and recommendations.
* Prepare concise financial summaries and presentations for internal stakeholders to support investment decisions.

**Strengthen Financial Operations**

* Map production costs to Netflix's Chart of Accounts and maintain accurate financial records.
* Update production data across Netflix's internal systems and reporting tools.
* Partner with auditors and production accountants to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant financial reporting.
* Help improve reporting processes, financial controls, and operational efficiencies across productions.

What We're Looking For
  
  
We're looking for someone who enjoys working with people just as much as they enjoy working with numbers. You are someone who is naturally curious, asks thoughtful questions, and isn't satisfied with simply reconciling numbers—you want to understand the story behind them.
  
  
**You'll Be Successful In This Role If You Have**

* 7+ years of experience in Production Finance, Production Accounting, Production Management, or a similar role within the film, television, or media industry.
* Strong understanding of production budgeting, cost reporting, forecasting, and production accounting.
* Experience working with production companies, studios, line producers, or production accountants.
* Excellent financial analysis and problem-solving skills with strong business judgment.
* Advanced Excel skills and proficiency in Google Workspace; experience with production accounting software is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of Tally or similar accounting systems is preferred.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple teams.
* Exceptional attention to detail while maintaining the ability to see the bigger picture.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related discipline. CA or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.

Who You Are
  
  

* You thrive in fast-moving environments and enjoy solving new challenges every day.
* You are proactive, resourceful, and comfortable navigating ambiguity.
* You build strong relationships and enjoy partnering with diverse teams.
* You balance analytical thinking with practical decision-making.
* You have high standards, strong integrity, and a commitment to excellence.
* You're passionate about entertainment and excited to help bring incredible stories to audiences around the world.

Why Netflix?
  
  
At Netflix, you'll have the opportunity to work on some of the most exciting productions in the industry while partnering with exceptionally talented people across creative, production, and business teams.
  
  
You'll be trusted with meaningful responsibility from day one, encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, and empowered to make an impact on how world-class stories are produced.
  
  
If you're excited by the idea of combining finance, strategy, and storytelling, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.
  
  
We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.
