title: CA Finance & Acc Manufacturing
description:
**About The Opportunity**

* This role is for a Chartered Accountant to manage and support the end-to-end finance and accounting function for a manufacturing business, ensuring accurate financial reporting, robust controls, statutory and income-tax compliance, and timely financial insights. The role requires a hands-on finance professional who understands manufacturing operations, plant-level costs, inventory, working capital and business performance.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Oversee day-to-day accounting, general ledger, journal entries, provisions, accruals, prepayments and balance-sheet reconciliations.
* Support monthly, quarterly and annual closing, preparation of trial balance, schedules and financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards.
* Prepare and review MIS, management reports, variance analysis and key financial dashboards for management.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness and proper documentation of accounting records and financial transactions.
* Monitor plant-wise and product-wise costs, including raw materials, consumables, labour, utilities, overheads and production variances.
* Support standard costing, actual costing, BOM/routing cost reviews, cost-sheet preparation and analysis of material, yield and overhead variances, as applicable.
* Reconcile inventory records with the general ledger; review raw material, work-in-progress, finished goods, scrap and slow/non-moving inventory.
* Coordinate physical stock counts and investigate inventory discrepancies, wastage, process losses and abnormal costs.
* Work with plant, production, procurement and supply-chain teams to identify cost-saving opportunities and improve cost visibility.
* Coordinate computation and review of advance tax, self-assessment tax and corporate income-tax provisions.
* Ensure timely preparation and filing support for income-tax returns, tax audit requirements and related schedules, in coordination with internal teams or external tax advisors.
* Handle tax reconciliations, including books versus tax returns and tax-credit statements such as Form 26AS/AIS, as applicable.
* Support TDS compliance, including review of applicability, deduction, deposit, returns, certificates and reconciliations.
* Assist in responding to income-tax notices, assessments, audits and departmental queries; maintain supporting documentation and track due dates.
* Monitor changes in direct-tax laws and assess their impact on the business in consultation with the Finance Head or tax advisors.
* Coordinate GST return data, reconciliations of books with GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and GSTR-2B, input-tax-credit checks and follow-up on mismatches.
* Support e-invoicing, e-way bill controls and GST documentation, where applicable.
* Coordinate other applicable statutory, regulatory and financial reporting requirements with relevant teams and advisors.
* Coordinate statutory, internal, tax and cost audits, including preparation of schedules, reconciliations and audit evidence.
* Ensure adherence to accounting policies, approval matrices, delegation of authority and internal financial controls.
* Track audit observations, root causes and closure of corrective actions within agreed timelines.
* Maintain an organised audit trail and ensure compliance with company policies and applicable laws.
* Monitor receivables, payables, inventory and other working-capital drivers; highlight overdue items and unusual movements.
* Support annual budgeting, periodic forecasts and actual-versus-budget analysis.
* Assist in preparing financial data and reports for internal cash-flow planning and working-capital analysis, as required.
* Coordinate with internal departments to improve working-capital efficiency and reporting accuracy.
* Maintain and reconcile the fixed-asset register, depreciation schedules, additions, disposals and transfers.
* Support capital expenditure tracking, project-cost documentation, capitalisation reviews and physical verification of assets.
* Coordinate with plant and engineering teams to ensure timely and accurate recording of capital projects.
* Use ERP/accounting systems and advanced Excel to analyse financial data, prepare reconciliations and generate reports.
* Improve finance processes, documentation, reporting timelines and compliance trackers.
* Coordinate effectively with plant finance, procurement, stores, production, sales, HR, auditors and external consultants.

**Skills & Qualifications**
**Must-Have**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant with 2–5 years of post-qualification experience.
* Relevant experience in a core manufacturing, industrial, engineering, chemicals, packaging, printing or similar plant-based organisation is strongly preferred.
* Sound working knowledge of financial accounting, financial statements, costing, inventory accounting, working capital and income-tax compliance.
* Practical exposure to direct-tax compliance and coordination with statutory/internal/tax auditors.
* Working knowledge of GST and TDS compliance; familiarity with tax audits and assessment proceedings is desirable.
* Good command of MS Excel and experience with ERP/accounting systems such as SAP, Oracle, Microsoft Dynamics or similar.
* Strong analytical ability, attention to detail, ownership, integrity and ability to meet statutory and reporting deadlines.
* Ability to work cross-functionally with plant and corporate teams and communicate financial matters clearly.

title: Accounts and Finance Manager
description:
Location: Thane / Bhiwandi, Maharashtra

Department: Accounts & Finance

Reporting To: Managing Director (MD)

Experience: 5–8 years

Qualification: B.Com / M.Com; CA Inter preferred

Salary: ₹40,000–₹60,000 per month, negotiable based on experience.

1.⁠ ⁠Job Purpose

To manage the Accounts & Finance Department with primary responsibility for customer payment collection, outstanding recovery, cash flow management, expense control, supplier payment planning, financial reporting, and statutory compliance.

2.⁠ ⁠Key Responsibilities

A. Payment Collection & Outstanding Recovery — Primary Responsibility

• Prepare and maintain a daily customer-wise outstanding report.

• Follow up with customers daily for overdue payments through calls, WhatsApp, emails, and other appropriate channels.

• Prepare a customer-wise payment collection plan with specific dates and amounts.

• Coordinate with the Sales Team to recover overdue payments.

• Maintain an ageing report categorising outstanding amounts into 0–30, 31–60, 61–90, and above 90 days.

• Identify overdue, disputed, and high-risk customer accounts and report them to the MD.

• Ensure that every overdue payment has a follow-up date and a responsible person.

• Obtain customer payment commitments and track whether payments are received as promised.

• Escalate repeatedly overdue accounts to the MD for decisions on credit limits, order dispatch, or further credit sales.

• Reconcile customer ledgers and resolve payment allocation disputes.

• Submit a daily collection report showing target, actual collection, shortfall, and reasons.

• Work with Sales to reduce overdue receivables and improve the company’s working capital.

B. Cash Flow & Financial Management

• Prepare daily bank balance and cash position reports.

• Prepare weekly cash flow forecasts for the next 7–14 days.

• Monitor expected collections against upcoming payments.

• Alert the MD in advance about cash shortages and major financial commitments.

• Prepare monthly Profit & Loss statements and financial summaries.

C. Supplier Payments & Accounts Payable

• Maintain supplier-wise outstanding reports.

• Prepare a weekly supplier payment plan based on cash availability and business priorities.

• Verify invoices, purchase orders, and goods receipt records.

• Obtain the required approval before releasing payments.

• Avoid duplicate, incorrect, and unauthorised payments.

D. Expense Control & Product Costing

• Monitor expenses against the approved budget.

• Analyse rent, salaries, electricity, overtime, wastage, and other major expenses.

• Analyse product-wise manufacturing costs and profitability.

• Identify unnecessary expenses and recommend cost-saving measures.

• Coordinate with Production and Purchase to improve cost efficiency.

E. Accounts & Reconciliation

• Supervise daily accounting entries and ledger maintenance.

• Ensure regular bank reconciliation.

• Reconcile customer and supplier accounts.

• Maintain accurate sales, purchase, receipt, and payment records.

• Ensure timely month-end accounting closure.

F. Taxation & Statutory Compliance

• Monitor GST, TDS, and other applicable statutory compliance.

• Coordinate with the company’s CA and external auditors.

• Maintain proper financial documentation and filing records.

G. Team Management

• Supervise and allocate work to the Accounts Team.

• Establish daily reporting and follow-up procedures.

• Review collection performance of responsible team members.

• Ensure that customer follow-ups are completed on schedule

title: Store Ingestion Specialist
description:
Believe is a global artist development company. We empower local artists, labels and publishers to grow their audiences at each stage of their careers with expertise, respect, fairness and transparency.

Operating in 50+ countries, with more than 2,000 employees, Believe offers a full range of services including audience development, publishing, marketing and distribution, with a tailor-made approach to fit any artist, label or publisher.

Believe champions independence and innovation through a unique model that combines local expertise with a global tech platform, delivering exclusive solutions for artists to promote and monetize their music thanks to strategic partnerships with leading global digital service providers.

With a leading portfolio of brands that includes Nuclear Blast, naïve, TuneCore, Groove Attack, Sentric, AllPoints and Byond, Believe artists generated more than 800 billion streams worldwide in 2024 across all genres, and were recognized with more than 70 leading industry awards.

Learn more at www.believe.com

**Job Description**

As a Store Ingestion Specialist, you will play a key role in managing the ingestion, validation, reconciliation, and posting of financial and royalty data received from digital service providers (DSPs) and other delivery channels. You will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and completeness of raw financial files, supporting timely royalty postings, resolving data discrepancies, and maintaining data integrity throughout the ingestion process.

You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, BI, Tech/Data teams, DSPs, and other internal and external stakeholders in an international environment to ensure accurate and timely processing of financial and royalty data.

You will be reporting to the Head of Customer Finance and Legal Operations based in Mumbai and will work closely with the broader Revenue Invoicing, Ingestion and Customer Finance teams in an international environment.

Key Responsibilities:

* Receive and process raw financial and royalty files from various DSPs and delivery channels through email, SFTP/FTP, and backend portals, across formats including Excel, PDF, and TXT.
* Review incoming raw files for completeness and accuracy, identifying incorrect templates, missing information, data inconsistencies, and discrepancies between summary and detailed data.
* Maintain accurate records of raw files by ensuring files are stored in designated S3 buckets in accordance with internal processes.
* Manage the ingestion and posting of royalty and financial reports, including the upload of FX rate files and success files through FileZilla.
* Monitor ingestion processes and identify errors or issues, coordinating with relevant Tech, BI, Data, and Finance teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Review ingested reports for accuracy and perform reconciliation of financial data, including cross-checking AR invoices and payments.
* Export data to Retool and apply relevant foreign exchange rates as part of the ingestion and posting process.
* Perform appropriate validation and second-level reviews before obtaining Finance approvals and facilitating data posting.
* Manage regular SR/SIP report postings, ensuring postings are completed accurately and within defined timelines.
* Coordinate with DSPs to obtain corrected or updated raw files where required and follow up on data discrepancies until resolution.
* Work closely with Tech and Data teams during posting activities to monitor progress, troubleshoot issues, and ensure timely completion.
* Review postings against invoices and receipts created in Oracle and investigate discrepancies and variances.
* Perform detailed analysis of complex or exceptional cases and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to resolve differences.
* Communicate changes in split percentages or other relevant business inputs in advance to ensure appropriate accounting adjustments.
* Support monthly financial closing activities by ensuring ingestion, posting, reconciliation, and supporting financial data are complete and accurate.
* Prepare, maintain, and export relevant reports and documentation for financial reporting, audit, and record-keeping purposes.
* Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, BI, Tech/Data, and other internal stakeholders to resolve data, posting, reconciliation, and accounting-related queries.
* Identify recurring data and process issues and contribute to improvements in data quality, automation, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to internal controls, procedures, data management standards, and applicable financial policies throughout the ingestion and posting processes.
* Prioritize daily activities effectively and manage multiple ingestion, reconciliation, and posting activities within defined timelines.
* Work closely with the Royalty Ingestion Lead and other revenue and customer finance specialists to ensure consistent and efficient execution of store ingestion activities.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in finance operations, financial data processing, revenue operations, royalty operations, or related finance processes, preferably in an international environment.
* Strong understanding of financial data processing, reconciliation, revenue recognition, and financial operations.
* Experience working with digital platforms, marketplaces, DSPs, or media companies is a plus; experience in the music industry or royalty operations is a strong advantage.
* Strong analytical and data management skills, with the ability to identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and ensure data accuracy.
* Experience working with large volumes of financial data and maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheet and experience working with financial or data management tools; knowledge of SQL, Retool, FileZilla, and Amazon S3 is an advantage.
* Experience with ERP, accounting, reporting, or financial systems such as Oracle is an advantage.
* Ability to independently manage operational activities, prioritize tasks, and follow through on issues until resolution.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with Finance, Tech/Data, BI, DSPs, and other stakeholders.
* Fluent in English, both spoken and written; additional languages are a plus.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile, and international environment.
* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and a strong sense of ownership.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet operational deadlines while maintaining data quality.
* Demonstrated interest in process improvement, automation, data quality, and the optimization of finance operations.

title: Procure to Record (P2R) Finance Analyst
description:
**Role: Procure to Record (P2R) Finance Analyst**

**Location: Mumbai (Hybrid) (Romania working hours)**

**Job type: Full time, Permanent**

**This position offers a hybrid work model, allowing flexibility between working from home and our office. Typically, employees are expected to work 2 days in the office per week**

**Why QS?**

At QS, we believe that work should empower you. That’s why we foster a flexible working environment that encourages every employee to own their career whilst flourishing personally and professionally. Our commitment to people development is recognised globally: QS is a Gold-accredited Investors in People organisation, placing us among the top 28% of workplaces worldwide. Our company values underpin everything we do – we collaborate, respect and support each other.

It’s our mission to empower motivated people around the world to fulfil their potential through higher education, ensuring that everyone has access to opportunities that change lives.

Our diversity makes us stronger. By sharing our experiences, we learn from one another and achieve more together, driving progress across the sector.

At QS, you’ll be responsible for implementing real change in the international higher education landscape. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that see a positive impact across the business and the wider sector.

We’re confident you’ll feel right at home here. QS was named as one of Newsweek’s Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces® in the UK (October 2023), recognising the respect, trust and appreciation that drive our culture every day.

**The role**

We are seeking a detail oriented Procure to Record (P2R) Finance Analyst to support day-to-day transactional finance operations. This role is primarily responsible for purchase order processing and billing within NetSuite, maintaining vendor data, and ensuring timely and accurate payments. The position also supports month-end activities and helps the Finance team with accounting processes up to Trial Balance level.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong foundation in Accounts Payable who is looking to broaden their exposure to core accounting processes and month-end activities.

**Role responsibilities**

**Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Processing**

* Manage end-to-end processing of purchase orders, invoices and supplier billing in NetSuite.
* Ensure accurate matching of PO, invoice and receipt data.
* Independently assess and apply correct GL coding based on understanding of budgets, actuals and nature of spend.
* Liaise with internal stakeholders and suppliers to resolve discrepancies.

**Vendor Management**

* Maintain accurate vendor master data and ensure compliance with onboarding requirements.
* Support onboarding of new vendors, including documentation checks.

**Payments, Expenses & Travel**

* Prepare and process supplier payment runs in line with payment terms and controls.
* Review and process employee expense claims in accordance with company policy.
* Handle queries related to payments, travel and expenses.

**Month End, AP Control & Accruals**

* Prepare accruals for open purchase orders and unsubmitted expenses.
* Accrue for unsubmitted contractor costs based on available data.
* Assist with month-end close activities and reconciliations.
* Monitor and manage AP ageing, highlighting risks or overdue balances.
* Investigate and resolve aged items and discrepancies.

**Finance Support (Up to TB Level)**

* Support posting of journals and maintaining general ledger accuracy.
* Assist with account reconciliations.
* Provide support to ensure completeness and accuracy of financial data up to TB.
* Ad-hoc projects, including automation and efficiency initiatives.

**Process Improvement & Automation**

* Identify opportunities for automation and efficiency within procurement-to-record processes.
* Support and contribute to process improvement initiatives across AP, finance operations and procurement workflows.
* Proactively highlight gaps in controls, policies or systems and drive practical solutions to close them.
* Promote continuous improvement in accuracy, speed and efficiency of financial processing

**Key skills and experience**

**Technical**

* Transactional Finance roles expertise, proven extensive experience of Accounts Payable through professional experience.
* Strong understanding of cost allocation, GL coding and core accounting principles, ideally backed with Finance qualification (part-qualified studiers highly desirable).
* NetSuite or similar ERP system.
* Excel and emerging technologies with clear evidence of adaptation in work activities.

**Personal & Strategic**

* Highly organised with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Demonstrates a strong drive for productivity, focusing on outcomes and timely achievement of objectives.
* Comfortable working independently, taking ownership of tasks and making informed decisions with confidence.
* Exercises sound judgement - able to balance autonomy with awareness of when to seek input or escalate matters appropriately.
* Strong problem-solving skills with a practical, solutions-focused mindset.
* Confident stakeholder management skills with the ability to handle challenge and resolve issues constructively.
* Process and compliance oriented, with a continuous improvement mindset

**So, who are we and what do we do?**

QS is the world leader in higher education services, analytics, insights and intelligence. From consultancy to student mobility, academic partnerships to branding solutions, our services power both institutional and individual success.

We’re behind the world’s most widely read university rankings (Meltwater 2023). Our QS World University Rankings® reach hundreds of millions, shaping decisions and guiding futures.

Since launching in 1990, our impact and influence have only grown. Today, we work with more than 2,000 of the world’s leading higher education institutions, over 12,000 employers, and governments seeking change and socioeconomic development through higher education.

Join QS and you’ll join an 800-strong community of problem-solvers, creators, collaborators and change-makers based in 40+ countries and 11 international offices, including Australia, Malaysia, India, Romania, Singapore, France, Germany, the USA and our headquarters in London.

With every talented new hire, business acquisition and bold initiative, we’re strengthening our reach and delivering even greater value to institutions and learners worldwide. Are you ready to shape the future of higher education?

**We take investing in our people very seriously.**

**As standard you will have:**

* Competitive base salary
* Access to an annual bonus scheme (for qualifying roles only)
* 21 days annual leave – increasing to 23 days after 5 years’ service + 8 days casual leave
* 15 days holiday for the year 2026
* Enhanced maternity and paternity leave
* Access to Provident Fund and Pension Fund Scheme
* Group Medical Insurance
* A vibrant social environment and multicultural and multinational culture

But that’s not all. Outside of these standard benefits we also offer resources to allow professional growth and wellness initiatives to nurture a healthy mindset:

* Free subscription to the Calm App – the #1 app for sleep, meditation, and relaxation
* A focus on welfare which is led by our global wellness team, with mental health first aiders globally
* Access to a variety of diversity and inclusion initiatives and groups
* Strong recognition and reward programs – including a peer-to-peer recognition platform, quarterly and annual QS Applaud Awards, Connect with your Career annual personal development event
* Support for volunteering and study leave
* Free subscription to LinkedIn learning – with over 5,000 courses and programmes at your fingertips
* Options to join our outstanding global Mentorship programme

**Like what you’ve heard? Great, apply now!**

As a candidate, we know the application and interview process can be daunting and so it’s important that you have a great experience with us. Our dedicated Talent Team will work hard to ensure you are fully informed at all stages, and you are really excited by this opportunity to do meaningful work in the education space.

**Equal opportunities**

QS Quacquarelli Symonds is proud to be a fair and equal organisation where everyone has the same opportunity to achieve their full potential, irrespective of their background or personal attributes. We celebrate our diversity and believe through sharing our experiences we can learn from one another, be stronger together, and enable our business to thrive.

Role/ Job Title: Senior Business Risk Analyst - Supply Chain Finance

'Senior Business Risk Analyst - Supply Chain Finance is responsible for preparing SCF proposals, identifying/ analysing and mitigating risks in supply chain finance programs while ensuring regulatory compliance and operational efficiency.

'
  
  

* At a region level responsible to ensure timely sanction and on-boarding of SCF proposals originated by Regional Trade & SCF Sales team.
* Liaoning with SCF & Trade Sales team, Coverage RMs and Anchor/ Dealer/ Vendor clients to source necessary information for preparing SCF Credit Appraisal Memo (CAMs) for Anchor & Dealer/ Vendor new SCF facility sanctions and renewals of existing SCF facilities.
* Analyse financial and non-financial risks in Anchor proposals and Dealer/ Vendor proposals in supply chain finance programs and work with Product team and Credit/ Risk team for timely sanction of SCF facilities.

* Assist in developing and maintaining supply chain finance risk assessment framework and procedural manuals. Participate in product development from a risk lens – ensuring new programs meet the risk appetite.

title: Associate, Credit Risk Manager, Risk Management Group
description:
**Job Purpose**
The Policy Manager for Prime Loan Against Property (PLAP) is responsible for designing, formulating, and lifecycle-managing the credit policies, risk acceptance criteria (RAC), and underwriting guidelines for secured asset portfolios (specifically Loan Against Property / PLAP) within Consumer Banking Group (CBG) Credit.
  
  
The role ensures that the portfolio growth aligns with the bank's approved Risk Appetite Framework while balancing aggressive business expansion goals with prudent credit risk controls, regulatory compliance (RBI guidelines), and fraud mitigation.
  
  
**Job Duties & Requirements**

* Policy Formulation and Framework Design
* Credit Policy Architecture: Own, review, and periodically update the credit policies, Product Programs (CPP), and underwriting guidelines for Prime Loan Against Property (PLAP) in coordination with business units and senior management.
* Risk Acceptance Criteria (RAC): Calibrate and refine RAC parameters (such as LTV caps, debt-to-income ratios, collateral eligibility, property valuation metrics, and negative area/pincode restrictions) based on macroeconomic trends, portfolio performance, and stress-testing results.
* Standardization: Ensure clear alignment of PLAP policies with overarching Group Core Credit Policies, Risk Appetite Statements (RAS), and local regulatory mandates (e.g., RBI Master Directions).
* Portfolio Monitoring, Analytics & Quality Assurance
* Portfolio Health Tracking: Continuously monitor portfolio metrics (delinquencies, early-stage flow rates, bounce rates, LTV migration, and Concentration Risk thresholds) to identify emerging credit risks or asset quality deterioration.
* Trigger Management: Implement and monitor Management Action Triggers (MAT) and portfolio caps for PLAP and broader secured lending portfolios.
* Audit & Compliance Support: Partner with Quality Assurance (QA) and Credit Fraud Risk Management (CFRM) teams to review control parameters, address policy/process vulnerabilities, and ensure audit readiness.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Product Expansion
* New Product Programs (NPP): Collaborate with Business, Product, and Technology & Operations (T&O) teams to evaluate and structure new product variants, digital/phygital journey integration (e.g., automated appraisal workflows, API-driven verification), and alternative scoring models.
* Process Alignment: Work closely with Credit Operations (CBO) and underwriting teams to ensure seamless policy translation into system rules (e.g., One Risk Workbench/ORWB, IBPM workflows) and operational execution manuals.
* Exception & Escalation Governance: Review and decide on complex policy exception frameworks, setting clear delegation of authority (DoA) matrices for credit managers.

**Required Experience**
Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
  
  
Professional risk certifications (e.g., FRM, CFA) are an added advantage.
  
  
**Education / Preferred Qualifications**
Graduate / Post Graduate in relevant field.
  
  
****Core Competencies****
****Technical Competencies****
Deep Regulatory & Product Knowledge: Strong understanding of secured lending products, property valuation methodologies, legal title checks, CERSAI regulations, and RBI guidelines governing commercial and retail banks in India.
  
  
Data-Driven & Analytical: Strong command over portfolio analytics, credit risk modelling metrics (PD, LGD, EAD), and performance tracking dashboards.
  
  
Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence senior business leaders, risk committees, and operational teams.
  
  
Governance Mindset: Demonstrated ability to balance business growth objectives with robust risk controls and rigorous compliance standards.
  
  
****Work Relationship****
8 years of overall banking experience, with at least 5–7 years specialized experience in Retail/Consumer Credit Risk, Credit Policy, or Portfolio Management—specifically focused on Secured Lending, Mortgages, or Loan Against Property (LAP)

* Build pride and passion to protect, maintain and enhance DBS’ image and reputation
* Enhance knowledge base, build skill sets & develop competencies

description:

**Company:**

CEO Support Services

About Vittiya Insights

Vittiya Insights is a CEO Support Services firm that partners with business owners and leadership teams to strengthen decision-making, improve business performance, and drive sustainable growth.

We work closely with management to provide financial insights, performance monitoring, and structured decision support across key business functions. Our services include Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A), Management Information Systems (MIS), budgeting and forecasting, cash flow management, sales analytics, profitability analysis, and business performance management.

Our objective is to enable business leaders to gain better visibility into their business, identify opportunities for improvement, and make informed, data-driven decisions.

Role Overview

We are looking for a Financial Analyst who will support the delivery of CEO Support Services to our clients. The role involves analysing financial and operational data, developing management reports, monitoring business performance, and generating actionable insights to support strategic and operational decision-making.

The candidate will work closely with internal teams, client finance teams, and business leadership, gaining exposure to different industries and business models.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Financial Planning & Analysis (FP&A)**

* Assist in budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning exercises.
* Analyse actual performance against budgets, forecasts, and previous periods.
* Perform revenue, cost, profitability, and margin analysis.
* Identify key performance drivers, variances, risks, and opportunities.
* Support financial modelling and scenario analysis.

**2. Management Information Systems (MIS) & Reporting**

* Prepare monthly MIS reports and management dashboards.
* Develop business performance matrices covering key financial and operational KPIs.
* Analyse revenue, gross profit, EBITDA, operating expenses, and profitability.
* Ensure accuracy, consistency, and timely delivery of management reports.
* Support management review meetings through structured reports and presentations.

**3. Cash Flow & Working Capital Management**

* Prepare and monitor cash flow forecasts.
* Analyse receivables, payables, inventory, and working capital requirements.
* Track collections, payment cycles, and cash flow trends.
* Identify potential liquidity gaps and opportunities to improve cash flow.

**4. Sales Analytics & Business Performance**

* Analyse sales by customer, product, geography, and business segment.
* Monitor sales targets, growth trends, pricing, and contribution margins.
* Evaluate customer and product profitability.
* Identify business performance gaps and recommend corrective actions.
* Support management in tracking business objectives and performance indicators.

**5. Data Analysis & Process Improvement**

* Extract, validate, classify, and analyse financial and operational data.
* Develop and maintain Excel-based models, reports, and dashboards.
* Identify opportunities to automate and standardise reporting processes.
* Coordinate with client teams to improve data quality and reporting efficiency.

**6. CEO & Management Decision Support**

* Convert financial and operational data into meaningful business insights.
* Assist in identifying performance gaps, cost optimisation opportunities, and growth drivers.
* Prepare presentations and reports for business owners and senior management.
* Support management in evaluating business performance and making informed decisions.
* Contribute to client assignments across financial planning, performance management, and business analytics.

Required Qualifications & Skills

* Graduate or postgraduate degree in Finance, Commerce, Accounting, Economics, or a related discipline.
* CA Inter, CMA Inter, MBA Finance, or equivalent qualifications will be an added advantage.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, accounting principles, and financial analysis.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, lookup functions, SUMIFS, and data analysis.
* Understanding of budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and cash flow management.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and data interpretation skills.
* Good communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple client assignments.

Preferred Skills

* Knowledge of Power BI, Power Query, or other reporting and visualisation tools.
* Exposure to SAP, Tally, or other ERP and accounting systems.
* Experience in MIS reporting, FP&A, business analysis, or management consulting.
* Ability to interpret business trends and translate analysis into actionable recommendations.

Why Join Vittiya Insights?

* Work directly on business challenges faced by CEOs and business owners.
* Gain exposure to diverse industries, business models, and financial management practices.
* Develop practical expertise in FP&A, MIS, business performance, and management decision support.
* Build analytical, problem-solving, and client management capabilities.
* Contribute to decisions that have a measurable impact on business performance.
* **At Vittiya Insights, you will go beyond reporting numbers to understand businesses, generate insights, and support better management decisions.**

Title:
**Assistant Vice President (AVP) – Leveraged Finance Research**
Function:
**Investments**
Sub Function:
**Investment Research**
Reports to:
**Vice President – Private Markets Research**
Location:
**Mumbai**
**Overall Job Purpose**
This role is part of the front-office investments team and involves working closely with the onshore M&G Leveraged Finance Research team. This is a dual role and includes both team management and analytical contributions. The responsibilities include evaluating investment opportunities across leveraged loans & private corporate credit opportunities in the UK and Europe. The role has four primary areas of focus: 1) underwriting and recommending primary and secondary investment opportunities, 2) monitoring existing portfolio exposures and identifying emerging risks, 3) conducting thematic and sector research to support investment decision-making and 4) managing, mentoring and developing junior team members. The successful candidate will combine rigorous fundamental analysis and intellectual curiosity to develop differentiated credit views, challenge assumptions and provide actionable investment recommendations to portfolio managers and senior analysts.
  
  
**Accountabilities/Responsibilities**

* Play a pivotal role across teams in fostering analytical excellence, intellectual rigour and effective knowledge sharing.
* Work closely with onshore front-office leveraged finance analysts covering leveraged loans, private corporate credit opportunities, high yield bonds and other related opportunistic credit investments.
* Support the underwriting of primary and secondary opportunities, assessing business quality, industry dynamics, management execution, sponsor behaviour, financial performance and capital structure risk.
* Build and maintain detailed financial models covering earnings, cash flow, liquidity, debt capacity, leverage, covenant headroom and deleveraging pathways.
* Review credit agreements, bond indentures and intercreditor arrangements to assess security, guarantees, covenants, baskets, portability, structural subordination and lender protections.
* Participate actively in management meetings, lender presentations, sponsor discussions and due diligence calls, confidently challenging assumptions and testing the investment thesis.
* Prepare concise, decision-useful investment memos that clearly articulate the thesis, catalysts, key risks, downside protection, relative value and recommendation.
* Monitor portfolio investments continuously and act as the first line of defence in identifying deteriorating credit quality, liquidity pressure, covenant monitoring and refinancing risk.
* Conduct sector and thematic research to identify structural trends, vulnerable business models and attractive risk-adjusted opportunities ahead of consensus.
* Assess investments through an ESG lens, evaluating governance, sustainability and reputational factors that may affect long-term credit performance.
* Drive automation and enhancement of research tools and processes using Excel, Python, VBA, Power BI or other analytical technologies.
* Train, mentor and develop junior analysts through technical review, constructive challenge and continuous coaching.

**Key Stakeholder Management**
Internal:
  
  

* Head of Investment Research
* VP – Private Markets Research

External
  
  

* Onshore leveraged finance analysts
* Portfolio managers
* Issuers, management teams, arranging banks, financial sponsors and external advisers

**Knowledge, Skills, Experience & Educational Qualification:**
**Knowledge & Skills:**

* Deep understanding of leveraged finance, corporate credit and capital structures, including leveraged loans, high-yield bonds and private credit instruments.
* Good financial-statement analysis and modelling capability, including the ability to normalise EBITDA, identify adjustments and distinguish accounting earnings from sustainable cash generation.
* Strong understanding of credit agreements, bond indentures, covenant packages, security structures, intercreditor terms and restructuring or recovery mechanics.
* Proven ability to synthesise complex quantitative and qualitative information into decisive, well-supported investment recommendations.
* An investigative mindset, with the confidence to challenge management narratives, sponsor assumptions, market consensus and internal views constructively.
* Ability to build trusted relationships, understand stakeholder priorities, communicate proactively, and align offshore delivery with onshore business expectations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to defend recommendations under rigorous scrutiny from senior stakeholders.
* High ownership, attention to detail and resilience, with the ability to deliver high-quality work under tight transaction timelines.
* Demonstrated ability to mentor junior analysts and raise analytical standards across a research team.
* Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and proficiency in Bloomberg and corporate credit research platforms. Python, VBA and Power BI are desirable.

**Experience:**

* 9 - 12 years of relevant experience in leveraged finance, high-yield or loan research, private credit, credit underwriting, investment banking, rating advisory or a related discipline.
* Prior experience in managing highly effective teams is preferred.
* Demonstrable track record of underwriting complex credits and influencing investment, underwriting or risk decisions.
* Experience analysing sponsor-backed borrowers and event-driven transactions across multiple sectors and jurisdictions.
* Prior experience working directly with portfolio managers, investment committees or senior credit professionals is strongly preferred.

**Educational Qualification:**

* MBA, CA or equivalent postgraduate/professional qualification from a recognised institution.
* CFA charter, active CFA candidacy or FRM qualification is desirable; demonstrated investment judgement and technical excellence will be weighted more heavily than credentials alone.

**M&G Behaviours relevant to all roles:**
**Tell it like it is:**
Respectfully speaking up to create better ways forward – both direct and empathetic

Putting your name on things with confidence to drive progress and results quickly

Forming cross-functional teams to seize the right opportunities and solve real problems.

title: Credit Risk Analyst
description:

title: Corporate & Investment Banking Credit Risk Analyst
description:

title: Food Beverage Controller
description:
**Designation**
**-**
Senior Manager - F&B Controls

**Location -**
Worli, Mumbai

**A. Food & Beverage Cost Control**

• Monitor food and beverage costs against approved budgets and established cost benchmarks.

• Track actual food cost, beverage cost, consumption, wastage, and cost variances.

• Analyse recipe costing, portion control, yield, and menu profitability in coordination with the culinary team.

• Identify cost leakages and recommend corrective measures to improve gross margins.

• Monitor food cost percentages across outlets, banquet events, and catering operations.

**B. Inventory & Stores Management**

• Oversee inventory planning, stock movement, consumption, and reconciliation.

• Ensure regular physical stock counts and reconciliation with system records.

• Monitor expiry, spoilage, breakage, wastage, and stock discrepancies.

• Establish controls for stock transfers, material requisitions, returns, and inter-location movements. • Ensure appropriate stock levels and adherence to FIFO/FEFO practices.

**C. Procurement & Vendor Control**

• Review purchase prices, vendor rates, and procurement practices to identify cost-saving opportunities.

• Monitor purchase price variances and compliance with approved vendor and procurement policies.

• Coordinate with procurement, stores, culinary, and operations teams to control material costs.

• Review receiving procedures, quality checks, and quantity discrepancies. D. Banqueting & Catering Costing

• Prepare and review food and beverage cost sheets for banquets, weddings, corporate events, and large scale catering assignments.

• Validate event-wise consumption against planned menus, guest counts, and production quantities.

• Analyse actual versus estimated event costs and identify deviations.

• Monitor contribution margins and profitability by event, venue, and business vertical.

• Establish post-event cost reconciliation and variance reporting processes.

**E. Budgeting, MIS & Financial Analysis**

• Prepare monthly F&B cost reports, inventory reports, and variance analysis.

• Track food cost percentage, beverage cost percentage, gross margins, wastage, and inventory holding levels.

• Develop dashboards highlighting cost trends, exceptions, and corrective actions.

• Support annual budgeting, forecasting, and cost-saving initiatives.

• Provide actionable insights to senior management on profitability and operational efficiency.

**F. Audit, Compliance & Process Improvement**

• Conduct periodic operational audits across kitchens, stores, outlets, and banquet locations.

• Ensure adherence to inventory, procurement, billing, consumption, and stock reconciliation SOPs. • Identify control gaps, irregularities, and potential pilferage.

• Implement standardised F&B control processes across all operating locations.

• Coordinate with internal audit and finance teams to ensure accurate reporting and compliance.

**Experience:-**

* 8–12 years of relevant experience in F&B cost control, hospitality finance, inventory control, or food and beverage operations.
* Prior experience in hotels, premium restaurants, large-scale catering, banqueting, central kitchens, or multi-outlet F&B businesses.
* Experience in handling multi-location operations and high-volume food production will be preferred.

Job Description:
  
  
**About The Role**
Russell Investments is seeking a highly analytical, technology-minded Portfolio Implementation Analyst to join our Mumbai-based team supporting the fast-growing Personalized Managed Accounts (PMA) business. This role sits within a global portfolio management team responsible for implementing systematic, tax-aware and personalized investment strategies across client accounts.
  
  
You will support daily portfolio implementation, optimization, trade preparation and data validation while helping improve the systems and processes that make the business scalable. The strongest candidates will be comfortable working across multiple systems, investigating issues, using data to form a view, and translating problems and enhancement ideas into clear recommendations for portfolio managers, business partners and developers.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Support daily portfolio implementation, including account optimization, trade creation and review, compliance checks, cash management, data validation and exception resolution.
* Analyze optimizer results and portfolio data to identify unusual outcomes, data-quality issues, system defects and opportunities to improve decision rules or workflows.
* Work across investment, trading, risk, data and operational systems; determine whether breaks originate from data, configuration, process or technology and drive issues toward resolution.
* Use SQL, Excel and other analytical tools to query, reconcile and validate data, support root-cause analysis, and reduce manual checks where practical.
* Identify and help implement automation opportunities that improve accuracy, control, speed and scalability, including thoughtful use of AI and emerging technologies.
* Translate business problems into clear requirements: articulate the issue, impact, evidence and recommended enhancement to peers, managers and developers; support testing and implementation.
* Coordinate with global portfolio management, trading, operations, research and technology teams on trades, cash activity, account events and implementation issues.
* Interpret and process security corporate actions and help resolve security master, pricing and other market-data exceptions across a large security universe.
* Document procedures, controls, recurring issues and findings; manage multiple priorities, execute directions accurately, and escalate material issues with concise analysis and recommended next steps.

What We’re Looking For
  
  

* 3-5 years of experience in investment management, portfolio operations, trading, investment technology, data analysis or a related field.
* Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, mathematics, engineering, computer science or a related discipline. A master’s degree, CFA progress/designation or other relevant qualification is beneficial but not required.
* Strong understanding of capital markets, investment portfolios, asset classes and/or performance measurement, combined with rigorous analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated comfort working with multiple systems and large data sets, including the ability to recognize when something does not look right, investigate why, and recommend a practical response.
* Working knowledge of SQL and strong Excel skills. Experience with Python, Power BI or other data/automation tools is a plus.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain a problem, its business impact and a recommended solution to both investment professionals and technology teams.
* Ability to work autonomously and collaboratively; a self-starter who takes ownership, asks questions early and is candid when a concept, process or requirement is unclear.
* Strong organization, attention to detail and time management, with the ability to execute instructions consistently and accurately in a fast-paced environment.
* Comfort making pragmatic decisions in ambiguous situations, documenting the rationale, and adjusting as new information becomes available.
* Curiosity, strong work ethic and a continuous-improvement mindset; willing to challenge the status quo constructively and look for better ways to work.

**Preferred Experience**

* Retail or institutional trading, portfolio management, portfolio implementation or portfolio optimization.
* Axioma Portfolio or another portfolio optimization/risk platform; Bloomberg or similar market-data tools.
* Security-level corporate actions, security master/reference data, pricing data and exception resolution across a broad security universe.
* System testing, requirements gathering, process design, workflow automation or partnership with software developers and technology teams.
* Using AI or emerging technologies to streamline analysis, documentation, controls or investment workflows.
* Tax-managed investing, direct indexing or separately managed accounts is helpful, but prior U.S. tax-management experience is not required.

How You’ll Work
  
  
This is a hands-on role in a rapidly growing business. You should be comfortable moving quickly, learning continuously and taking ownership from the outset. We value people who are direct, curious and dependable; who ask good questions rather than make silent assumptions; who can make a reasonable decision with incomplete information and explain their reasoning; and who actively look for opportunities to make the portfolio-management process more efficient, scalable and robust.
  
  
Why Join PMA?
  
  

* Join one of Russell Investments’ strategic growth businesses and help shape how a scaled, technology-enabled portfolio-management platform evolves.
* Gain exposure to global portfolio management, trading, optimization, risk, investment operations and technology while working with experienced investment professionals across regions.
* Build a career at the intersection of investing, data and technology, with meaningful opportunities to take ownership as the business and platform expand.
* Have visible impact: strong ideas, thoughtful analysis and effective automation can improve client outcomes and the way the team operates from day one.Portfolio Implementation Analyst

title: Manager - COE, Business Intelligence & Account Performance
description:
Manager – COE, Business Intelligence & Account Performance

**Central COE | Founder's Office**

About Pepper

Pepper is building an
**AI-native SEO and content growth platform**
, combining strategy, technology, automation and AI to drive measurable business outcomes for customers.

This role sits within the
**Founder's Office**
, working on how the business is priced, resourced, delivered, measured and improved.

The Opportunity

We're looking for a
**Manager, COE – Business Intelligence & Account Performance**
to own the intelligence layer of the business.

This is a
**business-facing, problem-solving role**
, not a reporting role. You'll bring together account performance, delivery, commercial and client data to answer three questions:
**What is happening? Why is it happening? What should we do about it?**

You'll work closely with commercial, delivery, capability and finance leaders and be measured on business outcomes — not the number of reports produced.

What You'll Do

* Build a live intelligence layer combining
  **account, delivery, commercial and client signals**
  .
* Turn structured and unstructured data - including calls, decks, reviews and performance data into actionable insights.
* Build automated analysis and workflows so recurring reporting runs itself.
* Identify
  **account risks, retention opportunities and growth opportunities**
  early.
* Diagnose underperforming accounts and recommend specific actions to improve them.
* Work directly with business leaders to answer critical questions and influence decisions.
* Own data definitions and reconciliation to ensure the business has a
  **single source of truth**
  .
* Bring together commercial, delivery, SEO/GEO and margin data to understand account performance end-to-end.
* Be the person who can explain
  **why any account is performing the way it is, with evidence.**

What We're Looking For

* **3–6 years**
  in BI, performance analytics, business operations, strategy or consulting.
* Strong business-facing analytical skills and comfort working with senior stakeholders.
* Strong
  **Excel and SQL**
  skills.
* Comfortable working with AI and automation tools such as
  **Claude, Claude Code, Lovable and n8n**
  .
* Able to work with
  **unstructured data**
  such as calls, decks and written commentary.
* Familiarity with
  **SEO/web analytics tools**
  such as Ahrefs, Semrush, GA4 and Google Search Console is a strong plus.
* Strong first-principles problem solving — able to go from
  **data → diagnosis → action**
  .
* Comfortable challenging assumptions and communicating findings clearly.
* Digital, content, SEO or e-commerce services experience is a strong advantage.

Why This Role?

* Build the
  **intelligence layer for the business from the ground up**
  .
* Work directly with the
  **Founder's Office and senior leadership**
  .
* Influence both
  **commercial performance and client outcomes**
  .
* Define the metrics and systems rather than inherit them.
* Strong opportunity to grow into
  **business and strategy leadership**
  as Pepper scales.

title: Associate Business Intelligence Analyst
description:
**The Team:**

This information allows PitchBook’s customers to discover emerging companies, conduct research on potential investment opportunities, and gain a competitive edge in investment decision-making and negotiations.
  
  
**The Role:**

The role uses data to figure out trends, perform critical analysis and build data visualizations for Data Operations function at PitchBook. The Analyst will conduct thorough data analysis, help design and implement analytics programs, generate reports, and collaborate with various teams to ensure we are optimizing our resources and maximizing our output. The Analyst works closely with business and IT team to turn data into critical information and knowledge that can be used to make sound business decisions.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Work with a range of data and reporting technologies like SQL, Tableau and Power BI to help build, maintain, and manage dashboards to power analytics for data-driven decision making.
* Design and maintain SQL views, Power BI datasets, workspaces and reporting structures used to compile insights.
* Build executive level reporting that displays complex quantitative data in a simple, intuitive format and to present findings in a clear and concise manner.

* Provide design support for development of business intelligence solutions, build an in-depth understanding of the business, and serve as the primary owner of new report requests.
* Interpret business requirements and determines optimum BI solutions to meet business needs.

* Bachelor’s degree from STEM fields such as Computer Science, Engineering, IT, Analytics, etc. Specialized training/certification and master’s degree preferred.
* Basic SQL skills a necessity and intermediate SQL skills preferred, with experience querying large datasets from multiple sources and developing automated reporting.
* R and/or Python skills for scripting, data manipulation, custom ETLs, statistical analysis
* Experience with BI/data visualization software programs such as Tableau or Microsoft Power BI
* Excellent analytical thinking and interpersonal skills, with the ability to communicate complex data issues correctly and clearly to both internal and external customers.
* Attention to detail. Ability to define and organize tasks, responsibilities & priorities.
* Willing and flexible to work on UK shift, US shift and Indian holidays.

title: Founder’s Office
description:
**Job Description**
: Founder’s Office

**Strategy, Business Operations & Special Projects**

**About the Role**

We’re looking for a highly driven, analytical, and execution-oriented individual to join the Founder’s Office. Working closely with the Founders and Founder’s Office Lead, you will drive key business priorities across strategy, operations, e-commerce, brand, and special projects.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who can move seamlessly between strategic problem-solving and hands-on execution—from analysing business performance and building presentations to managing international retail accounts and driving cross-functional projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Strategy & Special Projects**

Drive high-priority initiatives from problem definition to execution across business strategy, growth, category expansion, and new opportunities.

Conduct market research, competitive analysis, and consumer insights to support decision-making.

Build business cases, financial models, and presentations to evaluate opportunities and track outcomes.

Translate business priorities into actionable plans with clear timelines, owners, and success metrics.

**2. Project Management & Business Operations**

Manage cross-functional projects across Marketing, E-commerce, Product, Finance, and Operations.

Maintain project trackers, launch calendars, dashboards, and reporting systems to ensure accountability and timely execution.

Track business performance, identify risks and dependencies, and proactively resolve execution bottlenecks.

Streamline workflows, improve processes, and introduce tools to enhance operational efficiency.

**3. D2C & E-commerce Account Management**

Support the day-to-day management and growth of D2C store and marketplace accounts

Coordinate product launches, product detail page (PDP) optimization, content updates, marketing activations, and account deliverables.

Track sales, account performance, and campaign metrics to identify growth opportunities.

Collaborate with internal teams and external partners to strengthen brand presence, customer experience, and conversion.

**4. Founder Support & Communications**

Support the Founders on business priorities, strategic initiatives, and ad hoc projects.

Prepare presentations, business updates, meeting briefs, and decision memos.

Conduct research and analysis to evaluate ideas and provide actionable recommendations.

Coordinate key meetings, track decisions, and ensure timely follow-through on action items.

Handle confidential information with discretion and sound judgment.

**5. AI, Analytics & Continuous Improvement**

Use Excel/Google Sheets and AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude to improve research, analysis, reporting, and execution.

Identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve team productivity.

Bring strong analytical thinking, creativity, and attention to detail to business, brand, and e-commerce initiatives.

**Who You Are:**

Ownership-driven: Take initiatives from idea to execution without constant supervision.

Analytical: Comfortable with numbers, data interpretation, business analysis, and problem-solving.

Highly organized: Manage multiple priorities, timelines, and stakeholders with attention to detail.

Proactive: Anticipate challenges, identify solutions, and follow through on commitments.

A strong communicator: Build clear presentations, write concise updates, and align cross-functional teams.

AI-native and curious: Actively use emerging tools to work smarter and more efficiently.

Creative and adaptable: Comfortable switching between strategic thinking, operational execution, and brand-focused work.

**Experience & Qualifications:**

2–4 years of experience in consulting, strategy, startups, business operations, e-commerce, consumer brands, or a Founder’s Office.

Strong proficiency in Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint/Google Slides.

Familiarity with AI tools such as ChatGPT and Claude; Canva experience is a plus.

Strong project management, analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Economics, or a related field; MBA optional.

**Good to have**
: Experience in beauty, personal care, D2C, retail, international marketplaces, or global expansion.

**What’s in It for You?**

Direct exposure to the Founders and leadership team.

Ownership of high-impact projects across strategy, operations, and growth.

A steep learning curve across business functions and international markets.

Opportunities for accelerated career growth, performance incentives, and ESOPs, where applicable.

The Bottom Line: We’re looking for a self-starter who combines strategic thinking with relentless execution—someone who can analyse a problem, build a plan, manage the details, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.

title: Finance Director, South Asia & South East Asia
description:
FMC Corporation is a global leader in agricultural sciences, driven by our purpose: Innovation for Agriculture. Solutions for the Planet. We are passionate about the power of science to solve agriculture’s biggest challenges. With one of the most productive and diversified pipelines in the industry, FMC is delivering cutting-edge and next-generation crop protection technologies – including Dodhylex™ active, Isoflex™ active, rimisoxafen, and fluindapyr – to help farmers increase the productivity and resilience of their land. Our employees are at the heart of this innovation. We’re looking for bold thinkers and collaborative doers. At FMC, your ideas matter. From day one, you’ll contribute to meaningful work that drives progress in agriculture, supported by a culture that values integrity, safety, respect, and results. Join us in advancing the future of agriculture. Together, we’re building a more resilient planet – one innovation at a time.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The primary purpose of this position is to provide Finance leadership to our South Asia & South East Asia [“S&SEA”] Sub-Region covering ASEAN, Pakistan, Bangladesh and Sri Lanka. The role will include reviewing all aspects of both business support and controllership covering [but not limited to] budgets, forecasts, pricing, monthly actual reporting, indirect/direct tax submission and audit and all aspects of financial business partnering to the Subregion Leadership. Additionally, the position will be responsible for all US, APAC and local reporting, both Profit and Loss and Balance Sheet. Critically this will be accomplished through both direct staff and various centralized services which are “owned” by other finance leaders globally.
  
  
As S&SEA Finance Director, you will be the finance business partner for the S&SEA leadership team which covers all aspects of commercial and operational management for the region. This position will report directly to Asia Finance Director and will collaborate with key stakeholders in the S&SEA organization, as well as corporate Finance functions such Controllership, Internal Controls, Tax and Treasury. Of considerable importance is the relationship/support of the S&SEA Subregion leader, providing financial strategic guidance but also helping to drive critical initiatives to hit $$ targets. As a key member of the S&SEA leadership team, advising/driving agreed business strategies and change into S&SEA organization will be a significant part of the role as we move to implement an exciting pipeline of new products and a new approach to market dynamics.
  
  
**Location: Jakarta/ Mumbai/ Singapore**
**The Role**

* Lead both ASEAN and Pakistan Finance teams
* Foster a strong business partner relationship with S&SEA Sub-region Leader and with S&SEA Asia Leadership Team members including Commercial Directors with Regional & Global Finance teams, external government bodies
* Lead the team to develop S&SEA Budget
* Supervise the team to provide monthly/quarterly forecasting reports for S&SEA ensuring clear paths to achieve stated $$ targets
* Monitor and report financial performance, understand and explain root causes cause of variances -vs- budget, forecast, and prior year. Work proactively to institutionalize improvements and remedy unfavorable performance
* Provide insight into strategic decisions to drive cost efficiencies and optimize resource allocation
* Supervise the monthly close process
* Lead the statutory preparation of accounts and indirect/direct tax incl. any requests for funding from Global Tax/Treasury
* Strong working capital management
* Support SOX, internal audit, and Tax audit as needed

**The Candidate (requirements)**

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting/Finance/business
* MBA or Chartered Accountant/CICPA
* Minimum of 15 years diversified experience in various levels of finance management covering both controllership and FP&A
* People leader experience required
* Strong financial acumen and analytics skills. Being able provide in-depth explanation of results, synthesize data to identify key business drivers and assess the quality of inputs, generate insightful outputs
* Experience with all aspects of financial reporting cycle including development of annual business plan / budget, financial projections / recurring forecasts and operations cost management required
* Standard costing experience (preferred)
* ERP System experience required

**Competencies**

* Ability to build effective business relationships, and interact and communicate effectively with executives and management
* Strong analytical skills with aptitude to ask challenging questions and reach the underlying issues
* Ability to influence outcomes and set overall performance expectations
* Strong written and oral presentations skills with fluency in English
* Ability to take ownership to act and to drive progress and deliver on commitments in an ethical way
* Demonstrated leadership ability, strategic mindset and organizational awareness
* Ability to work in a matrix organization and adapt to change as needed
* Proficient in the Microsoft office suite to include Excel and Power Point

FMC is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where all individuals are treated with respect and dignity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected status. Employment decisions at FMC are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications. We value diversity and strive to ensure that our hiring and employment practices support a work environment that is free from discrimination and harassment.

title: Sr Analyst, Financial Planning & Analysis
description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
  
  
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
  
  
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
  
  
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. Together, our values ensure that we work together as one global team with our customers at the center of everything we do – and they push us to ensure we take care of ourselves, each other, and our communities.
  
  
**Job Summary:**
**What Do You Need To Know About The Role**
A team in a key role supporting G&A financial planning and decision-making. You will help connect company strategy and goals to financial plans for headcount and operating expenses, deliver insights and recommendations to senior leadership, and establish scalable global standards for OPEX and headcount reporting. You’ll also identify opportunities to strengthen planning infrastructure and streamline financial processes while building and leading a high-performing team of analysts.
  
  
Meet our team
  
  
This role offers ownership of Opex strategy for Corporate/Enabling Functions at a global fintech leader, with high visibility to senior leadership and real influence over how the company invests in Legal, HR, Facilities, and IT. The candidate will work hands-on with modern planning tools (SAP, SAP Analytics Cloud) while driving automation and process improvement — not just reporting numbers, but shaping how Finance operates.
  
  
**Job Description:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Support planning and forecasting processes
* Review business performance on regular cadences (weekly, monthly, quarterly)Collaborate with stakeholders to gather inputs and summarize insights
* Produce executive-level presentations
* Work closely with the finance and technical teams to drive process and system improvements
* Facilitate discussions with various stakeholders, manage expectations, and collaborate cross-functionally
* Consult with finance leads to review and discuss key issues, risks, and dependencies for assigned initiatives
* Document and escalate potential risks/issues, assist in developing mitigation strategies, and support their implementation

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 3+ years relevant experience and a Bachelor’s degree OR Any equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Responsibilities & Preferred Qualifications:**
**Essential Responsibilities:**

* Own the Opex planning, forecasting, and budgeting cycle for Corporate/Enabling Functions (e.g., Legal, HR, Finance, Corporate Real Estate, IT), ensuring alignment with enterprise-wide financial targets
* Partner directly with senior functional leaders to translate business priorities into financial plans, headcount models, and investment cases, acting as a trusted financial advisor
* Deliver clear, concise, and compelling storytelling on financial performance, key cost drivers, and variances to executive and cross-functional audiences
* Drive standardization, automation, and process improvement across Opex reporting workstreams, leveraging tools such as SAP, SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC), and other planning platforms
* Lead monthly close, variance analysis (budget vs. actual/forecast), and headcount tracking, proactively flagging risks and opportunities before they surface in results
* Build and maintain robust financial models and business cases to support strategic decisions, cost-optimization initiatives, and ad hoc leadership requests
* Collaborate cross-functionally with Controllership, Corporate FP&A, Legal, HR/People, and business stakeholders to ensure data integrity, consistency, and a single source of truth across reporting
* Represent Finance in leadership forums, demonstrating strong executive presence and the ability to influence and articulate recommendations to senior stakeholders

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* 5+ years of progressive FP&A or corporate finance experience, ideally within a fintech, financial services, or technology environment, with direct exposure to Corporate/Enabling Functions

title: Senior FP&A & Financial Modeling Consultant
description:
**Location:**
India — Remote
  
  
**Company:**
Limelight Software, Toronto, Canada
  
  
**About The Role**
You’ve built financial models for different businesses, worked directly with clients or portfolio companies, and learned how to turn complex financial questions into practical recommendations.
  
  
At Limelight, you’ll bring that experience to help finance teams improve how they budget, forecast, and report.

**Senior Consultant, Financial Modeling & FP&A**
with experience in financial advisory, transaction advisory, private equity, venture capital, or a similar environment. You should have built models for multiple clients or portfolio companies, with the ability to understand a new business, identify its financial drivers, and design a model around them.
  
  
Using Limelight’s FP&A platform, you’ll turn that knowledge into connected planning models, reports, and dashboards. You’ll work directly with CFOs, Controllers, and business leaders, taking ownership of both the financial solution and the client relationship.
  
  
What You’ll Do
  
  

* Understand each client’s business. Lead discovery sessions to identify revenue drivers, cost structures, planning requirements, and reporting needs
* Build financial models from the ground up. Develop integrated models covering revenue, workforce, operating expenses, capital expenditure, balance sheets, and cash flow
* Turn analysis into working solutions. Translate spreadsheet models and business requirements into scalable planning models within Limelight
* Develop forecasts and scenarios. Help clients assess growth plans, hiring decisions, funding needs, and changes in business performance
* Advise finance leaders. Explain assumptions, challenge inconsistencies, and recommend approaches that improve planning and decision-making
* Manage client engagements. Own scope, timelines, deliverables, and communication across multiple projects
* Deliver reliable results. Validate calculations, reconcile source data, and ensure models and reports work together accurately
* Support client adoption. Train finance teams and help them confidently maintain and use the solutions you build

What You’ll Bring
  
  
**Experience Across Multiple Businesses**

* A track record of building financial models for several external clients or portfolio companies
* Experience in financial advisory, transaction advisory, valuation and modeling, outsourced CFO services, private equity, venture capital, or a comparable consulting environment
* The ability to get up to speed on different business models and industries quickly
* Ownership of substantial modeling work, including developing assumptions, structuring calculations, validating outputs, and presenting findings

**Strong Financial Modeling And FP&A Skills**

* Advanced Excel skills and experience building driver-based forecasts, integrated three-statement models, scenario analyses, and management reports
* A strong understanding of accounting, working capital, cash flow, and business performance
* The ability to build models that support ongoing budgeting and operating decisions, alongside any valuation or transaction experience
* Sound judgment about model structure, assumptions, accuracy, and usability

**Client and project management**

* Experience working directly with clients or portfolio company leadership to gather requirements and recommend solutions

Limelight is a Toronto-based software company helping finance teams simplify budgeting, forecasting, and reporting.

title: Senior Associate Specialist, Treasury - Finance Operations
description:

* Ensuring adequate funding availability for operational requirements, capital expenditure, and debt servicing obligations.
* Continuous monitoring and analysis of cash positions and liquidity requirements across all entities.
* Following with AR & AP team for payments & collection forecasts.
* Management of intercompany balances and liabilities/receivables.
* Managing the cashgap funding through short term, WCDL loans from bank and negotiating for the best rates.

**Funding, Debt & Capital Management**

* Acting as the key liaison between banks, legal, secretarial team on matters related to liquidity management, cash flow forecasting, and bank loans enhancements, new proposals or the renewals.

* Bachelor's Degree (or equivalent) in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, or a related discipline.

**Required Skills**

* Proven experience in a similar role within a multinational or global information technology organization.
* Demonstrated track record in treasury operations, funding management, liquidity planning, banking relationship management, and financial transformation initiatives.

**Good to have Skills**
