- Minimum 5+ years of relevant accounting experience, preferably in e-commerce, export, trading, or a related industry.

- Graduate in Accounting, Finance, Commerce, or a related field.

- Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial processes, GST, and TDS compliance.

- Hands-on experience with Tally ERP / Tally Prime.

- Strong proficiency in MS Excel / Advanced Excel, with mandatory knowledge of VLOOKUP and HLOOKUP.

- Practical experience in bank reconciliation, ledger scrutiny, payment processing, and financial reporting.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills for professional coordination with government departments, external stakeholders, and the company's overseas branch.

- Ability to communicate professionally through email, telephone, and virtual meetings.

- Strong coordination, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

- Ability to work independently, manage multiple responsibilities, and meet deadlines.

- Experience working with a CA firm or handling export-related accounting will be an added advantage.

**Preferred Candidate**

Mumbai-based candidates who can commute daily to Byculla West and Immediate joiners will be preferred for this role.

title: Account Manager (Chartered Accountant)
description:
**Post -**
Accounts Manager (CA)

Qualified Chartered Accountant

4+ years

**Working Days -**
Monday to Saturday

**Office Timings -**
10:00 AM - 07:00 PM

**Roles & Responsibilities**

**1. Accounting & Financial Management**

• Supervise day-to-day accounting operations and ensure accurate maintenance of books of accounts.

• Oversee general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable and bank reconciliations.

• Review accounting entries, journal vouchers, provisions and adjustments.

• Ensure timely monthly, quarterly and annual closing of accounts.

• Prepare and review financial statements, including balance sheets, profit and loss statements and cash

flow statements.

• Maintain project-wise and entity-wise accounting records.

• Monitor intercompany transactions, partner capital accounts and loans.

• Ensure adherence to applicable accounting standards and company policies.

**2. Real Estate Project Accounting**

• Maintain project-wise cost records and profitability statements.

• Track construction expenditure against approved budgets.

• Monitor contractor bills, vendor payments, retention amounts, advances and reconciliations.

• Review accounting for land acquisition, development rights, redevelopment obligations and project expenses.

• Track customer collections, outstanding receivables and project cash flows.

• Coordinate with construction, procurement, sales and CRM departments to ensure accurate financial reporting.

• Prepare project-wise cost-to-complete statements and financial MIS.

**3. Direct & Indirect Taxation**

• Ensure timely and accurate GST compliance, including GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and applicable reconciliations.

• Review input tax credit eligibility and GST treatment of real estate transactions.

• Oversee TDS/TCS deductions, payments, returns and reconciliations.

• Coordinate income tax computations, advance tax payments and annual return filings.

• Assist in handling income tax and GST assessments, notices and departmental queries.

• Work with external tax consultants to ensure tax-efficient and compliant transactions.

• Maintain updated knowledge of taxation applicable to real estate development, redevelopment and construction.

**4. Banking, Treasury & Cash Flow Management**

• Prepare periodic cash flow statements and fund requirement reports.

• Monitor banking transactions, loan accounts, interest calculations and repayment schedules.

• Coordinate with banks for project finance, working capital facilities and documentation.

• Track utilisation of project funds and compliance with lending conditions.

• Prepare financial information required by banks and financial institutions.

• Monitor receivables, payables and upcoming financial commitments.

**5. Financial Planning, Budgeting & MIS**

• Prepare monthly management information reports.

• Develop project-wise budget-versus-actual statements.

• Analyse cost overruns, profitability, cash flow gaps and financial variances.

• Prepare financial dashboards for management review.

• Assist in annual budgeting, forecasting and financial planning.

• Identify opportunities for cost optimisation and improvements in financial controls.

• Present key financial observations and actionable recommendations to management.

**6. Statutory Compliance & Audit**

• Coordinate statutory audits, tax audits, internal audits and other regulatory audits.

• Ensure timely completion of statutory filings and applicable financial disclosures.

• Support financial compliance under RERA and other applicable real estate regulations.

• Maintain proper accounting documentation, records and audit trails.

• Identify financial control weaknesses and implement corrective measures.

• Coordinate with company secretaries, auditors and legal consultants on finance-related matters.

**7. Internal Controls & Process Improvement**

• Establish and strengthen accounting procedures, approval systems and financial controls.

• Review payment authorisations and supporting documentation.

• Implement checks to prevent accounting errors, duplicate payments and financial irregularities.

• Improve accounting automation, reporting accuracy and efficiency.

• Supervise and guide junior accounts team members.

• Ensure compliance with internal financial policies and approval matrices.

**Skills**

• Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.

• High standards of accuracy, integrity and accountability.

• Ability to independently manage responsibilities and meet deadlines.

• Commercial understanding of real estate development.

• Strong communication and interdepartmental coordination skills.

• Proactive approach to identifying financial risks and improving processes.

• Ability to lead and develop an accounts team.

description:

**Job Description**
The Ares Corporate Treasury Department is responsible for capital planning, global cash and liquidity management, and foreign exchange risk mitigation across the organization’s multi-jurisdictional footprint. The department supports the business through several key functions spanning North America, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific, ensuring effective treasury operations across diverse regulatory, banking, and market environments, including:
  
  

* Balance Sheet Management: Developing strategies to leverage and monetize current and forecasted balance sheet assets across global entities and jurisdictions, while optimizing capital efficiency at both the corporate and regional levels.
* Capital Markets: Monitoring equity, debt, and loan capital markets to execute fundraising transactions that support anticipated capital requirements across multiple currencies and international markets.
* Liquidity and Cash Management: Forecasting and monitoring global cash needs, managing multi-currency liquidity structures, and facilitating cross-border transactions to support international entities and investment platforms.
* Foreign Exchange Risk Management: Identifying, evaluating, and executing derivative transactions to mitigate currency risks.

The Corporate Treasury Senior Associate will provide strategic support for the company’s global treasury team. This role is expected to participate in design, creation and maintenance of financial models and forecasts, the execution
  
  
of critical treasury activities and remain deeply involved in day-to-day cash, liquidity, and risk management across the organization. This role requires knowledge in treasury systems, experience operating in complex international environments, and a strategic mindset to drive global process standardization while accommodating regional requirements.
  
  
**Primary Functions And Essential Responsibilities**

* Perform cash management operations, including multi-currency cash pooling, intercompany funding structures, and short-term investment management across regions.
* Support treasury activities for fund groups, including Secondaries, Private Equity, and Co-investment.
* Support the management of credit facility activities, including forecasting facility requirements.
* Coordinate with regional finance teams across time zones to ensure optimal global cash positioning.
* Assist with the design, creation and implementation of liquidity and capital planning forecast models, including stress-testing functionalities.
* Collaborate with the Capital Solutions team to assess and monitor foreign exchange, interest rate, and counterparty risks.
* Drive initiatives for assessment and implementation of treasury workstations (e.g., Kyriba, FIS), including global system governance, regional workflow optimization, and integration with enterprise platforms.
* Drive enhancements and automation projects to improve visibility, efficiency, and accuracy in liquidity forecasting, cash management, payment processing, and reporting, including creation of PowerBi dashboards.
* Lead coordination for managing global cash positioning, banking relationships, and ensure compliance with internal controls and regulatory requirements.
* Participate to ensure compliance with internal controls, SOX requirements, and country-specific regulatory standards.
* Support global corporate treasury responsibilities, including rating agency relationships, financial commitments tracking, and other strategic transactions.
* Preparation, delivery, and presentation of global treasury reports to executive leadership.

**Qualifications**
**Education:**

* Bachelors Degree in Accounting, Economics or Finance

**Experience Required**

* 6+ years of experience in global Treasury or investment management.
* Demonstrated track record in hands-on forecasting, creation and maintenance of financial models.
* Comprehensive knowledge of treasury operations, including banking and cash management/forecasting in both U.S. and international contexts.
* Demonstrated experience partnering with business units to drive operational efficiency and collaborative outcomes
* Proficiency with treasury tools and banking portals, including familiarity with various payment methods and flows (local and cross-border wires, ACH).
* Strong technical acumen for solving complex problems using enterprise tools (report writers, SQL, Excel, Tableau/PowerBI, or Anaplan).
* Experience in business operations.
* Proven ability to lead process improvement and automation initiatives.
* Exceptional relationship management skills with banks and both internal and external stakeholders.

**General Requirements**

* Flexibility regarding role scope and willingness to take on new projects and acquire new skills.

* Ability to manage multiple priorities and competing demands; strong time management and prioritization skills.

* Sound judgment in escalating issues versus resolving problems independently.
* Analytical mindset with a passion for process efficiency and innovation.
* Comfort with ambiguity and uncertainty in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
* Flexibility in working hours to coordinate with team members across various time zones.

Principal, Treasury

title: Senior Manager - Strategic Finance
description:
**Location: Mumbai**
**Function: Finance**
**Reporting to: Head of Finance**
**About The Role**
We are looking for a high-calibre Senior Manager - Strategic Finance to join the Finance team and work closely with the Head of Finance and senior leadership team on some of CoinDCX's most important strategic, financial and enterprise-wide initiatives.
  
  
This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role for someone who can operate comfortably between strategy and execution. The individual will work on complex business problems, strategic planning, financial analysis, capital allocation, enterprise performance, financial infrastructure, crypto-asset reconciliation frameworks, financial processes and controls, and other high-priority initiatives led by the Head of Finance.
  
  
The ideal candidate will bring the structured problem-solving approach of a top-tier consultant, strong financial acumen and an operator's mindset.
  
  
This is not a traditional FP&A, Business Finance, Controllership or investment-banking role. The role is designed to be a strategic extension of the Head of Finance, focused on solving complex, ambiguous problems and driving high-impact initiatives across the organisation.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Strategic Finance & Enterprise Problem Solving
* Partner closely with the Head of Finance and senior leadership team on high-priority strategic and financial decisions.
* Take ownership of complex, ambiguous and cross-functional problems and develop structured, data-driven solutions.
* Analyse enterprise-level financial and operating drivers to support strategic decision-making, including cost structures, capital allocation, liquidity, cash deployment and operating leverage.
* Build financial models, scenarios and analytical frameworks to evaluate strategic choices and business decisions.
* Identify key risks, opportunities and value-creation levers and translate analysis into clear, actionable recommendations.
* Challenge existing assumptions and bring an objective, fact-based perspective to strategic discussions.
* Support Head of Finance in evaluating new initiatives, business models, strategic investments and other enterprise-level decisions.
* Special Projects
* Lead high-impact strategic projects sponsored by the Head of Finance, often involving multiple functions.
* Work across Finance, Product, Technology, Operations, Risk, Compliance and Business teams to solve complex problems.
* Drive projects end-to-end from problem definition to structuring, analysis, recommendation, stakeholder alignment and execution.
* Prepare high-quality decision-making materials for the Head of Finance, Executive Leadership Team and Board.
* Support strategic initiatives where there is no clearly defined playbook and where strong judgement and problem-solving are required.
* Act as a trusted execution partner and thought partner to the Head of Finance on critical initiatives.
* Establish project governance, milestones, decision points and accountability for Head of Finance-sponsored initiatives.
* Identify execution risks and proactively drive resolution across functions.
* Crypto & Financial Infrastructure
* Partner with Finance, Treasury, Operations, Product and Technology teams to strengthen crypto-asset and fiat reconciliation frameworks.
* Develop and enhance frameworks for reconciliation of customer balances, crypto assets, liabilities and financial records.
* Develop a strong understanding of complex transaction flows across wallets, exchanges, banking partners and internal systems.
* Identify systemic reconciliation gaps, control weaknesses and process inefficiencies and translate them into process, technology and control requirements.
* Design scalable frameworks for digital-asset financial reporting, reconciliation and operational finance.
* Partner with Technology and Controllership teams to drive automation of financial data flows, reconciliations and controls.
* Define requirements, control frameworks, exception-management mechanisms and governance processes for automated reconciliation.
* Monitor the effectiveness of reconciliation and financial-control frameworks through appropriate KPIs, exception reporting and governance mechanisms.
* Financial Strategy & Management Insights
* Develop enterprise-level financial insights beyond standard reporting to support strategic decision-making by the Head of Finance and leadership team.
* Build analytical frameworks to assess revenue drivers, cost structures, cash flows, liquidity, capital requirements and operating leverage.
* Support annual planning, forecasting and scenario analysis on strategic topics, where required.
* Identify opportunities to improve financial efficiency, capital utilisation and operating leverage at an enterprise level.
* Develop dashboards, analytical tools and management frameworks that enable senior leadership to make better decisions.
* Support Head of Finance in evaluating strategic trade-offs across growth, profitability, liquidity, risk and capital allocation.
* Capital Markets & IPO Readiness
* Support Head of Finance on IPO readiness and capital-markets-related initiatives as and when required.
* Work with investment bankers, auditors, lawyers and other external advisors on relevant projects.
* Support benchmarking, financial analysis, investor materials and management presentations.
* Help strengthen financial processes, reporting, governance and internal controls required for a potential public-market environment.
* Support projects relating to equity story, investor readiness, financial disclosures and capital-market benchmarking.
* Coordinate cross-functional workstreams required to close identified IPO-readiness gaps.

**What We Are Looking For**
We are looking for someone with exceptional analytical horsepower, structured thinking, financial depth and the ability to independently drive ambiguous, high-impact problems.
  
  
**Ideal Background**

* 8 to 12 years of experience in a top-tier management consulting firm, investment bank, Big 4 advisory practice, strategic finance or corporate finance role.
* Candidates from McKinsey, BCG, Bain, EY-Parthenon, Strategy&, Kearney, Deloitte, Accenture Strategy, Goldman Sachs, Morgan Stanley, JPMorgan and similar institutions would be relevant.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, corporate finance, financial modelling and business drivers.
* Excellent Gen AI capabilities.
* Demonstrated ability to break down complex and ambiguous problems into structured analytical frameworks.
* Ability to independently develop a point of view from incomplete or complex information.
* Strong commercial judgement and ability to translate analysis into actionable recommendations.
* Ability to operate independently with limited supervision and significant ambiguity.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
* High attention to detail combined with strong strategic judgement.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-moving, entrepreneurial and evolving environment.

**Preferred Experience**

* Strategic Finance / CFO Office experience.
* Top-tier consulting experience with significant exposure to financial services, fintech or technology.
* Experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation or strategic projects.
* Experience designing financial controls, reconciliation frameworks or financial infrastructure.
* Fintech / financial services / digital-asset experience.
* IPO / capital-markets exposure.
* Experience working with technology teams on automation of finance processes and data flows.

**What Success Looks Like**
The successful candidate will be capable of independently taking ownership of important strategic initiatives and driving them from ambiguity to execution.
  
  
**Success will be measured by the individual's ability to:**

* Independently solve high-priority, ambiguous problems.
* Drive strategic initiatives from problem definition through execution.
* Develop high-quality analysis and recommendations that materially improve management decision-making.
* Build scalable frameworks and automation rather than relying on manual processes.
* Strengthen financial governance and infrastructure without becoming the owner of day-to-day Finance operations.
* Work effectively across Finance, Product, Technology, Operations, Risk and Business teams.
* Become a trusted thought and execution partner to the Head of Finance.

title: Corporate Credit Underwriting (India, Bangladesh & Sri Lanka) – Vice President
description:
Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. Citi continues to enhance its business control and governance framework by building out Institutional Credit Management (ICM), a first line of defense business line, to house and consistently manage credit risk activities performed for Citi’s institutional clients. ICM’s objective is to provide integrated end-to-end credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, and monitoring for wholesale credit across the enterprise. Within ICM, the Credit Underwriting function (“ICM UW” or “UW”) provides credit analysis, underwriting, and first line of defense credit approval for periodic / material transaction reviews, and any necessary subsequent credit monitoring across all institutional business including Corporate Banking, Services, and Markets relationships.

description:
**About Us:**

iRage is one of India's leading high-frequency trading firms. We build and own everything in-house, from ultra-low-latency execution to our entire trading infrastructure. Our systems deliver some of the lowest latencies in the market, with order-send speeds under 100 nanoseconds - but the harder problem we've solved is keeping that latency low at scale. We run thousands of independent portfolios in parallel, carrying overnight positions across thousands of instruments, with tooling that coordinates state and information across hundreds of servers spanning multiple data centres in real time.

The stack is ours end-to-end: custom FPGA pipelines, including PHY and MAC layers we built in house in hardware firmware, and a C++ codebase we control from market-data ingestion through order entry and risk. We run experiments over days just to shave off a single clock cycle.

But great technology alone doesn't move markets. Our quant and tech teams work side by side, and the results speak for themselves: millions of trades a day. To put that in perspective, we handle the equivalent of several Big Billion Days in a single day, every day, at lightning speed. iRage is where deep technical expertise

description:

and

In this role, you will lead the end-to-end credit assessment, detailed financial modeling, and risk evaluation for complex debt and trade finance transactions. Additionally, you will leverage your market network to originate high-quality leads, maintain corporate relationships, and assist in closing mandate engagements across domestic and international markets.

**Key Responsibilities**

  Build, review, and stress-test comprehensive three-statement financial models, sensitivity analyses, debt service coverage calculations (DSCR, ICR), and valuation frameworks for corporate debt and project finance proposals.

* **Transaction Structuring:**
  Design and structure optimal debt products—including long-term senior secured loans, mezzanine/bridge financing, trade finance (LCs, discounting), and working capital solutions—aligned with client cash flows and lender criteria.

  Draft high-quality Investment Memorandums (IM), Credit Assessment Notes, pitch books, and financial presentations for submission to banks, DFIs, private credit funds, and institutional lenders.
* **Lender Syndication & Execution:**

**2. Business Development & Deal Origination (30%)**

  Proactively identify and originate middle-market debt advisory mandates across core focus sectors (Manufacturing, Clean Energy, Agro-Processing, Trade/Commodities, Healthcare, Infrastructure).
* **Client Relationship Management:**
  Build and nurture direct relationships with CFOs, promoters, and treasury heads of mid-sized and large corporates needing capital raising or debt restructuring.

  Track market trends, interest rate movements, corporate borrowing requirements, and cross-border trade flows to identify new advisory opportunities.

  Represent Firm at corporate forums and industry events to enhance brand visibility and thought leadership in corporate debt advisory.

title: Research Analyst
description:
**About the Role**

Our client is a leading multinational organization engaged in global commodity trading and international commerce, with an established presence across multiple markets and geographies. Its business focuses on the physical movement and trading of commodities, connecting producers, suppliers and end-users across international supply chains.

The organization is seeking a commercially minded
**Research Analyst – Trading Desk Support**
to support its physical trading business through in-depth market research, fundamental analysis and data-driven insights. The role will focus on understanding global commodity market dynamics, tracking physical supply-demand fundamentals and evaluating price movements, trade flows and commercial opportunities to support informed trading decisions.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Market Research & Intelligence:**
  Analyze global commodity markets, including production, consumption, inventory levels, supply-demand balances and international physical trade flows.
* **Market Monitoring:**
  Track macroeconomic developments, geopolitical events, government policies, regulatory changes, freight rates and other factors affecting physical commodity availability, pricing and trade economics.
* **Price Analysis & Forecasting:**
  Assess historical and current price trends, regional price differentials, market spreads, basis movements and arbitrage opportunities relevant to physical commodity trading.
* **Reporting & Insights:**
  Prepare daily, weekly and monthly market updates, research reports, dashboards and presentations highlighting market developments, emerging risks and potential trading opportunities.
* **Analytical Modelling:**
  Build and maintain commodity market models, databases and analytical tools to evaluate supply-demand scenarios, forecast price movements and assess physical trading economics.
* **Trading Desk Support:**
  Work closely with physical traders and commercial teams to provide market intelligence and analytical inputs for sourcing, procurement, sales and trading decisions, including pre-trade assessments and post-trade performance reviews.
* **Trade Flow & Commercial Analysis:**
  Evaluate regional supply-demand imbalances, import-export patterns, logistics constraints, freight costs and destination-market dynamics to identify potential sourcing and trading opportunities.
* **External Market Intelligence:**
  Use industry publications, market data platforms, research reports and relevant industry contacts to strengthen market understanding and develop independent views on commodity markets.
* **Strategic Market Outlook:**
  Contribute to medium- and long-term commodity outlooks, scenario analysis and strategic assessments to support the organization's physical trading activities and business planning.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Statistics or a related discipline. A postgraduate qualification in a relevant field would be an advantage.
* 3–7 years of relevant experience in commodity research, market intelligence, physical commodity trading, trading analytics or related commercial research.
* Good understanding of physical commodity markets, international trade flows, supply-demand fundamentals and the factors influencing commodity prices.
* Experience in fundamental research, commodity balance analysis, price forecasting and market modelling.
* Familiarity with regional price differentials, spreads, basis analysis, arbitrage concepts and hedging principles in the context of physical trading.
* Understanding of international sourcing, procurement, logistics, freight economics and import-export dynamics would be beneficial.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel and data analysis; experience with Power BI, Python or other analytical tools would be an advantage.
* Strong analytical, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to convert market information into actionable commercial insights.

**Job Overview**

We are seeking a detail-oriented, analytical, and highly motivated
**Revenue Assurance Intern**
to join our team. In this role, you will play a crucial part in monitoring, auditing, and safeguarding revenue streams across various channels and platforms (such as aggregators like Swiggy and Zomato, as well as direct-to-consumer platforms). You will work closely with cross-functional teams to identify revenue leakages, audit promotional/pricing variances, and reconcile financial data to ensure operational and financial accuracy.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Data Reconciliation & Audit:**
  Perform periodic reconciliations of sales, payouts, cancellations, discounts, and commission data across third-party aggregators and internal POS/ERP systems.
* **Leakage Identification:**
  Identify gaps, discrepancies, or revenue leakages across menu pricing, promo codes, delivery charges, and order refund structures.
* **Process Review & Control:**
  Monitor order fulfillment pipelines, deactivations, uptime metrics, and order level breakdowns to pinpoint operational inefficiencies affecting revenue.
* **Reporting & Dashboards:**
  Assist in creating, updating, and automating weekly/monthly revenue assurance trackers, dashboards, and P&L variance reports.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration:**
  Partner with Finance, Operations, Tech, and Account Management teams to resolve dispute claims, manage vendor reconciliations, and implement corrective controls.

* Strong proficiency in
  **MS Excel / Google Sheets**

* **Analytical Mindset:**
  Excellent numerical ability with a sharp eye for detail and pattern recognition in large datasets.
* **Communication:**
  Clear written and verbal communication skills to effectively collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners.
* **Problem-Solving:**
  Ability to work independently, ask the right questions, and follow through on resolution of discrepancies.

**What You Will Learn**

* Hands-on experience in corporate revenue assurance, financial controls, and risk mitigation.
* In-depth understanding of the e-commerce / food-tech supply chain and aggregator reconciliation workflows.
* Real-world application of data analytics tools to solve business-critical financial problems.

title: Senior Commercial Manager - Construction & MEP
description:
**Who are we?**
Equinix is the world’s digital infrastructure company®, shortening the path to connectivity to enable the innovations that enrich our work, life and planet.
  
  
A place where bold ideas are welcomed, human connection is valued, and everyone has the opportunity to shape their future.
  
  
A career at Equinix means being at the center of shaping what comes next and amplifying customer value through innovation and impact. You’ll work across teams, influence key decisions, and help shape the path forward. You’ll find belonging, purpose, and a team that welcomes you—because when you feel valued, you’re empowered to do your best work.
  
  
**Job Summary**
This position reports directly to the Director, Commercial Management, India, within the Global Design & Construction organization. The primary responsibility of this role is to provide commercial management oversight across Equinix's portfolio of major expansion and construction projects throughout India. The incumbent will work closely with cross-functional internal project teams and stakeholders at various levels of seniority to support successful project delivery.
  
  
The role is expected to provide strategic and day-to-day leadership specifically focused to drive down construction costs, provide assurance against internal financial controls, reporting processes and help manage all major contract risks.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Pre-Contract
  
  

* Procurement of third-party consultants including Design, Commercial and Pre-Construction Services
* Development of detailed Request for Proposals (RFP) and service deliverables for the commercial management services
* Day to day management of third-party commercial consultants to ensure deliverables are met in a timely manner and to a high standard
* Development of General Contractor and supplier procurement strategies in conjunction with the Construction Management (CM) team
* Working with Legal and Procurement Centre of Excellence (COE) to prepare General Contractor Contracts including negotiation of Contract terms
* Collation and presentation of market insights for the construction industry in the relevant country including market activity, comparative builds, construction cost indices, key suppliers and benchmarking information
* Preparation of budgets for all design stages including feasibility estimation, detailed cost modelling, benchmarking analysis and presentation of this to senior management throughout funding approval stages
* Advice on the most economical design and construction delivery strategy including budget comparisons
* Identification of market and region-specific commercial risks and development of practical mitigation strategies
* Ensuring that all cost data is prepared and presented in the Equinix WBS throughout the Project lifecycle
* Input and action of Value Engineering (VE) exercises at all stages of design. The output must include clear cost evaluation to support decision making
* Prepare annual and quarterly cashflow forecasts for active and pipeline projects
* Prepare and oversee monthly reports for budget, cashflow, risk and change management

Post Contract
  
  

* Day to day management of third-party commercial consultants to ensure deliverables are met in a timely manner and to a high standard
* Monitor adherence against budget throughout the project lifespan including cost checks and reviews, value engineering and cost saving initiatives and evaluation of alternates
* Oversee and provide guidance on commercial change management and change evaluation efforts on all projects
* Monitor and report monthly and quarterly on project portfolio cash flow for the region
* Provide Construction in Place (CIP) data to Finance
* Pro-actively lead all commercial risk management efforts including commercial audits, contingency analysis and management
* Prepare and oversee monthly cost reports for budget, cashflow, risk and change management
* Monitor the financial close-out on all projects including settlement of all vendors
* Prepare lessons learned cost analysis and detailed Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) analysis of outturn costs

Skills
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in quantity surveying, construction, business, financial, Engineering or related field
* Minimum 12 Years of experience in Commercial Management
* Proven Data Center and strong MEP experience
* Preferably RICS accreditation

* Must be able to handle multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment
* Must have strong written and verbal communication skills
* Must have strong sense of accountability, ownership and urgency
* Must have strong computer skills, particularly with Excel, Power BI, Cost Management Tools

**Job Description**

**In a context where the Group's Finance Core Model is currently under construction and evolving, the Expert Junior Consultant acts as an expert service provider on behalf of the Finance Executive Committee (Codir), which is its final guarantor and accountable owner.**

**The mission involves:**

* **1/ Securing**
  the subsidiary's integration trajectory by performing rigorous gap analyses, designing compliance solutions, and technically validating the quality of the integration prior to the switchover.
* **2/ Ensuring—**
  continuously and upstream—with the Finance Codir and its dedicated experts that the deployment and alignment proposals are perfectly in phase with the Group's target orientations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**Presentation and Alignment with the Finance Codir**

* Act as the operational relay for the Finance Codir on the ground during integration, adapting the level of escalation to the complexity of the subjects.
* Continuously ensure proper alignment of the proposed integration trajectories and projects with the latest evolutions and arbitrations of the Group Core Model.
* Submit and obtain validation from the Finance Codir regarding the relevance and accuracy of the "gap analysis" performed within the subsidiary.
* Management of simple / standard issues: Maintain complete autonomy over the analysis of gaps that do not challenge the guiding principles of the Core Model (e.g., alignment of standard processes, minor local configuration adaptations).
* Management of complex / structural issues: In the event of complex gaps (e.g., heavy local regulatory/tax constraints, major impacts on Finance IS flows, derogatory accounting schemes), structure the analysis and prepare the documentation required for validation by the Finance Codir's dedicated experts before any local validation.
* Technically investigate potential requests for local specificities and prepare arbitration files for the Finance Codir, in connection with functional experts (Accounting, Controlling, Finance IS, etc.).

**Gap Analysis and Business Diagnosis on the Ground (Fit-Gap Analysis)**

* Lead diagnostic workshops with the subsidiary to be integrated in order to map the existing situation (processes, tools, local regulations).
* Identify and formalize gaps in relation to the ambitions of the Core Model currently under construction.
* Draft and document the required compliance workstreams.

**Design of Workarounds**

* Co-build target solutions and any temporary or permanent workarounds with the subsidiary and the Finance IS team.
* Have these workaround scenarios validated by the Finance Codir prior to any implementation to guarantee compliance.

**Testing, Quality Validation, and Model Improvement**

* Define the functional testing strategy (UAT) for the subsidiary's financial flows.
* Validate the technical and regulatory compliance of data before the Go-Live (possessing a technical veto right over the switchover milestone in front of the Project Manager).
* Escalate relevant local specificities or innovations observed on the ground to the Finance Codir in order to feed into the continuous improvement and construction of the Group Core Model.

**Experience:**

* 4 to 5 full seasons in External Audit (Big 4) with high learning agility.

**Technical Skills:**

* In-depth mastery of financial processes (Order-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay, Record-to-Report, Payroll, Fixed Assets).
* Excellent understanding of Finance IS architectures, consolidation mechanisms, internal control matters, and tax issues (transfer pricing, VAT, withholding tax).

**Soft Skills:**

* Consultant / Service Provider Posture: Strong sense of internal customer service (Finance Codir).
* Excellent Interpersonal and Political Skills: Ability to interact with and bring credibility to analyses before high-level stakeholders (Codir members, Group experts)
* Methodological rigor, analytical and synthesis skills, and educational skills (pedagogy) to drive acceptance of a shifting model.

**Qualifications**

Master’s degree in Accounting/Controlling/Auditing (CCA), DSCG (Higher Diploma in Accounting and Management), or Business School specializing in Finance.

title: Senior Analyst - Power & Utilities, Energy Resources & Industries (ER&I), R&I - Hyderabad/Mumbai
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Senior Analyst – Power & Utilities, Energy Resources & Industries (ER&I),R&I-Hyderabad/Mumbai**
If you are passionate about providing quality insights obtained through research and would like to leverage your strengths to support Deloitte’s thoughtware, this could be the role for you. The role provides an opportunity to get involved in activities that help develop and deliver Deloitte’s thought leadership and client briefings in the power and utilities sector (P&U) and renewable energy (RE) industry. A self-motivated individual who is accustomed to working well in a close-knit team would be a good fit. As part of this team, you’ll gain exposure to a variety of resources and collaboration opportunities that will help in developing your skills and professional development.
  
  
Please explore deloitte.com and deloitte.com/insights to explore our papers and capabilities.
  
  
**Work you'll do**
As a Senior Analyst – Power & Utilities on the Energy Resources & Industries (ER&I) Research & Insights (R&I) team, you will be responsible for…
  
  

* Developing research proposals and hypotheses for thought leadership and client briefings focused on the power and utilities and renewable energy industries.
* Conducting secondary research, analyzing quantitative and qualitative data, and synthesizing findings into industry perspectives.
* Applying research methodologies, including surveys, financial analysis, and case studies, to support business decision-making.
* Preparing research briefings, written materials, and presentation content for clients and Deloitte leaders.
* Collaborating with project leads and senior team members in the United States and India to deliver research projects.

**The team**
The PU&R sector is part of the broader Energy Resources & Industries (ER&I) industry team within the R&I group. The ER&I industry team comprises individuals with varied subject matter expertise and skill sets that enables members to work both independently and collaboratively on small and large projects.
  
  
The overall R&I group’s objective is to develop compelling and forward-looking perspectives that allow clients to anticipate, prepare for, and respond to “what’s coming next.” The perspectives are formed by regular scanning and analysis of shaping trends, industry and company level developments, and regulatory environment. The group plays an integral role in strengthening the firm's strategic positioning in the marketplace and through end-to-end development of high-quality thoughtware.
  
  
**Location: Mumbai, Hyderabad**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM**
**Qualifications**
Required:
  
  

* Master of Business Administration (MBA) or Post Graduate Diploma in Business Management (PGDBM).
* 3-4 years of experience conducting research, analysis, and writing in United States power and utilities or renewable energy markets.
* Experience developing research proposals and hypotheses and conducting secondary research.
* Experience analyzing quantitative and qualitative data and producing written research reports, client briefings, or presentation materials.
* Experience applying at least one research methodology: surveys, financial analysis, case studies, forecasting or simulation, text analysis, regulatory review, mergers and acquisitions analysis, or social-media research.
* Experience using one or more online research databases, including Bloomberg, Hoovers, Factiva, OneSource, Thomson, or AlphaSense.
* Experience preparing business presentations for clients or senior leaders.

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience tracking and summarizing government filings and company strategy in the United States power and utilities or renewable energy industries.
* Experience using Tableau or Microsoft Power BI to develop data visualizations.
* Experience using generative artificial intelligence tools for research or productivity workflows and validating source information before including it in research outputs.
* Experience working with virtual teams in India and the United States.

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Corporate Credit Analysis - Greater China Coverage - Assistant Vice President
description:
Whether you’re at the start of your career or looking to discover your next adventure, your story begins here. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to expand your skills and make a difference at one of the world’s most global banks. We’re fully committed to supporting your growth and development from the start with extensive on-the-job training and exposure to senior leaders, as well as more traditional learning. You’ll also have the chance to give back and make a positive impact where we live and work through volunteerism.
  
  
Citi continues to enhance its business control and governance framework by building out Institutional Credit Management (ICM), a first line of defense business line, to house and consistently manage credit risk activities performed for Citi’s institutional clients. ICM’s objective is to provide integrated end-to-end credit underwriting, identification, measurement, management, and monitoring for wholesale credit across the enterprise. Within ICM, the Credit Underwriting function (“ICM UW” or “UW”) provides credit analysis, underwriting, and first line of defense credit approval for periodic / material transaction reviews, and any necessary subsequent credit monitoring across all institutional business including Corporate Banking, Services, and Markets relationships.
  
  
ICM Credit Risk Analysts are responsible for a portfolio of relationships across Greater China owning the Credit Risk Analysis for those relationships, and being responsible for the continuous monitoring of that portfolio. That includes the production of annual reviews, quarterly reviews, and the support of ad-hoc transactions and portfolio & industry reviews and stress testing, in partnership with CCB and Risk.
  
  
**In this role, you’re expected to:**

* Executes, aligned with global and regional strategies, all responsibilities regarding underwriting, including, but not limited to:

+ Adoption of leading practices in credit analysis, underwriting, and monitoring, including the end-to-end underwriting process, from early origination discussions to development of credit approval memos
+ Drafting of Credit Approval Memo (CAM) packages including but not limited to ensuring they are complete and accurate
+ Conducting initial financial analysis, due diligence, projection modeling, stress testing, risk ratings and other in-depth analysis
+ Support relationships with key stakeholders in Banking and Risk and with key Regulators, Internal Audit, and control functions
+ Support ICM Underwriting organization on strategic initiatives /projects as required

* Risk Management Experience:

+ Experience in and exposure to global credit risk management standards
+ Ability to understand financing and product structures
+ Ability to assess financial and industry data to conduct credit assessment
+ Able to discuss and address issues associated with the allocation of risk assets and risk capital in partnership with stakeholders and product organizations.

* Client Relationships / Business Partnership:

+ Ability to understand nuances of local markets, local regulation, and the capabilities and practices of competitors
+ Navigates organizational complexity and breaks silos
+ Creates and sustains a network of strong partnerships with the business in all segments & geographies and other risk functions
+ Provides well-reasoned, balanced assessments of risk/return trade-offs associated with transactions and client relationships

**As a successful candidate, you’d ideally have the following skills and exposure:**

+ 6-10 years relevant experience
+ Experience in effectively engaging with various functions
+ Demonstrates strong ethics and integrity
+ Ability to understand the ‘big picture’ in a complex environment
+ Strong verbal & written communication skills. Active listening skills
+ Demonstrated influencing and negotiating ability, resolve conflicts amongst various constituencies
+ Proficient presentation skills – adept at presenting effectively to audiences of various sizes and various constituencies
+ Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience

**Education:**

+ Bachelor’s/University degree or equivalent experience, Master’s degree preferred

title: Shipping Cost Analyst – Reconciliation & Settlement
description:
**Shipping Cost Analyst – Reconciliation & Settlement**

**Industry:**
Shipping / Maritime Logistics

**Location:**
Thane, Mumbai

**Experience:**
7+ Years

**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor

**About the Role:**

The role involves analyzing vessel operating costs, validating cost submissions received from shipping partners, identifying discrepancies, and ensuring accurate financial reconciliation of shared shipping operations. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of shipping or maritime operations, excellent analytical skills, and hands-on experience in
**cost reconciliation, financial analysis, and advanced Excel-based reporting.**

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Shipping Cost Reconciliation**

* Review and reconcile shipping-related costs, accruals, and financial data received from internal teams and external shipping partners.
* Validate cost calculations related to vessel operations, fuel consumption, voyage duration, vessel capacity allocation, and other operating expenses.
* Identify discrepancies between internal cost records and partner-submitted statements.
* Ensure timely and accurate reconciliation of costs for periodic settlement.

**2. Cost Analysis & Variance Management**

* Analyze differences in shipping and vessel operating costs to identify underlying causes.
* Investigate variations arising from fuel prices, consumption patterns, operational schedules, pricing assumptions, and allocation methods.
* Assess the financial impact of cost deviations and recommend necessary corrections.
* Prepare variance analysis reports and supporting reconciliation statements.

**3. Shipping Operations & Cost Coordination**

* Coordinate with shipping operations, vessel planning, finance, and commercial teams to validate operational and financial information.
* Review vessel deployment and voyage-related data to ensure alignment with cost calculations.
* Liaise with external shipping partners to clarify discrepancies and resolve settlement-related issues.
* Support accurate allocation of shared operational costs between shipping partners.

**4. Cost Data & Financial Reporting**

* Maintain shipping cost databases, master records, pricing references, and reconciliation trackers.
* Review and update cost assumptions relating to fuel prices, charter rates, exchange rates, and other operating expenses.
* Prepare periodic cost reports, reconciliation summaries, and management reports.
* Ensure proper documentation, data accuracy, and audit readiness.

**5. Process Accuracy & Continuous Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve reconciliation accuracy and reporting efficiency.
* Standardize Excel-based analysis, trackers, and settlement documentation.
* Support process improvements and automation initiatives.
* Ensure completion of assigned activities within reporting and month-end deadlines.

**Qualifications & Experience:**

* Graduate in Commerce, Finance, Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Shipping, or a related discipline.
* Minimum 5 years of relevant experience, preferably 7+ years, in shipping, maritime logistics, transportation, or associated cost reconciliation functions.
* Practical experience in cost analysis, accrual reconciliation, variance analysis, financial settlements, or operational cost reporting.
* Prior exposure to shipping line operations, vessel operating costs, freight-related cost analysis, or logistics finance would be advantageous.
* Experience working with large datasets, multiple cost sources, and periodic reporting requirements.

**Key Skills Required:**

* **Advanced MS Excel:**
  Strong proficiency in Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, data validation, and reconciliation of large datasets.
* **Cost Reconciliation:**
  Ability to compare financial and operational cost data and identify discrepancies.
* **Analytical Skills:**
  Strong numerical ability and experience investigating cost variations.
* **Shipping Industry Knowledge:**
  Understanding of shipping operations, vessel costs, logistics, and transportation-related expenses.
* **Stakeholder Management:**
  Ability to coordinate with internal teams and external business partners.
* **Reporting & Documentation:**
  Experience preparing reconciliation statements, cost reports, and management summaries.
* **Attention to Detail:**
  High accuracy in handling financial figures, calculations, and operational data.
* **Time Management:**
  Ability to independently manage deliverables within defined reporting timelines.

**Preferred Candidate Profile:**

Candidates with experience in the following areas would be particularly suitable:

* Shipping line cost control or financial reconciliation.
* Maritime or vessel operating cost analysis.
* Shipping or logistics finance and settlement operations.
* Cost accounting or accrual reconciliation within shipping companies.
* Vessel operations reporting with hands-on cost analysis exposure.
* Commercial operations involving cost-sharing arrangements or partner settlements.

title: BPO Director
description:
Associate Director – AUM Business Finance
  
  
**Mumbai (Work from Office)**
**This is an Asset Management Business Finance / FP&A role with AUM domain expertise and data-transformation ownership. It is not a Fund Operations, Middle Office, Fund Accounting, trade-processing, settlement, or reconciliation-only role.**
Position Overview
  
  
We are seeking a senior Asset Management Business Finance / FP&A leader with 10+ years of experience who can answer the core management questions: What is our AUM, why did it change, how does it drive revenue, and how do we create one governed enterprise source for that information?
  
  
The role owns the business-finance view of AUM across public and private markets, including AUM roll-forward, net flows, market/FX movement, Fee-Earning AUM, management-fee revenue, capital raise/capital lifecycle reporting, budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, profitability and executive management reporting.
  
  
The successful candidate will also lead transformation of AUM and finance reporting from spreadsheet- and tool-based processes into governed, automated, auditable enterprise reporting supported by modern data platforms, master/reference-data governance and certified data products.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
AUM Business Finance & Revenue
  
  

* Own end-to-end AUM reporting and monthly/quarterly AUM roll-forward across public and private market investment vehicles.
* Explain AUM movement across opening AUM, gross subscriptions/inflows, redemptions/outflows, transfers, distributions, market movement, FX, capital activity and other adjustments through closing AUM.
* Own net-flow reporting and attribution by product, strategy, vehicle, client/channel and region; distinguish business flows from market/FX performance.
* Calculate, reconcile and explain Fee-Earning AUM and its relationship to reported AUM.
* Own Revenue-to-AUM linkage, management-fee revenue analysis, fee-rate/yield analysis, accruals, true-ups and revenue variance commentary.
* Support capital raise and alternatives capital-lifecycle reporting, including commitments, subscriptions, calls/drawdowns, distributions and investor activity where applicable.
* Produce trusted management, Finance, Distribution, Product and executive AUM/revenue reporting.

FP&A & Management Reporting
  
  

* Lead annual budgeting, rolling forecasts and long-range planning for AUM, net flows, revenue, expenses and profitability.
* Build driver-based forecasts linking AUM, flows, market assumptions, fee rates, product mix and revenue.
* Perform actual vs budget / forecast / prior-period variance analysis with clear business commentary and root-cause attribution.
* Develop financial models and scenario / sensitivity analysis for AUM, flows, pricing, fee compression, market movements, capital activity and business risks.
* Prepare executive management packs and KPI dashboards covering AUM, flows, Fee-Earning AUM, revenue, margins and business performance.
* Partner with senior Finance and business leaders on performance reviews, risks, opportunities and forward-looking outlook.

Data Transformation & Enterprise AUM Model
  
  

* Lead migration from spreadsheet- and multi-tool AUM/FP&A reporting to a governed enterprise data platform / Lakehouse and certified reporting layer.
* Define the target-state AUM/business-finance data model, operating model, ownership, controls and certification process.
* Govern Fund Master, Security Master, Investment Vehicle hierarchy, Client hierarchy, Legal Entity structure, currency and benchmark mappings.
* Ensure consistent Investment Vehicle and fund/security codes across upstream and downstream systems.
* Integrate ABOR, IBOR, market data, ERP and enterprise data platforms to create a single governed AUM and business-finance source.
* Establish data-quality rules, lineage, reconciliation, certification, auditability and clear data ownership.
* Automate AUM roll-forward, flow attribution, revenue linkage, forecast and management-reporting workflows using Power BI/Tableau and modern data tooling.

Stakeholder & Transformation Leadership
  
  

* Partner closely with Business Finance/FP&A, Distribution, Product, Investment Operations, Fund Accounting, Data and Technology.
* Translate finance requirements into business rules, data definitions, source-to-target mappings, reporting logic and acceptance criteria.
* Lead transformation governance, cross-functional workstreams, UAT, adoption and operating-model change.
* Present AUM, flow, revenue and transformation insights to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

* 10+ years of relevant experience in Asset Management / Investment Management Finance, Business Finance, FP&A or closely related financial-management roles.
* Recent, direct ownership of AUM/business-finance reporting — not only Fund Operations, Middle Office, Fund Administration or Fund Accounting.
* Demonstrated ownership of AUM roll-forward, net flows and movement attribution.
* Demonstrated experience linking AUM / Fee-Earning AUM to management-fee or advisory revenue.
* Strong FP&A experience across budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, financial modelling, scenario analysis and management reporting.
* Strong understanding of public/private investment vehicles and capital lifecycle; alternatives exposure (Private Equity, Private Credit, Real Estate, Infrastructure) is highly valued.
* Experience leading finance-data/reporting transformation, automation or enterprise data initiatives.
* Bachelor degree in Finance, Accounting, Business or related field; MBA, CA, CFA, CPA or equivalent preferred.

Technical & Functional Skills
  
  

* ERP / Finance platforms: SAP, Oracle, Workday or equivalent.
* Enterprise data platforms / Lakehouse: Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric, Azure or AWS preferred.
* Data governance, MDM, metadata, lineage, data quality, reconciliation and certified reporting.
* Power BI / Tableau; SQL strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of ABOR and IBOR and how accounting/investment data feeds AUM and business-finance reporting.

Key Success Measures
  
  

* One certified enterprise AUM number with transparent roll-forward and flow attribution.
* Clear, explainable linkage between AUM / Fee-Earning AUM and revenue.
* Improved forecast accuracy and faster, higher-quality management reporting.
* Reduced manual spreadsheet dependency and accelerated month-/quarter-end reporting.
* Improved data quality, lineage, governance, certification and auditability.
* Successful adoption of the target-state AUM Business Finance operating model and reporting platform.

title: Equity Research Analyst
description:
**Haachi,**
an
**executive search firm**
, is supporting and advising a global high-frequency trading firm in hiring an Equity Research Analyst for its options trading desk, which trades Indian options. This is not a buy-side or sell-side role. The analyst sits alongside traders, producing notes and reports for internal use and advising the traders directly on the desk’s systematic and semi-systematic trading strategies, with real-time directional insight. The analyst maintains active coverage of a wide range of stocks and keeps close watch on the market, including earnings calls, policy changes and other events, assessing how they affect the price of the underlying stock and the price of its options. The analyst’s calls have a direct, immediate impact on the desk’s P&L, so the impact of the research is visible straight away.

**Role:**
Equity Research Analyst

**Location:**
Mumbai or Hong Kong, sitting alongside the traders on the desk

**Experience:**
3-5 years

**Coverage**
: Indian Markets

**About Our Client**

Our client is a privately held global trading firm with offices in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Australia. It has been a market maker in options for decades and now runs high-frequency and semi-systematic strategies across several asset classes. Research sits inside the trading process: ideas are judged by what they add to trading outcomes.

**The Role**

You will sit alongside the traders on the desk, in Mumbai or Hong Kong, and cover the Indian equity and options market. Your coverage is the core of the role: you follow Indian companies and the options market on them closely enough to tell traders what is priced, what is not, and why.

**Who You Will Write For**

-
**Primary readers:**
the derivatives and options traders on the semi-systematic desk.

-
**How they use your work**
: traders read your view within minutes, before the open or during the session, and act on it. Your analysis also feeds the desk's automated strategies.

-
**What this means:**
you are not writing a report for publication or a 12-month target. You are giving traders a direction, a confidence level, an expected move, and the condition that would change your view.

**Coverage**

- Indian single stocks and index options, including weekly and monthly expiries.

- Financials, insurers, IT, autos, and other sectors, with the companies that move the Indian options market most.

- Corporate actions, dividends, results, and regulatory decisions that change the expected move.

**Research Standard**

Your research is built on depth and rigour: the work behind each view is thorough, tested against past events, and checked against the options market. What reaches the trader is precise and succinct. A trader should be able to read a view in seconds and know exactly how confident you are and what would change your mind.

**How Your Work Is Measured**

- Hit rate on direction for event calls, tracked against outcomes.

- Accuracy of your expected move compared with the move the options market implied.

- Speed of first commentary after a company announcement.

- Quality of the scenario analysis, judged by whether the probabilities add to one and match the outcomes over time.

**A Typical Day**

-
**Before the open:**
Review overnight news, filings, and announcements. Send the desk a morning brief with the day's catalysts and expected moves.

-
**During market hours:**
Give real-time commentary on breaking news, results, and corporate actions, each with a direction, probability, and time frame.

-
**Event preparation:**
Build pre-event notes for earnings, dividends, M&A, and regulatory decisions. Estimate the expected move and compare it with the options-implied move.

-
**Ongoing coverage:**
Track financials, insurers, IT, autos, and other sectors. Update valuation and earnings views and flag any change.

-
**Collaboration:**
Work daily with derivatives traders on strategy and execution, and with the global research team across time zones.

**What You'll Do**

- Monitor Indian equity markets for catalysts and market-moving events

- Run event-driven and valuation analysis to find trading opportunities

- Deliver actionable commentary on news, earnings, and corporate actions

- Assess special situations: M&A, earnings surprises, regulatory shifts, and macro developments

- Forecast dividends and assess their effect on option pricing

- Work with derivatives traders to refine strategy and execution

**What our Client is looking for**

**Experience**

- 3-5 years in fundamental equity research, ideally on Indian markets

- Experience in a trading environment, event-driven desk, or investment team is a strong plus

- A record of views that others acted on, with the outcome tracked

**Options and probability**

- Understanding of how implied volatility, skew, and the expected move behave around events

- Ability to build a scenario tree with probabilities and compare it with the options market

- Experience with Indian single-stock options, including weekly and monthly expiries, is a strong plus

**Quantitative skills**

- Event studies: testing whether past catalysts moved the stock

- Basic backtesting, and working knowledge of Python or SQL

- Strong valuation and financial modelling skills

**Communication**

- Delivers a view to a trader in a few sentences, with a direction, a confidence level, and the condition that would change it

- Comfortable working under time pressure in a fast-paced environment

**Education**

- Bachelor's or Master's in Finance, Economics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related field

- Strong academic record

**Why This Role Matters**

Traders act on your view within minutes, and the desk's automated strategies depend on the quality of the research behind them. You will see the effect of your analysis on live positions, and be measured on it.

Strong analytical, numerical, communication, and coordination skills.
  
  
Ability to work independently and meet costing and quotation deadlines.

Plastic injection moulding
  
  
Consumer and industrial plastic products

Over the 12–15-month internship, you will build capability in management accounting, product and supply chain cost analysis, budgeting, forecasting, month-end reporting, variance commentary and process improvement. Competencies/Behaviors required for job

title: Principal - Underwriting/Research Lead
description:
**Position Overview**
**ABOUT APOLLO**
Apollo is a high-growth, global alternative asset manager. In our asset management business, we seek to provide our clients excess return at every point along the risk-reward spectrum from investment grade credit to private equity. For more than three decades, our investing expertise across our fully integrated platform has served the financial return needs of our clients and provided businesses with innovative capital solutions for growth. Through Athene, our retirement services business, we specialize in helping clients achieve financial security by providing a suite of retirement savings products and acting as a solutions provider to institutions. Our patient, creative, and knowledgeable approach to investing aligns our clients, businesses we invest in, our employees, and the communities we impact, to expand opportunity and achieve positive outcomes. As of March 31, 2025, Apollo had approximately $785 billion of assets under management. . To learn more, please visit www.apollo.com.
  
  
**OUR PURPOSE AND CORE VALUES**
Our Clients Rely On Our Investment Acumen To Help Secure Their Future. We Must Never Lose Our Focus And Determination To Be The Best Investors And Most Trusted Partners On Their Behalf. We Strive To Be
  
  
The leading provider of retirement income solutions to institutions, companies, and individuals.
  
  
The leading provider of capital solutions to companies. Our breadth and scale enable us to deliver capital for even the largest projects – and our small firm mindset ensures we will be a thoughtful and dedicated partner to these organizations. We are committed to helping them build stronger businesses.
  
  
A leading contributor to addressing some of the biggest issues facing the world today – such as energy transition, accelerating the adoption of new technologies, and social impact – where innovative approaches to investing can make a positive difference.
  
  
We are building a unique firm of extraordinary colleagues who:
  
  
Outperform expectations
  
  
Challenge Convention
  
  
Champion Opportunity
  
  
Lead responsibly
  
  
Drive collaboration
  
  
As One Apollo team, we believe that doing great work and having fun go hand in hand, and we are proud of what we can achieve together.
  
  
**Our Benefits**
Apollo relies on its people to keep it a leader in alternative investment management, and the firm’s benefit programs are crafted to offer meaningful coverage for both you and your family.
  
  
**Position Overview**
Apollo is looking for candidates to join its Credit Underwriting team in the Credit Research team which is split across multiple sectors. As part of the team, the candidate will work alongside respective sector leads and Portfolio Managers to maximize the return potential of investments while also collaborating with the larger Credit Research team. The role is a blend of Team Lead and Individual Contributor the candidate will be responsible for leading a team of analysts on the credit analysis as well as maintaining / initiating coverage on a portfolio of issuers. The candidate, together with the larger Analyst team, will be responsible for evaluating the credit quality of issuers and support lead analyst on primary and secondary deals while monitoring existing exposures. The candidate should have a good understanding of one or many fixed income asset classes, such as Investment Grade, High Yield Bonds or Leveraged Loans. The candidate should have prior experience in delivering end-to-end Credit Research solutions, having worked on developing extensive financial models with scenario analysis and preparing Investment Memos. The candidate must possess strong written and verbal communication skills, effectively manage client/stakeholder requirements and ensure their timely execution, while consistently delivering high-quality and impactful research. The candidate should demonstrate exceptional attention to detail and be capable of conducting thorough quality checks (QC)
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**
Managing Credit Research engagements where the Analyst Team is involved in initiating / monitoring single name corporate credit situations in US/EU/APAC markets as part of the engagement, the team performs investment research, including:
  
  

* Building detailed financial models with KPI driven Revenue projections, Cost drivers, Working capital analysis, Capex schedule, Capital Structure analysis, Covenant analysis, Default & Recovery workouts and IRR sensitivities and valuations.
* Creating a finalized product: Preparing Investment Memos including identification of investment catalysts and provide recommendations IG instruments. This is a fundamental analysis role.
* Presenting the primary/secondary deals to the investment committee and clearly articulating your opinion. Take full ownership of the investment view and continuously monitor key developments affecting the issuers credit quality.
* Maintain portfolio coverage including regular model updates and earning summary write-ups.
* Checking the work of and training younger analysts, as required.
* Driving Systemic Quality mindset across teams, implement and maintain best research delivery practices.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* MBA or equivalent in Finance /CFA/CA
* Experience: 7-12 Years
* Industry experience: PE / Investment Banking / Credit Research with high modelling skills
* Experience supporting equity research and/or FIG(M&A) at banks or PE firms. Ideally modelling writing reports.
* Excellent corporate credit analysis skills from a fundamental perspective.
* Proficiency in building detailed financial models and preparing investment memos besides having excellent analytical skills
* Generalist with sector exposure in any of TMT, IT, Healthcare, Autos, Manufacturing, Oil & Gas, Chemical sectors, Utilities or corporate finance background in a sell side firm. Thorough understanding of accounting.
* Proficiency in using Databases & Portfolio Asset Management Systems - Bloomberg, CapIQ.
* Ability to work under pressure and deliver high-quality research.
* Prior record of having worked on competitive Pilots will be an added advantage

*Apollo provides equal employment opportunities regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or maternity, race, color, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, veteran status, gender/sex or sexual orientation, or any other criterion or circumstance protected by applicable law, ordinance, or regulation. The above criteria are intended to be used as a guide only – candidates who do not meet all the above criteria may still be considered if they are deemed to have relevant experience/ equivalent levels of skill or knowledge to fulfil the requirements of the role. Any job offer will be conditional upon and subject to satisfactory reference and background screening checks, all necessary corporate and regulatory approvals or certifications as required from time to time, and entering definitive contractual documentation satisfactory to Apollo.*
