The Group has key positions in its three main fields of activity: Commercial, Personal Banking \& Services for the Group’s commercial \& personal banking and several specialized businesses including BNP Paribas Personal Finance and Arval; Investment \& Protection Services for savings, investment, and protection solutions; and Corporate \& Institutional Banking, focused on corporate and institutional clients. * Experienced in managing RBI inspections, regulatory queries \& correspondences

* Training and development to help you excel in your career.

title: MSET QR Strats Capital Market Specialist , Manager, Institutional Equity Division
description:
**Department Profile**
 From global institutions to hedge funds, investors come to Morgan Stanley for sales, trading, and market\-making services in almost every type of financial instrument in all the world’s financial markets. Morgan Stanley professionals use our network and technology to provide liquidity and sophisticated analysis, to manage risk and execute reliably in the fast\-changing markets.
   

  

 Morgan Stanley’s Institutional Equity Division (IED) is a world leader in the origination, distribution and trading of equity, equity\-linked and equity\-derivative securities. Our broad and deep client relationships, market\-leading platform and intellectual insights enable us to be a world\-class service provider to our clients for their financing, market access and portfolio management needs.
   

  

 Global Markets Group is the offshoring arm of Morgan Stanley’s Equity businesses in India. It covers functions across IED ranging from those associated with sales, trading, analytics, Strats to risk management.
   

  

 The Quantitative Research (QR) group designs, builds and maintains the models which drive the equity trading engines at Morgan Stanley. Our systems are used globally by both internal trading groups and clients of the firm. We utilize systematic, data\-driven approaches to understand how markets work and put those ideas in action. The team spans the disciplines of finance, econometrics, statistics, mathematics, machine learning and data analysis, with many team members well versed in multiple areas. We are looking to hire highly talented, creative individuals who are enthusiastic about research; and enthusiastic about making a contribution to a leading\-edge team, in an intellectually stimulating environment.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**
 This role, based in Mumbai, requires the individual to work closely with global Morgan Stanley Quantitative Research teams.. The successful candidate will be a fast\-learning, detail\-oriented, proactive, and self\-motivated individual responsible for analyzing, calculating, and reviewing free float for global equities. The role involves reviewing company filings, exchange disclosures, shareholder data, vendor feeds, and other public sources to assess float\-relevant ownership changes and their impact on shares outstanding, investable market capitalization, index weights, and benchmark treatment. The candidate will also monitor corporate actions, support client and internal queries, and produce high\-quality written analysis explaining complex float cases, methodology interpretation, and market impact.
   

  

 The expected working hours will be 7:30 am (local time) to 4:30 pm (local time)
   

  

**What You’ll Do In The Role**
* Responsible for analyzing, calculating, and reviewing free float for global equities in line with equity benchmark methodology and index implementation rules.
* Review company filings, exchange disclosures, regulatory announcements, shareholder data, vendor feeds, and other public sources to identify float\-relevant ownership changes.
* Assess the impact of strategic holdings, government ownership, founder/promoter holdings, cross\-shareholdings, employee trusts, lock\-up shares, treasury shares, foreign ownership limits, and other restricted holdings on free float.
* Perform detailed float calculations and determine investable shares, float factors, shares outstanding, and resulting index weight impacts.
* Monitor corporate actions such as M\&A, spin\-offs, placements, buybacks, secondary offerings, rights issues, IPO lock\-up expiries, restructurings, and share class changes to assess their impact on float and index treatment.
* Partner with global teams to respond to client and internal queries related to free float, shares outstanding, index weights, corporate actions, and equity benchmark methodology.
* Produce high\-quality written analysis, emails, and presentations explaining complex float cases, methodology interpretation, and market impact.


**Core Requirements**
 We are looking for a confident and outgoing individual, who has exceptional attention to detail and takes initiative.
   

  

* 5\+ years of experience in the financial services industry, with direct experience in equity markets, index products, benchmark methodology, corporate actions, or market data.
* Strong practical understanding of free float methodology, shares outstanding, investable market capitalization, float factors, and index weight calculations.
* Experience reviewing company filings, shareholder structures, ownership disclosures, exchange announcements, regulatory filings, and vendor data to determine float eligibility.
* Ability to analyze complex ownership structures, including promoter/founder holdings, government stakes, strategic investors, crossholdings, employee ownership plans, lock\-up shares, treasury shares, and restricted securities.
* Demonstrated experience calculating free float and assessing the impact of float changes on index membership, index weights, size classification, style classification, and market representation.
* Strong knowledge of corporate actions that affect float, including M\&A, spin\-offs, IPOs, lock\-up expiries, placements, buybacks, rights offerings, share conversions, and reorganizations.
* Experience with Asia and EU/EMEA equity markets is a plus, particularly in relation to corporate actions, ownership disclosures, float assessment, and index methodology application.
* Exceptional attention to detail, with a strong control mindset and ability to manage time\-sensitive calculations accurately.
* Strong Excel and data analysis skills are required. Experience with Bloomberg, Refinitiv, FactSet, corporate action vendors, SQL, Python, or data visualization tools is a plus.
* Degree in quantitative or finance\-related disciplines such as Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Financial Engineering, Economics, or Finance.


*Morgan Stanley is an equal opportunities employer. We work to provide a supportive and inclusive environment where all individuals can maximize their full potential.*

 At Morgan Stanley, we raise, manage and allocate capital for our clients – helping them reach their goals. We do it in a way that’s differentiated – and we’ve done that for 90 years. Our values \- putting clients first, doing the right thing, leading with exceptional ideas, committing to diversity and inclusion, and giving back \- aren’t just beliefs, they guide the decisions we make every day to do what's best for our clients, communities and more than 80,000 employees in 1,200 offices across 42 countries. title: Deputy Manager Finance
description:
**Qualification \& Experience** 




**Education:** 
 CA/ CMA qualification would be preferred with significant financial controllership and statutory compliance responsibilities.
 



**Experience:** 
 1–4 years of relevant experience in financial controllership, accounting, payments, statutory compliance, audit management, and financial governance.
 



**Preferred Experience:** 
 Prior experience in FMCG, manufacturing, consumer goods, food processing, or a similar operating environment would be advantageous
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**1\. Financial Controllership \& Governance** 



* Ensure accuracy, completeness, and integrity of books of accounts and financial records.
* Establish and maintain a robust financial control framework across key business processes.
* Ensure adherence to accounting policies, internal financial controls, delegation of authority, and standard operating procedures.
* Review key balance\-sheet accounts and ensure timely reconciliation and closure of outstanding items.
* Identify financial and process risks and implement appropriate preventive and detective controls.
* Drive strong financial discipline and governance across functions.
* Ensure appropriate documentation and audit trails for all financial transactions.
* Continuously review and strengthen finance processes to improve control effectiveness and operational efficiency.



**2\. Accounting \& Financial Closing** 



* Oversee periodic book closure processes and ensure timely and accurate monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing.
* Review general ledger entries, provisions, accruals, prepaid expenses, fixed assets, and other key accounting areas.
* Ensure timely completion of bank, vendor, customer, intercompany, and balance\-sheet reconciliations.
* Review ageing of open items and drive timely resolution of long\-pending balances.
* Ensure financial statements and management reports are prepared accurately and in accordance with applicable accounting standards and organisational policies.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to ensure timely availability of information required for financial closure.



**3\. Payments \& Accounts Payable Management** 



* Oversee end\-to\-end payment processes, ensuring timely and accurate payments to vendors, employees, statutory authorities, and other stakeholders.
* Ensure all payments are processed in accordance with approved policies, contractual terms, delegation of authority, and internal controls.
* Review payment proposals and ensure appropriate supporting documentation and approvals.
* Monitor vendor ageing, outstanding liabilities, advances, debit balances, and other exceptions.
* Ensure effective maker\-checker controls and segregation of duties across payment processes.
* Resolve vendor payment issues and coordinate with procurement and business teams for timely closure of discrepancies.
* Drive process improvements to enhance payment accuracy, turnaround time, and control effectiveness.



**4\. Statutory \& Regulatory Compliance** 



* Ensure timely and accurate compliance with applicable direct and indirect tax requirements, including GST, TDS, income tax, and other relevant statutory obligations.
* Ensure timely filing of statutory returns and payment of applicable taxes and duties.
* Maintain appropriate documentation and records to support statutory filings and assessments.
* Coordinate with tax consultants, regulatory authorities, and internal stakeholders on compliance matters.
* Monitor changes in accounting, taxation, and regulatory requirements and ensure timely implementation.
* Support responses to notices, assessments, queries, and other communications from statutory authorities.
* Maintain a comprehensive compliance calendar and ensure zero instances of missed statutory deadlines.



**5\. Audit Management** 



* Lead and coordinate statutory audits, internal audits, tax audits, and other financial or compliance\-related audits.
* Act as the primary point of coordination between auditors and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure timely availability of accurate data, documentation, schedules, and explanations required during audits.
* Track audit observations and drive timely closure of identified gaps and corrective actions.
* Analyse recurring audit observations and implement sustainable process improvements to prevent recurrence.
* Ensure audit readiness throughout the year rather than relying solely on year\-end preparation.



**6\. Internal Financial Controls \& Risk Management** 



* Design, implement, document, and periodically test internal financial controls across key finance processes.
* Identify control gaps, financial risks, fraud vulnerabilities, and process inefficiencies.
* Recommend and implement corrective and preventive actions.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of duties and access controls across financial systems and processes.
* Support risk assessments and ensure appropriate mitigation plans are established and monitored.
* Promote a strong culture of financial accountability, compliance, and ethical conduct across the organization.



**7\. Treasury \& Banking Coordination** 



* Coordinate with banks for payment processing, account administration, and other banking requirements.
* Monitor cash positions and support effective cash\-flow management.
* Ensure timely bank reconciliations and closure of outstanding reconciling items.
* Maintain appropriate controls over banking access, authorized signatories, and payment approval mechanisms.
* Support working\-capital optimization through effective monitoring of payables, receivables, and cash requirements.



**8\. Financial MIS \& Reporting** 



* Prepare and review periodic financial reports and management dashboards covering financial performance, cash flows, working capital, compliance, payments, audit status, and key control indicators.
* Provide timely and accurate financial information to management for decision\-making.
* Track key finance metrics and highlight significant exceptions, risks, and emerging issues.
* Analyze financial data to identify trends, control weaknesses, and opportunities for process improvement.
* Support management reviews with clear financial insights and actionable recommendations.



**9\. Process Improvement \& Automation** 



* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and automate finance processes.
* Drive improvements in accounting, payment processing, reconciliations, compliance tracking, and reporting.
* Leverage ERP systems, digital tools, and automation to improve accuracy, efficiency, transparency, and control.
* Develop and maintain SOPs for critical finance processes.
* Promote continuous improvement and adoption of best practices across the finance function.

 Mumbai, IN
   

  

**We are looking for a Treasury Professional (Trade Finance Guarantee Professional) (f/m/d) to join our team at Innomotics.**
**The Industry\-Leader of Motors and Drives**
 Innomotics is an industry\-leading supplier of motors and large drive systems. With a trusted legacy of more than 150 years of engineering expertise, our products power all of the world’s most essential industries. Today, we are bringing the \#EnergyTransition to life with a portfolio that enables our customers to boost energy efficiency, reduce greenhouse gases, and minimize the carbon footprints of plants.
   

  

**Our Most Powerful Engine: Our People**
 We are a team of more than 15,000 dedicated experts, doers, and innovators. For us, engineering the future means keeping businesses in motion. As a global player operating with the spirit and speed of a mid\-sized company, the future holds unlimited opportunities for us. If you share our bold mindset to be best\-in\-class, we want you IN.
   

  

**Your Future Role**
 As a Trade Finance / Guarantee Professional (f/m/d), you will take ownership of the end\-to\-end lifecycle of trade finance instruments in India, including Bank Guarantees, Letters of Credit, Standby Letters of Credit, Surety Bonds, and related instruments. You will work closely with local business teams, banks, and headquarters stakeholders to ensure smooth issuance, amendment, tracking, compliance, and closure of all trade finance transactions.
   

  

 You will serve Innomotics in a double role: Being part of Innomotics’ global guarantee governance team, you manage all trade finance / guarantee related aspects focusing on India. In addition, you report to the Regional Treasury Head (Hub AA) supporting him in selected treasury activities such as cash visibility, working capital support, Forex / commodity hedge exposure, bank interaction, and reporting.
   

  

 Key responsibilities
   

  

* Act as the primary point of contact in India for business units, financial institutions, and HQ stakeholders on all trade finance matters.
* Manage the full process lifecycle for trade finance instruments, from request intake and validation through issuance, amendment, monitoring, and closure.
* Review and prepare Bank Guarantees, Letters of Credit, Standby Letters of Credit, Surety Bonds requests, supporting documentation, and bank\-specific formats in line with business requirements.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to obtain all necessary approvals, vetting of formats and supporting documents, and clarifications in a timely manner.
* Submit issuance and amendment requests to banks via banking portals, email, SWIFT\-related channels, or other approved communication methods, and follow through until completion and confirmation.
* Ensure compliance with internal policies, bank requirements, and applicable local and international trade finance regulations.
* Monitor validity, expiry, renewal, and return/closure status of trade instruments; maintain accurate registers and proactively escalate upcoming renewals, claims, or risk items.
* Liaise with banks and internal stakeholders to resolve discrepancies, claims, document issues, and payment\-related matters efficiently.
* Prepare and maintain regular reports, dashboards, and status updates for local management and HQ, ensuring visibility of outstanding instruments, exposure, deadlines, and operational risks.
* Be active member of the global guarantee governance team, i.e. collaborate closely with the other team members as well as HQ Treasury and other global stakeholders to align processes, reporting standards, and governance requirements.
* Support the Regional Treasury Head with cash and liquidity reporting, working capital\-related activities, trade\-related reconciliations, Forex and Commodity Hedge banking topics, and ad hoc treasury projects.
* Identify and drive opportunities for process improvement, standardization, and automation across trade finance operations and reporting worldwide.


**Your Profile**
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business Administration, Law or a related field. A professional qualification such as CA, ICWA, CS, or MBA would be an advantage.
* \>5\-8 years of hands\-on experience in trade finance operations in India with strong practical experience working with Indian banks, bank portals, trade finance documentation, and within global treasury teams.
* Good understanding of relevant trade finance rules and practices, including UCP 600, URC 522, URDG, Indian legal requirements and applicable FEMA/RBI regulations related to import/export transactions.
* Strong experience with MS Office, reporting, and data handling; familiarity with SAP, ERP platforms, or treasury systems is an advantage.
* Persuasive communication, networking and stakeholder management skills, paired with high commitment and resilience in dynamic environments
* Strong teamwork and cross\-functional collaboration, with a proactive, solution\-oriented approach that extends beyond the assigned scope
* Demonstrated analytical and conceptual thinking, with the ability to structure complex problems and translate insights into action.
* Openness and curiosity for new areas, such as treasury, pensions, and insurance, ensuring success and effectiveness of our small and agile global treasury team at Innomotics


**What’s IN It For You (Our Benefits)**
* All standard benefits prevailing at Innomotics India.
* Opportunity to work in a high\-visibility role with close exposure to both Local Leadership and global HQ teams
* Broad scope across trade finance, treasury coordination, reporting, and process improvement
* A collaborative international environment with opportunities to contribute to standardization and operational excellence

title: Associate, Private Markets and Alternative Operations
description:
**About This Role**
 Since 2000, BlackRock has delivered Investment Accounting and Middle Office services, supporting a diverse client base with approximately $2\.7 trillion in assets across 250,000 positions. Our team processes over 300,000 trades and reconciles more than 1 million transactions annually across 1,700 portfolios. To enhance scalability, mitigate risk, and deliver exceptional client experiences, we established Outsourced Platform Services (OPS).
   

  

 At the heart of our outsourced services are the functional teams that support our clients’ portfolios, assets \& transactions daily.
   

  

**Team Overview**
 BlackRock’s
 **Outsourced Platform Services (OPS)** 
 provides global middle\- and back\-office support for BlackRock Solutions’ outsourcing business, encompassing trade support, transaction servicing, collateral management, data governance, payments, corporate actions, reconciliations, alternative operations, and investment accounting—delivering operational excellence worldwide.
   

  

**Global Client Alternative Services (GCAS),** 
 a specialized team within Tech \& Ops under OPS, ensures the integrity of cash and position data for middle\-office clients and delivers comprehensive outsourcing solutions for Aladdin clients investing in Alternatives and Private Markets. The team drives global collaboration on strategic initiatives and oversees all aspects of Private and Alternative assets, including client engagement and daily IBOR reconciliation to manage risk and client exposure.
   

  

 This role demands expertise in reconciliation, exception management, and client service, complemented by strong problem\-solving, data analysis, and process improvement skills. Additional responsibilities include maintaining documentation, supporting management initiatives, and driving operational efficiency.
   

  

**Role Responsibility**
* Apply deep expertise in loan and private markets—including project finance, structured credit, real assets, and syndicated loans—to engage effectively with stakeholders, agents, borrowers, counterparties, and high\-profile clients.
* Interpret and analyze complex legal documentation, translating key provisions into actionable insights to ensure operational clarity.
* Facilitate settlement processes across a broad spectrum of instruments, including syndications, secondary trades, CLOs, restructurings, private markets, infrastructure debt, renewable power, real estate debt, and trade claims.
* Collaborate with internal and external teams to maintain the accuracy and integrity of the Investment Book of Record (IBOR).
* Maintain comprehensive knowledge of portfolios and deal documentation to uphold control standards and ensure regulatory compliance.
* Lead initiatives focused on process automation and control enhancements to improve efficiency and mitigate operational risk.
* Investigate and resolve cash, position, and transaction discrepancies promptly and accurately.
* Demonstrate proficiency in loan systems as an added advantage.
* Manage multiple projects concurrently in a fast\-paced, dynamic environment while maintaining exceptional attention to detail and adherence to deadlines.
* This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of private markets and operational innovation, contributing to BlackRock’s mission of delivering scalable, risk\-aware solutions for global clients.


**Experience**
 The ideal candidate will have 3–6 years in loan operations or similar expertise in settlements, reconciliations, and documentation\-driven transactions. Strong understanding of private credit, real assets, and project finance.
   

  

**In Addition, We Are Looking For The Following Qualifications**
* Exceptional communication and client service skills, with the ability to foster strong relationships.
* Comprehensive understanding of banking and investment management, including experience in alternatives such as Private Credit, bank loans, credit strategies, registered funds, financial institutions, and a diverse range of investor types.
* Proven ability to perform effectively under pressure in high\-volume, high\-risk environments with minimal margin for error.
* Highly self\-motivated and collaborative, demonstrating a proactive approach to taking on additional responsibilities.
* Strong capability to prioritize and manage multiple requests while maintaining focus on overarching objectives and deadlines.
* Sound decision\-making skills, with the ability to make well\-informed judgments based on available information and seek clarification or assistance when necessary.
* Comfortable working within dynamic teams that embrace varied perspectives and problem\-solving approaches.
* Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and related applications; familiarity with loan\-centric systems is advantageous.
* Solid knowledge of trading instruments and settlement processes.
* Excellent analytical and organizational skills, ensuring accuracy and efficiency in execution.
* Demonstrates initiative and a commitment to contributing beyond defined responsibilities to support team and firm\-wide goals.


**Our Benefits**
 To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.
   

  

**Our hybrid work model**
 BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. title: Sustainability Consultant
description:
**Role Overview** 
  

  

 The candidate should be well versed in ESG, sustainability reporting, ESG ratings and assessments, with demonstrated experience of working with corporate clients to strengthen ESG disclosures, improve performance against leading ESG assessment frameworks and support sustainability\-related business decisions.
   

  

 Candidates with experience in sustainability consulting, ESG reporting/advisory, ESG ratings or corporate sustainability functions would be preferred.
   

  

**Job Requirements** 
  

  

 \* Strong understanding of ESG principles, sustainability issues, ESG governance frameworks and global sustainability reporting and disclosure standards.
   

 \* Demonstrated experience in sustainability reporting and disclosures aligned with frameworks such as GRI, BRSR/BRSR Core, IFRS S1 \& S2, ESRS, CSRD,  CSDDD SFDR, EU Taxonomy, Integrated Reporting Framework, TCFD and SASB, among others.
   

 \* Hands\-on experience in ESG ratings and assessment frameworks such as S\&P Global Corporate Sustainability Assessment (CSA), CDP and EcoVadis. Exposure to MSCI ESG and Sustainalytics methodologies would be an advantage.
   

 \* Experience in conducting ESG rating gap assessments, including question\-level assessment of existing practices, policies, disclosures, quantitative performance and supporting evidence.
   

 \* Ability to identify improvement opportunities and develop prioritized ESG rating and disclosure improvement roadmaps based on assessment requirements, peer practices and sector benchmarks.
   

 \* Experience in developing Sustainability Reports, ESG Reports and Integrated Reports, including report structure, content development, management approach disclosures, performance narratives and case studies.
   

 \* Ability to conduct peer benchmarking and ESG maturity assessments across companies and sectors covering policies, targets, commitments, ESG KPIs, governance mechanisms and disclosure practices.
   

 \* Strong understanding of ESG data requirements and data management, including development of data collection templates, KPI definitions, calculation methodologies, data validation and supporting documentation.
   

 \* Ability to analyze ESG performance and translate quantitative and qualitative information into meaningful insights and recommendations for management.
   

 \* Experience of working with companies across multiple sectors from an ESG / sustainability perspective. Exposure to sectors such as Manufacturing, Automotive, Pharmaceuticals, Chemicals, Power, Oil \& Gas, Metals \& Mining, Infrastructure, FMCG and Financial Services would be preferred.
   

 \* Ability to track and interpret evolving Indian and global ESG regulations, reporting requirements and rating methodologies, and assess their implications for clients.
   

 \* Ability to engage with multiple client stakeholders including Sustainability, EHS, HR, Procurement, Finance, Investor Relations, Company Secretariat, Operations and Corporate Communications.
   

 \* Ability to independently manage client workstreams, coordinate data collection, conduct stakeholder discussions and ensure timely delivery of high\-quality assignments.
   

 \* Ability to prepare and deliver high\-impact presentations and recommendations to client management and internal committees.
   

 \* Experience in reviewing and guiding the work of junior team members while ensuring analytical rigor and quality of deliverables.
   

 \* Support preparation of proposals, technical approaches, pitch presentations and client discussions for sustainability reporting and ESG ratings opportunities.
   

 \* Contribute to thought leadership, knowledge reports, articles, webinars, seminars and conferences to showcase Crisil’s capabilities in ESG and sustainability.
   

  

**Experience** 
  

  

 At least 3–5 years of relevant experience in Sustainability / ESG, preferably in consulting, with demonstrated experience in:
   

  

 \* ESG / Sustainability Reporting
   

 \* ESG Ratings and Assessments
   

 \* ESG Gap Assessment and Benchmarking
   

 \* ESG Data Analysis and Management
   

 \* Client and Project Management
   

  

 Candidates should have independently managed significant workstreams or assignments and should be comfortable interacting with senior client stakeholders.
   

  

**Qualification** 
  

  

 \* MBA / Master’s degree in Sustainability, Environmental Management, Climate Change, Energy, Finance, Economics or related discipline; or
   

 \* Bachelor’s / Master’s degree in Environmental Science, Engineering or another relevant discipline.
   

  

 Relevant certifications in GRI, Integrated Reporting, IFRS Sustainability, ESG, climate change or sustainability reporting would be an advantage.
   

  

**Preferred Skill Set** 
  

  

 Core skills: ESG Reporting \| ESG Ratings \| S\&P Global CSA \| CDP \| EcoVadis \| GRI \| BRSR \| IFRS S1 \& S2 \| ESRS \| CSRD \| CSDDD SFDR \| EU Taxonomy \| Integrated Reporting \| ESG Benchmarking \| ESG Data Analysis
   

  

 Consulting skills: Client Management \| Project Management \| Stakeholder Engagement \| Business Development \| Report Writing \| Research \& Analysis \| Presentation Skills
   

  

 Tools: Strong working knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint and Word.

 Interactive Brokers Group, Inc. (NASDAQ: IBKR), a member of the S\&P 500, is a global financial services company headquartered in Greenwich, Connecticut, with offices in over 15 countries. Through its affiliates, Interactive Brokers provides automated trade execution and custody of securities, commodities, foreign exchange, and prediction markets on over 170 markets in numerous countries and currencies.
   

  

 For more than four decades, Interactive Brokers has focused on technology, automation, and innovation to provide clients worldwide with a sophisticated, unified platform to manage their investment portfolios. We serve individual investors, hedge funds, proprietary trading groups, financial advisors, and introducing brokers.

Interactive Brokers has consistently been recognized as a top broker by respected industry sources including Barron’s, Investopedia, Stockbrokers.com, and others.
   

  

**Job Description And Responsibilities**
 Interactive Brokers (IBSSI) is hiring an Accounts Payable Analyst, whose primary responsibility will be to manage our licensed Optical Character Recognition (“OCR”) software that reads and processes global invoices for IBSSI and its affiliates. Invoice processing is time\-sensitive, and this position owns the first step in the accounts payable process: ensuring invoices are properly recorded in our systems and routed for approval upon receipt, while resolving exceptions to minimize manual intervention. As a global brokerage firm, this role also requires handling exchange\-related invoices and entering them into our fee reconciliation system. Additionally, you will maintain and update the global supplier database in GEP Quantum, ensuring seamless integration and accuracy of supplier data. In this role, you will also process employee reimbursement claims, address vendor and internal queries, and participate in testing new software releases to optimize performance.
   

  

 This position is ideal for someone who thrives on developing automated solutions, enjoys independent problem\-solving, and is motivated to streamline processes for maximum
   

  

 efficiency.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Oversee Accounts Payable OCR software and daily workflows, ensuring timely and accurate invoice review, fee reconciliation, and tax setups in compliance with regulatory standards to support prompt vendor payments.
* Manage and maintain the global supplier database in GEP Quantum and Oracle E\-Business Suite.
* Handle bank account verification to safeguard against fraudulent transactions and ensure payments are directed to the correct accounts.
* Review and process employee reimbursement claims in OnBase while ensuring adherence to company policies and guaranteeing timely disbursements.
* Address and resolve queries from vendors and internal departments via email and phone communication.
* Identify opportunities for continuous process optimization to improve efficiency and accuracy in operations.
* Participate in testing new software releases to ensure seamless integration and consider training courses on new features and best practices.


**Skills And Qualifications**
* Educational Qualification: A master's degree in finance, accounting, or a related field is essential.
* Experience: 4–5 years of hands\-on experience managing the end\-to\-end Accounts Payable process, including international invoice processing with OCR tools.
* Proficiency in accounting software \- Oracle E\-Business Suite.
* Fluency in English is required, and any additional language is a plus.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Excellent communication skills and ability to work well within a team.

title: Finance Executive
description:
The Finance Executive will be responsible for preparing and maintaining Finance MIS, monitoring commercial transactions, and conducting regular checks related to dealer’s incentives, discounts, schemes, and other financial/commercial data. The role will ensure accuracy of financial information, identify discrepancies, and provide timely reports to management for decision\-making. Apart from above person will perform the other duties as well based on in the department.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
 Perform checks and validations of sales, discounts, incentives, schemes, and other commercial transactions. Verify incentive calculations and ensure payouts are as per approved policies and targets. Review discounts and schemes to ensure they are within approved limits and properly authorized. Identify data discrepancies, unusual transactions, errors, or financial leakages and coordinate with concerned teams for correction. Maintain various MIS trackers for dealer, incentives, discounts, collections, outstanding, margins, and other key financial parameters. Provide accurate and timely MIS to management for business and financial decision\-making. Maintain proper records and supporting documents for all MIS and control checks. Coordinate with Sales and Accounts teams to resolve data\-related and commercial discrepancies. Monitor and ensure adherence to statutory compliances, including GST, TDS, Companies Act, and other applicable regulatory requirements. Process Credit Notes and Debit Notes in the system related to incentives and other transactions. Provide support to the Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable teams as and when required. Assist in improving existing MIS formats, reporting systems, and internal financial controls. Perform any other financial analysis or MIS\-related work assigned by management.
   

  

 Key Skills \& Criteria
   

  

 2–5 years of experience in Finance MIS / Commercial Finance / Management Reporting. Strong Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIFS, data analysis, and reporting. Good understanding of sales data, discounts, incentives, schemes, and financial transactions. Strong analytical and numerical skills. High attention to detail and ability to identify discrepancies. Candidate should be comfortable working with large volumes of data and recurring MIS/reporting requirements.

title: VP, Finance Technology
description:
*Over the last 20 years, Ares’ success has been driven by our people and our culture. Today, our team is guided by our core values – Collaborative, Responsible, Entrepreneurial, Self\-Aware, Trustworthy – and our purpose to be a catalyst for shared prosperity and a better future. Through our recruitment, career development and employee\-focused programming, we are committed to fostering a welcoming and inclusive work environment where high\-performance talent of diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives can build careers within this exciting and growing industry.*
**Job Description**
 Finance Technology is seeking a Vice President to lead the data and engineering capability supporting Fund Accounting. Based in Mumbai, this individual will partner closely with Fund Accounting, Enterprise Data, Automation \& Reporting, and other technology teams to deliver scalable, controlled, and reliable data solutions.
   

  

 The ideal candidate brings a strong combination of Fund Accounting and Fund Finance domain expertise and significant hands\-on data and engineering experience. This individual should understand how fund accounting data is created, transformed, reconciled, controlled, reported, and consumed, and have the technical depth to lead the target\-state design and delivery of data pipelines, transformations, data models, reconciliation frameworks, and reporting solutions.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on leadership role. The VP will lead a Mumbai\-based team of Data Solution Engineers and Data Analysts while remaining engaged in solution design, technical decision\-making, and complex data problem\-solving.
   

  

**Primary Functions And Essential Responsibilities \-**
**Finance \& Fund Accounting Data Leadership**
* Lead the data capability supporting Fund Accounting and Fund Finance, with responsibility for delivering reliable, scalable, and well\-controlled data solutions.
* Partner closely with Fund Accounting and Fund Finance stakeholders and the Finance Tech team to translate business needs into clear data requirements and technical solutions.
* Provide strong functional leadership across fund accounting data, including NAVs, balances, transactions, capital activity, allocations, fees, waterfalls, financial reporting, reference data, and reconciliations.
* Partner with Enterprise Data, Reporting, and other technology teams to establish effective engineering practices, delivery alignment, and clear technical accountability across shared solutions.


**Data Solutions Engineering \& Technical Leadership**
* Provide hands\-on technical leadership across the design, build, testing, deployment, and support of Fund Accounting data solutions.
* Define technology target\-state architecture and technical design aligned with enterprise architecture and standards.
* Provide technical depth to review and challenge solution designs, data models, SQL and Python/PySpark implementations, and participate directly in complex troubleshooting and root\-cause analysis.
* Drive strong engineering practices across testing, CI/CD, observability, performance, resiliency, documentation, lineage, and production support.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual Finance processes and convert recurring data and reconciliation challenges into scalable solutions.\\


**Enterprise Data \& Reporting Partnership**
* Partner closely with Enterprise Data Engineering to leverage enterprise platforms, pipelines, governed data products, and engineering standards.
* Partner with Data Governance to establish appropriate data ownership, quality standards, lineage, and controls.
* Ensure Fund Accounting data is appropriately structured, controlled, and reliable for downstream consumption across reporting, analytics, extracts, and applications.
* Partner with centralized Reporting / BI teams, with the Fund Accounting data capability responsible for business/data requirements and reporting\-ready data, and Reporting / BI responsible for technical report and dashboard development.


**Team \& Delivery Leadership**
* Build, lead, mentor, and develop a high\-performing Mumbai\-based team of Data Solution Engineers and Data Analysts, including hiring, capability development, and succession planning.
* Own delivery of Fund Accounting data initiatives from requirements and solution design through implementation, testing, release, and production stabilization.
* Establish a high bar for technical quality, analytical rigor, controls, documentation, and operational ownership.
* Build strong partnerships across Finance, Technology, fund administrators, vendors, and global teams.


**Qualifications**
**Education**
* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Finance, or a related field.


**Experience Required**
* 10\+ years of relevant experience across data engineering, Finance Technology, Fund Accounting Technology, or related roles within asset management or financial services.
* Strong functional knowledge of Fund Accounting and Fund Finance, including fund structures, NAVs, investor accounting, capital activity, allocations, fees, waterfalls, reconciliations, and financial reporting processes.
* Significant hands\-on data engineering experience, including advanced SQL and strong experience with Databricks/Snowflake, Python/PySpark, ETL/ELT, data modeling, data pipelines, APIs, and modern cloud data platforms.
* Experience implementing data\-quality, reconciliation, validation, monitoring, lineage, and control frameworks for financial data.
* Experience with fund or investor accounting platforms such as Geneva, Investran, or comparable solutions and data integration with third\-party fund administrators.
* Experience working within enterprise data architecture and partnering effectively with centralized Data Engineering, Data Governance, and Reporting functions.
* Demonstrated experience leading and developing engineers and analysts while remaining technically engaged in solution design and complex problem\-solving.
* Strong communication and stakeholder\-management skills, with the ability to operate effectively across Finance and Technology audiences.


**Reporting Relationships**
 Head of Investment Systems
   

  

*There is no set deadline to apply for this job opportunity. Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis until the search is no longer active.*

title: Payments Planning and Analysis - Associate
description:

 Financial Analysis is responsible for partnering across the firm to provide financial and strategic analysis, oversight, and coordination of budgeting and forecasting. Our Financial Planning and Analysis (FP\&A) teams are responsible for a wide range of activities including financial control, forecasting and budgeting, analysis of financial/business metrics, delivery of weekly/monthly/quarterly management reporting, development of new reporting capabilities (e.g. dashboards), and advising the line of business CFOs on how to increase profitability and efficiencies.

You will also help develop recommendations effecting business procedures and operations and maintain financial and reporting systems. In addition, you will assist the department and other team members with special projects or components of other projects as needed.

* Helping design new reports and dashboards to efficiently deliver the financial results to senior management
* Enhancing controls and streamlining processes, introducing automation where possible

* Team player with the ability to be respected as a trusted partner for the Business, Finance, and FP\&A Teams
* Highly motivated self\-starter with excellent time management/prioritization skills
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills with ability to analyze large data sets and present conclusions concisely

description:
Relocation Assistance Offered Within Country
   

  

 Job Number \#175635 \- Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
   

  

**Who We Are**
 Colgate\-Palmolive Company is a global consumer products company operating in over 200 countries specialising in Oral Care, Personal Care, Home Care, Skin Care, and Pet Nutrition. Our products are trusted in more households than any other brand in the world, making us a household name!
   

  

 Join Colgate\-Palmolive, a caring, innovative growth company reimagining a healthier future for people, their pets, and our planet. Guided by our core values—Caring, Inclusive, and Courageous—we foster a culture that inspires our people to achieve common goals. Together, let's build a brighter, healthier future for all.
   

  

**Brief introduction \- Role Summary/Purpose :**
* In today’s multifaceted technology environment, it is an exciting time to be a part of the Finance team at Colgate!.
* Our Finance and innovative team is dedicated to driving growth for Colgate Palmolive in this constantly evolving landscape.
* The Supply Chain Finance Analyst is primarily responsible for performing the tasks related to Costing and Inventory and Fixed Assets Accounting processes.
* This includes supporting the accurate calculation and analysis of the costs associated with manufacturing or purchasing a product. Their work helps the company understand expenses, set pricing, and drive profitability.
* Perform and validate Technical CO Closing \- month end activity, New Product Costing, Mass Product Costing, Annual CO Budget \& Planning
* Capitalization, Retirement, master\-data maintenance of Fixed Assets
* Regularly review SOX/Internal controls compliances, with accurate documentation, report any discrepancy/potential risk to ATL and Team lead during peer reviews and promptly remediate it
* Perform Lease Accounting activities in SAP and Lease governance tool
* Support and perform Year end testing and validations to ensure smooth transition
* Prepare and review various C\&I and FA Reports (monthly/qtly/yearly \- mgmt \& stat) to ensure accuracy with analysis on variances, trend analysis to highlight any caveats and progress of plant performance


**Responsibilities :**
* Perform period closing activities and validation checks post\-closing activities.
* Fixed Assets accounting \& Capital budget monitoring.
* Record fixed asset acquisitions and dispositions in the accounting system.
* Conduct periodic reviews of the fixed asset schedule to determine dispositions and identify idle assets, if any.
* Reconcile the balance in the fixed asset subsidiary ledger to the general ledger
* Run depreciation for all fixed assets.
* Depreciation Forecasting for Budget purposes \- including depreciation on projected spending.
* Accounting for Restructuring Projects.
* Works on complex Analysis to provide insights \- such as impairment or restructuring projects, new plant set ups.
* Run monthly Plant Performance Report.
* Conduct MWIP Report and Analysis.
* Perform the fixed asset master data adjustment.
* Provide FA data to support tax, statutory and regulatory.
* Conduct Y/E asset accounting.
* Undertake the costing of new products \& periodic cost revisions.
* Calculate, post, and allocate JE.
* Allocate overheads to the product as per the stage of processing.
* Perform cost center review and resolve discrepancies, if any.
* Prepare daily/weekly purchase price variance analysis report.
* Settle internal orders on a daily/weekly basis.
* Prepare monthly costing reports.
* Post monthly standard and judgment based accruals.
* Calculate, Review and Approve inventory reserve requirements including SLOB monthly.
* Analyze Product wise profitability.
* Perform process reconciliations.
* Analyze the actual costs against the budgeted costs and explain the variances.
* Prepare standard cost calculation for commercial and manufacturing sites.
* Perform Budget costing.
* Works on complex Analysis to provide insights
* Perform FI / CO / PA reconciliation monthly.
* Perform SOX assessment and compliance.


**Required Qualifications :**
* CMA (Intermediate or Final), Any other finance graduate
* 1\-5 years of experience in Costing \& Finance
* SAP Experience \- minimum one year (Proficient in SAP \-FI/CO/PA modules)
* Advance Excel


**Preferred Qualifications :**
* Working knowledge of SOX
* Google suits
* Experience of month end closing
* SAP Experience \- minimum one year (Proficient in SAP \-FI/CO/PA/MM modules)
* Advanced knowledge of Cost and Plant accounting
* Well versed with BI Platforms,Domo,Sigma,Tableau,Scripting
* Comfortable with managing and analyzing large data and
* Developing visualization in Slides (or other tools)
* Prior experience in working with multiple teams including business engagement across virtual platforms


**Our Commitment to Inclusion**
 Our journey begins with our people—developing strong talent with diverse backgrounds and perspectives to best serve our consumers around the world and fostering an inclusive environment where everyone feels a true sense of belonging. We are dedicated to ensuring that each individual can be their authentic self, is treated with respect, and is empowered by leadership to contribute meaningfully to our business.

description:
**Working Days \-** 
 6 Days / week
 



  





**Godrej Tooling**




 Tooling In 1935, Tooling was established. A tool room, that was the most advanced in India for its time. The big idea behind this was to encourage the indigenization of machine tools. This forward thinking vision, coupled with the highly skilled expertise of the tool room, were the reasons why Godrej \& Boyce got the first order to manufacture satellite components for ISRO.
 



  





 Over the years, Tooling has retained its position as a key player in the design and manufacture of tools and tooling equipment. The business manufactures custom\-built, high\-quality tooling that caters to a broad cross\-section of players across industries. The business has expertise in industrial machines, pressure dies, casting dies, press dies, die casting dies, thermo compression moulds, complex and large\-sheet metal tooling for auto panels, and progressive dies.
 



  





 Tooling is a systems\-driven organization, eager to learn and experiment while keeping abreast of the latest technology platforms, software and manufacturing processes. Its commitment to innovation ensures that even today, the business is among India's most advanced tool rooms, and proudly serve customers such as Honda Cars \& Motorcycles, Toyota, Suzuki, Mahindra \& Mahindra, Tata Motors, Caparo, and Valeo.
 



  





**KRA: \-**




 1\. Financial Planning and Analysis
 



 2\. Financial Accounting \& Audits
 



 3\. Cost Management
 



 4\. Enterprise Risk Management
 



  





**Job Description: \-**




 The incumbent would be responsible for the following:
 



  





 1\. Financial Planning \& Analysis
 


* Preparation of monthly, quarterly, yearly financial reports like Profit \& Loss Statement, Working Capital Statement
* Analysis of Monthly MIS, study reason for variance against plans and to provide accurate MIS to the management.
* In depth Analysis of Revenue, variable Cost, Fixed Cost and working Capital. Ensuring errors are corrected by analysing root cause
* Weekly projection of Best Estimates.
* Analysis of Monthly MIS, along with in depth reasoning for variances for presentation to Management.
* Support Department head in preparation of BOD Decks for quarterly presentation to Management.



 2\. Financial Accounting \& Audits

 3\. Cost Management

* Support Sales and Marketing in Estimation project cost for Tendering.

 4\. ERM, Compliances and Capability Building

* Process optimization and capability building of team.

* Champion operational excellence through methodologies such as Kaizen, CII Business Excellence frameworks.

 – CA/CMA

title: Director, Financial Analysis
description:
**Calling all innovators – find your future at Fiserv.**
 We’re Fiserv, a global leader in Fintech and payments, and we move money and information in a way that moves the world. We connect financial institutions, corporations, merchants, and consumers to one another millions of times a day – quickly, reliably, and securely. Any time you swipe your credit card, pay through a mobile app, or withdraw money from the bank, we’re involved. If you want to make an impact on a global scale, come make a difference at Fiserv.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Director, Financial Analysis
   

  

**About The Role**
 The FP\&A Finance for APAC leads financial planning, budgeting, forecasting, and analytical oversight across a diverse, multi‑country region spanning ANZ, ASEAN, North Asia and India. This role serves as a strategic partner to senior leadership —translating financial data into insights that drive performance, support investment decisions, and ensure long term financial health.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Work with the business leaders and regional CFOs to develop and manage annual budgets, quarterly forecasts and long‑range financial plans, ensuring alignment with strategic and operational goals and implementing policies and processes that drive timely, accurate and consistent financial planning.
* Oversee driver‑based financial modelling, variance analysis, consolidated reporting, and the review of financial statements and performance metrics to identify risks and opportunities.
* Articulate APAC’s financial position to Corporate Finance and Global Business Segment leaders while driving continuous improvements in financial modelling methodologies and reporting frameworks.
* Provide strategic insights and recommendations to guide business decisions, capital allocation, and investment priorities; work closely with the APAC business leaders and CFO to influence financial strategy and corporate priorities.
* Lead the preparation of quarterly financial reviews, strategy and long‑range planning decks, while overseeing the Management Information System (MIS) for the APAC Merchant business to ensure reliable data and insights.
* Monitor performance against budgets and forecasts, developing KPIs and dashboards for executive review while supporting key APAC initiatives such as sales‑to‑revenue conversion, headcount allocation, and country‑specific investments.
* Drive a people‑centric transformation culture by strengthening AI adoption within the Finance team—reducing fear of automation, fostering experimentation, and promoting cross‑functional sharing of AI/automation best practices in line with enterprise standards.
* Manage and mentor a team of FP\&A managers, senior analysts, and analysts, while recruiting, training, and developing finance talent to foster a high‑performance culture.


**Experience You'll Need To Have**
* 15\+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis (FP\&A) or corporate finance, including regional or multi\-country responsibility in a complex corporate environment.
* Leading budgeting, forecasting, financial modelling and management reporting for senior leaders.
* Partnering with senior executives (e.g., CFO, business heads) to inform strategic decisions and drive financial performance.
* Managing and developing teams of finance professionals across multiple locations or functions.
* Demonstrated ability to build and improve driver\-based financial models, analytics, KPIs and dashboards using financial analytics tools.
* Proven experience leading adoption of new technologies and implementing AI and automation solutions within finance or related functions.


**Experience That Would Be Great To Have**
* Experience in fintech, payments, software\-as\-a\-service (SaaS) or fast\-moving consumer goods (FMCG) industries.
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise planning and reporting tools (for example, Hyperion, Anaplan, SAP, Oracle, or similar) and data visualization platforms.
* Experience supporting merchant acquiring or broader payments businesses across multiple APAC markets.


**Thank You For Considering Employment With Fiserv. Please**
* Apply using your legal name
* Complete the step\-by\-step profile and attach your resume (either is acceptable, both are preferable).


**Our Commitment To Diversity And Inclusion**
 Fiserv is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other category protected by law.
   

  

**Note To Agencies**
 Fiserv does not accept resume submissions from agencies outside of existing agreements. Please do not send resumes to Fiserv associates. Fiserv is not responsible for any fees associated with unsolicited resume submissions.

****You’ll Excel in This Role If You****
* Think in systems and obsess over accuracy and controls
* Thrive in high\-volume, high\-velocity operational environments
* Have strong analytical skills and can break down complex transaction flows
* Bring precision and structure to ambiguous operational challenges
* Communicate clearly across Finance, Risk, Product, and Support teams
* Have a bias for action and solve problems before they grow

****You’ll Know You’re Winning When (First 6 Months)****
* You’re independently managing high\-volume payment operations with \>99% accuracy

****Where We Work****
 We believe the best ideas emerge when people build together. Collaboration, speed and trust come alive when teams share the same space.

 **Mumbai**

* Design Your Own Benefits: Flexible perks to match your lifestyle

title: Manager - Quantity Surveying
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Quantity Surveying team within Forensic Accounting and Claims Services (FACS) at Knowledge Services \- Marsh Risk. This role will be based in Mumbai. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
   

  

 The Knowledge Services team is an integral part of the future strategy of FACS and Risk Consulting. The FACS team in Mumbai is a dynamic and innovative unit within Marsh Risk Consulting, specializing in managing complex insurance claims. We bring together a diverse group of experts, including forensic accountants, lawyers, fraud experts, engineers, and insurance professionals, to deliver comprehensive consultancy solutions to clients managing complex insurance claims or proactively managing risk.
   

  

* Quantity Surveying is a bespoke service offered to Marsh clients by the FACS team. The team works closely with other Marsh colleagues across the globe to support preparation and analysis of insurance claims related to construction projects. This role offers exposure to a variety of insurance claims and the opportunity to develop expertise in post\-loss construction assessment and cost analysis.


**We will count on you to:**
* Assist in the preparation and presentation of insurance claims as part of a multidisciplinary team.
* Work with other senior consultants from Global offices of Marsh in reviewing contractors’ and employers’ loss submissions against contracts and insurance policies.
* Analyze construction documents, design drawings, and site reports to identify damage and assess repair requirements.
* Help verify the accuracy of data and documentation provided by clients and contractors.
* Assist in the preparation of client\-ready reports, proposals, and presentations.
* Collaborate with claims managers and insurers’ quantity surveyors during claim settlement discussions.
* Contribute to the development of continuous risk improvement methodologies.
* Maintain compliance with professional standards and company policies.
* Assist in evaluating business interruption impacts resulting from construction delays.
* Support delay and quantum analysis for post\-loss claims to determine financial impacts.


**What you need to have:**
* 3\-5 years of relevant construction experience (quantity surveying, project management, cost control, contact administration) preferably with exposure to insurance claims or construction cost consulting.
* Basic understanding of construction contracts, cost control, cost evaluation and project management principles.
* Experience in undertaking tender analysis and reports.
* Knowledge of JCT Intermediate and Minor works preliminaries and valuations.
* Knowledge of VAR construction re\-build costs.
* Strong analytical and report\-writing skills.
* Good communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability to work collaboratively in a multidisciplinary team environment.
* Attention to detail and ability to challenge data critically.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office and relevant QS software tools.
* Degree/Engineering or diploma in Quantity Surveying, Construction Management, or related field.


**What makes you stand out?**
* Relevant professional qualifications (e.g. RICS, CEng, CIArb, RIBA, APM).
* Both employer and contractor side experience is desirable.
* Experience in post\-loss construction services (delay and quantum analysis).
* Experience in UK construction techniques and use of BCIS.
* Prior experience handling Business Interruption insurance claims is highly desirable.
* Advanced knowledge of financial data modelling and loss valuations.
* VBA Macros and experience in automating tasks.
* Building dashboards or visualizations in Excel or PowerBI.
* Professional working proficiency in English required but additional linguistic skills in European languages (Spanish, French, or German) is a plus.


**Why join our team:**
* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well\-being.


 Marsh (NYSE: MRSH) is a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.

title: Manager - Taxation and Finance
description:
About Company
 



  





 A fast\-growing fintech platform transforming access to growth capital and working capital solutions for startups, MSMEs, and digital\-first businesses.
 



  





 Job Description
 



  





**About the Role** 




 • We are looking for a qualified and experienced CA Inter / Chartered Accountant with 3–7 years of relevant experience to manage taxation, statutory compliances and day\-to\-day accounting activities for the group companies. The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in GST, TDS and other statutory compliances, along with a good understanding of accounting, reconciliations and treasury operations.
 



 • Experience in an NBFC, financial services or fintech organisation will be preferred.
 



  





**GST \& Indirect Taxation** 




 • Computation, review and timely filing of GSTR\-1 and GSTR\-3B.
 



 • Preparation and filing of GST Annual Return (GSTR\-9\) and other applicable GST compliances.
 



 • Preparation and review of GST/ITC reconciliations with books of accounts and GST portal data.
 



 • Reconciliation of ITC with GSTR\-2B and follow\-up with vendors for missing or incorrect invoices/ITC.
 



 • Coordination with vendors for correction of GST\-related discrepancies and ensuring timely compliance.
 



 • Handling GST notices, queries and correspondence received from tax authorities, wherever applicable.
 



**TDS \& Other Direct Tax Compliances** 




  





 • Review and validation of data for quarterly TDS returns – Form 24Q and Form 26Q – for all group companies.
 



 • Computation and timely filing of quarterly TDS returns.
 



 • Reconciliation of TDS payable, deductions and challans with books and TRACES.
 



 • Identification and resolution of TDS defaults, short deductions, interest and late filing issues on the TRACES portal.
 



 • Coordination for correction statements and resolution of TDS\-related discrepancies.
 



 • Handling and responding to notices, communications and queries received from the Income Tax Department and other statutory authorities.
 



  





**Professional Tax, LWF \& Other Statutory Compliances** 




 • Computation, filing and payment of Professional Tax (PT) returns.
 



 • Computation, filing and payment of Labour Welfare Fund (LWF) and other applicable statutory dues.
 



 • Ensuring timely completion of all applicable periodic statutory compliances.
 



  





**Accounting \& Finance** 




 • Handling day\-to\-day accounting activities and ensuring accurate and timely recording of transactions.
 



 • Preparation and review of Bank Reconciliation Statements (BRS).
 



 • Reconciliation of various ledger accounts, including vendor, customer, statutory and bank accounts.
 



 • Assisting in month\-end and year\-end closing activities.
 



 • Supporting preparation of MIS and other management reports.
 



 • Assisting in treasury operations, including monitoring of bank balances, fund movements, investments and related reconciliations.
 



 • Coordination with auditors, consultants, banks and other external stakeholders as required.
 



 • Good understanding of financial reporting, consolidation and inter\-company reconciliations.
 



 • Preparation and review of quarterly standalone and consolidated financial statements for the group companies.
 



 • Preparation of monthly MIS and management reports, including analysis of key financial and operational metrics.
 



  





**Tax Notices \& Departmental Matters** 




 • Monitor and coordinate responses to notices and communications received from GST, Income Tax, TRACES and other statutory authorities.
 



 • Maintain proper documentation and records of tax filings, reconciliations, notices and responses.
 



 • Coordinate with external tax consultants and advisors, wherever required.
 



  





**Candidate Profile** 




**• CA Inter / Chartered Accountant with approximately 3–7 years of relevant experience.** 




 • Strong hands\-on knowledge of GST, TDS and statutory compliances.
 



 • Good understanding of GSTR\-1, GSTR\-3B, GSTR\-9, GSTR\-2B, TDS 24Q/26Q and TRACES.
 



 • Practical experience in GST and ITC reconciliation and vendor follow\-up.
 



 • Good knowledge of accounting principles and day\-to\-day accounting processes.
 



 • Working knowledge of BRS, ledger reconciliation and treasury operations.
 



 • Experience in handling tax notices and departmental correspondence will be an added advantage.
 



 • Prior experience in an NBFC, fintech or financial services organisation is preferred.
 



 • Strong analytical, reconciliation and problem\-solving skills.
 



 • Good communication and coordination skills.
 



 • Ability to independently manage multiple statutory compliances and meet strict deadlines.
 



 • Proficiency in MS Excel and accounting/ERP systems.
 



  





**Key Attributes** 




 • The candidate should be hands\-on, detail\-oriented, deadline\-driven and capable of independently managing taxation and statutory compliance activities while also supporting the broader finance and accounting function.

title: Assistant Manager Finance Account
description:
WE’RE HIRING: ASST. MANAGER – ACCOUNTS \& FINANCE
 



  





 Location: Seawoods, Navi Mumbai
 



 Experience: 6–9 years
 



 Employment: Full\-time \| Work from Office
 



 Company: Accordible Integrated Facility Solutions
 



  





 Accordible is looking for a strong Accounts \& Finance Manager who can build financial discipline, improve cash\-flow visibility and provide management with reliable information for decision\-making.
 



  





 This is a managerial role, not a bookkeeping\-only position.
 



  





 ROLE MANDATE
 



  





 The Finance Manager will take ownership of the complete finance cycle:
 



  





 Accounting → Compliance → Billing → Collections → Cash Flow → MIS → Profitability → Financial Controls
 



  





 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 



  





 • Lead monthly books closure and ensure accurate accounting
 



 • Review bank, customer and vendor reconciliations
 



 • Control billing and prevent unbilled revenue
 



 • Own receivable ageing, collections and overdue recovery
 



 • Manage payables, vendor reconciliations and payment cycles
 



 • Maintain a rolling 13\-week cash\-flow forecast
 



 • Ensure timely GST, TDS, PF, ESIC, PT and other statutory compliance
 



 • Review payroll inputs, deductions, advances and reimbursements
 



 • Prepare monthly P\&L, Balance Sheet summaries and Management MIS
 



 • Monitor budgets, overheads, direct costs and margin performance
 



 • Develop client\-wise, service\-wise and job\-wise profitability reporting
 



 • Strengthen maker\-checker controls and prevent financial leakage
 



 • Lead, allocate and review the work of the Accounts \& Finance team
 



  





 MANAGEMENT REPORTING
 



  





 The Finance Manager will provide clear visibility of:
 



  





 Booked → Executed → Invoiced → Collected
 



  





 The monthly Finance Dashboard will also cover:
 



  





 • Cash position and forecast
 



 • Receivable and payable ageing
 



 • Gross profit and gross margin
 



 • EBITDA and PAT
 



 • Budget vs Actual
 



 • Client, service and job profitability
 



 • Financial risks and corrective actions
 



  





 KEY KRAs AND KPIs
 



  





 Financial Accuracy \& Compliance
 



  





 • Monthly books closure by the 7th working day
 



 • Accounting accuracy of at least 99%
 



 • 100% on\-time statutory compliance
 



  





 Cash Flow, Billing \& Collections
 



  





 • At least 95% of eligible executed revenue invoiced within three working days
 



 • At least 90% of due collections received within agreed credit terms
 



 • Immediate 30\-day cash\-flow forecast variance maintained within ±10%
 



  





 Profitability, MIS \& Financial Controls
 



  





 • Monthly Management MIS submitted by the 10th
 



 • At least 95% of material revenue mapped to identifiable direct costs
 



 • Zero material financial leakage resulting from control failure
 



  





 CANDIDATE PROFILE
 



  





 • 6–9 years of relevant Accounts \& Finance experience
 



 • Strong knowledge of GST, TDS, accounts receivable and accounts payable
 



 • Experience managing monthly closure and Balance Sheet schedules
 



 • Strong understanding of cash flow and working\-capital management
 



 • Experience preparing P\&L, MIS and Budget vs Actual reports
 



 • Strong Excel and financial\-analysis skills
 



 • Experience managing a small finance team
 



 • Strong follow\-up, ownership and problem\-solving ability
 



 • Comfortable working directly with the CEO and senior management
 



  





 PREFERRED BACKGROUND
 



  





 • B.Com or M.Com
 



 • CA Inter, CMA Inter or MBA Finance is desirable
 



 • Experience with Tally, Zoho Books or an equivalent accounting system
 



 • Experience in facility management, manpower, projects, contracting, hospitality services or another B2B service business
 



 • Exposure to job costing and project profitability
 



  





 WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR
 



  





 We need a finance professional who can move beyond transaction processing and convert financial data into business insight.
 



  





 The ideal candidate should be able to:
 



  





 • Explain the key drivers behind financial performance
 



 • Provide reliable visibility of cash flow and working capital
 



 • Identify margin leakage and cost\-control opportunities
 



 • Anticipate financial risks before they affect operations
 



 • Recommend practical and commercially sound corrective actions
 



 • Establish financial accountability across departments
 



  





 This role will not suit candidates whose experience is limited to data entry, voucher posting, GST filing, payroll processing or operating Tally without financial analysis and management reporting.
 



  





 If you have the experience and ownership mindset to make a growing company’s finances more visible, predictable and controlled, we would like to hear from you.
 



  





 Apply directly through LinkedIn.
 



  





 Candidates must be comfortable working full\-time from our Seawoods, Navi Mumbai office.

title: Category Finance Manager
description:
**JOB ROLE:** 
 Category Finance Manager – Fans and Consumer Lighting
 



**REPORTING TO:** 
 Head – FP\&A
 



**TYPE OF ROLE:** 
 Individual Contributor Role
 



**LOCATION:** 
 Prabhadevi, Mumbai.
 



**BU/ DIVISION:** 
 Finance
 



  





**JOB PURPOSE** 




 To be the finance co\-pilot to the Fans and Consumer Lighting business — owning the business P\&L, driving profitable growth through disciplined investment decisions, portfolio and pricing management, innovation governance and marketing ROI, so that every rupee invested behind the portfolio creates long term value.
 



  





**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES** 




**1\.** 
**Business P\&L ownership** 



* Own the Fans and Consumer Lighting P\&L end to end — from gross sales to business contribution and business EBITDA.
* Act as the single finance point of accountability for the portfolio; co\-sign every commercial decision that moves the P\&L.
* Publish a monthly business performance review with drivers, risks and corrective actions — not just numbers.



**2\. Rolling forecasts \& AOP** 



* Build and maintain a rolling 12\-month forecast for volume, revenue, margin and A\&P at business and category level.
* Lead the Annual Operating Plan for Fans and Consumer Lighting — bottom\-up build by category, channel and SKU.
* Flag forecast\-to\-actual gaps early with a quantified bridge and a recovery plan agreed with the business.



**3\. Margin by SKU \& category P\&L** 



* Maintain SKU\-level gross margin, contribution and profitability rankings; refresh with every cost or price change.
* Build product category P\&Ls (Fans, Consumer Lighting, Lamps, Luminaires, Decorative and Functional Lighting, etc.) with fully allocated costs.
* Identify and drive margin\-accretive mix shifts; escalate loss\-making and sub\-threshold SKUs with an exit or fix plan.



**4\. Variance** 



* Deliver disciplined price–volume–mix–cost (PVM) bridges versus AOP, forecast and prior year at business and category level.
* Explain the business reason behind every variance — category mix, channel mix, promo intensity, input cost, operating leverage.
* Convert variance insight into named actions with owners and timelines; track closure to completion.



**5\.** 
**Pricing \& revenue growth management** 



* Partner on MOP/MRP architecture, price laddering and premiumization across the Fans and Consumer Lighting portfolio.
* Evaluate price elasticity, competitive positioning versus peers, and the price–pack architecture (PPA) opportunity.
* Govern trade schemes, discounts and gross\-to\-net leakage; quantify the ROI of every scheme before and after launch.



**6\. PPA \& premiumization** 



* Lead price–pack architecture work — identify white spaces, entry price points and premium tiers by channel.
* Model the margin and mix impact of PPA interventions and track realization against the approved business case.
* Support portfolio simplification and SKU rationalization to reduce complexity, working capital, and supply chain cost.



**7\. A\&P investment \& marketing ROI** 



* Own planning, tracking and governance of Fans and Consumer Lighting A\&P spend — media, digital, e\-commerce, activation and visibility.
* Measure ROI on media, consumer promotions and platform spends; recommend reallocation towards the highest\-return levers.
* Ensure spends follow the DOA process and stay within the approved plan; no unbudgeted commitments.



**8\.** 
**Innovation \& NPD finance** 



* Build and challenge business cases for new launches — costing, pricing, payback, breakeven volumes and cannibalization.
* Prioritize the innovation pipeline on the basis of value creation, not activity.
* Conduct post\-launch reviews at 6 and 12 months; report benefit realisation versus the approved case.



**9\. Channel \& customer profitability** 



* Track profitability by channel — general trade, modern trade, e\-commerce, quick commerce and alternate — and by key account.
* Quantify the true cost to serve, including placement fees, returns, damages and platform commissions.
* Support channel mix decisions that protect category margins while defending share.



**10\. Controls, working capital \& governance** 



* Ensure the integrity of business financials — provisions, rebates, claims, price protection and inventory valuation.
* Partner supply chain on inventory health, ageing, non\-moving stock and working capital release for the business.
* Uphold internal financial controls, the RACM and statutory/audit requirements within the business commercial processes.



  





**EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS** 



* Chartered Accountant / MBA (Finance) from a reputed institute. CMA with strong commercial exposure will also be considered.



  





**WORK EXPERIENCE** 



* 6\-10 years post\-qualification, with at least 2 years in category or commercial finance in consumer durables, FMEG, electricals, fans, lighting, FMCG or appliances.



  





**PREFERRED/ ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENT** 



* Strong costing and margin analytics
* PVM bridging
* Price elasticity and scenario modelling
* Advanced Excel and financial modelling
* SAP (FI/CO, COPA), Power BI or equivalent visualization, planning tools such as Anaplan / TM1 / SAP BPC. Familiarity with e\-commerce and secondary sales data platforms is an advantage.
